defEn: the sister of your mother or father, or your uncle's wife
defUz: ota yoki onaning singlisi, yoki amaki/tog'aning xotini

examples.en: We only have one aunt
examples.uz: my mum's sister. – Bizning bor yo'g'i birgina xolamiz bor–oyimning
examples.grammar: 'We have + son' tuzilishi - Present Simple zamonida egalik (bizda bor) ma'nosini bildiradi; 'only one' - 'faqat bitta' deb cheklovni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: My aunt lives near us, so she visits every weekend.
examples.uz: Xolam biznikiga yaqin yashaydi, shuning uchun u har dam olish kunlari keladi.
examples.grammar: Ikki sodda gap 'so' bog'lovchisi bilan bog'langan - sabab-natijani ko'rsatadi; ikkala fe'l ham Present Simple.

defEn: the friend who is closest and most important to you
defUz: siz uchun eng yaqin va eng muhim do'st

examples.en: I met my best friend when we were five.
examples.uz: Men eng yaxshi do'stimni 5 yoshligimizda
examples.grammar: Asosiy gap Past Simple ('met'), 'when' ergash gapi vaqtni bildiradi va 'we were five' - Past Simple 'be' fe'li bilan yoshni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: My best friend always helps me when I have a problem.
examples.uz: Eng yaxshi do'stim muammoga duch kelganimda har doim menga yordam beradi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple ('helps') va 'always' ravishi odatiy harakatni bildiradi; 'when' ergash gapi shartni ko'rsatadi.

defEn: the child of your aunt or uncle
defUz: amaki, tog'a, xola yoki ammaning farzandi

examples.en: My aunt's children are my cousins.
examples.uz: Xolamning farzandlari mening xolavachchalarimdir.
examples.grammar: 'My aunt's children' - egalik qo'shimchasi ('s) bilan tegishlilik bildiriladi; gap Present Simple 'are' bilan tuzilgan va 'my cousins' - ko'plik kesim.

examples.en: My cousin and I play football together every Sunday.
examples.uz: Amakivachcham bilan men har yakshanba birga futbol o'ynaymiz.
examples.grammar: 'and' bog'lovchisi ikki egani bog'laydi; Present Simple ('play') va vaqt ifodasi 'every Sunday' odatiy harakatni ko'rsatadi.

defEn: hair that has natural curls and is not straight
defUz: tabiiy jingalakli, tekis bo'lmagan soch

examples.en: Her sister has curly hair, but hers is straight.
examples.uz: Uning singlisining sochi jingalak, lekin o'ziniki silliq.
examples.grammar: 'has + curly hair' - Present Simple ('has') egalikni bildiradi; 'but' bog'lovchisi qarama-qarshilikni, 'hers' egalik olmoshi 'her hair'ni almashtiradi.

examples.en: My little sister has beautiful curly hair like our mum.
examples.uz: Kichkina singlimning oyimnikiga o'xshagan chiroyli jingalak sochi bor.
examples.grammar: Present Simple ('has') egalikni bildiradi; 'like our mum' - 'like' predlogi o'xshashlikni ko'rsatadi.

defEn: hair that has had its colour changed with a special product
defUz: maxsus vosita bilan rangi o'zgartirilgan soch

examples.en: Look at that boy's dyed hair
examples.uz: it's red and green! – Anavi bolaning bo'yalgan sochiga qarang–qizil
examples.grammar: 'Look at + ot' - buyruq gap (imperativ); 'that boy's dyed hair' - 'that' ko'rsatish olmoshi va ('s) egalik qo'shimchasi bilan tegishlilikni bildiradi.

examples.en: She has dyed hair now because she wanted a new look.
examples.uz: U endi bo'yalgan sochli, chunki yangi ko'rinish xohlagan edi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple ('has') va 'because' bog'lovchisi sababni bildiradi; ergash gapda Past Simple ('wanted').

defEn: hair that is not curly and falls in a straight line
defUz: jingalak bo'lmagan, tekis tushadigan soch

examples.en: Anne has straight hair, not curly hair!
examples.uz: Anning sochi silliq, zinhor jingalak emas!
examples.grammar: Present Simple ('has') egalikni bildiradi; 'not curly hair' - inkor ifodasi bo'lib, qarama-qarshilikni ta'kidlaydi.

examples.en: I want straight hair, but mine is very curly.
examples.uz: Men silliq soch xohlayman, lekin meniki juda jingalak.
examples.grammar: 'but' bog'lovchisi qarama-qarshilikni bildiradi; 'mine' egalik olmoshi 'my hair'ni almashtiradi.

defEn: hair that is a pale colour, such as blond
defUz: och rangli, masalan, malla soch

examples.en: Your dad and mum have dark hair, but you have light hair.
examples.uz: Otangiz va onangizning sochlari
examples.grammar: Present Simple ('have') egalikni bildiradi; 'but' bog'lovchisi ota-onaning to'q sochi va 'you'ning och sochi orasidagi qarama-qarshilikni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: The baby has light hair, but it may get darker later.
examples.uz: Chaqaloqning sochi och rangli, lekin keyinroq to'qroq bo'lishi mumkin.
examples.grammar: 'but' qarama-qarshilik bog'lovchisi; 'may get' - modal fe'l 'may' kelajakdagi ehtimollikni bildiradi.

defEn: hair that is a deep colour, such as brown or black
defUz: to'q rangli, masalan, jigarrang yoki qora soch

examples.en: My brother has dark hair, but mine is fair.
examples.uz: Akamning sochi to'q rangli, lekin meniki och rangli.
examples.grammar: Present Simple ('has') egalikni bildiradi; 'but mine is fair' - 'mine' egalik olmoshi va qarama-qarshilik bog'lovchisi 'but' ishlatilgan.

examples.en: Most people in my family have dark hair.
examples.uz: Oilamdagi ko'pchilik odamning sochi to'q rangli.
examples.grammar: Present Simple ('have') egalikni bildiradi; 'most people' - ko'plikdagi ega.

defEn: a person's female child
defUz: odamning qiz farzandi

examples.en: They have two sons and one daughter.
examples.uz: Ularning ikki o'g'il va bir qiz farzandi bor.
examples.grammar: Present Simple ('have') egalikni bildiradi; 'two sons and one daughter' - sanoq sonlar bilan ko'plik va birlik ot ishlatilgan.

examples.en: Their daughter is studying English at school.
examples.uz: Ularning qizi maktabda ingliz tilini o'rganmoqda.
examples.grammar: Present Continuous ('is studying') hozir davom etayotgan harakatni bildiradi.

defEn: the child of your son or daughter
defUz: o'g'il yoki qizning farzandi

examples.en: Our son got married, and we'll have a grandchild soon.
examples.uz: O'g'limiz turmush qurdi, va tez orada
examples.grammar: Birinchi qism Past Simple ('got married'), ikkinchi qism Future ('we'll have') - 'will' bilan kelajakdagi harakatni bildiradi; 'soon' ravishi yaqin vaqtni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: My grandmother plays with her grandchild every day.
examples.uz: Buvim har kuni nabirasi bilan o'ynaydi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple ('plays') va 'every day' odatiy harakatni bildiradi; 'with' predlogi birgalikni ko'rsatadi.

defEn: the daughter of your son or daughter
defUz: o'g'il yoki qizning qiz farzandi

examples.en: The old man looked after his granddaughter every summer.
examples.uz: Qariya har yozda nabira qiziga
examples.grammar: Past Simple ('looked after') o'tgan odatiy harakatni bildiradi; 'every summer' - takrorlanishni ko'rsatuvchi vaqt ifodasi.

examples.en: Their granddaughter sends them a letter every month.
examples.uz: Ularning nabira qizi har oy ularga xat yuboradi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple ('sends') va 'every month' odatiy takroriy harakatni bildiradi.

defEn: the father of your mother or father
defUz: ota yoki onaning otasi

examples.en: Is the grandfather staying with you, your father's father?
examples.uz: Bobo sizlar bilan turibdilarmi,
examples.grammar: 'Is the grandfather staying...?' - Present Continuous so'roq gapi; 'be' fe'li ('is') gap boshiga chiqib savol hosil qiladi.

examples.en: My grandfather tells us stories about his childhood.
examples.uz: Bobom bizga bolaligi haqidagi hikoyalarni aytib beradi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple ('tells') odatiy harakatni bildiradi; 'about' predlogi mavzuni ko'rsatadi.

defEn: the mother of your mother or father
defUz: ota yoki onaning onasi

examples.en: Their grandmother taught them to swim.
examples.uz: Ularning buvisi ularga suzishni o'rgatgan.
examples.grammar: Past Simple ('taught') o'tgan harakatni bildiradi; 'to swim' - infinitiv bo'lib, nimaga o'rgatganini ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: My grandmother makes the best soup in the world.
examples.uz: Buvim dunyodagi eng mazali sho'rvani pishiradi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple ('makes'); 'the best' - sifatning orttirma darajasi 'the' artikli bilan.

uz: yoki bobo yoki buvi, ulardan biri tushuniladi
defEn: the parent of your mother or father
defUz: ota yoki onaning ota-onasi

examples.en: My grandparents are coming to stay at Christmas.
examples.uz: Bobom bilan buvim Rojdestvoda biznikida
examples.grammar: Present Continuous ('are coming') yaqin kelajakdagi rejani bildiradi; 'at Christmas' - 'at' predlogi bilan vaqtni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: My grandparents live in a small village in the mountains.
examples.uz: Bobom bilan buvim tog'dagi kichik qishloqda yashashadi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple ('live'); 'in' predlogi joyni bildiradi; 'grandparents' - ko'plik shakl.

defEn: the son of your son or daughter
defUz: o'g'il yoki qizning o'g'il farzandi

examples.en: Their son is having a boy
examples.uz: their first grandson! – Ularning o'g'li o'g'il farzandlik bo'lyapti–bu
examples.grammar: 'is having a boy' - Present Continuous yaqin kelajakdagi rejani (tug'ilishni) bildiradi; 'a boy' - 'a' artikli bilan noaniq ot.

examples.en: Their grandson is only two years old.
examples.uz: Ularning nabirasi hali bor-yo'g'i ikki yoshda.
examples.grammar: Present Simple ('is') yoshni bildiradi; 'two years old' - yoshni ifodalovchi qurilma.

defEn: the man that a woman is married to
defUz: ayol turmush qurgan erkak

examples.en: Where did you and your husband get married?
examples.uz: Siz va eringiz qayerda turmush qurgansizlar?
examples.grammar: Past Simple so'roq gap: 'did + you + get married' tuzilishi o'tgan zamonda savol hosil qiladi; 'where' so'roq so'zi joyni so'raydi.

examples.en: Her husband cooks dinner every evening.
examples.uz: Uning eri har oqshom kechki ovqat pishiradi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple ('cooks') va 'every evening' odatiy harakatni bildiradi.

defEn: a person who lives near you
defUz: yaqin atrofda yashaydigan odam

examples.en: Peter kicked his ball into the neighbour's garden.
examples.uz: Piter koptogini qo'shnisining bog'iga tepib
examples.grammar: Past Simple ('kicked') o'tgan harakatni bildiradi; 'the neighbour's garden' - ('s) egalik qo'shimchasi tegishlilikni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: Our neighbour often gives us fresh vegetables from her garden.
examples.uz: Qo'shnimiz ko'pincha o'z bog'idan bizga yangi sabzavotlar beradi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple ('gives') va 'often' ravishi odatiy harakatni bildiradi; 'from' predlogi manbani ko'rsatadi.

uz: ota yoki ona, ulardan biri tushuniladi
defEn: a person's mother or father
defUz: odamning otasi yoki onasi

examples.en: Children usually ask their parents for advice.
examples.uz: Bolalar odatda ota-onalaridan maslahat
examples.grammar: Present Simple ('ask') odatiy harakatni bildiradi; 'usually' ravishi takrorlanishni, 'for advice' - 'for' predlogi maqsadni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: My parents always support me in everything I do.
examples.uz: Ota-onam men qiladigan har bir ishda doim qo'llab-quvvatlaydi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple ('support') va 'always' odatiy harakatni bildiradi; 'parents' - ko'plik shakl.

uz: faqatgina xat orqali yozishadigan do'stingiz, odatda real hayotda ko'rishmagansiz chunki u olisda yashaydi
defEn: a person you become friends with by writing letters
defUz: xat yozish orqali do'st bo'lib qolgan odam

examples.en: I write to my pen friend every week.
examples.uz: Men xatdoshimga har hafta xat yozib turaman.
examples.grammar: Present Simple ('write') odatiy harakatni bildiradi; 'every week' takrorlanishni, 'to my pen friend' - 'to' predlogi yo'nalishni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: My pen friend lives in Canada and we have never met.
examples.uz: Xatdoshim Kanadada yashaydi va biz hech qachon uchrashmaganmiz.
examples.grammar: 'and' bog'lovchisi ikki gapni bog'laydi; 'have never met' - Present Perfect inkor shakli tajriba yo'qligini bildiradi.

defEn: more than one person; human beings
defUz: bir nechta odam; insonlar

examples.en: There are many people in the park today.
examples.uz: Bugun parkda odamlar ko'p.
examples.grammar: 'There are + many + people' - ko'plikda mavjudlikni bildiradi; 'people' o'zi ko'plik ot, 'today' - vaqt ravishi.

examples.en: Many people enjoy spending time with their family.
examples.uz: Ko'p odamlar oilasi bilan vaqt o'tkazishni yoqtiradi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple ('enjoy'); 'spending' - gerundiy fe'ldan keyin keladi.

defEn: something that you do not tell other people
defUz: boshqalarga aytmaydigan narsa

examples.en: I can tell my best friend all my secrets.
examples.uz: Men eng yaxshi do'stimga barcha sirlarimni ayta
examples.grammar: Present Simple ('can tell') - 'can' modal fe'li imkoniyatni bildiradi; 'all my secrets' - 'all' va egalik olmoshi bilan ko'plik ot.

examples.en: Please keep this secret and do not tell anyone.
examples.uz: Iltimos, bu sirni saqla va hech kimga aytma.
examples.grammar: Buyruq gap (imperativ); 'and' bilan ikki buyruq bog'langan, 'do not tell' - inkor buyruq.

defEn: a person's male child
defUz: odamning o'g'il farzandi

examples.en: John's son is six and his daughter is eight.
examples.uz: Jo'nning o'g'li 6 yoshda, qizi esa 8 da.
examples.grammar: Present Simple ('is') ikki marta yoshni bildiradi; 'and' bog'lovchisi ikki sodda gapni bog'laydi, 'his daughter' - egalik olmoshi.

examples.en: Their son works as a doctor in a big hospital.
examples.uz: Ularning o'g'li katta shifoxonada shifokor bo'lib ishlaydi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple ('works'); 'as a doctor' - 'as' kasbni, 'in' predlogi joyni ko'rsatadi.

defEn: the family name that you share with your relatives
defUz: qarindoshlar bilan umumiy bo'lgan oila nomi

examples.en: I know your first name's Tony, but what's your surname?
examples.uz: Sizning ismingiz To'ni ekanligini
examples.grammar: 'I know...' asosiy gap, 'but what's your surname?' - 'but' bog'lovchisi bilan so'roq gap; ('s) qisqartma 'first name is'ni bildiradi.

examples.en: My surname is hard for English people to say.
examples.uz: Familiyamni inglizlar aytishi qiyin.
examples.grammar: Present Simple ('is'); 'for English people to say' - infinitiv qurilma kimga qiyinligini ko'rsatadi.

defEn: the brother of your mother or father, or your aunt's husband
defUz: ota yoki onaning akasi/ukasi, yoki xola/ammaning eri

examples.en: We only have one uncle
examples.uz: my mum's brother. – Bizning bor yo'g'i birgina tog'amiz bor–oyimning
examples.grammar: 'We have + only one + uncle' - Present Simple egalikni bildiradi; 'only one' cheklovni, 'my mum's brother' - ('s) egalik qo'shimchasini ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: My uncle works abroad and visits us once a year.
examples.uz: Tog'am chet elda ishlaydi va biznikiga yiliga bir marta keladi.
examples.grammar: 'and' bog'lovchisi ikki harakatni bog'laydi; Present Simple ('works', 'visits') odatiy harakatni bildiradi.

defEn: the woman that a man is married to
defUz: erkak turmush qurgan ayol

examples.en: Michael's wife Judy works and he looks after their kids.
examples.uz: Mayklning xotini Jyudi ishlaydi va
examples.grammar: Present Simple ('works', 'looks after') odatiy harakatni bildiradi; 'and' bog'lovchisi ikki gapni, 'their kids' - egalik olmoshini ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: His wife teaches music at the local school.
examples.uz: Uning xotini mahalliy maktabda musiqa o'qitadi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple ('teaches'); 'at the local school' - 'at' predlogi joyni bildiradi.

defEn: to respect and like someone very much
defUz: kimnidir juda hurmat qilmoq va yoqtirmoq

examples.en: I admire my mum because she is good at her job.
examples.uz: Men oyimga qoyil qolaman chunki u o'z
examples.grammar: Present Simple ('admire') odatiy his-tuyg'uni bildiradi; 'because' bog'lovchisi sababni, 'is good at' - 'at' predlogi qobiliyatni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: I admire my teacher because she is always patient.
examples.uz: O'qituvchimga qoyil qolaman, chunki u har doim sabrli.
examples.grammar: 'because' bog'lovchisi sababni bildiradi; Present Simple ('admire', 'is') doimiy holatni ko'rsatadi.

uz: asabiga tegmoq, jahlini chiqarmoq · g'ashini keltirmoq, jahlini chiqarmoq
defEn: to make someone feel a little angry
defUz: kimnidir biroz jahlini chiqarmoq

examples.en: It annoys me when my brother takes my toys.
examples.uz: Akam mening o'yinchoqlarimni olishlari
examples.grammar: 'It annoys me when...' - Present Simple ('annoys') va 'when' ergash gapi bilan qaysi holat bezovta qilishini bildiradi.

examples.en: Loud music annoys me when I am trying to study.
examples.uz: O'qishga harakat qilayotganimda baland musiqa asabimga tegadi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple ('annoys'); 'when' ergash gapida Present Continuous ('am trying') davom etayotgan harakatni bildiradi.

examples.en: Your behaviour is annoying me, so stop it.
examples.uz: Sizning xatti-harakatingiz meni g'ashimni keltiryapti,
examples.grammar: 'Your behaviour is annoying me, so stop it' - Present Continuous ('is annoying'); 'so' bog'lovchisidan keyin buyruq gap ('stop it') keladi.

examples.en: It really annoys me when people drop litter on the street.
examples.uz: Odamlar ko'chaga chiqindi tashlaganda meni juda g'ashim keladi.
examples.grammar: 'annoys' - Present Simple, ega ('it') birlik bo'lgani uchun '-s'; 'when ...' vaqt ergash gapi.

defEn: to disagree with someone, often in an angry way
defUz: kimdir bilan, ko'pincha jahl bilan, tortishmoq

examples.en: I'm upset because I argued with my friend.
examples.uz: Men xafaman chunki do'stim bilan tortishib qoldim.
examples.grammar: 'I'm upset' Present Simple holat, 'because' bog'lovchisi sababni; 'argued with' - Past Simple va 'with' predlogi kim bilan tortishganini ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: My sisters often argue about which film to watch.
examples.uz: Singillarim qaysi filmni ko'rish haqida ko'pincha tortishishadi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple ('argue') va 'often' odatiy harakatni bildiradi; 'about' predlogi mavzuni ko'rsatadi.

defEn: to think that something is true
defUz: biror narsani rost deb o'ylamoq

examples.en: He says his dad's a footballer, but I don't believe him.
examples.uz: Uning aytishicha uning dadasi futbolchi
examples.grammar: 'He says...' Present Simple, 'but I don't believe him' - 'don't' bilan Present Simple inkor; ('s) qisqartma 'dad is'ni bildiradi.

examples.en: I believe that hard work brings success.
examples.uz: Men mehnat muvaffaqiyat keltiradi deb ishonaman.
examples.grammar: Present Simple ('believe', 'brings'); 'that' ergash gapni boshlab fikr mazmunini bildiradi.

defEn: to talk in a friendly and informal way
defUz: do'stona va erkin tarzda gaplashmoq

examples.en: He chats with his friends about football.
examples.uz: U do'stlari bilan futbol to'g'risida suhbatlashadi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple ('chats') odatiy harakatni bildiradi; 'with his friends' - 'with' predlogi birgalikni, 'about football' - 'about' predlogi mavzuni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: We often chat on the phone for hours.
examples.uz: Biz ko'pincha telefonda soatlab suhbatlashamiz.
examples.grammar: Present Simple ('chat') va 'often' odatiy harakatni bildiradi; 'on the phone' - 'on' predlogi vositani ko'rsatadi.

defEn: to argue or hurt each other angrily
defUz: jahl bilan tortishmoq yoki bir-birini xafa qilmoq

examples.en: Don't fight with your brother. Try to be friendly.
examples.uz: Ukangiz bilan urushmang. Do'stona
examples.grammar: 'Don't fight...' - inkor buyruq gap (imperativ); 'Try to be friendly' - 'try to' + infinitiv maslahat berishni bildiradi.

examples.en: The two boys started to fight over the toy.
examples.uz: Ikki bola o'yinchoq ustida urusha boshlashdi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple ('started'); 'to fight' - infinitiv, 'over' predlogi sababni ko'rsatadi.

defEn: to feel sad because someone is not with you
defUz: kimdir yoningizda bo'lmagani uchun qayg'urmoq

examples.en: I miss my friends during the summer holidays.
examples.uz: Yozgi ta'til davomida men do'stlarimni
examples.grammar: Present Simple ('miss') doimiy his-tuyg'uni bildiradi; 'during the summer holidays' - 'during' predlogi vaqt davomiyligini ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: I miss my grandmother because she lives far away.
examples.uz: Buvimni sog'inaman, chunki u uzoqda yashaydi.
examples.grammar: 'because' bog'lovchisi sababni bildiradi; Present Simple ('miss', 'lives') doimiy holatni ko'rsatadi.

defEn: to like one thing more than another
defUz: bir narsani boshqasidan ko'ra ko'proq yoqtirmoq

examples.en: I prefer pizza to hamburgers.
examples.uz: Men gamburgerdan ko'ra pitsani afzal ko'raman.
examples.grammar: Present Simple ('prefer') doimiy xohishni bildiradi; 'prefer A to B' qurilmasi 'to' predlogi bilan afzallikni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: I prefer staying at home to going out in winter.
examples.uz: Qishda men tashqariga chiqishdan ko'ra uyda qolishni afzal ko'raman.
examples.grammar: 'prefer ...ing to ...ing' qurilmasi gerundiy bilan ishlatilgan; 'to' predlogi afzallikni bildiradi.

defEn: to understand something for the first time
defUz: biror narsani birinchi marta anglab yetmoq

examples.en: Do you realise how important this exam is?
examples.uz: Bu imtihon qanchalar muhim ekanligini
examples.grammar: 'Do you realise...?' - Present Simple so'roq gap, 'do' yordamchi fe'li bilan; 'how important this exam is' - bilvosita so'roq qurilmasi.

examples.en: I did not realise how late it was until I looked at the clock.
examples.uz: Soatga qaragunimcha qanchalik kech bo'lganini anglamabman.
examples.grammar: Past Simple inkor ('did not realise'); 'until' bog'lovchisi vaqt chegarasini bildiradi.

defEn: to give part of something to other people
defUz: biror narsaning bir qismini boshqalarga bermoq

examples.en: Share your chips with your brother!
examples.uz: Chipslaringizni ukangiz bilan birga baham ko'ring!
examples.grammar: 'Share...!' - buyruq gap (imperativ); 'with your brother' - 'with' predlogi kim bilan bo'lishishni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: Good friends always share their problems with each other.
examples.uz: Yaxshi do'stlar muammolarini har doim bir-biri bilan bo'lishadi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple ('share') va 'always' odatiy harakatni bildiradi; 'with each other' o'zaro munosabatni ko'rsatadi.

defEn: to move your hand to say hello or goodbye
defUz: salom yoki xayr deyish uchun qo'lni silkitmoq

examples.en: As we were leaving, we waved goodbye.
examples.uz: Jo'nab ketar ekanmiz, qo'l silkitib xayrlashdik.
examples.grammar: 'As we were leaving' - 'as' bog'lovchisi va Past Continuous ('were leaving') davom etayotgan harakatni; asosiy gap Past Simple ('waved').

examples.en: The children waved at the train as it passed by.
examples.uz: Poyezd o'tib ketayotganda bolalar unga qo'l silkitishdi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple ('waved'); 'as' bog'lovchisi bilan vaqt ergash gapi, 'at' predlogi yo'nalishni bildiradi.

defEn: to want to know something or think about it
defUz: biror narsani bilishni xohlamoq yoki o'ylamoq

examples.en: I wonder why Aunt Judy didn't visit this year.
examples.uz: Jyudi xola bu yil nega kelmadi ekan-a?
examples.grammar: 'I wonder why...' - Present Simple va 'why' bilan bilvosita so'roq qurilmasi; ergash gapda Past Simple ('didn't visit') inkor shakli.

examples.en: I wonder what my friends are doing right now.
examples.uz: Do'stlarim hozir nima qilishayotgani qiziq.
examples.grammar: Present Simple ('wonder'); 'what' bilan bilvosita so'roq, ergash gapda Present Continuous ('are doing').

defEn: to look after and educate a child until they grow up
defUz: bolani voyaga yetguncha parvarishlamoq va tarbiyalamoq

examples.en: My parents worked, so my grandma brought me up.
examples.uz: Ota-onam ishlashardi, shuning uchun
examples.grammar: Past Simple ('worked', 'brought up') o'tgan harakatni bildiradi; 'so' bog'lovchisi natijani, 'bring up' - phrasal fe'l tarbiyalashni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: My grandparents brought up six children in a small house.
examples.uz: Bobom bilan buvim kichik bir uyda olti farzandni tarbiyalashgan.
examples.grammar: Past Simple ('brought up') phrasal fe'l o'tgan harakatni bildiradi; 'in' predlogi joyni ko'rsatadi.

uz: (biron kim bilan) yaxshi munsobatda bo'lmoq/chiqisha olmaslik
defEn: to have a good or bad relationship with someone
defUz: kimdir bilan yaxshi yoki yomon munosabatda bo'lmoq

examples.en: I get on well with my sister
examples.uz: we have a great relationship. – Men singlim bilan yaxshi
examples.grammar: 'get on well with' phrasal fe'l Present Simple ('get on') munosabatni bildiradi; 'with my sister' - 'with' predlogi kim bilanligini ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: I get on well with all of my classmates.
examples.uz: Sinfdoshlarimning hammasi bilan yaxshi chiqishaman.
examples.grammar: Present Simple ('get on') phrasal fe'l; 'with' predlogi munosabatni, 'all of my' miqdorni bildiradi.

defEn: to happen
defUz: sodir bo'lmoq, ro'y bermoq

examples.en: There's a lot of noise next door
examples.uz: I wonder what's going on? – Yon qo'shnimiznikida rosa shovqin
examples.grammar: 'There's a lot of noise' - 'there is' mavjudlikni bildiradi; ('s) qisqartma 'there is'ni ko'rsatadi, 'next door' joyni bildiradi.

examples.en: What is going on in the kitchen? It is very noisy.
examples.uz: Oshxonada nima bo'lyapti? U yer juda shovqinli.
examples.grammar: Present Continuous ('is going on') so'roq gap hozir sodir bo'layotganini bildiradi; 'in' predlogi joyni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: The festival goes on for three days.
examples.uz: Bayram uch kun davom etadi.
examples.grammar: 'ot + for + vaqt' - biror narsaning qancha davom etishini bildiradi; go on phrasal fe'l - Present Simple.

examples.en: The show went on for nearly three hours.
examples.uz: Tomosha qariyb uch soat davom etdi.
examples.grammar: 'ot + for + vaqt' - davom etish muddatini bildiradi - Past Simple.

defEn: to become an adult
defUz: kattalashmoq, voyaga yetmoq

examples.en: I grew up in a small town and left the minute I turned 18.
examples.uz: Men kichik bir shaharchada o'sib
examples.grammar: Past Simple ('grew up', 'left') o'tgan harakatni bildiradi; 'the minute I turned 18' - vaqt ergash gapi qachonligini ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: I grew up in a big family with four brothers.
examples.uz: Men to'rt akali katta oilada o'sganman.
examples.grammar: Past Simple ('grew up') phrasal fe'l o'tgan harakatni bildiradi; 'in' va 'with' predloglari joy va birgalikni ko'rsatadi.

defEn: to take care of someone or something
defUz: kimnidir yoki nimanidir parvarish qilmoq

examples.en: Can you look after the baby while I go to the shops?
examples.uz: Men do'konga chiqib ketganimda
examples.grammar: 'Can you look after...?' - 'can' modal fe'li bilan iltimos so'roq gap; 'while I go to the shops' - 'while' bog'lovchisi bir vaqtdalikni bildiradi.

examples.en: My sister looks after our cat when we are away.
examples.uz: Biz uydan ketganimizda mushukimizni opam parvarish qiladi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple ('looks after') phrasal fe'l odatiy harakatni bildiradi; 'when' ergash gapi vaqtni ko'rsatadi.

defEn: to have the same opinion as someone or about something
defUz: kimnidir yoki biror narsani xuddi shunday deb o'ylamoq

examples.en: I agree with Owen that we should go to the cinema.
examples.uz: Men Ovenning fikriga qo'shilaman, kinoga
examples.grammar: Present Simple ('agree') fikrni bildiradi; 'agree with' - 'with' predlogi kimga qo'shilishni, 'that...' ergash gapi sababini ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: I agree with my friend that this book is very interesting.
examples.uz: Do'stimning bu kitob juda qiziqarli degan fikriga qo'shilaman.
examples.grammar: Present Simple ('agree'); 'with' predlogi va 'that' ergash gapi fikr mazmunini bildiradi.

defEn: now; at this time
defUz: hozir; shu vaqtda

examples.en: At present, my sister is at university, but it's her final year.
examples.uz: Hozirgi paytda singlim universitetda,
examples.grammar: 'At present' - vaqt ifodasi gap boshida; asosiy gap Present Simple ('is'), 'but' bog'lovchisi qarama-qarshilikni va ('s) 'it is'ni bildiradi.

examples.en: At present, I am living with my parents in the city.
examples.uz: Hozirgi paytda men ota-onam bilan shaharda yashayapman.
examples.grammar: Present Continuous ('am living') vaqtinchalik holatni bildiradi; 'at present' vaqt ifodasi gap boshida turibdi.

defEn: to be owned by someone
defUz: kimgadir tegishli bo'lmoq

examples.en: Does this phone belong to you or is it Jane's?
examples.uz: Bu telefon sizga tegishlimi yoki u Jeynnikimi?
examples.grammar: 'Does this phone belong to...?' - Present Simple so'roq gap, 'does' yordamchi fe'li bilan; 'or' bog'lovchisi muqobilni, 'Jane's' egalikni bildiradi.

examples.en: These books belong to my older brother.
examples.uz: Bu kitoblar katta akamga tegishli.
examples.grammar: Present Simple ('belong to'); 'to' predlogi egalikni, 'these books' ko'plik egani bildiradi.

defEn: to talk about something with someone
defUz: kimdir bilan biror narsa haqida gaplashmoq

examples.en: I had a discussion with my parents about my future.
examples.uz: Men ota-onam bilan kelajagimni
examples.grammar: Past Simple ('had a discussion') o'tgan harakatni bildiradi; 'with my parents' - 'with' predlogi, 'about my future' - 'about' predlogi mavzuni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: We had a long chat about our school days.
examples.uz: Biz maktab kunlarimiz haqida uzoq suhbatlashdik.
examples.grammar: Past Simple ('had a chat'); 'about' predlogi mavzuni, 'long' sifati suhbat davomiyligini bildiradi.

defEn: to enjoy yourself
defUz: vaqtni yoqimli o'tkazmoq, zavqlanmoq

examples.en: We had a great time at the party
examples.uz: it was so much fun! – Biz ziyofatda ajoyib vaqt o'tkazdik–juda
examples.grammar: Past Simple ('had a great time') o'tgan zavqni bildiradi; 'at the party' - 'at' predlogi joyni, ('s) 'it was'ni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: We had a great time at my cousin's birthday party.
examples.uz: Biz amakivachchamning tug'ilgan kunida ajoyib vaqt o'tkazdik.
examples.grammar: Past Simple ('had a great time'); 'at' predlogi joyni, ('s) egalik qo'shimchasini bildiradi.

defEn: feeling strong romantic love for someone
defUz: kimgadir kuchli ishqiy muhabbat his qilmoq

examples.en: He is still in love with his wife after all these years!
examples.uz: Shuncha yildan so'ng u hali ham xotinini
examples.grammar: Present Simple ('is') holatni bildiradi; 'still' ravishi davom etishni, 'after all these years' - 'after' predlogi vaqtni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: She has been in love with him since they first met.
examples.uz: U bilan birinchi uchrashganidan beri unga oshiq.
examples.grammar: Present Perfect ('has been') o'tmishdan hozirgacha davom etayotgan holatni; 'since' bog'lovchisi boshlanish vaqtini bildiradi.

defEn: to have a similar appearance to someone or something
defUz: kimgadir yoki nimagadir tashqi ko'rinishi bilan o'xshamoq

examples.en: Peter looks like his dad
examples.uz: they both have dark hair and brown eyes. – Piter dadasiga o'xshaydi–
examples.grammar: Present Simple ('looks like') o'xshashlikni bildiradi; 'look like' - 'like' predlogi bilan tashqi o'xshashlikni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: My brother looks like our father when he smiles.
examples.uz: Akam kulganda dadamizga o'xshaydi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple ('looks like'); 'when' ergash gapi vaqtni, 'like' predlogi o'xshashlikni bildiradi.

defEn: to speak about a person or thing
defUz: biror odam yoki narsa haqida gapirmoq

examples.en: Are you talking about the film last night? Wasn't it great!
examples.uz: O'tgan tundagi film haqida
examples.grammar: 'Are you talking about...?' - Present Continuous so'roq gap; 'about' predlogi mavzuni, 'Wasn't it great!' - Past Simple inkor so'roq his-tuyg'uni bildiradi.

examples.en: We often talk about our plans for the future.
examples.uz: Biz ko'pincha kelajak rejalarimiz haqida gaplashamiz.
examples.grammar: Present Simple ('talk about') va 'often' odatiy harakatni bildiradi; 'about' predlogi mavzuni ko'rsatadi.

defEn: to speak to a person
defUz: biror odam bilan gaplashmoq

examples.en: I want to talk to you about your bad behaviour yesterday.
examples.uz: Men kechagi yomon xulqingiz
examples.grammar: 'I want to talk to you' - Present Simple ('want') va 'to talk' infinitiv; 'to you' - 'to' predlogi kim bilanligini, 'about' mavzuni bildiradi.

examples.en: You should talk to your teacher if you have a problem.
examples.uz: Muammoyingiz bo'lsa, o'qituvchingiz bilan gaplashishingiz kerak.
examples.grammar: 'should' modal fe'li maslahatni bildiradi; 'if' bog'lovchisi shartni, 'to' predlogi kim bilanligini ko'rsatadi.

defEn: to have something in your mind
defUz: biror narsa yoki kishi xayolingizda bo'lmoq

examples.en: You're smiling
examples.uz: are you thinking about your holiday? – Siz jilmayyapsiz–ta'tilingiz haqida
examples.grammar: 'You're smiling' Present Continuous, 'are you thinking about...?' - Present Continuous so'roq gap; 'about' predlogi mavzuni bildiradi.

examples.en: I often think about my old friends from school.
examples.uz: Men ko'pincha maktabdagi eski do'stlarim haqida o'ylayman.
examples.grammar: Present Simple ('think about') va 'often' odatiy harakatni bildiradi; 'about' predlogi mavzuni ko'rsatadi.

defEn: very similar to each other
defUz: bir-biriga juda o'xshash

examples.en: She and her dad are very alike. They have the same interests.
examples.uz: U va uning dadasi juda o'xshash.
examples.grammar: Present Simple ('are') holatni bildiradi; 'very' ravishi darajani kuchaytiradi; ikkinchi gap 'have the same' o'xshashlikni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: The two sisters are so alike that people often mix them up.
examples.uz: Ikki opa-singil shu qadar o'xshashki, odamlar ularni ko'pincha adashtirishadi.
examples.grammar: 'so ... that' qurilmasi natijani bildiradi; Present Simple ('are', 'mix up') doimiy holatni ko'rsatadi.

defEn: able to learn and understand things quickly
defUz: narsalarni tez o'rganadigan va tushunadigan

examples.en: Jim's very clever and always gets good marks.
examples.uz: Jim juda aqlli va har doim yaxshi baholar oladi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple ('is', 'gets') doimiy holatni bildiradi; 'very' ravishi darajani, 'always' takrorlanishni, 'and' bog'lovchisi ikki gapni bog'laydi.

examples.en: My clever cousin solved the difficult problem very quickly.
examples.uz: Aqlli amakivachcham qiyin masalani juda tez yechdi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple ('solved'); 'clever' sifati otdan oldin, 'very quickly' ravish harakat tarzini bildiradi.

defEn: having an attractive appearance
defUz: tashqi ko'rinishi chiroyli, jozibali

examples.en: That film star is really good-looking.
examples.uz: Anavi kino yulduzi juda ham chiroyli.
examples.grammar: Present Simple ('is') holatni bildiradi; 'really' ravishi darajani kuchaytiradi, 'good-looking' - qo'shma sifat tashqi ko'rinishni ta'riflaydi.

examples.en: Her new boyfriend is tall and very good-looking.
examples.uz: Uning yangi yigiti baland bo'yli va juda kelishgan.
examples.grammar: Present Simple ('is'); 'and' bog'lovchisi ikki sifatni bog'laydi, 'very' darajani kuchaytiradi.

defEn: not wanting to work or do anything
defUz: ishlashni yoki biror narsa qilishni xohlamaydigan

examples.en: His dog is so lazy
examples.uz: it sleeps all the time. – Uning iti juda yalqov–u har doim uxlaydi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple ('is') holatni bildiradi; 'so' ravishi darajani kuchaytiradi, ('s) qisqartma 'is'ni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: He is too lazy to clean his room.
examples.uz: U juda yalqov, xonasini tozalashga eringadi.
examples.grammar: 'too ... to' qurilmasi haddan ortiqlik va natijani bildiradi; Present Simple ('is') doimiy holatni ko'rsatadi.

uz: turmush qurgan: uylangan yoki turmushga chiqqan
defEn: having a husband or wife
defUz: eri yoki xotini bor; turmush qurgan

examples.en: Is your brother married to that woman?
examples.uz: Sizning akangiz o'sha ayolga uylanganmi?
examples.grammar: 'Is your brother married to...?' - Present Simple so'roq gap, 'be' fe'li ('is') boshda; 'married to' - 'to' predlogi kimgaligini bildiradi.

examples.en: My sister has been married for ten years.
examples.uz: Opam o'n yildan beri turmush qurgan.
examples.grammar: Present Perfect ('has been married') o'tmishdan hozirgacha davom etayotgan holatni bildiradi; 'for' predlogi davomiylikni ko'rsatadi.

defEn: with no others of the same type
defUz: shu turdagi boshqasi yo'q; yagona

examples.en: John is an only child and wants a brother or sister.
examples.uz: Jo'n yolg'iz farzand va u uka yoki singil
examples.grammar: Present Simple ('is', 'wants') holat va xohishni bildiradi; 'an only child' - 'an' artikli, 'or' bog'lovchisi muqobilni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: She is the only girl in a family of five boys.
examples.uz: U beshta o'g'il bola bor oilada yagona qiz.
examples.grammar: Present Simple ('is'); 'the only' - 'the' artikli bilan yagonalikni, 'in a family of' miqdorni bildiradi.

defEn: weighing more than is healthy
defUz: sog'liq uchun zarur me'yordan ortiq vaznli

examples.en: My uncle is overweight and needs to do more exercise.
examples.uz: Mening tog'am semizlar va ular ko'proq
examples.grammar: Present Simple ('is', 'needs') holat va zaruriyatni bildiradi; 'and' bog'lovchisi ikki gapni, 'to do' infinitiv maqsadni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: The doctor said he was a little overweight.
examples.uz: Shifokor uning biroz ortiqcha vaznli ekanini aytdi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple ('said', 'was'); 'a little' ravishi darajani biroz pasaytiradi.

uz: rangida rang yo'q, rangi oqarib ketgan
defEn: having a light skin colour, often when not well
defUz: rangi och, ko'pincha betobligda oqargan teri rangli

examples.en: Don't stay long in the sun if you have pale skin.
examples.uz: Agar teringizning rangi oqargan bo'lsa,
examples.grammar: 'Don't stay...' - inkor buyruq gap (imperativ); 'if you have pale skin' - 'if' bog'lovchisi shartni bildiradi.

examples.en: You look very pale today. Are you feeling ill?
examples.uz: Bugun rangingiz juda oqargan. O'zingizni yomon his qilyapsizmi?
examples.grammar: Present Simple ('look') va Present Continuous so'roq ('Are you feeling') holatni bildiradi.

defEn: almost the same but not exactly
defUz: deyarli bir xil, lekin aniq emas; o'xshash

examples.en: My sister and I look similar, but have different characters.
examples.uz: Singlim va men o'xshash ko'rinamiz,
examples.grammar: Present Simple ('look', 'have') holatni bildiradi; 'but' bog'lovchisi qarama-qarshilikni, 'different characters' - sifat va ko'plik ot ishlatilgan.

examples.en: Our houses are similar, but ours has a bigger garden.
examples.uz: Uylarimiz o'xshash, lekin biznikida kattaroq bog' bor.
examples.grammar: 'but' qarama-qarshilik bog'lovchisi; 'bigger' - sifatning qiyosiy darajasi, 'ours' egalik olmoshi.

defEn: very thin
defUz: juda ozg'in, oriq

examples.en: I'm very skinny because I was ill.
examples.uz: Men juda oriqman chunki xasta edim.
examples.grammar: Present Simple ('I'm') holatni bildiradi; 'because' bog'lovchisi sababni, ergash gapda Past Simple ('was ill') o'tgan holatni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: The cat was very skinny when we found it on the street.
examples.uz: Mushukni ko'chada topganimizda u juda oriq edi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple ('was', 'found'); 'when' ergash gapi vaqtni bildiradi.

defEn: thin in an attractive way
defUz: yoqimli tarzda ozg'in; xushbichim

examples.en: The model was tall and slim.
examples.uz: Model baland bo'yli va xushbichim edi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple ('was') holatni bildiradi; 'and' bog'lovchisi ikki sifatni ('tall', 'slim') bog'laydi.

examples.en: She stays slim because she eats healthy food.
examples.uz: U sog'lom ovqat yegani uchun xushbichim bo'lib qoladi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple ('stays', 'eats'); 'because' bog'lovchisi sababni bildiradi.

defEn: different from normal and important
defUz: oddiydan farqli va muhim; alohida

examples.en: Your birthday is a special day.
examples.uz: Tug'ilgan kuningiz boshqacha kun.
examples.grammar: Present Simple ('is') holatni bildiradi; 'a special day' - 'a' artikli bilan noaniq ot va 'special' sifati.

examples.en: My grandmother made a special cake for my birthday.
examples.uz: Buvim tug'ilgan kunim uchun alohida tort pishirdi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple ('made'); 'special' sifati otdan oldin, 'for' predlogi maqsadni bildiradi.

defEn: having darker skin from being in the sun
defUz: quyoshda bo'lganidan terisi qoraygan

examples.en: By the end of the beach holiday, we were all tanned.
examples.uz: Plyajdagi ta'tilning oxiriga kelib,
examples.grammar: 'By the end of...' - 'by' predlogi vaqt chegarasini bildiradi; asosiy gap Past Simple ('were tanned') o'tgan holatni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: After the holiday, my whole family looked tanned and happy.
examples.uz: Ta'tildan keyin butun oilam quyoshda toblangan va xursand ko'rinardi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple ('looked'); 'after' predlogi vaqtni, 'and' bog'lovchisi ikki sifatni bog'laydi.

defEn: not fat; having little flesh on the body
defUz: semiz emas; tanasida go'shti kam; ozg'in

examples.en: He's good at basketball because he's tall and thin.
examples.uz: U basketbol o'ynashda usta chunki u baland
examples.grammar: Present Simple ('is') holatni bildiradi; 'because' bog'lovchisi sababni, 'and' ikki sifatni ('tall', 'thin') bog'laydi.

examples.en: This ice is too thin to walk on safely.
examples.uz: Bu muz ustidan xavfsiz yurish uchun juda yupqa.
examples.grammar: 'too ... to' qurilmasi haddan ortiqlik va natijani bildiradi; Present Simple ('is').

defEn: sometimes but not often
defUz: ba'zan, lekin tez-tez emas; gohida

examples.en: We occasionally go to London to see my aunt.
examples.uz: Biz gohi-gohida xolamni ko'rish uchun Londonga
examples.grammar: Present Simple ('go') odatiy harakatni bildiradi; 'occasionally' takrorlanish ravishi, 'to see my aunt' - infinitiv maqsadni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: We occasionally visit our relatives in another city.
examples.uz: Biz boshqa shahardagi qarindoshlarimizni gohida boramiz.
examples.grammar: Present Simple ('visit'); 'occasionally' takrorlanish ravishi, 'in' predlogi joyni bildiradi.

defEn: not often; almost never
defUz: tez-tez emas; deyarli hech qachon; kamdan-kam

examples.en: It rarely snows in the Sahara.
examples.uz: Sahara cho'lida qor kamdan-kam yog'adi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple ('snows') tabiat hodisasini bildiradi; 'rarely' takrorlanish ravishi fe'ldan oldin, 'in the Sahara' - 'in' predlogi joyni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: My grandfather rarely goes out in cold weather.
examples.uz: Bobom sovuq havoda kamdan-kam tashqariga chiqadi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple ('goes out'); 'rarely' takrorlanish ravishi, 'in' predlogi sharoitni bildiradi.

defEn: at the same times often; in a regular way
defUz: muntazam, bir xil vaqtlarda; doimiy ravishda

examples.en: We go to the cinema regularly
examples.uz: about twice a month. – Biz doimiy ravishda kinoga borib
examples.grammar: Present Simple ('go') odatiy harakatni bildiradi; 'regularly' takrorlanish ravishi, 'about twice a month' - takrorlanish chastotasini ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: She calls her parents regularly to ask how they are.
examples.uz: U ota-onasi qanday ekanini so'rash uchun ularga muntazam qo'ng'iroq qiladi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple ('calls'); 'regularly' ravishi, 'to ask' infinitiv maqsadni bildiradi.

defEn: to have the same opinion as someone
defUz: kimningdir fikriga qo'shilmoq

examples.en: I totally agree with you!
examples.uz: Men sizning fikringizga butunlay qo'shilaman!
examples.grammar: Present Simple ('agree') fikrni bildiradi; 'totally' ravishi darajani kuchaytiradi, 'with you' - 'with' predlogi kimga qo'shilishni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: We all agree that this is a good idea.
examples.uz: Hammamiz bu yaxshi fikr ekaniga qo'shilamiz.
examples.grammar: Present Simple ('agree'); 'that' ergash gapi fikr mazmunini, 'all' barchani bildiradi.

defEn: to have a different opinion from someone
defUz: kimdandir farqli fikrda bo'lmoq; qo'shilmaslik

examples.en: My brother says it's the best film ever but I disagree.
examples.uz: Akamning aytishicha, u kinolar ichida eng
examples.grammar: 'My brother says...' Present Simple, 'but I disagree' - 'but' bog'lovchisi qarama-qarshilikni va Present Simple ('disagree') inkor fikrni bildiradi.

examples.en: I disagree with you about this matter.
examples.uz: Men bu masala bo'yicha siz bilan kelisha olmayman.
examples.grammar: Present Simple ('disagree'); 'with' predlogi kim bilan, 'about' mavzuni bildiradi.

defEn: a decision that two or more people make together
defUz: ikki yoki undan ortiq odam birga qabul qilgan qaror; kelishuv

examples.en: Paul has an agreement with his mum to do the dishes every day.
examples.uz: Po'l har kuni idish-tovoqlarni
examples.grammar: Present Simple ('has an agreement') egalikni bildiradi; 'an agreement' - 'an' artikli, 'with his mum' - 'with' predlogi, 'to do' infinitiv maqsadni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: The two friends made an agreement to help each other.
examples.uz: Ikki do'st bir-biriga yordam berish bo'yicha kelishuvga erishdi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple ('made'); 'an agreement' - 'an' artikli bilan ot, 'to help' infinitiv maqsadni bildiradi.

defEn: to say what someone or something is like
defUz: kimdir yoki nimadir qanday ekanini aytib bermoq

examples.en: Can you describe him to me?
examples.uz: Menga uni tasvirlab bera olasizmi?
examples.grammar: 'Can you describe...?' - 'can' modal fe'li bilan iltimos so'roq gap; 'to me' - 'to' predlogi kimgaligini bildiradi.

examples.en: Can you describe your new house to me?
examples.uz: Yangi uyingizni menga tasvirlab bera olasizmi?
examples.grammar: 'can' modal fe'li bilan so'roq gap; 'to me' - 'to' predlogi yo'nalishni bildiradi.

defEn: words that tell you what someone or something is like
defUz: kimdir yoki nimadir qanday ekanini bildiradigan so'zlar; ta'rif

examples.en: Can you give me a description of your sister so I know which girl she is?
examples.uz: Singlingiz qaysi qiz
examples.grammar: 'Can you give me a description...?' - 'can' modal fe'li so'roq gap; 'a description' - 'a' artikli, 'so I know' - 'so' bog'lovchisi maqsadni bildiradi.

examples.en: The police asked for a description of the man.
examples.uz: Politsiya o'sha erkakning ta'rifini so'radi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple ('asked'); 'a description' - 'a' artikli bilan ot, 'for' predlogi maqsadni bildiradi.

defEn: to talk about something with other people
defUz: biror narsani boshqalar bilan gaplashib muhokama qilmoq

examples.en: We need to discuss the situation at home.
examples.uz: Biz holatni uyda muhokama qilishimiz zarur.
examples.grammar: 'We need to discuss...' - Present Simple ('need') va 'to discuss' infinitiv zaruriyatni bildiradi; 'at home' - 'at' predlogi joyni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: We need to discuss our holiday plans this evening.
examples.uz: Bugun oqshom ta'til rejalarimizni muhokama qilishimiz kerak.
examples.grammar: 'need to' + infinitiv ('discuss') zaruriyatni bildiradi; 'this evening' vaqt ifodasi.

defEn: a talk about something with other people
defUz: biror narsa haqida boshqalar bilan gaplashish; muhokama

examples.en: Let's have a discussion about where to go on holiday.
examples.uz: Keling ta'tilda qayerga borishni
examples.grammar: 'Let's have a discussion...' - 'let's' bilan taklif gapi; 'a discussion' - 'a' artikli, 'about where to go' - bilvosita so'roq qurilmasi.

examples.en: We had a long discussion about the new school rules.
examples.uz: Biz maktabning yangi qoidalari haqida uzoq muhokama o'tkazdik.
examples.grammar: Past Simple ('had'); 'a discussion' - 'a' artikli bilan ot, 'about' predlogi mavzuni bildiradi.

defEn: a person you know well and like
defUz: yaxshi bilgan va yoqtiradigan odam; do'st

examples.en: Jane's a friend of the family.
examples.uz: Jeyn oilamiz do'sti.
examples.grammar: Present Simple ('is') holatni bildiradi; 'a friend of the family' - 'a' artikli va 'of' predlogi tegishlilikni, ('s) 'Jane is'ni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: My best friend and I have known each other for years.
examples.uz: Eng yaxshi do'stim bilan bir-birimizni yillar davomida bilamiz.
examples.grammar: Present Perfect ('have known') o'tmishdan hozirgacha davom etgan holatni; 'for years' davomiylikni bildiradi.

defEn: the relationship between friends
defUz: do'stlar o'rtasidagi munosabat; do'stlik

examples.en: My friendship with John began when we were in school together.
examples.uz: Jo'n bilan do'stligim
examples.grammar: Past Simple ('began') o'tgan harakatni bildiradi; 'when we were in school together' - 'when' ergash gapi vaqtni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: Their friendship has lasted for more than twenty years.
examples.uz: Ularning do'stligi yigirma yildan ortiq davom etib kelmoqda.
examples.grammar: Present Perfect ('has lasted') o'tmishdan hozirgacha davom etayotgan holatni; 'for' davomiylikni bildiradi.

defEn: kind and pleasant to other people
defUz: boshqalarga mehribon va yoqimli; do'stona

examples.en: Don't be scared of the dog
examples.uz: it's very friendly. – Itdan qo'rqmang–u juda muloyim.
examples.grammar: 'Don't be scared...' - inkor buyruq gap; 'it's very friendly' - Present Simple ('is'), 'very' ravishi darajani kuchaytiradi.

examples.en: Our new neighbours are very friendly and helpful.
examples.uz: Yangi qo'shnilarimiz juda do'stona va yordam beradigan.
examples.grammar: Present Simple ('are'); 'and' bog'lovchisi ikki sifatni bog'laydi, 'very' darajani kuchaytiradi.

defEn: not kind or pleasant to other people
defUz: boshqalarga mehribon yoki yoqimli emas; qo'rs

examples.en: That boy is very unfriendly
examples.uz: I said hello and he walked away. – Anavi bola juda qo'rs ekan–men
examples.grammar: Present Simple ('is') holatni bildiradi; 'very' ravishi darajani kuchaytiradi, 'un-' old qo'shimchasi inkor ma'no beradi.

examples.en: The shop assistant was very unfriendly and did not smile.
examples.uz: Sotuvchi juda qo'rs edi va jilmaymadi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple ('was', 'did not smile'); 'and' bog'lovchisi ikki gapni bog'laydi.

defEn: feeling pleased and glad
defUz: mamnun va xursand his qilmoq

examples.en: You don't look very happy today.
examples.uz: Siz bugun juda xursand ko'rinmaysiz.
examples.grammar: Present Simple ('look') holatni bildiradi; 'don't look very happy' - 'don't' bilan inkor, 'today' vaqt ravishi.

examples.en: She was very happy to see her old friends again.
examples.uz: U eski do'stlarini yana ko'rganidan juda xursand bo'ldi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple ('was'); 'to see' infinitiv sababni bildiradi, 'very' darajani kuchaytiradi.

defEn: feeling sad
defUz: g'amgin his qilmoq; xafa

examples.en: Your teacher is unhappy with your low mark in the test.
examples.uz: O'qituvchingiz testdagi past
examples.grammar: Present Simple ('is') holatni bildiradi; 'unhappy with' - 'with' predlogi sababini, 'un-' old qo'shimchasi inkor ma'no beradi.

examples.en: He felt unhappy after he lost the football match.
examples.uz: U futbol o'yinida yutqazganidan keyin xafa bo'ldi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple ('felt', 'lost'); 'after' bog'lovchisi vaqt ketma-ketligini bildiradi.

defEn: the feeling of being happy
defUz: xursand bo'lish hissi; baxt

examples.en: The girl smiled with happiness when she saw her present.
examples.uz: Qiz sovg'asini ko'rganda quvonchdan
examples.grammar: Past Simple ('smiled') o'tgan harakatni bildiradi; 'with happiness' - 'with' predlogi sababini, 'when she saw' - vaqt ergash gapini ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: A loving family brings great happiness to everyone.
examples.uz: Mehribon oila hammaga katta baxt keltiradi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple ('brings'); 'to everyone' - 'to' predlogi yo'nalishni, 'great' sifati darajani bildiradi.

defEn: in a happy way
defUz: xursandchilik bilan, baxtli tarzda

examples.en: The children laughed happily as they played in the garden.
examples.uz: Bolalar bog'da o'ynashar ekan,
examples.grammar: Past Simple ('laughed') o'tgan harakatni bildiradi; 'happily' harakat tarzi ravishi, 'as they played' - 'as' bog'lovchisi bir vaqtdalikni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: The children played happily together in the garden.
examples.uz: Bolalar bog'da birga xursandchilik bilan o'ynashdi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple ('played'); 'happily' harakat tarzi ravishi, 'together' va 'in' joyni bildiradi.

defEn: the act of making something easier for someone
defUz: kimgadir biror ishni osonlashtirish; yordam

examples.en: I really appreciate your help.
examples.uz: Yordamingizni rosa qadrlayman.
examples.grammar: Present Simple ('appreciate') his-tuyg'uni bildiradi; 'really' ravishi darajani kuchaytiradi, 'your help' - egalik olmoshi bilan ot.

examples.en: Thank you for all your help with my homework.
examples.uz: Uy vazifam bo'yicha barcha yordamingiz uchun rahmat.
examples.grammar: 'Thank you for' qolipi minnatdorchilikni bildiradi; 'for' predlogi sababini, 'with' yordam mavzusini ko'rsatadi.

defEn: giving help; useful
defUz: yordam beradigan; foydali

examples.en: My aunt was very helpful when I had a problem with maths.
examples.uz: Matematikadan qiynalgan
examples.grammar: Past Simple ('was') holatni bildiradi; 'very' ravishi darajani kuchaytiradi, 'when I had' - vaqt ergash gapi, 'with maths' - mavzuni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: The teacher gave us some very helpful advice.
examples.uz: O'qituvchi bizga juda foydali maslahatlar berdi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple ('gave'); 'helpful' sifati otdan oldin, 'very' darajani kuchaytiradi.

defEn: not giving help; not useful
defUz: yordam bermaydigan; foydasiz

examples.en: The map you drew me was completely unhelpful and I got lost.
examples.uz: Menga chizib bergan
examples.grammar: Past Simple ('was', 'got lost') o'tgan holatni bildiradi; 'completely' ravishi darajani, 'and' bog'lovchisi ikki gapni bog'laydi.

examples.en: His answer was completely unhelpful and confused me even more.
examples.uz: Uning javobi mutlaqo foydasiz bo'ldi va meni yanada chalkashtirdi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple ('was', 'confused'); 'and' bog'lovchisi ikki gapni, 'even more' darajani bildiradi.

defEn: in a way that gives help
defUz: yordam beradigan tarzda

examples.en: Helpfully, John left instructions about how to turn on the computer.
examples.uz: Jo'n yordam berib,
examples.grammar: 'Helpfully' ravishi gap boshida butun gapga baho beradi; asosiy gap Past Simple ('left'); 'about how to turn on' - bilvosita so'roq qurilmasi.

examples.en: She helpfully explained the rules before the game started.
examples.uz: U o'yin boshlanishidan oldin yordam berib, qoidalarni tushuntirdi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple ('explained', 'started'); 'helpfully' harakat tarzi ravishi, 'before' bog'lovchisi vaqtni bildiradi.

defEn: to enjoy or be fond of something
defUz: biror narsadan zavqlanmoq yoki uni yoqtirmoq

examples.en: I personally liked this song a lot.
examples.uz: Shaxsan menga bu qo'shiq rosa yoqdi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple ('liked') o'tgan his-tuyg'uni bildiradi; 'personally' ravishi shaxsiy fikrni, 'a lot' darajani ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: I like to spend my weekends with my family.
examples.uz: Dam olish kunlarimni oilam bilan o'tkazishni yoqtiraman.
examples.grammar: Present Simple ('like'); 'to spend' infinitiv nimani yoqtirishini bildiradi, 'with' predlogi birgalikni ko'rsatadi.

defEn: to not like something
defUz: biror narsani yoqtirmaslik

examples.en: I dislike people telling me what to do
examples.uz: it's so annoying! – Odamlar menga nima qilishim
examples.grammar: Present Simple ('dislike') his-tuyg'uni bildiradi; 'people telling me' - gerundiy qurilmasi nimani yoqtirmasligini, ('s) 'it is'ni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: I dislike waking up early on cold winter mornings.
examples.uz: Sovuq qish tonglarida erta turishni yoqtirmayman.
examples.grammar: Present Simple ('dislike'); 'waking up' gerundiy nimani yoqtirmasligini, 'on' predlogi vaqtni bildiradi.

defEn: a dirty or untidy state
defUz: kir yoki tartibsiz holat

examples.en: The kids made a mess in the bathroom.
examples.uz: Bolalar vannani yoyib tashlashibdi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple ('made a mess') o'tgan harakatni bildiradi; 'a mess' - 'a' artikli, 'in the bathroom' - 'in' predlogi joyni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: Please clean up the mess you made in the kitchen.
examples.uz: Iltimos, oshxonada qilgan tartibsizligingizni yig'ishtiring.
examples.grammar: Buyruq gap (imperativ) 'clean up' phrasal fe'l bilan; 'you made' - aniqlovchi ergash gap.

defEn: dirty or untidy
defUz: kir yoki tartibsiz

examples.en: Your room's very messy. Go and tidy it up.
examples.uz: Xonangiz juda betartib–borib tartibga soling.
examples.grammar: Present Simple ('is') holatni bildiradi; 'very' darajani kuchaytiradi; ikkinchi gap 'Go and tidy it up' - buyruq gap.

examples.en: His desk is always messy and full of papers.
examples.uz: Uning yozuv stoli har doim tartibsiz va qog'ozlarga to'la.
examples.grammar: Present Simple ('is'); 'always' takrorlanishni, 'and' bog'lovchisi ikki sifatni bog'laydi.

defEn: a single human being
defUz: bitta inson; shaxs

examples.en: She's the only person I can talk to about my problems.
examples.uz: U muammolarim to'g'risida gapira
examples.grammar: Present Simple ('can talk') - 'can' modal fe'li imkoniyatni bildiradi; 'the only person' - 'the' artikli, 'about my problems' - mavzuni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: My grandmother is a very kind and gentle person.
examples.uz: Buvim juda mehribon va muloyim inson.
examples.grammar: Present Simple ('is'); 'a ... person' - 'a' artikli bilan ot, 'and' ikki sifatni bog'laydi.

defEn: the qualities that make someone who they are
defUz: odamni o'zi qiladigan xususiyatlar; shaxsiyat

examples.en: Jenny's got a great personality
examples.uz: she's so warm and friendly. – Jenni ajoyib xarakterga ega–u juda
examples.grammar: Present Simple ('has got a personality') egalikni bildiradi; ('s) qisqartma 'has'ni; ikkinchi qism sababni izohlaydi.

examples.en: My sister has a strong and friendly personality.
examples.uz: Opamning kuchli va do'stona xarakteri bor.
examples.grammar: Present Simple ('has'); 'and' bog'lovchisi ikki sifatni bog'laydi, 'a ... personality' - 'a' artikli bilan ot.

defEn: belonging to or about one particular person
defUz: ma'lum bir odamga tegishli yoki u haqida; shaxsiy

examples.en: I never talk to people I don't know about my personal life.
examples.uz: Men hech qachon tanimaydigan
examples.grammar: Present Simple ('talk') odatiy harakatni bildiradi; 'never' inkor takrorlanish ravishi, 'about my personal life' - mavzuni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: She keeps a personal diary about her daily life.
examples.uz: U kundalik hayoti haqida shaxsiy kundalik yuritadi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple ('keeps'); 'personal' sifati otdan oldin, 'about' predlogi mavzuni bildiradi.

defEn: speaking only for yourself
defUz: faqat o'zingiz uchun gapirib; shaxsan

examples.en: Personally, I think you need to find a new job.
examples.uz: Shaxsan men o'ylashimcha, siz yangi ish
examples.grammar: 'Personally' ravishi gap boshida shaxsiy fikrni bildiradi; asosiy gap Present Simple ('think'), 'to find' infinitiv zaruriyatni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: Personally, I prefer tea to coffee in the morning.
examples.uz: Shaxsan men ertalab qahvadan ko'ra choyni afzal ko'raman.
examples.grammar: Present Simple ('prefer'); 'personally' shaxsiy fikr ravishi gap boshida, 'to' afzallikni bildiradi.

defEn: true and not imaginary
defUz: rost va xayoliy emas; haqiqiy

examples.en: Are those real flowers?
examples.uz: Bular haqiqiy gullarmi?
examples.grammar: 'Are those real flowers?' - Present Simple so'roq gap, 'be' fe'li ('are') boshda; 'those' ko'rsatish olmoshi ko'plikni bildiradi.

examples.en: Is that a real diamond or just a copy?
examples.uz: Bu haqiqiy olmosmi yoki shunchaki nusxami?
examples.grammar: Present Simple so'roq gap ('Is'); 'or' bog'lovchisi muqobilni, 'real' sifati otdan oldin keladi.

defEn: seeming strange and not real
defUz: g'alati va haqiqiy emasdek tuyuladigan

examples.en: It feels unreal that I no longer have to go to school.
examples.uz: Bundan buyon maktabga borishga majbur
examples.grammar: 'It feels unreal that...' - Present Simple ('feels') his-tuyg'uni bildiradi; 'that' ergash gapi nima g'alati tuyulishini, 'un-' inkor ma'no beradi.

examples.en: It felt unreal when I won first prize in the competition.
examples.uz: Musobaqada birinchi o'rinni egallaganimda buni haqiqiy emasdek his qildim.
examples.grammar: Past Simple ('felt', 'won'); 'when' ergash gapi vaqtni bildiradi.

defEn: the way things really are
defUz: narsalarning aslida qanday ekani; haqiqat

examples.en: In reality, the actor is very nice, but he always plays bad characters.
examples.uz: Haqiqatda, aktyor juda
examples.grammar: 'In reality' - 'in' predlogi bilan haqiqatni ta'kidlovchi ifoda; asosiy gap Present Simple ('is'), 'but' qarama-qarshilikni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: In reality, learning a language takes a lot of time.
examples.uz: Haqiqatda, tilni o'rganish ko'p vaqt talab qiladi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple ('takes'); 'in reality' ifodasi gap boshida, 'learning' gerundiy egani bildiradi.

defEn: very; truly
defUz: juda; chinakam

examples.en: He looks unfriendly but he's really nice.
examples.uz: U ko'rinishidan do'stona emasdek, lekin u juda ham
examples.grammar: Present Simple ('looks', 'is') holatni bildiradi; 'but' qarama-qarshilikni, 'really' ravishi darajani kuchaytiradi.

examples.en: This book is really interesting and I cannot stop reading it.
examples.uz: Bu kitob juda qiziqarli va men uni o'qishni to'xtata olmayman.
examples.grammar: Present Simple ('is'); 'really' darajani kuchaytiruvchi ravish, 'and' bog'lovchisi ikki gapni bog'laydi.

examples.en: That's a really cool phone! Is it yours?
examples.uz: Bu juda zo'r telefon! Bu siznikimi?
examples.grammar: 'That's a really cool phone! Is it yours?' - 'That is' (= 'That's); 'really' - sifatni kuchaytiruvchi ravish; 'Is it yours?' - 'to be' bilan so'roq gap.

examples.en: This new tablet is really fast and easy to use.
examples.uz: Bu yangi planshet juda tez va ishlatishga oson.
examples.grammar: 'is' - Present Simple; 'really' - sifatni kuchaytiruvchi ravish; 'and' - bog'lovchi; 'to use' - infinitiv.

defEn: to make a place neat and in order
defUz: joyni toza va tartibli qilmoq; yig'ishtirmoq

examples.en: I've tidied the bedroom and the bathroom.
examples.uz: Men yotoqxona hamda vannani yig'ishtirib
examples.grammar: Present Perfect ('I've tidied') yaqinda tugagan harakatni bildiradi; ('ve) qisqartma 'have'ni, 'and' ikki otni bog'laydi.

examples.en: I tidy my room every Saturday morning.
examples.uz: Men har shanba ertalab xonamni yig'ishtiraman.
examples.grammar: Present Simple ('tidy') va 'every Saturday morning' odatiy harakatni bildiradi.

defEn: not neat; in a mess
defUz: tartibli emas; tartibsiz; betartib

examples.en: Why is your bedroom so untidy? Pick up those clothes!
examples.uz: Nima uchun yotoqxonangiz bu qadar
examples.grammar: 'Why is your bedroom so untidy?' - Present Simple so'roq gap, 'why' sababni so'raydi; ikkinchi gap 'Pick up...!' buyruq gap.

examples.en: His bedroom is always untidy with clothes on the floor.
examples.uz: Uning yotoqxonasi har doim betartib, kiyimlar polda yotadi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple ('is'); 'always' takrorlanishni, 'with' predlogi holatni bildiradi.

defEn: in a neat and ordered way
defUz: toza va tartibli tarzda

examples.en: She put her clothes away tidily in the wardrobe.
examples.uz: U kiyimlarini shkafga tartib bilan joyladi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple ('put away') o'tgan harakatni bildiradi; 'tidily' harakat tarzi ravishi, 'in the wardrobe' - 'in' predlogi joyni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: He arranged the books tidily on the shelf.
examples.uz: U kitoblarni javonga tartib bilan terib qo'ydi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple ('arranged'); 'tidily' harakat tarzi ravishi, 'on' predlogi joyni bildiradi.

defEn: in a messy and disordered way
defUz: tartibsiz va betartib tarzda

examples.en: He went to school so untidily dressed that the head teacher sent him home.
examples.uz: U maktabga shu
examples.grammar: 'so untidily ... that' qurilmasi natijani bildiradi; asosiy gap Past Simple ('went', 'sent'), 'untidily' harakat tarzini ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: The papers were thrown untidily all over the desk.
examples.uz: Qog'ozlar stol ustiga betartiblik bilan sochib tashlangan edi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple passiv ('were thrown'); 'untidily' harakat tarzi ravishi, 'all over' joyni bildiradi.

defEn: something that you do, often for fun or interest
defUz: odam, ko'pincha qiziqib yoki zavqlanib qiladigan ish, mashg'ulot

examples.en: Fishing is an activity anyone can do.
examples.uz: Baliq tutish istalgan odam qila oladigan mashg'ulot.
examples.grammar: 'Fishing is an activity (that) anyone can do' - Present Simple, 'is' bog'lovchi fe'l + 'an' artikl + ot; oxirida 'can' modal fe'l bilan ergash gap.

examples.en: Reading is my favourite activity on a rainy day.
examples.uz: O'qish yomg'irli kunda mening eng yoqtirgan mashg'ulotim.
examples.grammar: 'Reading is my favourite activity' - Present Simple, ravishdosh (-ing) ega o'rnida + 'is' + egalik olmoshi 'my' + ot.

defEn: the making of pictures, music or other beautiful things
defUz: rasm, musiqa yoki boshqa go'zal narsalar yaratish; san'at

examples.en: I love all art, but painting most of all.
examples.uz: Men hamma san'at turini sevaman, lekin hammasidan
examples.grammar: 'I love all art, but painting most of all' - Present Simple, 'love' fe'li + 'all' aniqlovchi; 'but' bog'lovchi ikki qismni ulaydi.

examples.en: We study art at school every Tuesday.
examples.uz: Biz maktabda har seshanba kuni san'at o'rganamiz.
examples.grammar: 'We study art every Tuesday' - Present Simple, 'study' fe'li + ot; 'every Tuesday' takrorlanishni bildiruvchi vaqt holi.

examples.en: We learned how to draw faces in Art today.
examples.uz: Biz bugun tasviriy san'at darsida yuz tuzilishini
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'learned'; 'how to draw' - so'roq so'z + infinitiv usulni bildiradi; 'in Art' - predlog fanni bildiradi.

examples.en: I painted a picture of the sea in Art.
examples.uz: Men tasviriy san'at darsida dengiz manzarasini chizdim.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'painted' o'tgan zamonda; 'of the sea' - 'of' predlogi tegishlilikni bildiradi.

defEn: a vehicle with two wheels that you ride by pushing the pedals
defUz: ikkita g'ildiragi bo'lgan, pedal bosib uchiladigan transport vositasi; velosiped

examples.en: Do you ride your bicycle to school?
examples.uz: Maktabga velosipedingizni minib borasizmi?
examples.grammar: 'Do you ride your bicycle to school?' - Present Simple so'roq gap, 'Do' yordamchi fe'l + ega + asosiy fe'l; 'to' predlog yo'nalishni bildiradi.

examples.en: My new bicycle is faster than my old one.
examples.uz: Mening yangi velosipedim eskisidan tezroq.
examples.grammar: 'My bicycle is faster than my old one' - Present Simple, 'faster' qiyosiy daraja + 'than' bog'lovchi solishtirishni bildiradi.

defEn: a device that you use to take photos or films
defUz: rasm yoki video olish uchun ishlatiladigan asbob; fotoapparat

examples.en: Can I take your picture with my new camera?
examples.uz: Yangi fotoapparatim bilan sizni rasmga olsam
examples.grammar: 'Can I take your picture with my new camera?' - 'Can' modal fe'l bilan so'roq gap + ruxsat so'rash; 'with' predlog vositani bildiradi.

examples.en: She bought a small camera for her holiday.
examples.uz: U ta'tili uchun kichik fotoapparat sotib oldi.
examples.grammar: 'She bought a camera' - Past Simple, 'bought' ('buy' fe'lining o'tgan zamoni) + 'a' artikl + sifat + ot.

defEn: a machine that plays music from a CD disc
defUz: CD diskdan musiqa chaladigan asbob; CD pleyer

examples.en: My CD player doesn't play this pop music CD.
examples.uz: Mening CD disk pleyerim bu pop qo'shig'i diskini
examples.grammar: 'My CD player does not play this pop music CD' - Present Simple inkor, 'does not' yordamchi + asosiy fe'l; 'this' ko'rsatish olmoshi.

examples.en: My grandfather still listens to music on an old CD player.
examples.uz: Bobom hali ham eski CD pleyerda musiqa tinglaydi.
examples.grammar: 'He listens to music on a CD player' - Present Simple, 'listen to' iborali fe'l + 'on' predlog vositani bildiradi.

defEn: a place where people go to watch films
defUz: odamlar film tomosha qilish uchun boradigan joy; kinoteatr

examples.en: John went to the cinema to watch a film on Friday.
examples.uz: Jo'n juma kuni kino tomosha qilish uchun
examples.grammar: 'John went to the cinema to watch a film on Friday' - Past Simple, 'went' ('go' fe'lining o'tgan zamoni) + 'to the' predlog va artikl; 'to watch' maqsad infinitivi.

examples.en: There is a new cinema near our house.
examples.uz: Uyimiz yonida yangi kinoteatr bor.
examples.grammar: 'There is a new cinema' - Present Simple, 'There is' birlikda narsa borligini bildiradi + 'a' artikl + sifat + ot.

defEn: a group of people who meet to do an activity they enjoy
defUz: yoqtirgan mashg'ulotni qilish uchun yig'iladigan odamlar guruhi; klub, to'garak

examples.en: My sister is in the chess club and plays every lunchtime.
examples.uz: Singlim shaxmat to'garagida va har
examples.grammar: 'My sister is in the chess club and plays every lunchtime' - Present Simple, 'is in' joylashishni bildiradi + 'and' bog'lovchi ikkinchi fe'lni ulaydi.

examples.en: I joined a book club to make new friends.
examples.uz: Men yangi do'stlar orttirish uchun kitob to'garagiga qo'shildim.
examples.grammar: 'I joined a club to make new friends' - Past Simple, 'joined' o'tgan zamon fe'l + 'to make' maqsad infinitivi.

defEn: an event where people play music for an audience
defUz: odamlar tomoshabinlar oldida musiqa ijro etadigan tadbir; konsert

examples.en: My favourite band gave a concert in my town yesterday.
examples.uz: Mening yoqtirgan guruhim kecha
examples.grammar: 'My favourite band gave a concert in my town yesterday' - Past Simple, 'gave' ('give' fe'lining o'tgan zamoni) + 'a' artikl; 'yesterday' o'tgan vaqt holi.

examples.en: We are going to a rock concert this weekend.
examples.uz: Biz bu dam olish kuni ro'k konsertiga boramiz.
examples.grammar: 'We are going to a concert this weekend' - Present Continuous kelajak rejasi uchun, 'are going to' + 'a' artikl + ot.

defEn: a musical instrument that you hit with your hands or sticks
defUz: qo'l yoki cho'plar bilan urib chalinadigan musiqa asbobi; baraban

examples.en: He plays the drum in the school band.
examples.uz: U maktab guruhida baraban chaladi.
examples.grammar: 'He plays the drum' - Present Simple, 'play' fe'li musiqa asbobi bilan 'the' artikl oladi + ot.

examples.en: The loud drum woke up the whole street.
examples.uz: Baland ovozli baraban butun ko'chani uyg'otib yubordi.
examples.grammar: 'The drum woke up the street' - Past Simple, 'woke up' iborali fe'lning o'tgan zamoni + 'the' artikl.

defEn: a machine that plays films from a DVD disc
defUz: DVD diskdan film chaladigan asbob; DVD pleyer

examples.en: The DVD player is broken so we can't watch the film.
examples.uz: DVD disk pleyer buzilgan, shuning uchun
examples.grammar: 'The DVD player is broken so we cannot watch the film' - Present Simple, 'is broken' passiv shaklli sifat + 'so' bog'lovchi natijani bildiradi.

examples.en: We bought a new DVD player for the living room.
examples.uz: Biz mehmonxona uchun yangi DVD pleyer sotib oldik.
examples.grammar: 'We bought a DVD player' - Past Simple, 'bought' o'tgan zamon fe'l + 'a' artikl + sifat + ot.

defEn: a story shown in moving pictures at a cinema or on TV
defUz: kinoteatr yoki televizorda harakatlanuvchi tasvirlarda ko'rsatiladigan hikoya; kino

examples.en: My favourite kind of film is romantic comedy.
examples.uz: Mening yoqtirgan kino turim romantik komediya.
examples.grammar: 'My favourite kind of film is romantic comedy' - Present Simple, 'is' bog'lovchi fe'l; 'kind of' biror narsaning turini bildiradi.

examples.en: We watched a funny film at home last night.
examples.uz: Biz kecha kechqurun uyda kulgili film ko'rdik.
examples.grammar: 'We watched a film last night' - Past Simple, 'watched' o'tgan zamon fe'l + 'a' artikl + sifat + ot.

defEn: the time when you are not working and can do what you like
defUz: ishlamayotgan va xohlagan ishingizni qila oladigan vaqtingiz; bo'sh vaqt

examples.en: Do you do any sports in your free time?
examples.uz: Bo'sh vaqtingizda qandaydir sport bilan
examples.grammar: 'Do you do any sports in your free time?' - Present Simple so'roq gap, 'Do' yordamchi fe'l + 'any' aniqlovchi; 'in' predlog vaqt ichida ekanini bildiradi.

examples.en: In my free time I like to read books.
examples.uz: Bo'sh vaqtimda men kitob o'qishni yoqtiraman.
examples.grammar: 'In my free time I like to read' - Present Simple, 'in' predlog + egalik olmoshi 'my' + 'like to' + infinitiv.

defEn: a musical instrument with strings that you play with your fingers
defUz: barmoqlar bilan chalinadigan torli musiqa asbobi; gitara

examples.en: My sister plays guitar in a rock band.
examples.uz: Singlim ro'k guruhida gitara chaladi.
examples.grammar: 'My sister plays guitar in a rock band' - Present Simple, 'plays' uchinchi shaxs birlik (-s) + 'in a' predlog va artikl joyni bildiradi.

examples.en: I am learning to play the guitar this year.
examples.uz: Men bu yil gitara chalishni o'rganyapman.
examples.grammar: 'I am learning to play the guitar' - Present Continuous, 'am learning' + 'to play' infinitiv + 'the' artikl.

defEn: a thin book with stories and pictures that comes out every week or month
defUz: har hafta yoki har oy chiqadigan, maqola va rasmlardan iborat yupqa kitob; jurnal

examples.en: Do you know any good fishing magazines I can read?
examples.uz: O'qishim mumkin bo'lgan baliq tutish
examples.grammar: 'Do you know any good fishing magazines (that) I can read?' - Present Simple so'roq gap, 'Do' yordamchi; 'any' ko'plik aniqlovchi + ergash gapda 'can' modal fe'l.

examples.en: She reads a sports magazine every Sunday morning.
examples.uz: U har yakshanba ertalab sport jurnalini o'qiydi.
examples.grammar: 'She reads a magazine every Sunday' - Present Simple, 'reads' uchinchi shaxs birlik (-s) + 'a' artikl + ot.

defEn: a person who belongs to a group or club
defUz: biror guruh yoki klubga mansub odam; a'zo

examples.en: Every member of the club must come to the meeting.
examples.uz: Klubning har bir a'zosi majlisga kelishi
examples.grammar: 'Every member of the club must come to the meeting' - Present Simple, 'Every' birlik aniqlovchi + 'must' majburiyat modal fe'li + asosiy fe'l.

examples.en: She is the youngest member of our team.
examples.uz: U bizning jamoamizning eng yosh a'zosi.
examples.grammar: 'She is the youngest member' - Present Simple, 'the youngest' eng yuqori daraja + ot egalik bilan.

defEn: a small machine that stores and plays music
defUz: musiqani saqlaydigan va chaladigan kichik asbob; MP3 pleyer

examples.en: How many songs have you got on your MP3 player?
examples.uz: MP3 pleyeringizda nechta qo'shiq bor?
examples.grammar: 'How many songs have you got on your MP3 player?' - Present Perfect so'roq gap, 'How many' ko'plik so'rog'i + 'have got' egalikni bildiradi; 'on' predlog.

examples.en: I put my favourite songs on my MP3 player.
examples.uz: Men eng yoqtirgan qo'shiqlarimni MP3 pleyerimga joyladim.
examples.grammar: 'I put my songs on my MP3 player' - Past Simple, 'put' o'tgan zamon fe'l + 'on' predlog + egalik olmoshi 'my'.

defEn: sounds that are made by instruments or voices in a pleasant way
defUz: asboblar yoki ovozlar yordamida yoqimli tarzda yaratilgan tovushlar; musiqa

examples.en: What kind of music do you prefer, pop or rock?
examples.uz: Musiqaning qanday turini afzal ko'rasiz, pop
examples.grammar: 'What kind of music do you prefer, pop or rock?' - Present Simple so'roq gap, 'What kind of' tur so'rog'i + 'do' yordamchi fe'l; 'or' tanlov bog'lovchisi.

examples.en: I listen to music while I do my homework.
examples.uz: Men uy vazifamni qilayotganimda musiqa tinglayman.
examples.grammar: 'I listen to music while I do my homework' - Present Simple, 'while' bog'lovchi bir vaqtda bo'layotgan ish-harakatni bildiradi.

examples.en: We're learning about opera in Music at the moment.
examples.uz: Ayni damda musiqa darsida opera haqida
examples.grammar: Present Continuous - 'are learning' hozir davom etayotgan ishni bildiradi; 'about opera' - 'about' predlogi mavzuni bildiradi.

examples.en: In Music we learned to play the guitar.
examples.uz: Musiqa darsida biz gitara chalishni o'rgandik.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'learned' o'tgan zamonda; 'to play' - infinitiv natijani bildiradi.

defEn: a large musical instrument that you play by pressing black and white keys
defUz: qora va oq tugmalarni bosib chalinadigan katta musiqa asbobi; pianino

examples.en: Joanne plays the piano beautifully.
examples.uz: Jo'an pianinani chiroyli chaladi.
examples.grammar: 'Joanne plays the piano beautifully' - Present Simple, 'plays' + 'the' artikl musiqa asbobi bilan + 'beautifully' ravish fe'lni izohlaydi.

examples.en: My brother learns to play the piano after school.
examples.uz: Akam maktabdan keyin pianino chalishni o'rganadi.
examples.grammar: 'My brother learns to play the piano' - Present Simple, 'learns' uchinchi shaxs birlik (-s) + 'to play' infinitiv + 'the' artikl.

defEn: a machine that shows programmes with pictures and sound
defUz: tasvir va ovoz bilan ko'rsatuvlar namoyish etadigan asbob; televizor

examples.en: Is there any good comedy on TV tonight?
examples.uz: Bugun oqshomda televizorda qandaydir yaxshi
examples.grammar: 'Is there any good comedy on TV tonight?' - Present Simple so'roq gap, 'Is there' borligini so'raydi + 'any' aniqlovchi; 'on' predlog televizorda ekanini bildiradi.

examples.en: We watch the news on TV every evening.
examples.uz: Biz har oqshom televizorda yangiliklarni tomosha qilamiz.
examples.grammar: 'We watch the news on TV every evening' - Present Simple, 'watch' fe'li + 'on TV' predlogli ibora + 'every evening' takror vaqt holi.

defEn: a building where you watch plays performed on a stage
defUz: sahnada qo'yiladigan spektakllarni tomosha qiladigan bino; teatr

examples.en: The actor first performed in the theatre when she was ten.
examples.uz: Aktyor birinchi marta 10 yoshligida
examples.grammar: 'The actor first performed in the theatre when she was ten' - Past Simple, 'performed' o'tgan zamon fe'l + 'when' bog'lovchi vaqt ergash gapini boshlaydi.

examples.en: We saw a wonderful play at the theatre last week.
examples.uz: Biz o'tgan hafta teatrda ajoyib spektakl ko'rdik.
examples.grammar: 'We saw a play at the theatre' - Past Simple, 'saw' ('see' fe'lining o'tgan zamoni) + 'at the' predlog va artikl joyni bildiradi.

defEn: to play a part in a film or play
defUz: filmda yoki spektaklda rol o'ynamoq

examples.en: Who acts in this film?
examples.uz: Bu kinoda kim rol o'ynaydi?
examples.grammar: 'Who acts in this film?' - Present Simple so'roq gap, 'Who' ega so'rog'i + 'acts' uchinchi shaxs birlik (-s); 'in' predlog.

examples.en: She wants to act in a famous film one day.
examples.uz: U bir kun mashhur filmda rol o'ynashni xohlaydi.
examples.grammar: 'She wants to act in a film' - Present Simple, 'wants' + 'to act' infinitiv + 'in' predlog.

defEn: to gather things of the same kind because you like them
defUz: yoqtirganingiz uchun bir xil narsalarni yig'moq, to'plamoq

examples.en: Lee collects coins and has ones from all over the world.
examples.uz: Li tangalar to'playdi va unda butun
examples.grammar: 'Lee collects coins and has ones from all over the world' - Present Simple, 'collects' va 'has' uchinchi shaxs birlik (-s) + 'and' bog'lovchi; 'from' predlog manbani bildiradi.

examples.en: My brother collects old stamps from many countries.
examples.uz: Akam ko'plab mamlakatlardan eski markalar to'playdi.
examples.grammar: 'My brother collects old stamps' - Present Simple, 'collects' uchinchi shaxs birlik (-s) + sifat + ot ko'plikda.

defEn: to move your body to music
defUz: musiqa ostida tanani harakatlantirmoq; raqs tushmoq
