examples.en: Nobody at the party is dancing because they dislike the music.
examples.uz: Bazmdagi hech kim raqs
examples.grammar: 'Nobody at the party is dancing because they dislike the music' - Present Continuous, 'is dancing' hozir bo'layotgan ishni bildiradi + 'because' sabab bog'lovchisi.

examples.en: We danced all night at my friend's wedding.
examples.uz: Biz do'stimning to'yida tun bo'yi raqs tushdik.
examples.grammar: 'We danced all night' - Past Simple, 'danced' o'tgan zamon fe'l (-ed) + 'all night' davomiylikni bildiruvchi vaqt holi.

defEn: to repair something that is broken
defUz: buzilgan narsani ta'mirlamoq, tuzatmoq

examples.en: My dad fixes my bike when it has a problem.
examples.uz: Qachonki velosipedimda muammo bo'lsa, otam
examples.grammar: 'My dad fixes my bike when it has a problem' - Present Simple, 'fixes' uchinchi shaxs birlik (-es) + 'when' bog'lovchi shart-vaqt ergash gapini boshlaydi.

examples.en: Can you fix my old radio for me?
examples.uz: Mening eski radiomni tuzatib bera olasizmi?
examples.grammar: 'Can you fix my radio?' - 'Can' modal fe'l bilan so'roq gap + ega + asosiy fe'l + egalik olmoshi 'my'.

defEn: to get better at something
defUz: biror narsada yaxshilanmoq, mukammallashmoq

examples.en: You can improve at tennis if you practise a lot.
examples.uz: Agar ko'p shug'ullansangiz, tennisda yaxshilana
examples.grammar: 'You can improve at tennis if you practise a lot' - Present Simple, 'can' modal fe'l + 'if' shart mayli ergash gapini boshlaydi; 'at' predlog.

examples.en: Her English improved a lot after the summer course.
examples.uz: Uning ingliz tili yozgi kursdan keyin ancha yaxshilandi.
examples.grammar: 'Her English improved after the course' - Past Simple, 'improved' o'tgan zamon fe'l (-ed) + 'after' predlog vaqtni bildiradi.

examples.en: I hope my French will improve when I go to France.
examples.uz: Umid qilamanki, Fransiyaga borganimda
examples.grammar: 'I hope my French will improve when I go to France' - Present Simple 'hope', asosiy fikrda Future 'will improve'; 'when' vaqt ergash gapi.

examples.en: Doing exercise every day will improve your health.
examples.uz: Har kuni mashq qilish sog'lig'ingizni yaxshilaydi.
examples.grammar: Future 'will improve', 'Doing exercise' gerundiy ega vazifasida; egalik olmoshi 'your'.

defEn: to become a member of a club or group
defUz: klub yoki guruhga a'zo bo'lmoq, qo'shilmoq

examples.en: It costs £10 to join the karate club.
examples.uz: Karate to'garagiga qo'shilish 10 funt sterling turadi.
examples.grammar: 'It costs 10 pounds to join the karate club' - Present Simple, 'costs' uchinchi shaxs birlik (-s) + 'to join' infinitiv maqsadni bildiradi.

examples.en: I want to join the swimming club next month.
examples.uz: Men kelasi oy suzish to'garagiga qo'shilmoqchiman.
examples.grammar: 'I want to join the club' - Present Simple, 'want' fe'li + 'to join' infinitiv + 'the' artikl.

examples.en: You need to join a gym and get fit again.
examples.uz: Siz sport zaliga qo'shilib, yana jismonan tetik holatga
examples.grammar: 'You need to join ... and get fit again' - 'need to' majburiyatni bildiradi; 'and get' ikkinchi maqsadni qo'shadi.

examples.en: I joined a swimming club to get more exercise.
examples.uz: Men ko'proq mashq qilish uchun suzish klubiga qo'shildim.
examples.grammar: Past Simple 'joined', 'to get' maqsadni bildiruvchi infinitiv.

defEn: to act, sing or play music in front of people
defUz: odamlar oldida rol o'ynamoq, kuylamoq yoki musiqa chalmoq; ijro etmoq

examples.en: They performed the play in front of 200 people.
examples.uz: Ular 200 ta odam ko'z oldida spektaklni
examples.grammar: 'They performed the play in front of 200 people' - Past Simple, 'performed' o'tgan zamon fe'l (-ed) + 'in front of' predlogli ibora joyni bildiradi.

examples.en: The students will perform a song at the concert.
examples.uz: O'quvchilar konsertda qo'shiq ijro etishadi.
examples.grammar: 'The students will perform a song' - Future ('will'), 'will' + asosiy fe'l + 'a' artikl + ot.

defEn: to make music with an instrument
defUz: asbob yordamida musiqa chalmoq

examples.en: Can you play any musical instruments?
examples.uz: Qandaydir musiqiy asbobni chala olasizmi?
examples.grammar: 'Can you play any musical instruments?' - 'Can' modal fe'l bilan so'roq gap + ega + asosiy fe'l + 'any' ko'plik aniqlovchi.

examples.en: My friend can play the violin very well.
examples.uz: Do'stim skripkani juda yaxshi chala oladi.
examples.grammar: 'My friend can play the violin' - 'can' modal fe'l + asosiy fe'l + 'the' artikl + 'very well' ravishli ibora.

examples.en: She has played in every game this season.
examples.uz: U ushbu mavsumdagi har bir o'yinda o'ynadi.
examples.grammar: Present Perfect - 'has played' o'tmishdan hozirgacha bo'lgan harakatni bildiradi; 'every game' - 'every' bilan birlik ot; 'this season' - vaqt holi.

examples.en: We play football together in the park after every lesson.
examples.uz: Biz har darsdan keyin bog'da birga futbol o'ynaymiz.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'play' takror harakat; 'after every lesson' - vaqt holi.

defEn: to make music with your voice
defUz: ovoz bilan musiqa yaratmoq, qo'shiq aytmoq; kuylamoq

examples.en: She takes voice lessons to help her sing better.
examples.uz: U yaxshiroq kuylashiga yordam berishi uchun
examples.grammar: 'She takes voice lessons to help her sing better' - Present Simple, 'takes' uchinchi shaxs birlik (-s) + 'to help' infinitiv maqsadni bildiradi; 'better' qiyosiy daraja.

examples.en: The children sing a happy song at school.
examples.uz: Bolalar maktabda quvnoq qo'shiq kuylashadi.
examples.grammar: 'The children sing a song' - Present Simple, 'sing' fe'li ko'plik ega bilan + 'a' artikl + sifat + ot.

defEn: to go to see a person or place
defUz: biror odam yoki joyni ko'rish uchun bormoq; tashrif buyurmoq

examples.en: How often does your aunt from Miami visit you?
examples.uz: Mayamilik xolangiz qanchalik tez-tez siznikiga
examples.grammar: 'How often does your aunt from Miami visit you?' - Present Simple so'roq gap, 'How often' chastota so'rog'i + 'does' yordamchi fe'l + asosiy fe'l.

examples.en: We visit our grandparents every weekend.
examples.uz: Biz har dam olish kuni buvi-bobomiznikiga tashrif buyuramiz.
examples.grammar: 'We visit our grandparents every weekend' - Present Simple, 'visit' fe'li + egalik olmoshi 'our' + 'every weekend' takror vaqt holi.

examples.en: He is planning to visit China later this month.
examples.uz: U bu oyning oxirida Xitoyga tashrif buyurishni
examples.grammar: 'He is planning to visit ... later this month' - Present Continuous reja; 'to visit' - 'plan to + infinitiv' qurilishi; 'later this month' - kelajak vaqt iborasi.

examples.en: We visit our grandparents in the village every summer.
examples.uz: Biz har yoz qishloqdagi buvimiz va bobomiznikiga boramiz.
examples.grammar: 'visit' - Present Simple ko'plikdagi ega; 'in the village' - joy predlogi; 'every summer' - takrorlanishni bildiradi.

defEn: to look at something on television for a time
defUz: televizordagi biror narsaga bir muddat qaramoq; tomosha qilmoq

examples.en: I don't want to watch TV again tonight.
examples.uz: Bugun oqshomda yana televizor tomosha qilishni
examples.grammar: 'I do not want to watch TV again tonight' - Present Simple inkor, 'do not' yordamchi + asosiy fe'l + 'to watch' infinitiv; 'tonight' vaqt holi.

examples.en: We watch a film together every Friday evening.
examples.uz: Biz har juma oqshom birga film tomosha qilamiz.
examples.grammar: 'We watch a film every Friday evening' - Present Simple, 'watch' fe'li + 'a' artikl + ot + takror vaqt holi.

defEn: to put on special clothes to look like someone else
defUz: boshqa birovga o'xshash ko'rinish uchun maxsus kiyim kiymoq

examples.en: I'm dressing up as a rock star for the fancy dress party.
examples.uz: Men maskaradga (= odamlar qiyofani
examples.grammar: 'I am dressing up as a rock star for the fancy dress party' - Present Continuous, 'am dressing up' iborali fe'l + 'as' predlog o'xshatishni bildiradi.

examples.en: The children dressed up as animals for the party.
examples.uz: Bolalar bazm uchun hayvonlar qiyofasida kiyinishdi.
examples.grammar: 'The children dressed up as animals' - Past Simple, 'dressed up' iborali fe'lning o'tgan zamoni + 'as' predlog.

defEn: to leave your home to do something fun, often with friends
defUz: ko'ngil ochish uchun, ko'pincha do'stlar bilan, uydan tashqariga chiqmoq

examples.en: Do you go out with your friends on Friday nights?
examples.uz: Siz juma tunlarida do'stlaringiz bilan
examples.grammar: 'Do you go out with your friends on Friday nights?' - Present Simple so'roq gap, 'Do' yordamchi + iborali fe'l 'go out' + 'with' predlog hamrohlikni bildiradi.

examples.en: We go out for a meal every Saturday.
examples.uz: Biz har shanba ovqatlanish uchun tashqariga chiqamiz.
examples.grammar: 'We go out for a meal every Saturday' - Present Simple, iborali fe'l 'go out' + 'for' predlog maqsadni bildiradi.

defEn: to spend time in a relaxed way, often with friends
defUz: ko'pincha do'stlar bilan bo'sh-bo'sh, hordiq chiqarib vaqt o'tkazmoq

examples.en: The girls spent the day hanging out at the mall.
examples.uz: Qizlar kunni do'konda sarflab o'tkazishdi.
examples.grammar: 'The girls spent the day hanging out at the mall' - Past Simple, 'spent' ('spend' fe'lining o'tgan zamoni) + ravishdosh 'hanging out' tarzni bildiradi.

examples.en: I like to hang out with my cousins at weekends.
examples.uz: Men dam olish kunlari amakivachchalarim bilan vaqt o'tkazishni yoqtiraman.
examples.grammar: 'I like to hang out with my cousins' - Present Simple, 'like to' + iborali fe'l + 'with' predlog hamrohlikni bildiradi.

uz: yalqovlik qilmoq, kam ish qilib ko'p dam olmoq
defEn: to relax and do almost nothing
defUz: dam olib, deyarli hech narsa qilmaslik; yalqovlik qilmoq

examples.en: Ivan just lazed around doing nothing all Sunday.
examples.uz: Ivan butun yakshanba davomida hech narsa
examples.grammar: 'Ivan just lazed around doing nothing all Sunday' - Past Simple, 'lazed around' iborali fe'lning o'tgan zamoni + ravishdosh 'doing' bir vaqtdagi ishni bildiradi.

examples.en: On Sundays I just laze around and read books.

examples.grammar: 'I really enjoyed myself at the pool' - Past Simple, 'enjoyed' o'tgan zamon fe'l (-ed) + 'myself' qaytim olmoshi; 'at' predlog joyni bildiradi.

examples.en: We really enjoyed ourselves at the party last night.

examples.grammar: 'We enjoyed ourselves at the party' - Past Simple, 'enjoyed' o'tgan zamon fe'l + 'ourselves' qaytim olmoshi.

examples.grammar: 'We go horse-riding in the hills' - Present Simple, 'go' fe'li + ravishdosh 'horse-riding' + 'in' predlog joyni bildiradi.

examples.grammar: 'Go skateboarding every weekend and you will soon learn to go really fast' - buyruq gap, 'Go' buyruq fe'li + ravishdosh; 'and' bog'lovchi natijani bildiruvchi qismni ulaydi.

examples.en: My brother and I go skateboarding in the park.
examples.uz: Akam bilan men bog'da skeytbord uchishga boramiz.
examples.grammar: 'My brother and I go skateboarding' - Present Simple, ko'plik ega + 'go' fe'li + ravishdosh (-ing).

examples.en: Let us go to the cinema on Saturday evening.

examples.grammar: 'Let us go to the cinema' - taklif gap, 'Let us' + asosiy fe'l + 'to the' predlog va artikl.

examples.grammar: 'I listen to music before I sleep' - Present Simple, 'listen to' iborali fe'l + 'before' bog'lovchi vaqtni bildiradi.

examples.en: She looked at the photos and smiled.
examples.uz: U suratlarga qaradi va jilmaydi.
examples.grammar: 'She looked at the photos' - Past Simple, 'looked at' iborali fe'lning o'tgan zamoni + 'the' artikl + ot ko'plikda.

defEn: to travel on a bicycle
defUz: velosipedda yurmoq, velosiped uchmoq

examples.grammar: 'Everyone falls off a few times while they are learning to ride a bike' - Present Simple, 'falls off' iborali fe'l + 'while' bog'lovchi bir vaqtda bo'layotgan ishni bildiradi.

examples.grammar: 'I learned to ride a bike when I was six' - Past Simple, 'learned' o'tgan zamon fe'l + 'to ride' infinitiv + 'when' vaqt bog'lovchisi.

examples.grammar: 'My grandmother loves classical music' - Present Simple, 'loves' uchinchi shaxs birlik (-s) + sifat 'classical' otdan oldin keladi.

examples.grammar: 'A great way to get fit is running' - Present Simple, 'A' artikl + sifat 'great' + ot; 'to get fit' infinitiv maqsadni bildiradi.

examples.en: We had a great time at the music festival.
examples.uz: Biz musiqa festivalida ajoyib vaqt o'tkazdik.
examples.grammar: 'We had a great time' - Past Simple, 'had' ('have' fe'lining o'tgan zamoni) + 'a' artikl + sifat + ot.

examples.grammar: 'She listens to pop on the radio' - Present Simple, 'listen to' iborali fe'l + ot 'pop' + 'on' predlog.

examples.grammar: 'We have a weekly meeting' - Present Simple, 'have' fe'li + 'a' artikl + sifat 'weekly' otdan oldin keladi.

examples.grammar: 'camp' - Present Simple, takrorlanuvchi harakat; 'by the river' - joy predlogi 'by'; 'for a week' - davomiylikni bildiradi.

examples.grammar: 'Collecting stamps is a popular hobby' - Present Simple, ravishdosh (-ing) ega o'rnida + 'is' + 'a' artikl + sifat + ot.

defUz: bir xil narsalarni yig'ib saqlaydigan odam; kolleksioner

examples.grammar: 'A serious collector can have coins worth thousands' - Present Simple, 'A' artikl + sifat + ot; 'can' modal fe'l imkoniyatni bildiradi.

examples.en: Her grandson came first in the swimming competition.
examples.uz: Uning nabirasi suzish musobaqasida
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'came first' g'olib chiqishni bildiruvchi ibora; 'in the swimming competition' - 'in' predlogi bilan o'rin holi.

examples.en: There is a big competition at our school next month.
examples.uz: Maktabimizda kelasi oy katta musobaqa bo'ladi.
examples.grammar: 'There is + ot' - birlikda biror narsa borligini bildiradi; 'next month' - kelasi zamonni ko'rsatuvchi vaqt holi.

defEn: wanting very much to win
defUz: g'alaba qozonishni juda istaydigan; raqobatbardosh

examples.en: Roger's very competitive and always wants to win.
examples.uz: Ro'jer juda raqobatbardosh va doim
examples.grammar: 'Roger is very competitive and always wants to win' - Present Simple, 'is' + 'very' kuchaytiruvchi ravish + sifat; 'always' chastota ravishi.

examples.en: My friend is very competitive when we play games.
examples.uz: Do'stim o'yin o'ynaganimizda juda raqobatbardosh.
examples.grammar: 'My friend is very competitive' - Present Simple, 'is' + 'very' kuchaytiruvchi ravish + sifat 'competitive'.

defEn: to do something fun that other people enjoy
defUz: boshqalar zavqlanadigan qiziqarli ish qilmoq; ko'ngil ochmoq

examples.en: She entertained us with stories of her travels.
examples.uz: U sayohatlari haqidagi hikoyalari bilan bizni
examples.grammar: 'She entertained us with stories of her travels' - Past Simple, 'entertained' o'tgan zamon fe'l (-ed) + 'with' predlog vositani bildiradi.

examples.en: The clown entertained the children at the party.
examples.uz: Masxaraboz bazmda bolalarning ko'nglini ochdi.
examples.grammar: 'The clown entertained the children' - Past Simple, 'entertained' o'tgan zamon fe'l + 'the' artikl + ot ko'plikda.

defEn: things like films or music that people enjoy in their free time
defUz: odamlar bo'sh vaqtida zavqlanadigan film yoki musiqa kabi narsalar; o'yin-kulgi

examples.en: What's your favourite form of entertainment? Mine's the cinema.
examples.uz: O'yin-kulgining qaysi turi
examples.grammar: 'What is your favourite form of entertainment? Mine is the cinema' - Present Simple so'roq gap, 'What is' + egalik olmoshi 'your'; 'Mine' egalik olmoshi.

examples.en: Music is my favourite kind of entertainment.
examples.uz: Musiqa mening eng yoqtirgan o'yin-kulgi turim.
examples.grammar: 'Music is my favourite kind of entertainment' - Present Simple, 'is' bog'lovchi fe'l + egalik olmoshi 'my' + ot.

defEn: a person whose job is to make other people have fun
defUz: boshqalarni xursand qilish kasbi bo'lgan odam; qiziqchi

examples.en: We called a children's entertainer to hire him for the birthday party.
examples.uz: Biz tug'ilgan kun bazmi
examples.grammar: 'We called a children is entertainer to hire him for the birthday party' - Past Simple, 'called' o'tgan zamon fe'l + 'to hire' infinitiv maqsadni bildiradi; 'for' predlog.

examples.en: The entertainer made all the children laugh.
examples.uz: Qiziqchi barcha bolalarni kuldirdi.
examples.grammar: 'The entertainer made the children laugh' - Past Simple, 'made' ('make' fe'lining o'tgan zamoni) + ot + asosiy fe'l 'laugh'.

defEn: fun and enjoyable to watch or do
defUz: tomosha qilish yoki bajarish qiziqarli va yoqimli; ko'ngilochar

examples.en: It was an entertaining film that made me laugh quite often.
examples.uz: U meni rosa kuldirgan maroqli film
examples.grammar: 'It was an entertaining film that made me laugh quite often' - Past Simple, 'was' bog'lovchi fe'l + 'an' artikl + sifat + ot; 'that' ergash gapni boshlaydi.

examples.en: The show was very entertaining and we laughed a lot.
examples.uz: Tomosha juda ko'ngilochar edi va biz rosa kuldik.
examples.grammar: 'The show was very entertaining' - Past Simple, 'was' bog'lovchi fe'l + 'very' kuchaytiruvchi ravish + sifat.

defEn: the activity of moving your body to music
defUz: musiqa ostida tanani harakatlantirish mashg'uloti; raqs tushish

examples.en: I like pop music because it's good for dancing.
examples.uz: Menga po'p musiqa yoqadi chunki u raqs tushish
examples.grammar: 'I like pop music because it is good for dancing' - Present Simple, 'like' fe'li + ot; 'for' predlogdan keyin ravishdosh 'dancing' keladi.

examples.en: Dancing is a good way to keep fit.
examples.uz: Raqs tushish jismonan tetik bo'lishning yaxshi usuli.
examples.grammar: 'Dancing is a good way to keep fit' - Present Simple, ravishdosh (-ing) ega o'rnida + 'is' + 'a' artikl + sifat + ot.

defEn: a person who dances, often as a job
defUz: ko'pincha kasb sifatida raqs tushadigan odam; raqqos

examples.en: Kate's sister is a dancer who performs in music videos.
examples.uz: Keytning singlisi musiqiy videolarda
examples.grammar: 'Kate is sister is a dancer who performs in music videos' - Present Simple, 'is' bog'lovchi fe'l + 'a' artikl + ot; 'who' ergash gapni boshlaydi.

examples.en: She is a great dancer and trains every day.
examples.uz: U zo'r raqqos va u har kuni mashq qiladi.
examples.grammar: 'She is a great dancer' - Present Simple, 'is' bog'lovchi fe'l + 'a' artikl + sifat + ot.

defEn: to make a picture with a pen or pencil
defUz: ruchka yoki qalam bilan rasm yasamoq; chizmoq

examples.en: You draw beautifully.
examples.uz: Siz chiroyli rasm chizarkansiz.
examples.grammar: 'You draw beautifully' - Present Simple, ega 'You' + asosiy fe'l 'draw' + 'beautifully' ravish fe'lni izohlaydi.

examples.en: The little boy drew a picture of his house.
examples.uz: Kichkina bola uyining rasmini chizdi.
examples.grammar: 'The boy drew a picture' - Past Simple, 'drew' ('draw' fe'lining o'tgan zamoni) + 'a' artikl + ot.

defEn: a picture made with a pen or pencil
defUz: ruchka yoki qalam bilan yasalgan rasm; chizma

examples.en: The artist did a drawing of me and my dog in pencil.
examples.uz: Musavvir qalam yordamida men va
examples.grammar: 'The artist did a drawing of me and my dog in pencil' - Past Simple, 'did' o'tgan zamon fe'l + 'a' artikl + ot; 'in pencil' vositani bildiradi.

examples.en: She put her drawing on the wall of her room.
examples.uz: U chizmasini xonasining devoriga osib qo'ydi.
examples.grammar: 'She put her drawing on the wall' - Past Simple, 'put' o'tgan zamon fe'l + egalik olmoshi 'her' + ot; 'on' predlog.

defEn: an activity or subject that you enjoy and want to know about
defUz: siz zavqlanadigan va bilishni xohlaydigan mashg'ulot yoki mavzu; qiziqish

examples.en: Her main interests are music and tennis.
examples.uz: Uning asosiy qiziqishlari musiqa va tennisdir.
examples.grammar: 'Her main interests are music and tennis' - Present Simple, egalik olmoshi 'her' + sifat + ot ko'plikda + 'are'; 'and' bog'lovchi.

examples.en: Photography is one of my main interests.
examples.uz: Fotosurat olish mening asosiy qiziqishlarimdan biri.
examples.grammar: 'Photography is one of my interests' - Present Simple, 'is' bog'lovchi fe'l + 'one of' ibora + ot ko'plikda.

defEn: making you want to know more
defUz: ko'proq bilishni xohlatadigan; qiziqarli

examples.en: Tell me more about the book
examples.uz: it's very interesting. – Kitob haqida ko'proq aytib bering–juda
examples.grammar: 'Tell me more about the book, it is very interesting' - buyruq gap, 'Tell' buyruq fe'li + 'about' predlog; ikkinchi qismda 'is' + sifat.

examples.en: I read an interesting book about famous painters.
examples.uz: Men mashhur rassomlar haqida qiziqarli kitob o'qidim.
examples.grammar: 'I read an interesting book' - Past Simple, 'read' fe'li + 'an' artikl + sifat 'interesting' otdan oldin keladi.

defEn: wanting to know more about something
defUz: biror narsa haqida ko'proq bilishni xohlaydigan; qiziqqan

examples.en: Our son is interested in photography, so we bought him a camera.
examples.uz: O'g'limiz fotograflikka
examples.grammar: 'Our son is interested in photography, so we bought him a camera' - Present Simple, 'is interested in' iborasi + 'in' predlog; 'so' bog'lovchi natijani bildiradi.

examples.en: She is interested in classical music and old films.
examples.uz: U mumtoz musiqa va eski filmlarga qiziqadi.
examples.grammar: 'She is interested in music' - Present Simple, 'is interested in' iborasi + 'in' predlog mavzuni bildiradi.

defEn: to make a picture using colours and a brush
defUz: ranglar va mo'yqalam yordamida rasm yasamoq; chizmoq

examples.en: My mother paints well.
examples.uz: Oyim yaxshi rasm chizadilar.
examples.grammar: 'My mother paints well' - Present Simple, egalik olmoshi 'my' + ot + 'paints' uchinchi shaxs birlik (-s) + 'well' ravish.

examples.en: He paints pictures of the sea every summer.
examples.uz: U har yoz dengiz manzaralarini chizadi.
examples.grammar: 'He paints pictures of the sea' - Present Simple, 'paints' uchinchi shaxs birlik (-s) + ot ko'plikda + 'of' predlog.

defEn: a picture made with colours and a brush
defUz: ranglar va mo'yqalam bilan yasalgan rasm; surat

examples.en: There was a colourful painting of some flowers on the wall.
examples.uz: Devorda rang-barang gullar surati
examples.grammar: 'There was a colourful painting of some flowers on the wall' - Past Simple, 'There was' birlikda narsa borligini bildiradi + 'a' artikl + ot; 'on' predlog.

examples.en: We saw a beautiful painting in the gallery.
examples.uz: Biz galereyada chiroyli surat ko'rdik.
examples.grammar: 'We saw a beautiful painting' - Past Simple, 'saw' o'tgan zamon fe'l + 'a' artikl + sifat + ot.

defEn: an artist who makes pictures with paint
defUz: bo'yoq bilan rasm yasaydigan san'atkor; rassom

examples.en: Picasso was probably the greatest painter of the 20th century.
examples.uz: Pikasso 20-asrning eng buyuk
examples.grammar: 'Picasso was probably the greatest painter of the 20th century' - Past Simple, 'was' bog'lovchi fe'l + 'the greatest' eng yuqori daraja + ot; 'of' predlog.

examples.en: The painter sold all of his pictures last year.
examples.uz: Rassom o'tgan yili barcha suratlarini sotdi.
examples.grammar: 'The painter sold all of his pictures' - Past Simple, 'sold' ('sell' fe'lining o'tgan zamoni) + egalik olmoshi 'his' + ot.

defEn: to take a picture of someone or something with a camera
defUz: kamera bilan biror odam yoki narsaning rasmini olmoq

examples.en: He has photographed many other celebrities too.
examples.uz: U boshqa ko'plab mashhurlarni ham rasmga
examples.grammar: 'He has photographed many other celebrities too' - Present Perfect, 'has photographed' yaqin o'tmishdagi tajribani bildiradi + 'many' ko'plik aniqlovchi.

examples.en: She photographed the birds in the park yesterday.
examples.uz: U kecha bog'dagi qushlarni rasmga oldi.
examples.grammar: 'She photographed the birds' - Past Simple, 'photographed' o'tgan zamon fe'l (-ed) + 'the' artikl + ot ko'plikda.

defEn: a person who takes photos, often as a job
defUz: ko'pincha kasb sifatida rasm oladigan odam; fotograf

examples.en: The photographer told us to smile so he could take our picture.
examples.uz: Fotograf bizni rasmga ola olishi
examples.grammar: 'The photographer told us to smile so he could take our picture' - Past Simple, 'told' o'tgan zamon fe'l + 'to smile' infinitiv; 'so' bog'lovchi maqsadni bildiradi.

examples.en: The photographer took many pictures at the wedding.
examples.uz: Fotograf to'yda ko'plab rasmlar oldi.
examples.grammar: 'The photographer took many pictures' - Past Simple, 'took' ('take' fe'lining o'tgan zamoni) + 'many' ko'plik aniqlovchi + ot.

defEn: the art or hobby of taking photos
defUz: rasm olish san'ati yoki hobbisi; fotografiya

examples.en: Photography is a cheap hobby now that there are digital cameras.
examples.uz: Hozirda raqamli kameralar
examples.grammar: 'Photography is a cheap hobby now that there are digital cameras' - Present Simple, ot ega o'rnida + 'is' + 'a' artikl + sifat + ot; 'now that' sabab bog'lovchisi.

examples.en: She studies photography at a college in London.
examples.uz: U Londondagi kollejda fotografiyani o'rganadi.
examples.grammar: 'She studies photography at a college' - Present Simple, 'studies' uchinchi shaxs birlik (-es) + ot; 'at' predlog joyni bildiradi.

defEn: a person who sings, often as a job
defUz: ko'pincha kasb sifatida kuylaydigan odam; qo'shiqchi

examples.en: Their brother is the singer in a rock band.
examples.uz: Ularning akasi ro'k guruhida qo'shiqchi.
examples.grammar: 'Their brother is the singer in a rock band' - Present Simple, egalik olmoshi 'their' + ot + 'is' + 'the' artikl + ot; 'in' predlog.

examples.en: The singer has a wonderful voice.
examples.uz: Qo'shiqchining ajoyib ovozi bor.
examples.grammar: 'The singer has a wonderful voice' - Present Simple, 'has' fe'li + 'a' artikl + sifat + ot.

defEn: a short piece of music with words that you sing
defUz: kuylanadigan, so'zlari bo'lgan qisqa musiqa parchasi; qo'shiq

examples.en: Do you write all the songs for your band?
examples.uz: Guruhingiz uchun barcha qo'shiqlarni o'zingiz
examples.grammar: 'Do you write all the songs for your band?' - Present Simple so'roq gap, 'Do' yordamchi fe'l + 'all the' aniqlovchi + ot ko'plikda; 'for' predlog.

examples.en: This song is very popular among young people.
examples.uz: Bu qo'shiq yoshlar orasida juda mashhur.
examples.grammar: 'This song is very popular' - Present Simple, 'This' ko'rsatish olmoshi + ot + 'is' + 'very' kuchaytiruvchi ravish + sifat.

defEn: A team game where players throw a ball through a high net.
defUz: Ikki jamoa to'pni baland savatga tashlab o'ynaydigan sport o'yini.

examples.en: It's good to be tall if you play basketball.
examples.uz: Agar basketbol o'ynasangiz, baland bo'yli bo'lish
examples.grammar: 'It's good to + infinitiv' - biror ishni bajarish yaxshi ekanini bildiradi; 'if' bilan shart mayli (conditional) ergash gap qo'shilgan.

examples.en: My brother plays basketball every weekend with his friends.
examples.uz: Akam har dam olish kunlari do'stlari bilan basketbol o'ynaydi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'plays' uchinchi shaxs birlikda '-s' qo'shimchasi oladi; 'every weekend' takror harakatni bildiradi.

defEn: The leader of a sports team.
defUz: Sport jamoasining boshlig'i yoki yetakchisi.

examples.en: Joe's the captain of the team, so on the pitch you listen to him.
examples.uz: Jo' jamoa sardori, shunday ekan
examples.grammar: ''s' qisqartmasi 'is' fe'lini bildiradi (Joe's = Joe is); 'so' - bog'lovchi natija ergash gapini ulaydi.

examples.en: Our team captain always helps the new players before a match.
examples.uz: Jamoamiz sardori o'yindan oldin yangi o'yinchilarga doim yordam beradi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'helps' uchinchi shaxs birlikda '-s' oladi; 'always' - takrorlanish ravishi fe'ldan oldin keladi.

defEn: A person who trains a sports team or player.
defUz: Sport jamoasi yoki o'yinchini mashq qildiradigan murabbiy.

examples.en: The coach told me I have to be fitter to get on the team.
examples.uz: Murabbiy menga aytdiki, jamoaga
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'told' (tell fe'lining o'tgan zamoni); 'have to' - majburiyatni bildiruvchi modal ibora.

examples.en: The coach showed us a new way to pass the ball.
examples.uz: Murabbiy bizga to'pni uzatishning yangi usulini ko'rsatdi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'showed' o'tgan zamonda '-ed' qo'shimchasi oladi; 'us' - to'ldiruvchi olmosh.

examples.en: We're going to Manchester by coach since it's cheaper than the train.
examples.uz: Biz Manchesterga
examples.grammar: 'going to + joy + by coach' - Present Continuous kelasi rejani bildiradi; 'since' - sabab ergash gapini bog'laydi; 'cheaper than' - qiyosiy daraja.

examples.en: The coach to London leaves at eight o'clock every morning.
examples.uz: Londonga boradigan turistik avtobus har kuni ertalab soat sakkizda jo'naydi.
examples.grammar: 'leaves' - Present Simple, doimiy harakat; 'to London' - yo'nalishni bildiruvchi predlog; 'every morning' - takrorlanishni bildiradi.

defEn: A person who likes a team or sport very much.
defUz: Biror jamoa yoki sportni juda yaxshi ko'radigan muxlis.

examples.en: He is a huge fan and goes to every game they play.
examples.uz: U ashaddiy muxlis va ular o'ynaydigan har
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'is' va 'goes' fe'llari birlikda; 'and' - bog'lovchi ikki gapni ulaydi.

examples.en: My sister is a big fan of our local football team.
examples.uz: Singlim mahalliy futbol jamoamizning ashaddiy muxlisi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'is' bog'lovchi fe'l; 'a big fan of' - 'of' predlogi bilan kelgan ibora.

defEn: A team game where players kick a ball to score goals.
defUz: O'yinchilar to'pni tepib go'l urishga harakat qiladigan jamoaviy o'yin.

examples.en: Football is the most popular team sport in the world.
examples.uz: Futbol dunyodagi eng mashhur jamoaviy
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'is' bog'lovchi fe'l; 'the most popular' - qiyosiy darajaning orttirma shakli (superlative).

examples.en: We play football in the park after school every day.
examples.uz: Biz har kuni maktabdan keyin bog'da futbol o'ynaymiz.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - takror harakat; 'after school' va 'every day' - vaqt holatlari.

defEn: A point you win when the ball goes into the net.
defUz: To'p darvozaga kirganda qo'lga kiritiladigan ochko, go'l.

examples.en: I scored a goal at the end of the game, so we won 1:0.
examples.uz: Men o'yin yakunida bitta go'l urdim,
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'scored' o'tgan zamonda '-ed' oladi; 'so' - natija bog'lovchisi; 'won' (win fe'lining o'tgan zamoni).

examples.en: He scored the winning goal in the last minute of the game.
examples.uz: U o'yinning so'nggi daqiqasida g'alaba keltiruvchi go'lni urdi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'scored' o'tgan zamon; 'in the last minute' - 'in' predlogi bilan vaqt holi.

defEn: A place with machines where people exercise.
defUz: Odamlar mashqlar qiladigan, jihozlangan sport zali.

examples.en: Sue goes to the gym to build up her muscles after the accident.
examples.uz: Syu halokatdan so'ng
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'goes' uchinchi shaxs birlikda '-s' oladi; 'to build up' - maqsadni bildiruvchi infinitiv; 'after' - vaqt predlogi.

examples.en: I go to the gym three times a week to stay healthy.
examples.uz: Men sog'lom bo'lib qolish uchun haftada uch marta sport zaliga boraman.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'go' takror harakat; 'to stay healthy' - maqsad infinitivi.

defEn: A team game played with sticks and a ball or puck.
defUz: Tayoqcha va to'p yoki shayba bilan o'ynaladigan jamoaviy o'yin.

examples.en: In hockey, you can't raise your stick above the shoulder.
examples.uz: Hakkey o'yinida, tayoqchani yelkadan
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'can't raise' modal fe'l 'can'ning bo'lishsiz shakli; 'above the shoulder' - 'above' predlogi bilan o'rin holi.

examples.en: They watched a hockey game on the ice yesterday.
examples.uz: Ular kecha muz ustida hakkey o'yinini tomosha qilishdi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'watched' o'tgan zamonda '-ed' oladi; 'yesterday' - o'tgan vaqt holi.

defEn: Moving over ice on special boots with blades.
defUz: Tig'li maxsus poyabzalda muz ustida sirpanib yurish.

examples.en: I never go ice skating because I'm scared of slipping over.
examples.uz: Men hech qachon muz ustida
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'never go' takrorlanmaslikni bildiruvchi ravish bilan; ''m scared of + -ing' - 'of' predlogidan keyin fe'l '-ing' shaklida keladi.

examples.en: We went ice skating at the new rink in the city.
examples.uz: Biz shahardagi yangi maydonchada muz ustida konkida uchdik.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'went' (go fe'lining o'tgan zamoni); 'go ice skating' - mashg'ulotni bildiruvchi ibora.

defEn: A person who takes part in a game or sport.
defUz: O'yin yoki sportda qatnashadigan o'yinchi.

examples.en: The best player on the team is Simon and he scores all the goals.
examples.uz: Jamoadagi eng yaxshi o'yinchi
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'is' va 'scores' fe'llari birlikda; 'the best player' - orttirma daraja (superlative); 'and' bog'lovchi.

examples.en: Every player on the team trains hard before a big match.
examples.uz: Jamoadagi har bir o'yinchi katta o'yindan oldin qattiq mashq qiladi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'trains' uchinchi shaxs birlikda '-s' oladi; 'before' - vaqt predlogi.

defEn: Doing something many times to get better at it.
defUz: Biror ishda mohir bo'lish uchun ko'p marta takrorlanadigan mashq.

examples.en: It takes practice to shoot baskets from so far away.
examples.uz: Savatchani bunday uzoqlikdan mo'ljalga
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'It takes practice to + infinitiv' - biror ishni o'rganish uchun mashq kerakligini bildiruvchi tuzilma.

examples.en: With a lot of practice, she became a very good swimmer.
examples.uz: Ko'p mashq tufayli u juda yaxshi suzuvchiga aylandi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'became' (become fe'lining o'tgan zamoni); 'with' - vosita predlogi.

defEn: Something you win for doing very well.
defUz: Biror ishni juda yaxshi bajargani uchun beriladigan sovrin.

examples.en: The winner of the bike race won a prize of £5000.
examples.uz: Velosiped poygasining g'olibi 5000 funt
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'won' (win fe'lining o'tgan zamoni); 'a prize of' - 'of' predlogi bilan miqdor bildiriladi.

examples.en: She won first prize for her drawing at the competition.
examples.uz: U musobaqada rasmi uchun birinchi sovrinni qo'lga kiritdi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'won' o'tgan zamon; 'for her drawing' - 'for' predlogi sababni bildiradi.

defEn: A contest to see who is the fastest.
defUz: Kim eng tez ekanini aniqlash uchun o'tkaziladigan poyga.

examples.en: Ten runners are taking part in this ten-mile race.
examples.uz: Ushbu 10 milya uzunlikdagi poygada o'n nafar
examples.grammar: Present Continuous - 'are taking part' hozir davom etayotgan harakatni bildiradi; 'in this ten-mile race' - 'in' predlogi.

examples.en: He won the race and finished before everyone else.
examples.uz: U poygada g'olib chiqdi va hammadan oldin marraga yetdi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'won' va 'finished' o'tgan zamonda; 'before' - vaqt predlogi.

examples.en: It was the first time he'd seen someone not of his race.
examples.uz: U o'z irqiga mansub bo'lmagan odamni
examples.grammar: 'It was the first time he had seen someone' - Past Perfect; 'had seen' undan oldingi harakatni bildiradi.

examples.en: People of every race should be treated the same.
examples.uz: Har bir irqdagi odamlarga bir xil munosabatda bo'lish kerak.
examples.grammar: 'should be treated' - 'should' modal fe'li + passiv tuzilma maslahatni bildiradi.

defEn: A bat with strings used to hit a ball in tennis.
defUz: Tennisda to'pni urish uchun ishlatiladigan torli raketka.

examples.en: The tennis player hit the ball so hard that he broke his racket.
examples.uz: Tennischi koptokchani shu qadar
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'hit' va 'broke' o'tgan zamonda; 'so hard that' - 'so ... that' natija ergash gapini ulaydi.

examples.en: I need a new racket because the old one is broken.
examples.uz: Menga yangi raketka kerak, chunki eskisi singan.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'need' va 'is'; 'because' - sabab bog'lovchisi ergash gapni ulaydi.

defEn: Moving over snow on long narrow boards.
defUz: Uzun va tor taxtachalarda qor ustida sirpanib yurish.

examples.en: Lots of people come to this mountain village in winter for skiing.
examples.uz: Ko'plab odamlar chang'i
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'come' takror harakat; 'in winter' va 'for skiing' - 'in' va 'for' predloglari bilan holatlar.

examples.en: Skiing is fun, but you must be careful on the snow.
examples.uz: Chang'i uchish qiziqarli, ammo qor ustida ehtiyot bo'lish kerak.
examples.grammar: 'must' - majburiyatni bildiruvchi modal fe'l; 'but' - zidlovchi bog'lovchi.

defEn: Moving down snow standing on a single board.
defUz: Bitta taxtada turib qor ustida pastga sirpanish.

examples.en: Snowboarding is a popular winter sport among skateboarders.
examples.uz: Snovbordda uchish
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'is' bog'lovchi fe'l; 'among skateboarders' - 'among' predlogi bilan o'rin holi.

examples.en: My friends love snowboarding in the mountains in winter.
examples.uz: Do'stlarim qishda tog'larda snovbordda uchishni juda yaxshi ko'radi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'love'; 'snowboarding' bu yerda ot o'rnida (gerund) qo'llangan; 'in winter' - vaqt holi.

uz: sport markazi: ichida turli-tuman sportlar bilan shug'ullanish mumkin
defEn: A large building where people can do many sports.
defUz: Odamlar turli sport turlari bilan shug'ullanadigan katta bino.

examples.en: Liam joined the sports centre and goes there every day to use the gym or pool.
examples.uz: Liem sport
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'joined'; Present Simple - 'goes'; 'to use' - maqsad infinitivi; 'or' - bog'lovchi.

examples.en: The new sports centre near my house has a big swimming pool.
examples.uz: Uyim yonidagi yangi sport markazida katta suzish havzasi bor.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'has' uchinchi shaxs birlikda; 'near my house' - o'rin holi.

defEn: A large place with seats where people watch sport.
defUz: Odamlar sportni tomosha qiladigan, o'rindiqli katta maydon.

examples.en: The stadium was full of fans enjoying the match.
examples.uz: Stadion o'yindan mazza qilayotgan
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'was' (is fe'lining o'tgan zamon birlik shakli); 'full of fans' - 'of' predlogi bilan ibora; 'enjoying' - sifatdosh.

examples.en: Thousands of people came to the stadium to watch the final.
examples.uz: Minglab odamlar finalni tomosha qilish uchun stadionga kelishdi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'came'; 'to watch' - maqsad infinitivi; 'thousands of' - miqdor ibora.

defEn: Moving through water using your arms and legs.
defUz: Qo'l va oyoqlar yordamida suvda harakatlanish, suzish.

examples.en: Swimming is great exercise because it's hard to get injured in the water.
examples.uz: Suzish ajoyib mashq
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'is' bog'lovchi fe'l; 'because' - sabab bog'lovchisi; 'it's hard to + infinitiv' - tuzilma.

examples.en: Swimming in the sea is more fun than swimming in a pool.
examples.uz: Dengizda suzish havzada suzishdan ko'ra qiziqarliroq.
examples.grammar: 'more fun than' - qiyosiy daraja (comparative); 'swimming' bu yerda ot o'rnida (gerund).

defEn: A game played on a table with small bats and a light ball.
defUz: Stol ustida kichik raketkalar va yengil to'p bilan o'ynaladigan o'yin.

examples.en: Table tennis is a great indoor sport played with two bats  🏓 and a ball.
examples.uz: Stol tennisi ikkita
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'is' bog'lovchi fe'l; 'played with' - passiv ma'noli sifatdosh; 'with' - vosita predlogi.

examples.en: We often play table tennis at home when it rains.
examples.uz: Biz yomg'ir yog'ganda ko'pincha uyda stol tennisi o'ynaymiz.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'play'; 'when' - vaqt bog'lovchisi ergash gapni ulaydi.

defEn: A group of people who play a sport together.
defUz: Sportni birga o'ynaydigan bir guruh odamlar, jamoa.

examples.en: There are five players on a basketball team.
examples.uz: Bitta basketbol jamoasida besh nafar o'yinchi
examples.grammar: 'There are + ko'plik ot' - ko'plikda narsa borligini bildiradi; 'on a basketball team' - 'on' predlogi.

examples.en: Our team won every game and became the champions this year.
examples.uz: Jamoamiz har bir o'yinda g'olib chiqdi va bu yil chempion bo'ldi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'won' va 'became'; 'every game' - 'every' bilan birlik ot keladi.

defEn: A person who plays the game of tennis.
defUz: Tennis o'yinini o'ynaydigan sportchi.

examples.en: The biggest competition for a tennis player is probably Wimbledon.
examples.uz: Tennischi uchun eng katta
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'is' (gapdagi tushirib qoldirilgan); 'the biggest competition' - orttirma daraja; 'for a tennis player' - 'for' predlogi.

examples.en: A good tennis player must run fast and hit the ball well.
examples.uz: Yaxshi tennischi tez yugurishi va to'pni yaxshi urishi kerak.
examples.grammar: 'must' - majburiyatni bildiruvchi modal fe'l; 'and' - bog'lovchi ikki fe'lni ulaydi.

defEn: A small paper that lets you go into an event.
defUz: Biror tadbirga kirishga ruxsat beruvchi kichik chipta.

examples.en: How much is a ticket for the football match tomorrow?
examples.uz: Ertangi futbol o'yini uchun chipta necha
examples.grammar: So'roq gap (question) - 'How much is ...?' narx haqida so'rash uchun ishlatiladi; 'for the football match' - 'for' predlogi.

examples.en: I bought two tickets for the basketball game on Sunday.
examples.uz: Men yakshanba kuni bo'ladigan basketbol o'yiniga ikkita chipta sotib oldim.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'bought' (buy fe'lining o'tgan zamoni); 'on Sunday' - vaqt holi.

defEn: To stop a planned event from happening.
defUz: Rejalashtirilgan tadbirni bo'lmaydigan qilib bekor qilmoq.

examples.en: They cancelled the football match because it was raining so hard.
examples.uz: Futbol o'yinini bekor qilishdi
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'cancelled' o'tgan zamonda '-ed' oladi; 'because' - sabab bog'lovchisi; 'so hard' - daraja ravishi.

examples.en: They cancelled the race because the weather was very bad.
examples.uz: Ob-havo juda yomon bo'lgani uchun ular poygani bekor qilishdi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'cancelled' va 'was'; 'because' - sabab ergash gapini ulaydi.

defEn: To take and hold something moving in the air.
defUz: Havoda harakatlanayotgan narsani tutib olmoq.

examples.en: You throw the ball and I'll catch it.
examples.uz: Siz to'pni uloqtirasiz, men esa uni ushlab olaman.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'throw'; Future - 'I'll catch' ('will' qisqartmasi) kelajak harakatni bildiradi.

examples.en: She ran fast and caught the ball with one hand.
examples.uz: U tez yugurdi va to'pni bir qo'li bilan ushlab oldi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'ran' va 'caught' (catch fe'lining o'tgan zamoni) noto'g'ri fe'llardir.

defEn: To ride a bicycle.
defUz: Velosiped haydab yurmoq.

examples.en: The plan was to cycle 50 miles, but my bike had a problem.
examples.uz: Reja 50 milya masofani velosipedda
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'was' va 'had'; 'to cycle' - maqsad infinitivi; 'but' - zidlovchi bog'lovchi.

examples.en: I cycle to school every morning because it is good exercise.
examples.uz: Maktabga velosipedda borish yaxshi mashq bo'lgani uchun har tongda velosiped haydab boraman.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'cycle' takror harakat; 'because' - sabab bog'lovchisi.

defEn: To have earned something because of what you did.
defUz: Qilgan ishi tufayli biror narsaga loyiq, munosib bo'lmoq.

examples.en: You were unlucky to lose. You deserved to win.
examples.uz: Mag'lub bo'lishingiz omadsizlik bo'ldi. Siz
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'were' va 'deserved'; 'to lose' va 'to win' - infinitiv shakllari.

examples.en: The team played really well and deserved to win the cup.
examples.uz: Jamoa juda yaxshi o'ynadi va kubokni yutishga munosib edi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'played' va 'deserved'; 'to win' - maqsad infinitivi.

defEn: To let something fall from your hand.
defUz: Biror narsani qo'ldan tushirib yubormoq.

examples.en: I threw the ball to him but he dropped it.
examples.uz: Men to'pni unga uloqtirdim, ammo u tushirib yubordi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'threw' (throw fe'lining o'tgan zamoni) va 'dropped'; 'but' - zidlovchi bog'lovchi.

examples.en: He dropped his phone on the floor during the game.
examples.uz: U o'yin paytida telefonini polga tushirib yubordi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'dropped' o'tgan zamonda '-ed' oladi; 'during' - vaqt predlogi.

uz: ruhlantirmoq, chorlamoq, da'vat qilmoq, undamoq · ruhlantirmoq, qo'llab-quvvatlamoq, dalda bo'lmoq
defEn: To give someone hope or help to do something.
defUz: Birovni biror ishni qilishga ruhlantirmoq, undamoq.

examples.en: Our coach encouraged us to try a little harder.
examples.uz: Murabbiyimiz bizni biroz qattiqroq harakat
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'encouraged'; 'encourage someone to + infinitiv' - kimnidir biror ishga undashni bildiruvchi tuzilma.

examples.en: My parents always encourage me to do more sport.
examples.uz: Ota-onam meni doim ko'proq sport bilan shug'ullanishga undaydi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'encourage'; 'to do' - maqsad infinitivi; 'always' - takror ravishi.

examples.en: "You're doing fine," he encouraged her.
examples.uz: "Yaxshi bajaryapsiz," deya yigit qizga dalda berdi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'encouraged'; to'g'ridan-to'g'ri nutq Present Continuous 'You're doing fine'; 'her' - to'ldiruvchi olmosh.

examples.en: Our teacher always encourages us to ask questions.
examples.uz: O'qituvchimiz bizni doim savol berishga undaydi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'encourages' uchinchi shaxs birlikda '-s' oladi; 'to ask' - infinitiv maqsadni bildiradi.

defEn: To stop or finish.
defUz: To'xtamoq yoki tugamoq.

examples.en: The match starts at five and ends at six forty-five.
examples.uz: O'yin soat 5 da boshlanadi va 6.45 da
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'starts' va 'ends' uchinchi shaxs birlikda '-s' oladi; 'at five' - 'at' predlogi bilan vaqt holi.

examples.en: The game ended with a score of two to one.
examples.uz: O'yin ikki-bir hisobi bilan tugadi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'ended' o'tgan zamonda '-ed' oladi; 'with' - holatni bildiruvchi predlog.

defEn: To take part in a competition or race.
defUz: Musobaqa yoki poygaga qatnashish uchun qo'shilmoq.

examples.en: You have to be under 16 to enter the race.
examples.uz: Poygaga qo'shilish uchun 16 yoshdan kichik
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'have to be' majburiyatni bildiruvchi modal ibora; 'to enter' - maqsad infinitivi; 'under 16' - 'under' predlogi.

examples.en: Many young runners entered the race for the first time.
examples.uz: Ko'plab yosh yuguruvchilar poygaga ilk bor qo'shildilar.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'entered' o'tgan zamonda '-ed' oladi; 'for the first time' - vaqt ibora.

defEn: To move something away by pressing it.
defUz: Biror narsani bosib, oldinga yoki nari surmoq, itarmoq.

examples.en: The other player pushed me away from the ball and I fell down.
examples.uz: Boshqa o'yinchi meni to'pdan
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'pushed' va 'fell down'; 'away from the ball' - 'from' predlogi bilan yo'nalish holi.

examples.en: He pushed the door open and ran onto the pitch.
examples.uz: U eshikni itarib ochdi va maydonga yugurib chiqdi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'pushed' va 'ran'; 'onto' - yo'nalishni bildiruvchi predlog.

defEn: To arrive at a place.
defUz: Biror joyga yetib bormoq.

examples.en: Tony was tired when he reached the end of the race.
examples.uz: To'ni poyganing oxiriga yetganida, u
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'was' va 'reached'; 'when' - vaqt bog'lovchisi ergash gapni ulaydi.

examples.en: The runners reached the finish line after two hours.
examples.uz: Yuguruvchilar ikki soatdan keyin marra chizig'iga yetib kelishdi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'reached' o'tgan zamonda '-ed' oladi; 'after' - vaqt predlogi.

uz: velosiped yoki mototsikl haydamoq; ot minmoq
defEn: To sit on and control a bike, horse or motorbike.
defUz: Velosiped, ot yoki mototsiklni minib boshqarmoq.

examples.en: The first time you ride a horse can be scary because they're big animals.
examples.uz: Birinchi marta ot
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'can be scary' modal fe'l 'can' bilan; 'because' - sabab bog'lovchisi; 'they're' (they are) qisqartma.

examples.en: We rode our bikes around the park all afternoon.
examples.uz: Biz tushdan keyin bo'yi bog' atrofida velosiped haydadik.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'rode' (ride fe'lining o'tgan zamoni); 'around' - o'rin predlogi.

defEn: To move by turning over and over.
defUz: Aylanib-aylanib harakatlanmoq, dumalamoq.

examples.en: The ball rolled slowly across the line and into the net. Goal!
examples.uz: To'p sekinlik bilan chiziq bo'ylab
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'rolled' o'tgan zamonda '-ed' oladi; 'across the line' va 'into the net' - 'across' va 'into' predloglari.

examples.en: The ball rolled under the chair and stopped.
examples.uz: To'p stul tagiga dumalab kirdi va to'xtadi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'rolled' va 'stopped'; 'under' - o'rin predlogi.

defEn: To win a point or goal in a game.
defUz: O'yinda ochko yoki go'l qo'lga kiritmoq.

examples.en: Sharon's our best player
examples.uz: she scored fifteen goals last year. – Sheron bizning eng yaxshi
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'is' (gapda ''s'); Past Simple - 'scored'; 'last year' - o'tgan vaqt holi.

examples.en: She scored two goals in the second half of the match.
examples.uz: U o'yinning ikkinchi yarmida ikkita go'l urdi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'scored' o'tgan zamonda '-ed' oladi; 'in the second half' - 'in' predlogi.

defEn: To choose someone or something from a group.
defUz: Bir guruhdan kimnidir yoki nimanidir tanlab olmoq.

examples.en: I'm playing well at the moment, so the coach selected me for the team.
examples.uz: Men ayni damda yaxshi
examples.grammar: Present Continuous - 'I'm playing' hozir davom etayotgan harakat; Past Simple - 'selected'; 'so' - natija bog'lovchisi.

examples.en: The coach selected five players for the new team.
examples.uz: Murabbiy yangi jamoa uchun besh nafar o'yinchini tanladi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'selected' o'tgan zamonda '-ed' oladi; 'for the new team' - 'for' predlogi.

defEn: To push someone or something hard.
defUz: Birovni yoki biror narsani qattiq itarib yubormoq, turtmoq.

examples.en: You can't shove the other player out of the way to get to the ball.
examples.uz: To'pga yetish uchun boshqa
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'can't shove' modal fe'l 'can'ning bo'lishsiz shakli; 'to get to the ball' - maqsad infinitivi.

examples.en: He shoved his bag into the locker and ran to the gym.
examples.uz: U sumkasini shkafga tiqib turtdi va sport zaliga yugurdi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'shoved' va 'ran'; 'into' - yo'nalishni bildiruvchi predlog.

defEn: To move on ice or a flat surface on skates.
defUz: Konkida muz yoki tekis yuza ustida sirpanib yurmoq.

examples.en: The ice hockey player skated fast towards the goal.
examples.uz: Hakkeychi tezlik bilan darvoza tomon
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'skated' o'tgan zamonda '-ed' oladi; 'towards the goal' - 'towards' predlogi bilan yo'nalish holi.

examples.en: The children love to skate on the lake when it freezes.
examples.uz: Bolalar ko'l muzlaganda uning ustida konkida uchishni yaxshi ko'radi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'love'; 'to skate' - infinitiv; 'when' - vaqt bog'lovchisi.

defEn: To send something through the air with your hand.
defUz: Biror narsani qo'l bilan havoga uloqtirmoq.

examples.en: The basketball player threw the ball towards the basket.
examples.uz: Basketbolchi to'pni savat tomon
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'threw' (throw fe'lining o'tgan zamoni, noto'g'ri fe'l); 'towards the basket' - 'towards' predlogi.

examples.en: Throw the ball to me and I will catch it.
examples.uz: To'pni menga uloqtir, men uni ushlab olaman.
examples.grammar: Buyruq gap (imperative) - 'Throw' fe'l asosi bilan boshlanadi; 'will catch' - kelasi zamon.

defEn: To put your hand on something.
defUz: Biror narsaga qo'l tekkizmoq.

examples.en: Only the goalkeeper can touch the ball with their hand in football.
examples.uz: Futbolda faqatgina
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'can touch' modal fe'l 'can' bilan; 'only' - cheklovchi ravish; 'with their hand' - 'with' vosita predlogi.

examples.en: Do not touch the ball with your hands during the game.
examples.uz: O'yin paytida to'pga qo'lingiz bilan tegmang.
examples.grammar: Buyruq gapning bo'lishsiz shakli - 'Do not touch'; 'during' - vaqt predlogi.

defEn: To look at a game or match for a time.
defUz: O'yin yoki musobaqani bir muddat ko'rib turmoq.

examples.en: Let's go and watch the match in the stadium, not on TV.
examples.uz: Keling o'yinni borib stadionda
examples.grammar: 'Let's + infinitiv' - taklif gapini bildiradi; 'not on TV' - 'on' predlogi bilan zidlash; 'in the stadium' - o'rin holi.

examples.en: We watched the match together at my friend's house.
examples.uz: Biz o'yinni do'stimning uyida birga tomosha qildik.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'watched' o'tgan zamonda '-ed' oladi; 'at my friend's house' - egalik bilan o'rin holi.

uz: biror kimni biror narsa bilan tabriklamoq
defEn: To tell someone you are happy about their success.
defUz: Birovni muvaffaqiyati bilan tabriklamoq.

examples.en: The coach congratulated the team on winning the cup.
examples.uz: Murabbiy jamoani kubokni yutgani
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'congratulated'; 'congratulate someone on + -ing' - 'on' predlogidan keyin fe'l '-ing' shaklida keladi.

examples.en: She congratulated her friend on passing the swimming test.
examples.uz: U do'stini suzish sinovidan o'tgani bilan tabrikladi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'congratulated'; 'on passing' - 'on' predlogidan keyin gerund (-ing) keladi.

defEn: To take part in a sport like judo or karate.
defUz: Dzyudo yoki karate kabi sport bilan shug'ullanmoq.

examples.en: I do judo and I've got a black belt.
examples.uz: Men dzyudo bilan shug'ullanaman va mening qora
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'do'; Present Perfect - 'I've got' (have got) egalikni bildiradi; 'and' - bog'lovchi.

examples.en: My sister does karate twice a week at the sports centre.
examples.uz: Singlim sport markazida haftada ikki marta karate bilan shug'ullanadi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'does' uchinchi shaxs birlikda; 'twice a week' - takrorlanishni bildiruvchi vaqt holi.

uz: futbol butsalari (futbol o'ynash uchun mo'ljallangan oyoq kiyimlar)
defEn: Special shoes worn for playing football.
defUz: Futbol o'ynash uchun kiyiladigan maxsus oyoq kiyim, butsa.

examples.en: My old football boots have got a hole near the toe.
examples.uz: Mening eski futbol butsalarimning barmoq
examples.grammar: Present Perfect - 'have got' egalikni bildiradi; 'near the toe' - 'near' predlogi bilan o'rin holi.

examples.en: He bought new football boots before the start of the season.
examples.uz: U mavsum boshlanishidan oldin yangi futbol butsalarini sotib oldi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'bought' (buy fe'lining o'tgan zamoni); 'before' - vaqt predlogi.

uz: chang'i uchishga/snovbordda uchishga/dengizda syo'rfing qilishga/va hokazo qilishga bormoq
defEn: To go somewhere to do a sport like skiing.
defUz: Chang'i uchish kabi sport bilan shug'ullanish uchun bir joyga bormoq.

examples.en: We'll go skiing this weekend if it snows in the mountains.
examples.uz: Agar tog'da qor yog'sa, bu hafta
examples.grammar: Future - 'We'll go' ('will' qisqartmasi); 'if it snows' - shart mayli (conditional) ergash gapi; 'go skiing' - mashg'ulot ibora.

examples.en: They go surfing at the beach every summer holiday.
examples.uz: Ular har yozgi ta'tilda plyajda syorfing qilishga boradi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'go' takror harakat; 'every summer holiday' - takrorlanishni bildiruvchi vaqt holi.

defEn: After a long time or after everything.
defUz: Uzoq vaqtdan yoki hamma narsadan keyin, oxir-oqibat.

examples.en: In the end we won the game, though it was really hard.
examples.uz: Qiyin bo'lishiga qaramay, oxir-oqibat
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'won'; 'In the end' - gap boshida vaqt iborasi; 'though' - zidlovchi bog'lovchi ergash gapni ulaydi.

examples.en: We tried many times and in the end we found the answer.
examples.uz: Biz ko'p marta urindik va oxir-oqibat javobni topdik.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'tried' va 'found'; 'in the end' - natijani bildiruvchi vaqt ibora.

defEn: To not win a game or competition.
defUz: O'yin yoki musobaqada g'olib bo'lolmay, mag'lub bo'lmoq.

examples.en: We lost the match when the other team scored near the end.
examples.uz: Narigi jamoa yakunga yaqin
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'lost' (lose fe'lining o'tgan zamoni) va 'scored'; 'when' - vaqt bog'lovchisi; 'near the end' - o'rin ibora.

examples.en: Our team lost the game, but everyone played very well.
examples.uz: Jamoamiz o'yinda mag'lub bo'ldi, ammo hamma juda yaxshi o'ynadi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'lost' va 'played'; 'but' - zidlovchi bog'lovchi.

defEn: Shown on a television.
defUz: Televizorda ko'rsatilayotgan.

examples.en: Is the match on TV tonight?
examples.uz: O'yin bugun oqshomda televizorda ko'rsatiladimi?
examples.grammar: So'roq gap (question) - 'Is the match on TV ...?' 'is' fe'li gap boshiga chiqadi; 'on TV' va 'tonight' - holatlar.

examples.en: The big football game will be on TV this evening.
examples.uz: Katta futbol o'yini bugun kechqurun televizorda ko'rsatiladi.
examples.grammar: Future - 'will be' kelasi zamonni bildiradi; 'this evening' - vaqt holi.

defEn: To take part in a game like golf or football.
defUz: Golf yoki futbol kabi o'yinni o'ynamoq.

examples.en: Can you play golf? It looks very hard.
examples.uz: Siz golf o'ynay olasizmi? U juda qiyin ko'rinadi.
examples.grammar: So'roq gap (question) - 'Can you play ...?' modal fe'l 'can' gap boshiga chiqadi; 'It looks' - Present Simple.

examples.en: My friends play baseball in the park on Saturday mornings.
examples.uz: Do'stlarim shanba tonglari bog'da beysbol o'ynashadi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'play' takror harakat; 'on Saturday mornings' - vaqt holi.

defEn: To do an activity with other people.
defUz: Boshqalar bilan birga biror faoliyatda qatnashmoq.

examples.en: Fifty runners are taking part in the race.
examples.uz: Poygada ellik nafar yuguruvchi ishtirok etmoqda.
examples.grammar: Present Continuous - 'are taking part' hozir davom etayotgan harakatni bildiradi; 'in the race' - 'in' predlogi.

examples.en: She wants to take part in the school sports day this year.
examples.uz: U bu yil maktab sport kunida qatnashmoqchi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'wants'; 'to take part' - maqsad infinitivi; 'this year' - vaqt holi.

defEn: To beat others and come first in a game.
defUz: Boshqalarni yengib, o'yinda birinchi bo'lmoq, g'olib bo'lmoq.

examples.en: We rarely win our matches, but we enjoy playing anyway.
examples.uz: Biz kamdan-kam holatda o'yinda
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'win' va 'enjoy'; 'rarely' - kamdan-kam holatni bildiruvchi ravish; 'anyway' - baribir ma'nosi.

examples.en: If we play well, we can win the match on Sunday.
examples.uz: Agar yaxshi o'ynasak, yakshanba kuni o'yinda g'olib bo'lishimiz mumkin.
examples.grammar: 'If' bilan shart mayli (conditional); 'can win' - imkoniyatni bildiruvchi modal fe'l.

defEn: Making you feel happy and interested.
defUz: Odamni xursand va qiziqtiradigan, maroqli.

examples.en: What an exciting game! I don't know who's going to win!
examples.uz: Naqadar ajoyib o'yin-a! Bilmasam
examples.grammar: His gap (exclamation) - 'What an exciting game!' kuchli his-tuyg'uni bildiradi; 'an' - artikl unli tovushdan oldin keladi.

examples.en: The last minute of the game was very exciting.
examples.uz: O'yinning so'nggi daqiqasi juda maroqli edi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'was'; 'exciting' - sifat ot 'minute'ni izohlaydi; 'very' - daraja ravishi.

defEn: Very good or wonderful.
defUz: Juda yaxshi, ajoyib.

examples.en: The team was fantastic and won 5:0.
examples.uz: Jamoa ajoyib bo'ldi va 5:0 hisobda g'alaba qozondi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'was' va 'won'; 'fantastic' - sifat 'was' fe'lidan keyin keladi; 'and' - bog'lovchi.

examples.en: The players were fantastic and the fans were very happy.
examples.uz: O'yinchilar ajoyib bo'lishdi va muxlislar juda xursand edi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'were' (ko'plik); 'fantastic' - sifat; 'and' - bog'lovchi.

defEn: Moving or able to move quickly.
defUz: Tez harakatlanadigan yoki tez harakatlana oladigan.

examples.en: Oscar's very fast and usually wins running races.
examples.uz: O'skr juda tezkor va odatda yugurish
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'is' va 'wins'; 'very fast' - daraja ravishi bilan sifat; 'and' - bog'lovchi.

examples.en: He is a fast runner and always finishes the race first.
examples.uz: U tezkor yuguruvchi va doim poygada birinchi bo'lib marraga yetadi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'is' va 'finishes'; 'fast' - sifat 'runner'ni izohlaydi.

defEn: Inside a building.
defUz: Bino ichidagi.

examples.en: The hotel has an indoor swimming pool, which is good when it's winter.
examples.uz: Mehmonxonada ichki
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'has'; 'which' - sifatlovchi ergash gapni ulaydi; 'when it's winter' - vaqt ergash gapi.

examples.en: We play indoor games like table tennis when it is cold.
examples.uz: Havo sovuq bo'lganda biz stol tennisi kabi bino ichidagi o'yinlarni o'ynaymiz.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'play'; 'indoor' - sifat 'games'ni izohlaydi; 'when' - vaqt bog'lovchisi.

defEn: Happening or used outside, not in a building.
defUz: Ochiq havoda bo'ladigan yoki ishlatiladigan, bino ichida emas.

examples.en: I like to get fresh air, so I prefer outdoor sports.
examples.uz: Men toza havo olishni yoqtiraman, shuning
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'like' va 'prefer'; 'so' - natija bog'lovchisi; 'outdoor sports' - sifat + ot birikmasi.

examples.en: Football is an outdoor sport that people play on grass.
examples.uz: Futbol odamlar maysa ustida o'ynaydigan ochiq havodagi sport turidir.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'is' va 'play'; 'outdoor' - sifat 'sport'ni izohlaydi; 'that' - ergash gap bog'lovchisi.

defEn: Liked by many people.
defUz: Ko'p odamlar yoqtiradigan, mashhur.

examples.en: Football is a popular sport, with many people playing it or watching it.
examples.uz: Futbol mashhur sport
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'is'; 'with many people playing it' - 'with' predlogi bilan sifatdosh ibora; 'or' - bog'lovchi.

examples.en: Swimming is a popular sport with both children and adults.
examples.uz: Suzish ham bolalar, ham kattalar orasida mashhur sport turidir.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'is'; 'popular' - sifat 'sport'ni izohlaydi; 'both ... and' - bog'lovchi juftlik.

defEn: Having a lot of power or skill.
defUz: Ko'p kuch yoki mahoratga ega bo'lgan, kuchli.

examples.en: He's a strong swimmer who wins all the races that he enters.
examples.uz: U qo'shilgan barcha poygasida
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'is' va 'wins'; 'who' - sifatlovchi ergash gapni ulaydi; 'a strong swimmer' - sifat + ot birikmasi.

examples.en: She is a strong player and helps her team win games.
examples.uz: U kuchli o'yinchi va jamoasiga o'yinlarda g'olib bo'lishga yordam beradi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'is' va 'helps'; 'strong' - sifat 'player'ni izohlaydi.

examples.en: Get Carl to lift it
examples.uz: he's as strong as an ox. – Uni Karlga ko'tartiring–u ho'kizdek kuchli.
examples.grammar: 'Get Carl to lift it' - buyruq gap, 'get somebody to do' kimnidir ishga undashni bildiradi.

examples.en: Doing sport every day makes your body strong.
examples.uz: Har kuni sport bilan shug'ullanish tanangizni kuchli qiladi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple 'makes', 'make + ot + sifat' biror holatga keltirishni bildiradi; 'strong' sifat.

defEn: Coming before all others.
defUz: Hammadan oldin keladigan, birinchi.

examples.en: The team that comes first in the competition wins a cup.
examples.uz: Musobaqada birinchi bo'lib kelgan
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'comes' va 'wins'; 'the team that comes first' - 'that' ergash gap bog'lovchisi; 'first' - tartib son.

examples.en: She finished first in the swimming race last week.
examples.uz: U o'tgan hafta suzish poygasida birinchi bo'lib marraga yetdi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'finished'; 'first' - tartib son; 'last week' - o'tgan vaqt holi.

defEn: Coming after all others.
defUz: Hammadan keyin keladigan, oxirgi.

examples.en: She hurt her leg and came last in the race.
examples.uz: U oyog'ini shikastlab oldi va poygada oxirgi bo'lib
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'hurt' va 'came'; 'came last' - oxirgi o'rinni bildiruvchi ibora; 'and' - bog'lovchi.

examples.en: He was tired, so he came last in the long race.
examples.uz: U charchagan edi, shuning uchun uzoq poygada oxirgi bo'lib keldi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'was' va 'came'; 'last' - tartibni bildiradi; 'so' - natija bog'lovchisi.

defEn: In a good way.
defUz: Yaxshi tarzda.

examples.en: Wendy got on the team because she plays well.
examples.uz: Vendi jamoaga kirdi chunki u yaxshi o'ynaydi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'got' (gapdagi) va 'plays'; 'because' - sabab bog'lovchisi; 'well' - ravish fe'ldan keyin keladi.

examples.en: He played very well and scored the only goal of the match.
examples.uz: U juda yaxshi o'ynadi va o'yindagi yagona go'lni urdi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'played' va 'scored'; 'well' - ravish 'played' fe'lini izohlaydi.

defEn: To tell someone you are happy about their success.
defUz: Birovni muvaffaqiyati bilan tabriklamoq.

examples.en: I congratulated them all on their results.
examples.uz: Men ularning barini natijalari bilan tabrikladim.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'congratulated' o'tgan zamonda '-ed' oladi; 'on their results' - 'on' predlogi bilan ibora.

examples.en: We congratulated the team after they won the cup.
examples.uz: Biz jamoani kubokni yutganidan keyin tabrikladik.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'congratulated' va 'won'; 'after' - vaqt bog'lovchisi ergash gapni ulaydi.

defEn: Words you say to show you are happy for someone.
defUz: Kimnidir muvaffaqiyati bilan tabriklash uchun aytiladigan so'zlar.

examples.en: Congratulations on winning the prize!
examples.uz: Sovrinni yutganingiz bilan tabriklayman!
examples.grammar: His gap (exclamation) - 'Congratulations on + -ing' tabrik bildiradi; 'on winning' - 'on' predlogidan keyin gerund keladi.

examples.en: Congratulations on your win in the big race today!
examples.uz: Bugungi katta poygadagi g'alabangiz bilan tabriklayman!
examples.grammar: His gap - 'Congratulations on + ot' tuzilmasi; 'on your win' - 'on' predlogi bilan ibora.

defEn: A chance that something bad may happen.
defUz: Yomon narsa ro'y berishi mumkin bo'lgan xavf.

examples.en: We weren't in any danger.
examples.uz: Biz hech qanday xavf ostida emasdik.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'weren't' (were not) bo'lishsiz shakli; 'in any danger' - 'in' predlogi bilan holat ibora.

examples.en: There is some danger in skiing fast down the mountain.
examples.uz: Tog'dan tez chang'i uchishda biroz xavf bor.
examples.grammar: 'There is + ot' - biror narsa borligini bildiradi; 'in skiing' - 'in' predlogidan keyin gerund keladi.

defEn: Able to hurt or harm you.
defUz: Sizga zarar yoki shikast yetkazishi mumkin bo'lgan, xavfli.

examples.en: Snowboarding can be dangerous if you fall while going fast.
examples.uz: Agar tez ketayotganda yiqilib
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'can be dangerous' modal fe'l 'can' bilan; 'if you fall' - shart mayli (conditional) ergash gapi.

examples.en: Riding a bike on a busy road can be dangerous for children.
examples.uz: Gavjum yo'lda velosiped haydash bolalar uchun xavfli bo'lishi mumkin.
examples.grammar: 'can be' - imkoniyatni bildiruvchi modal fe'l; 'dangerous' - sifat; 'for children' - 'for' predlogi.

defEn: To go into a place.
defUz: Biror joyga kirmoq.

examples.en: Someone entered the room behind me.
examples.uz: Kimdir mening ortimdan xonaga kirdi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'entered' o'tgan zamonda '-ed' oladi; 'behind me' - 'behind' predlogi bilan o'rin holi.

examples.en: The players entered the field as the fans cheered loudly.
examples.uz: Muxlislar baland ovozda olqishlagan paytda o'yinchilar maydonga kirib kelishdi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'entered' va 'cheered'; 'as' - vaqt bog'lovchisi ergash gapni ulaydi.

defEn: The door or way into a place.
defUz: Biror joyga kiriladigan eshik yoki joy.

examples.en: The entrance to the stadium was full of fans.
examples.uz: Stadionga kirish joyi muxlislarga to'la edi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'was'; 'the entrance to the stadium' - 'to' predlogi bilan ibora; 'full of fans' - 'of' predlogi.

examples.en: Many people waited at the entrance before the game started.
examples.uz: O'yin boshlanishidan oldin ko'p odamlar kirish joyida kutib turishdi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'waited' va 'started'; 'at the entrance' - 'at' predlogi bilan o'rin holi.

defEn: To make someone feel happy and interested.
defUz: Birovni xursand va qiziqqan his qildirmoq, quvontirmoq.

examples.en: Nothing about my life excites me at present.
examples.uz: Hozirgi paytda hayotimdagi hech narsa meni
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'excites' uchinchi shaxs birlikda '-s' oladi; 'Nothing' - bo'lishsiz ma'noli ega; 'at present' - hozirgi vaqt ibora.

examples.en: The new football season really excites all the young fans.
examples.uz: Yangi futbol mavsumi barcha yosh muxlislarni juda quvontiradi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'excites' uchinchi shaxs birlikda; 'really' - daraja ravishi.

defEn: A happy and interested feeling.
defUz: Xursandlik va qiziqishga to'la his-tuyg'u, hayajon.

examples.en: The fans were full of excitement as the teams came out.
examples.uz: Jamoalar chiqar ekan, muxlislar
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'were' va 'came out'; 'full of excitement' - 'of' predlogi bilan ibora; 'as' - vaqt bog'lovchisi.

examples.en: There was a lot of excitement before the final match.
examples.uz: Final o'yinidan oldin katta hayajon bor edi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'There was + ot' o'tgan zamonda biror narsa borligini bildiradi; 'before' - vaqt predlogi.

defEn: Feeling happy and interested about something.
defUz: Biror narsadan xursand va hayajonlangan.

examples.en: I'm very excited
examples.uz: I'm taking part in my first swimming competition today. – Men juda zavqlanib
examples.grammar: Present Continuous - 'I'm taking part' hozirgi rejani bildiradi; 'excited' - his-tuyg'uni bildiruvchi sifat 'am' fe'lidan keyin keladi.

examples.en: The children were excited about their first day at the gym.
examples.uz: Bolalar sport zalidagi birinchi kunlaridan hayajonlangan edi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'were'; 'excited' - sifat; 'about' - predlog his-tuyg'u sababini ulaydi.

defEn: Being known by many people.
defUz: Ko'p odamlarga tanilganlik, shon-shuhrat.

examples.en: She first rose to fame as a singer at the age of 16.
examples.uz: U ilk bor 16 yoshida qo'shiqchi sifatida
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'rose to fame' o'tgan zamonda; 'as a singer' - 'as' predlogi bilan; 'at the age of 16' - 'at' predlogi.

examples.en: The young player found fame after he won the big cup.
examples.uz: Yosh o'yinchi katta kubokni yutgach, shuhrat qozondi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'found' va 'won'; 'after' - vaqt bog'lovchisi ergash gapni ulaydi.

defEn: Known by many people.
defUz: Ko'p odamlarga tanilgan, mashhur.

examples.en: Ronaldo's a famous football player who has won every cup you can imagine.
examples.uz: Ronaldo siz
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'is' (gapda ''s'); Present Perfect - 'has won' natijasi hozirgi paytga ta'sir qiladi; 'who' - sifatlovchi ergash gap.

examples.en: She is a famous swimmer who has won many gold medals.
examples.uz: U ko'plab oltin medallarni qo'lga kiritgan mashhur suzuvchi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'is'; 'famous' - sifat 'swimmer'ni izohlaydi; 'who' - ergash gap bog'lovchisi.

uz: yutqazmoq, mag'lub bo'lmoq · yo'qotmoq, ayrilmoq, judo bo'lmoq
defEn: To not win.
defUz: G'olib bo'lolmay qolmoq, yutqazmoq.

examples.en: We lost to a stronger team.
examples.uz: Biz kuchliroq jamoaga yengildik.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'lost' (lose fe'lining o'tgan zamoni, noto'g'ri fe'l); 'to a stronger team' - 'to' predlogi; 'stronger' - qiyosiy daraja.

examples.en: If we do not practise more, we will lose the next game.
examples.uz: Agar ko'proq mashq qilmasak, keyingi o'yinda yutqazamiz.
examples.grammar: 'If' bilan shart mayli (conditional); 'will lose' - kelasi zamonni bildiradi.

examples.en: She lost a leg in a car crash.
examples.uz: U avariyada bir oyog'idan ayrilgan.
examples.grammar: 'She lost a leg in a car crash' - Past Simple; 'lose' o'tgan zamonda 'lost', 'in' predlogi vaziyatni bildiradi.

examples.en: He lost his keys on the way to work.
examples.uz: U ishga ketayotganda kalitlarini yo'qotdi.
examples.grammar: 'He lost his keys' - Past Simple; 'lose' fe'li o'tgan zamonda 'lost' bo'ladi.

defEn: A person who does not win.
defUz: G'olib bo'lolmagan kishi, mag'lub.

examples.en: The winner of the final gets £300,000, but the loser gets some money too.
examples.uz: Final g'olibi 300,000
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'gets'; 'the winner' va 'the loser' - 'the' artikli bilan; 'too' - qo'shimcha ma'nosi.

examples.en: Even the loser of the race got a small gift at the end.
examples.uz: Hatto poyganing mag'lubi ham oxirida kichik sovg'a oldi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'got'; 'even' - kutilmaganlikni ta'kidlovchi so'z; 'at the end' - vaqt ibora.

defEn: To do something many times to get better.
defUz: Mohir bo'lish uchun biror ishni ko'p marta takrorlamoq.

examples.en: She's the best tennis player because she practises every day.
examples.uz: U eng yaxshi tennischi chunki u
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'is' va 'practises' uchinchi shaxs birlikda; 'because' - sabab bog'lovchisi; 'the best player' - orttirma daraja.

examples.en: You must practise every day if you want to play well.
examples.uz: Yaxshi o'ynashni istasangiz, har kuni mashq qilishingiz kerak.
examples.grammar: 'must' - majburiyatni bildiruvchi modal fe'l; 'if' - shart mayli (conditional) ergash gapi.

defEn: To move over snow on skis.
defUz: Chang'ida qor ustida sirpanib yurmoq.

examples.en: Our children want to learn to ski.
examples.uz: Farzandlarimiz chang'i uchishni o'rganishni istashadi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'want'; 'to learn' va 'to ski' - infinitiv shakllari; 'learn to + infinitiv' - tuzilma.

examples.en: We learned to ski in the mountains last winter.
examples.uz: Biz o'tgan qishda tog'larda chang'i uchishni o'rgandik.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'learned'; 'to ski' - maqsad infinitivi; 'last winter' - o'tgan vaqt holi.

defEn: To practise to get ready for a sport.
defUz: Sportga tayyorlanish uchun mashq qilmoq, shug'ullanmoq.

examples.en: I train in the gym for two hours a day.
examples.uz: Men kuniga ikki soat sport zalida shug'ullanaman.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'train' takror harakat; 'in the gym' - 'in' predlogi; 'for two hours a day' - davomiylik ibora.

examples.en: The team trains hard every day before a big match.
examples.uz: Jamoa katta o'yindan oldin har kuni qattiq shug'ullanadi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'trains' uchinchi shaxs birlikda; 'before' - vaqt predlogi.

examples.en: I have to train three new members of staff this week.
examples.uz: Bu hafta uch nafar yangi ishchi xodimni
examples.grammar: 'have to + train' - Present Simple - 'have to' majburiyatni bildiradi, 'this week' vaqtni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: The company trains all new workers for two weeks.
examples.uz: Kompaniya barcha yangi ishchilarni ikki hafta o'qitadi.
examples.grammar: 'trains + ot (ko'plik)' - Present Simple - 'for two weeks' davomiylikni bildiradi.

defEn: Practice to get better at a sport.
defUz: Sportda yaxshi bo'lish uchun qilinadigan mashg'ulot.

examples.en: When Joe arrived late at training, the coach shouted at him.
examples.uz: Jo' mashg'ulotga kech yetib
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'arrived' va 'shouted'; 'when' - vaqt bog'lovchisi ergash gapni ulaydi; 'at him' - 'at' predlogi.

examples.en: Daily training helped the players get much stronger.
examples.uz: Kundalik mashg'ulot o'yinchilarga ancha kuchliroq bo'lishga yordam berdi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'helped'; 'get stronger' - 'help someone get' tuzilmasi; 'stronger' - qiyosiy daraja.

defEn: A person who helps people train for sport.
defUz: Odamlarga sportga tayyorlanishga yordam beradigan trener.

examples.en: Paula's a trainer at a local gym.
examples.uz: Po'la mahalliy sport zalda trener.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'is' (gapda ''s'); 'a trainer at a local gym' - 'at' predlogi bilan o'rin holi.

examples.en: The trainer showed us how to lift the weights safely.
examples.uz: Trener bizga toshlarni xavfsiz ko'tarishni ko'rsatdi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'showed'; 'how to lift' - so'roq so'zi bilan infinitiv tuzilmasi.

defEn: To be the best in a game or competition.
defUz: O'yin yoki musobaqada birinchi, g'olib bo'lmoq.

examples.en: Our team easily won the competition.
examples.uz: Bizning jamoa musobaqada osonlik bilan g'olib bo'ldi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'won' (win fe'lining o'tgan zamoni, noto'g'ri fe'l); 'easily' - tarz ravishi fe'ldan oldin keladi.

examples.en: If we play well, we will win the competition this year.
examples.uz: Agar yaxshi o'ynasak, bu yil musobaqada g'olib bo'lamiz.
examples.grammar: 'If' bilan shart mayli (conditional); 'will win' - kelasi zamonni bildiradi.

defEn: A person who wins a game or competition.
defUz: O'yin yoki musobaqada g'olib bo'lgan kishi.

examples.en: The winner of the competition held the cup above his head.
examples.uz: Musobaqa g'olibi kubokni boshi
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'held' (hold fe'lining o'tgan zamoni); 'the winner of the competition' - 'of' predlogi bilan ibora; 'above his head' - 'above' predlogi.

examples.en: The winner of the race got a gold medal and a big cup.
examples.uz: Poyga g'olibi oltin medal va katta kubokni qo'lga kiritdi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'got'; 'the winner of the race' - 'of' predlogi bilan ibora; 'and' - bog'lovchi.

defEn: A flat surface on a classroom wall where the teacher writes.
defUz: O'qituvchi yozadigan, sinf devoriga osilgan tekis yuza.

examples.en: The teacher wrote the homework up on the board.
examples.uz: O'qituvchi uy vazifasini doskaga yozdi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'wrote' fe'lining o'tgan zamon shakli; 'up on the board' - predloglar joyni bildiradi.

examples.en: The teacher cleaned the board before the next lesson.
examples.uz: O'qituvchi keyingi darsdan oldin doskani tozaladi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'cleaned' fe'li o'tgan zamonda; 'before' - bog'lovchi vaqtni bildiradi.

defEn: A room in a school where lessons take place.
defUz: Maktabda darslar o'tiladigan xona.

examples.en: The kids had covered the walls of the classroom with their work.
examples.uz: Bolalar sinfxona devorlarini
examples.grammar: Past Perfect - 'had covered' tugagan ish o'tgan boshqa vaqtgacha bajarilganini bildiradi; 'with' predlogi vositani ko'rsatadi.
