examples.en: Our classroom has big windows and twenty desks.
examples.uz: Bizning sinfxonamizda katta derazalar va yigirmata parta bor.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'has' egalik va mavjudlikni bildiradi; 'and' - bog'lovchi ikki narsani bog'laydi.

defEn: A table where a student sits and works in class.
defUz: O'quvchi o'tirib ish bajaradigan stol, parta.

examples.en: The students were sitting at their desks writing an essay.
examples.uz: O'quvchilar o'z partalarida insho yozib
examples.grammar: Past Continuous - 'were sitting' o'tgan zamonda davom etgan ishni bildiradi; 'at their desks' - predlog joyni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: Please put your books on the desk.
examples.uz: Iltimos, kitoblaringizni partaga qo'ying.
examples.grammar: Buyruq gap - 'put' fe'li bilan boshlanadi; 'on the desk' - predlog joyni bildiradi.

defEn: A book that explains the meaning of words.
defUz: So'zlarning ma'nosini tushuntiruvchi kitob, lug'at.

examples.en: Look up any words you don't know in your dictionary.
examples.uz: Bilmaydigan har qanday so'zlaringizni
examples.grammar: Buyruq gap - 'Look up' phrasal fe'l; 'you don't know' - ergash gap, 'don't' bilan inkor Present Simple.

examples.en: I use my dictionary to find new words.
examples.uz: Men yangi so'zlarni topish uchun lug'atimdan foydalanaman.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'use' fe'li odatiy ishni bildiradi; 'to find' - infinitiv maqsadni ko'rsatadi.

defEn: An important test of what you have learned.
defUz: O'rgangan narsangizni tekshiruvchi muhim sinov, imtihon.

examples.en: You must get 55% to pass the exam.
examples.uz: Imtihondan muvaffaqiyatli o'tish uchun 55% olishingiz
examples.grammar: Modal fe'l 'must' majburiyatni bildiradi; 'to pass' - infinitiv maqsadni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: I studied all week for my English exam.
examples.uz: Men ingliz tili imtihonim uchun butun hafta tayyorlandim.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'studied' o'tgan zamonda; 'for' predlogi maqsadni bildiradi.

defEn: The teacher who is in charge of a school.
defUz: Maktabni boshqaradigan bosh o'qituvchi, direktor.

examples.en: His teacher sent him to the head teacher for talking in class.
examples.uz: Uning o'qituvchisi uni darsda
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'sent' o'tgan zamon shakli; 'for talking' - 'for' predlogi sababni, '-ing' shakli harakatni bildiradi.

examples.en: The head teacher talked to all the parents this morning.
examples.uz: Maktab direktori bugun ertalab barcha ota-onalar bilan suhbatlashdi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'talked' o'tgan zamonda; 'to' predlogi yo'naltirilgan harakatni bildiradi.

defEn: Work that a teacher gives students to do at home.
defUz: O'qituvchi o'quvchilarga uyda bajarish uchun beradigan vazifa.

examples.en: Our teacher asked us to do some research on the Internet for homework.
examples.uz: O'qituvchimiz bizdan
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'asked'; 'asked us to do' - 'ask somebody to do' konstruksiyasi; 'for homework' predlog maqsadni bildiradi.

examples.en: I finished my homework before dinner.
examples.uz: Men kechki ovqatdan oldin uy vazifamni tugatdim.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'finished' o'tgan zamonda; 'before' bog'lovchi vaqtni bildiradi.

uz: interaktiv doska O'qituvchimiz Julini sinf oldiga olib borib, javobni interaktiv doskaga yozdirdi  .
defEn: A large electronic board in class that you can touch and write on.
defUz: Sinfda barmoq bilan boshqariladigan va yoziladigan katta elektron doska.

examples.en: Our teacher showed us a video on the IWB.
examples.uz: O'qituvchimiz bizga interaktiv doskada videoni ko'rsatdi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'showed' o'tgan zamonda; 'on the IWB' predlog joyni bildiradi.

examples.en: You can write on the IWB with your finger.
examples.uz: Interaktiv doskaga barmog'ingiz bilan yozishingiz mumkin.
examples.grammar: Modal fe'l 'can' imkoniyatni bildiradi; 'with' predlogi vositani ko'rsatadi.

defEn: The words and grammar that people use to speak or write.
defUz: Odamlar gapirish yoki yozish uchun ishlatadigan so'zlar va grammatika, til.

examples.en: The English language is the language of business.
examples.uz: Ingliz tili tadbirkorlik tilidir.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'is' bog'lama fe'l; 'the language of business' - 'of' predlogi tegishlilikni bildiradi.

examples.en: She speaks three languages very well.
examples.uz: U uchta tilda juda yaxshi gapiradi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'speaks' uchinchi shaxs birlikda '-s' qo'shimchasi oladi; 'very well' - ravish.

defEn: A period of time when a teacher teaches students.
defUz: O'qituvchi o'quvchilarga dars o'tadigan vaqt oralig'i.

examples.en: Our Maths lesson can be quite boring sometimes.
examples.uz: Matematika darsimiz ba'zida ancha zerikarli
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'can be' modal 'can' + bog'lama; 'quite' va 'sometimes' - ravishlar darajani va chastotani bildiradi.

examples.en: Our English lesson starts at nine o'clock.
examples.uz: Bizning ingliz tili darsimiz soat to'qqizda boshlanadi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'starts' uchinchi shaxs birlikda '-s' oladi; 'at nine o'clock' - predlog vaqtni bildiradi.

defEn: A place where you can read or borrow books.
defUz: Kitob o'qish yoki ijaraga olish mumkin bo'lgan joy, kutubxona.

examples.en: We can borrow three books from the library every week.
examples.uz: Kutubxonadan har haftada uchta
examples.grammar: Modal fe'l 'can' imkoniyatni bildiradi; 'from the library' - predlog manbani; 'every week' - chastotani bildiradi.

examples.en: I go to the library to study after school.
examples.uz: Men darsdan keyin o'qish uchun kutubxonaga boraman.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'go' odatiy harakatni bildiradi; 'to study' - infinitiv maqsadni ko'rsatadi.

defEn: A book with empty pages where you write notes.
defUz: Yozuvlar yozish uchun bo'sh varaqli kitob, daftar.

examples.en: Write down these nouns in your notebooks.
examples.uz: Ushbu otlarni daftarlaringizga yozib oling.
examples.grammar: Buyruq gap - 'Write down' phrasal fe'l; 'in your notebooks' - 'in' predlogi joyni, 'your' egalik olmoshini bildiradi.

examples.en: I keep all my notes in one notebook.
examples.uz: Men barcha yozuvlarimni bitta daftarda saqlayman.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'keep' odatiy harakatni bildiradi; 'in one notebook' - predlog joyni bildiradi.

defEn: A piece of work that you study and plan over a period of time.
defUz: Ma'lum vaqt davomida o'rganib, rejalashtirib bajariladigan ish, loyiha.

examples.en: Ivan is doing a project on growing fruit this term.
examples.uz: Ivan ushbu chorakda meva o'stirish ustida
examples.grammar: Present Continuous - 'is doing' hozir davom etayotgan ishni bildiradi; 'on' predlogi mavzuni, 'this term' vaqtni bildiradi.

examples.en: We are working on a project about animals.
examples.uz: Biz hayvonlar haqidagi loyiha ustida ishlayapmiz.
examples.grammar: Present Continuous - 'are working' hozir davom etayotgan ishni bildiradi; 'about' predlog mavzuni ko'rsatadi.

defEn: A child who goes to school.
defUz: Maktabga qatnaydigan bola, maktab o'quvchisi.

examples.en: All the pupils in the class helped to get the class ready for parents' evening.
examples.uz: Sinfdagi barcha
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'helped'; 'to get the class ready' - 'to' infinitiv maqsadni; 'parents'' - egalik (ko'plik) shaklini bildiradi.

examples.en: Every pupil in the class has a new book.
examples.uz: Sinfdagi har bir o'quvchining yangi kitobi bor.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'has' egalikni bildiradi; 'every pupil' - birlik ot, fe'l ham birlikda keladi.

uz: o'quvchining baholari to'g'risidagi hisobot (maktabda) · ma'lum qilmoq, xabar bermoq
defEn: A written note about how well a student is doing at school.
defUz: O'quvchining maktabdagi natijalari haqidagi yozma hisobot.

examples.en: Peter's parents were pleased with his report
examples.uz: he got all A's! – Piterning ota-onasi uning baholari
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'were pleased'; 'pleased with' - sifat + 'with' predlogi munosabatni bildiradi.

examples.en: My teacher wrote a good report about my work.
examples.uz: O'qituvchim mening ishim haqida yaxshi hisobot yozdi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'wrote' o'tgan zamonda; 'about' predlog mavzuni bildiradi.

examples.en: The newspaper reported the discovery of a 1000-year-old sword.
examples.uz: Gazeta 1000 yillik qilich
examples.grammar: 'ot + the + ot + of + something' - biror narsa haqida xabar berishni bildiradi - Past Simple.

examples.en: The radio reported heavy rain across the country.
examples.uz: Radio butun mamlakat bo'ylab kuchli yomg'ir haqida xabar berdi.
examples.grammar: 'ot + something' - xabar berishni bildiradi - Past Simple.

defEn: A visit to a place that students make together with their school.
defUz: O'quvchilarning maktab bilan birga biror joyga uyushtirgan sayohati.

examples.en: The class went on a school trip to the science museum.
examples.uz: Sinf maktab tomonidan ilm-fan
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'went'; 'go on a trip' - turg'un ibora; 'to the science museum' - predlog yo'nalishni bildiradi.

examples.en: We went on a school trip to the zoo last Friday.
examples.uz: Biz o'tgan juma kuni hayvonot bog'iga maktab sayohatiga bordik.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'went' o'tgan zamonda; 'last Friday' - o'tgan vaqtni bildiruvchi ifoda.

defEn: The special clothes that all students at a school must wear.
defUz: Maktabdagi barcha o'quvchilar kiyishi shart bo'lgan maxsus kiyim, forma.

examples.en: The school uniform is black trousers, a white shirt and a blue tie.
examples.uz: Maktab formasi qora shim, oq
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'is' bog'lama fe'l; 'a white shirt and a blue tie' - 'a' artikli birlikda sanaladigan otni bildiradi.

examples.en: I wear my school uniform every day.
examples.uz: Men maktab formamni har kuni kiyaman.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'wear' odatiy harakatni bildiradi; 'every day' - chastotani bildiruvchi ifoda.

uz: o'quvchi: maktab o'quvchisi, universitet o'quvchisi, o'quv markazida biror narsa o'rganadigan o'quvchi, istalgan turdagi o'quvchi
defEn: A person who studies at a school, college or university.
defUz: Maktab, kollej yoki universitetda tahsil oladigan kishi, o'quvchi.

examples.en: There are thirty students in my class.
examples.uz: Mening sinfimda o'ttiz nafar o'quvchi bor.
examples.grammar: 'There are + ko'plik ot' - mavjudlikni bildiradi; 'in my class' - predlog joyni bildiradi.

examples.en: The students listened to the teacher carefully.
examples.uz: O'quvchilar o'qituvchini diqqat bilan tingladilar.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'listened' o'tgan zamonda; 'carefully' - tarz ravishi.

defEn: The school subject that studies living things.
defUz: Tirik mavjudotlarni o'rganadigan maktab fani, biologiya.

examples.en: The Biology teacher is telling us about how plants grow.
examples.uz: Biologiya o'qituvchisi bizga o'simliklar
examples.grammar: Present Continuous - 'is telling' hozir davom etayotgan ishni bildiradi; 'about how plants grow' - ergash gap.

examples.en: In Biology we learn about plants and animals.
examples.uz: Biologiya darsida biz o'simliklar va hayvonlar haqida o'rganamiz.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'learn' odatiy harakatni bildiradi; 'about' predlog mavzuni bildiradi.

defEn: The school subject that studies what things are made of.
defUz: Narsalar nimadan tashkil topganini o'rganadigan maktab fani, kimyo.

examples.en: Do you do real experiments in Chemistry?
examples.uz: Kimyo darsida haqiqiy tajribalar o'tkazasizlarmi?
examples.grammar: So'roq gap - Present Simple, 'do you do' yordamchi 'do' bilan tuziladi; 'in Chemistry' predlog fanni bildiradi.

examples.en: We mixed two liquids together in Chemistry today.
examples.uz: Biz bugun kimyo darsida ikki suyuqlikni aralashtirdik.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'mixed' o'tgan zamonda; 'together' - ravish harakat tarzini bildiradi.

defEn: The school subject that studies countries, oceans and the Earth.
defUz: Mamlakatlar, okeanlar va Yerni o'rganadigan maktab fani, geografiya.

examples.en: I'm learning the capital cities of the world for a Geography test.
examples.uz: Men geografiya fanidan test
examples.grammar: Present Continuous - 'am learning' hozir davom etayotgan ishni bildiradi; 'for a Geography test' - predlog maqsadni bildiradi.

examples.en: We looked at a map of Europe in Geography.
examples.uz: Biz geografiya darsida Yevropa xaritasini ko'rib chiqdik.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'looked at' phrasal fe'l o'tgan zamonda; 'of Europe' - 'of' predlogi tegishlilikni bildiradi.

defEn: The school subject that studies the past.
defUz: O'tmishni o'rganadigan maktab fani, tarix.

examples.en: We're doing the Second World War in History at the moment.
examples.uz: Ayni damda tarix darsida
examples.grammar: Present Continuous - 'are doing' hozir o'rganilayotgan mavzuni bildiradi; 'at the moment' - hozirgi vaqtni bildiruvchi ifoda.

examples.en: In History we learned about old kings and queens.
examples.uz: Tarix darsida biz qadimgi shohlar va malikalar haqida o'rgandik.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'learned' o'tgan zamonda; 'about' predlog mavzuni bildiradi.

defEn: The school subject about using computers.
defUz: Kompyuterlardan foydalanish o'rgatiladigan maktab fani, informatika.

examples.en: Do you learn how to program in IT?
examples.uz: Informatika texnologiyalari fanida qanday qilib
examples.grammar: So'roq gap - Present Simple, 'do you learn' yordamchi 'do' bilan; 'how to program' - so'roq so'z + infinitiv usulni bildiradi.

examples.en: We made a simple website in IT class.
examples.uz: Biz informatika darsida oddiy veb-sayt yaratdik.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'made' o'tgan zamonda; 'simple' - ot oldidan kelgan sifat.

defEn: The school subject of reading and studying books and poems.
defUz: Kitoblar va she'rlarni o'qib o'rganadigan maktab fani, adabiyot.

examples.en: We are studying Tolstoy's Anna Karenina in Literature.
examples.uz: Adabiyot fanida Tolstoyning Anna
examples.grammar: Present Continuous - 'are studying' hozir davom etayotgan ishni bildiradi; 'Tolstoy's' - egalik (apostrof + s) shaklini bildiradi.

examples.en: We read a famous poem in Literature this week.
examples.uz: Biz bu hafta adabiyot darsida mashhur she'rni o'qidik.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'read' fe'lining o'tgan zamon shakli; 'this week' - vaqtni bildiruvchi ifoda.

defEn: The school subject of numbers and shapes.
defUz: Sonlar va shakllarni o'rganadigan maktab fani, matematika.

examples.en: We did some geometry in Maths today.
examples.uz: Bugun matematika darsida biroz geometriya
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'did'; 'some geometry' - 'some' sanab bo'lmaydigan otdan oldin noaniq miqdorni bildiradi; 'in Maths' predlog fanni bildiradi.

examples.en: I am good at Maths and I like numbers.
examples.uz: Men matematikadan zo'rman va sonlarni yaxshi ko'raman.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'am good at' sifat + 'at' predlogi mahoratni bildiradi; 'and' - bog'lovchi.

defEn: The school subject of sport and exercise.
defUz: Sport va jismoniy mashqlar o'rgatiladigan maktab fani, jismoniy tarbiya.

examples.en: In PE today, we played a game of football.
examples.uz: Bugun jismoniy tarbiya darsida biz futbol o'ynadik.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'played'; 'In PE today' - boshda kelgan predlog joy va vaqtni bildiradi; 'a game of football' - 'of' predlogi tur ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: We ran around the field in PE today.
examples.uz: Biz bugun jismoniy tarbiya darsida maydon bo'ylab yugurdik.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'ran' fe'lining o'tgan zamon shakli; 'around' predlog yo'nalishni bildiradi.

defEn: The school subject that studies energy, light and movement.
defUz: Energiya, yorug'lik va harakatni o'rganadigan maktab fani, fizika.

examples.en: I'm learning Newton's laws for my Physics test.
examples.uz: Men fizika fanidan testim uchun Nyuton
examples.grammar: Present Continuous - 'am learning' hozir davom etayotgan ishni bildiradi; 'for my Physics test' - predlog maqsadni bildiradi.

examples.en: In Physics we learned how light moves.
examples.uz: Fizika darsida biz yorug'lik qanday harakatlanishini o'rgandik.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'learned' o'tgan zamonda; 'how light moves' - ergash gap.

defEn: The school subject that studies religions.
defUz: Dinlarni o'rganadigan maktab fani, diniy ta'lim asoslari.

examples.en: We learned about the life of the Prophet (PBUH) in RE today.
examples.uz: Bugun diniy ta'lim asoslari
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'learned'; 'about the life of the Prophet' - 'about' predlogi mavzuni, 'of' predlogi tegishlilikni bildiradi.

examples.en: We talked about kindness in RE today.
examples.uz: Biz bugun diniy ta'lim asoslari darsida mehribonlik haqida gaplashdik.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'talked' o'tgan zamonda; 'about' predlog mavzuni bildiradi.

defEn: The school subject that studies how people live in society.
defUz: Insonlarning jamiyatda qanday yashashini o'rganadigan maktab fani.

examples.en: Social Science teaches us how people live with one another.
examples.uz: Sotsiologiya fani bizga insonlar bir-
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'teaches' uchinchi shaxs birlikda '-es' oladi; 'how people live with one another' - ergash gap.

examples.en: In Social Science we learn about families and communities.
examples.uz: Sotsiologiya darsida biz oilalar va jamoalar haqida o'rganamiz.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'learn' odatiy harakatni bildiradi; 'and' - bog'lovchi ikki otni bog'laydi.

defEn: One of the periods that the school year is divided into.
defUz: O'quv yili bo'lingan davrlardan biri, chorak.

examples.en: At the end of Christmas term, we always give our teacher a present.
examples.uz: Rojdestvo choragining
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'give'; 'At the end of ... term' - 'of' predlogi tegishlilikni bildiradi; 'always' - chastota ravishi.

examples.en: We have a long holiday at the end of the term.
examples.uz: Chorak oxirida bizda uzoq ta'til bo'ladi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'have' egalik va mavjudlikni bildiradi; 'at the end of' - predlogli ibora vaqtni bildiradi.

defEn: A list that shows when each lesson happens during the week.
defUz: Hafta davomida har bir dars qachon bo'lishini ko'rsatuvchi jadval.

examples.en: Ronny's timetable is hard on Tuesdays
examples.uz: he has Maths and Physics. – Seshanba kunlari Ro'nining
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'is' bog'lama fe'l; 'on Tuesdays' - 'on' predlogi takrorlanuvchi kun uchun ishlatiladi (ko'plik shakli).

examples.en: I check my timetable to know my next lesson.
examples.uz: Men keyingi darsimni bilish uchun jadvalimni tekshiraman.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'check' odatiy harakatni bildiradi; 'to know' - infinitiv maqsadni ko'rsatadi.

defEn: To say or write a reply to a question.
defUz: Savolga og'zaki yoki yozma javob bermoq.

examples.en: You haven't answered my question.
examples.uz: Mening savolimga javob bermadingiz.
examples.grammar: Present Perfect - 'haven't answered' yaqin o'tmishdagi tugallanmagan natijani inkor bilan bildiradi.

examples.en: She answered every question in the test correctly.
examples.uz: U testdagi har bir savolga to'g'ri javob berdi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'answered' o'tgan zamonda; 'correctly' - tarz ravishi.

defEn: To not pass a test or exam.
defUz: Test yoki imtihondan o'ta olmaslik, yiqilmoq.

examples.en: Students who fail the test must take it again.
examples.uz: Imtihondan yiqilgan o'quvchilar uni qayta
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'fail'; 'Students who fail the test' - 'who' bilan boshlangan ergash gap; modal 'must' majburiyatni bildiradi.

examples.en: He failed the exam because he did not study.
examples.uz: U o'qimagani uchun imtihondan yiqildi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'failed' o'tgan zamonda; 'because' - bog'lovchi sababni bildiradi.

defEn: To have information about something in your mind.
defUz: Biror narsa haqida ma'lumotga ega bo'lmoq, bilmoq.

examples.en: I don't know the answer to that question.
examples.uz: U savolga javobni bilmayman.
examples.grammar: Present Simple inkor - 'don't know' yordamchi 'do' + 'not' bilan tuziladi; 'to that question' - predlog yo'nalishni bildiradi.

examples.en: I know the answer to this question.
examples.uz: Men bu savolning javobini bilaman.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'know' holatni bildiruvchi fe'l; 'to this question' - predlog tegishlilikni bildiradi.

defEn: To get new knowledge or a new skill.
defUz: Yangi bilim yoki yangi ko'nikma egallamoq, o'rganmoq.

examples.en: Our teacher makes us learn ten new verbs every week.
examples.uz: O'qituvchimiz bizni har hafta o'nta
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'makes'; 'make somebody do' - majburlash konstruksiyasi; 'every week' - chastotani bildiradi.

examples.en: I want to learn how to speak French.
examples.uz: Men frantsuzcha gapirishni o'rganmoqchiman.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'want' istakni bildiradi; 'to learn' - infinitiv niyatni ko'rsatadi.

defEn: To check and grade a student's work.
defUz: O'quvchining ishini tekshirib, baho qo'ymoq.

examples.en: If you don't hand your homework in on time, I won't mark it.
examples.uz: Agar uyga vazifangizni o'z vaqtida
examples.grammar: Shart mayli - 'If you don't hand ... in, I won't mark it' - birinchi tip shart gap (Present Simple + Future 'will').

examples.en: The teacher marked all our tests last night.
examples.uz: O'qituvchi kecha bizning barcha testlarimizni baholadi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'marked' o'tgan zamonda; 'last night' - o'tgan vaqtni bildiruvchi ifoda.

defEn: To find things that go together.
defUz: Bir-biriga mos keladigan narsalarni topmoq.

examples.en: The exercise asks students to match pictures to vocabulary.
examples.uz: Ushbu mashq o'quvchilardan
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'asks'; 'ask somebody to do' konstruksiyasi; 'match pictures to vocabulary' - 'to' predlogi moslikni bildiradi.

examples.en: Match each word with the correct picture.
examples.uz: Har bir so'zni to'g'ri rasmga moslang.
examples.grammar: Buyruq gap - 'Match' fe'li bilan boshlanadi; 'with' predlogi moslikni bildiradi.

examples.en: I bought you a blue tie to match your eyes.
examples.uz: Sizni ko'zlaringizga mos tushadigan bir moviy rangli
examples.grammar: 'bought + you + a + sifat + ot + to match + egalik + ko'plik ot' - Past Simple, 'to match' maqsad infinitivi.

examples.en: Her shoes match her handbag perfectly.
examples.uz: Uning oyoq kiyimi sumkasiga juda yaxshi mos tushadi.
examples.grammar: 'ega + match + egalik + ot + perfectly' - Present Simple, 'perfectly' tarz ravishi fe'lni izohlaydi.

defEn: To have a particular meaning.
defUz: Muayyan ma'noga ega bo'lmoq, anglatmoq.

examples.en: Find out what the word means by looking it up in a dictionary.
examples.uz: Lug'atdan qidirish orqali, so'z
examples.grammar: Buyruq gap - 'Find out' phrasal fe'l; 'what the word means' - ergash gap; 'by looking it up' - 'by + -ing' usulni bildiradi.

examples.en: What does this new word mean?
examples.uz: Bu yangi so'z nimani anglatadi?
examples.grammar: So'roq gap - Present Simple, 'does' yordamchi fe'l bilan tuziladi; 'mean' asosiy fe'l.

defEn: To be successful in a test or exam.
defUz: Test yoki imtihondan muvaffaqiyatli o'tmoq.

examples.en: If I pass all my exams, my mum will buy me a new jacket.
examples.uz: Agar hamma imtihonlarimdan
examples.grammar: Shart mayli - 'If I pass ..., my mum will buy ...' - birinchi tip shart gap (Present Simple + Future 'will').

examples.en: She passed her Maths exam with a high mark.
examples.uz: U matematika imtihonidan yuqori baho bilan o'tdi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'passed' o'tgan zamonda; 'with' predlogi tarzni bildiradi.

defEn: To look at words and understand them.
defUz: So'zlarga qarab, ularni tushunmoq, o'qimoq.

examples.en: I love to read comics and magazines.
examples.uz: Men ko'mik kitoblar va jurnallar o'qishni yoqtiraman.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'love'; 'love to read' - fe'l + infinitiv yoqtirishni bildiradi; 'comics and magazines' - 'and' bog'lovchi.

examples.en: She reads a book every evening before bed.
examples.uz: U har oqshom uxlashdan oldin kitob o'qiydi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'reads' uchinchi shaxs birlikda '-s' oladi; 'before' predlog vaqtni bildiradi.

defEn: To keep something in your mind and not forget it.
defUz: Biror narsani yodda saqlab, unutmaslik, eslab qolmoq.

examples.en: We have to remember a lot of important dates for the History exam.
examples.uz: Tarix imtihoni uchun juda
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'have to remember' - 'have to' majburiyatni bildiradi; 'for the History exam' - predlog maqsadni bildiradi.

examples.en: I always remember my friend's birthday.
examples.uz: Men do'stimning tug'ilgan kunini doim eslab qolaman.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'remember' holatni bildiruvchi fe'l; 'always' - chastota ravishi.

defEn: To help someone learn something.
defUz: Birovga biror narsani o'rganishda yordam bermoq, o'rgatmoq.

examples.en: Our English teacher taught us the past tenses today.
examples.uz: Ingliz tili o'qituvchimiz bugun bizga o'tgan
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'taught' 'teach' fe'lining o'tgan zamon shakli; 'taught us the past tenses' - ikki to'ldiruvchili konstruksiya.

examples.en: My father teaches Maths at a big school.
examples.uz: Mening otam katta maktabda matematikadan dars beradi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'teaches' uchinchi shaxs birlikda '-es' oladi; 'at' predlog joyni bildiradi.

defEn: To put a small check mark next to something.
defUz: Biror narsaning yoniga belgi qo'ymoq.

examples.en: Please tick the appropriate box.
examples.uz: Iltimos, tegishli katakchani belgilang.
examples.grammar: Buyruq gap - 'tick' fe'li bilan boshlanadi; 'Please' - xushmuomalalik so'zi; 'the appropriate box' - aniq artikl 'the'.

examples.en: Tick the correct answer on the page.
examples.uz: Sahifadagi to'g'ri javobni belgilang.
examples.grammar: Buyruq gap - 'Tick' fe'li bilan boshlanadi; 'on the page' - predlog joyni bildiradi.

defEn: To know what something means.
defUz: Biror narsaning ma'nosini bilmoq, tushunmoq.

examples.en: I still don't understand how to make programs in IT.
examples.uz: Men hali-hanuz informatika
examples.grammar: Present Simple inkor - 'don't understand' yordamchi 'do' + 'not' bilan; 'how to make programs' - so'roq so'z + infinitiv usulni bildiradi.

examples.en: I understand the lesson very well now.
examples.uz: Men endi darsni juda yaxshi tushunaman.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'understand' holatni bildiruvchi fe'l; 'now' - vaqtni bildiruvchi ravish.

defEn: To make words or letters with a pen or pencil.
defUz: Ruchka yoki qalam bilan so'z yoki harf yozmoq.

examples.en: We have to write an essay discussing a book we read in Literature.
examples.uz: Adabiyot darsida o'qigan
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'have to write' - 'have to' majburiyatni bildiradi; 'discussing a book' - sifatdosh ('-ing') otni aniqlaydi.

examples.en: I write a letter to my grandmother every month.
examples.uz: Men har oy buvimga xat yozaman.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'write' odatiy harakatni bildiradi; 'to my grandmother' - predlog yo'nalishni bildiradi.

examples.en: I wanted to travel and then write about it.
examples.uz: Men sayohat qilishni va keyin bu haqida yozishni
examples.grammar: 'I wanted to travel and then write about it' - Past Simple ('wanted'); 'to travel and ... write' - infinitivlar 'and' bog'lovchisi bilan; 'about it' - predlogli holat.

examples.en: I write an email to my teacher every Monday.
examples.uz: Men har dushanba o'qituvchimga email yozaman.
examples.grammar: 'write' - Present Simple; 'to' - predlog yo'nalishni bildiradi; 'every Monday' - takrorlanish holi.

uz: biror xatoni ustidan o'chirmoq (x chiziq chizmoq)
defEn: To draw a line through something to remove it.
defUz: Biror narsani o'chirish uchun ustidan chiziq tortmoq.

examples.en: When you make a mistake, just cross it out neatly.
examples.uz: Xatoga yo'l qo'yganingizda, shunchaki uni
examples.grammar: Buyruq gap - 'When you make a mistake' ergash gap, asosiy gap 'cross it out' phrasal fe'l bilan; 'neatly' - tarz ravishi.

examples.en: Cross out the wrong word and write the right one.
examples.uz: Noto'g'ri so'zni o'chirib tashlang va to'g'risini yozing.
examples.grammar: Buyruq gap - 'Cross out' phrasal fe'l bilan boshlanadi; 'and' - bog'lovchi ikki buyruqni bog'laydi.

defEn: To give your work to a teacher.
defUz: Ishingizni o'qituvchiga topshirmoq.

examples.en: Hand in your homework to me at the end of the lesson.
examples.uz: Dars yakunida uyga vazifangizni menga
examples.grammar: Buyruq gap - 'Hand in' phrasal fe'l; 'to me' - predlog yo'nalishni; 'at the end of the lesson' - predlogli ibora vaqtni bildiradi.

examples.en: Please hand in your essays before Friday.
examples.uz: Iltimos, insholaringizni jumagacha topshiring.
examples.grammar: Buyruq gap - 'hand in' phrasal fe'l; 'before Friday' - predlog vaqt chegarasini bildiradi.

defEn: To give something to each person in a group.
defUz: Guruhdagi har bir kishiga biror narsa bermoq, tarqatmoq.

examples.en: The teacher handed out exam papers to the class.
examples.uz: O'qituvchi imtihon varaqalarini sinfga
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'handed out' phrasal fe'l o'tgan zamonda; 'to the class' - predlog yo'nalishni bildiradi.

examples.en: The teacher handed out new books to all the students.
examples.uz: O'qituvchi barcha o'quvchilarga yangi kitoblarni tarqatdi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'handed out' phrasal fe'l o'tgan zamonda; 'to all the students' - predlog yo'nalishni bildiradi.

defEn: To raise your hand to speak in class.
defUz: Darsda gapirish uchun qo'lingizni ko'tarmoq.

examples.en: Put up your hand if you know the answer
examples.uz: don't shout it out. – Agar javobni bilsangiz, qo'lingizni
examples.grammar: Buyruq gap - 'Put up' phrasal fe'l; 'if you know the answer' - shart bildiruvchi ergash gap (Present Simple).

examples.en: Put up your hand if you want to ask a question.
examples.uz: Agar savol bermoqchi bo'lsangiz, qo'lingizni ko'taring.
examples.grammar: Buyruq gap - 'Put up' phrasal fe'l; 'if' - shart bog'lovchisi ergash gapni boshlaydi.

defEn: To remove something written with a rubber.
defUz: Yozilgan narsani o'chirg'ich bilan o'chirmoq.

examples.en: Rub out the word that is spelled wrong and write it correctly.
examples.uz: Noto'g'ri harflar bilan yozilgan
examples.grammar: Buyruq gap - 'Rub out' phrasal fe'l; 'that is spelled wrong' - 'that' bilan boshlangan ergash gap; 'and write it' - 'and' bog'lovchi.

examples.en: Rub out the answer and try again.
examples.uz: Javobni o'chiring va qaytadan urinib ko'ring.
examples.grammar: Buyruq gap - 'Rub out' phrasal fe'l; 'and' - bog'lovchi ikki buyruqni bog'laydi.

defEn: To write something on paper so you do not forget it.
defUz: Unutmaslik uchun biror narsani qog'ozga yozib qo'ymoq.

examples.en: Write down these adjectives in your notebooks.
examples.uz: Ushbu sifatlarni daftarlaringizga yozib oling.
examples.grammar: Buyruq gap - 'Write down' phrasal fe'l; 'these adjectives' - 'these' ko'rsatish olmoshi (ko'plik); 'in your notebooks' - predlog joyni bildiradi.

examples.en: Write down the new words in your notebook.
examples.uz: Yangi so'zlarni daftaringizga yozib oling.
examples.grammar: Buyruq gap - 'Write down' phrasal fe'l; 'in your notebook' - predlog joyni bildiradi.

defEn: To get to school.
defUz: Maktabga yetib bormoq.

examples.en: I arrive at school at nine in the morning.
examples.uz: Men maktabga tonggi soat 9 da yetib boraman.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'arrive'; 'arrive at school' - 'at' predlogi joyni; 'at nine in the morning' - vaqtni bildiradi.

examples.en: We arrive at school early on Mondays.
examples.uz: Biz dushanba kunlari maktabga erta yetib boramiz.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'arrive' odatiy harakatni bildiradi; 'on Mondays' - takrorlanuvchi kunni bildiradi.

defEn: During the short rest between lessons.
defUz: Darslar orasidagi qisqa dam olish vaqtida.

examples.en: At breaktime, my friends and I usually play football.
examples.uz: Tanaffus vaqtida, do'stlarim va men
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'play'; 'At breaktime' boshda kelgan predlogli ibora vaqtni; 'usually' - chastota ravishi.

examples.en: At breaktime, we eat a snack in the yard.
examples.uz: Tanaffus vaqtida biz hovlida yengil tamaddi qilamiz.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'eat' odatiy harakatni bildiradi; 'in the yard' - predlog joyni bildiradi.

defEn: To do something wrong, or to fix what is wrong.
defUz: Xato qilmoq yoki xatoni to'g'rilamoq.

examples.en: I made a mistake and answered the wrong question in the exam.
examples.uz: Men xatoga yo'l qo'ydim va
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'made' va 'answered'; 'made a mistake' - turg'un ibora; 'and' bog'lovchi ikki harakatni bog'laydi.

examples.en: I made a mistake, but the teacher helped me correct it.
examples.uz: Men xato qildim, ammo o'qituvchi uni to'g'rilashga yordam berdi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'made' va 'helped' o'tgan zamonda; 'but' - bog'lovchi qarama-qarshilikni bildiradi.

defEn: To complete the work a teacher gives you for home.
defUz: O'qituvchi uyga bergan vazifani bajarmoq.

examples.en: Do you do your homework as soon as you get home?
examples.uz: Uyga yetib borishingiz bilanoq uyga
examples.grammar: So'roq gap - Present Simple, 'do you do' yordamchi 'do' bilan; 'as soon as you get home' - vaqt bildiruvchi ergash gap.

examples.en: I do my homework every evening after dinner.
examples.uz: Men har oqshom kechki ovqatdan keyin uy vazifamni bajaraman.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'do' odatiy harakatni bildiradi; 'after dinner' - predlog vaqtni bildiradi.

defEn: To try as hard as you can.
defUz: Qo'lingizdan kelganicha harakat qilmoq.

examples.en: You don't have to get the top mark
examples.uz: just do your best. – Eng yuqori bahoni olishingiz shart emas–
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'don't have to get' inkor majburiyatni bildiradi; 'just do your best' - buyruq gap turg'un ibora bilan.

examples.en: Just do your best in the exam and do not worry.
examples.uz: Imtihonda qo'lingizdan kelganicha harakat qiling va xavotir olmang.
examples.grammar: Buyruq gap - 'do your best' turg'un ibora; 'and' bog'lovchi ikki buyruqni bog'laydi.

defEn: To take someone to school by car.
defUz: Birovni maktabga mashinada olib bormoq.

examples.en: Does your mother drive you to school every morning?
examples.uz: Har tongda onangiz sizni maktabga
examples.grammar: So'roq gap - Present Simple, 'Does your mother drive' yordamchi 'does' bilan; 'to school' predlog yo'nalishni bildiradi.

examples.en: My father drives me to school when it rains.
examples.uz: Yomg'ir yog'ganda otam meni maktabga mashinada olib boradi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'drives' uchinchi shaxs birlikda '-s' oladi; 'when' - vaqt bog'lovchisi ergash gapni boshlaydi.

defEn: To take a rest, or to take part in a class.
defUz: Dam olmoq yoki darsda qatnashmoq.

examples.en: They have a lesson with Mrs Evans at two o'clock.
examples.uz: Soat ikkida ularning Evens xonim bilan
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'have'; 'have a lesson' turg'un ibora; 'with Mrs Evans' - predlog hamrohlikni; 'at two o'clock' vaqtni bildiradi.

examples.en: We have a short break after the first lesson.
examples.uz: Birinchi darsdan keyin bizda qisqa tanaffus bo'ladi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'have' mavjudlikni bildiradi; 'after' - predlog vaqtni bildiradi.

defEn: Written with a pen or with a pencil.
defUz: Ruchka yoki qalam bilan yozilgan.

examples.en: When you write in ink, you can't rub out your mistakes.
examples.uz: Ruchkada yozganingizda, xatolaringizni
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'When you write in ink' ergash gap; asosiy gapda 'can't rub out' modal 'can' inkori imkonsizlikni bildiradi.

examples.en: Please write your name in ink, not in pencil.
examples.uz: Iltimos, ismingizni qalamda emas, ruchkada yozing.
examples.grammar: Buyruq gap - 'write' fe'li bilan; 'in ink' va 'in pencil' - predloglar vositani bildiradi.

defEn: To listen and watch carefully.
defUz: Diqqat bilan tinglab va kuzatmoq, e'tibor bermoq.

examples.en: I didn't pay attention to the teacher in class, so I couldn't do my homework.
examples.uz: Darsda men
examples.grammar: Past Simple inkor - 'didn't pay attention'; 'pay attention to' turg'un ibora; 'so' - natija bog'lovchisi.

examples.en: Please pay attention to the teacher during the lesson.
examples.uz: Iltimos, dars davomida o'qituvchiga e'tibor bering.
examples.grammar: Buyruq gap - 'pay attention to' turg'un ibora; 'during' - predlog vaqtni bildiradi.

uz: davomat qilmoq, yo'qlama qilmoq, o'quvchi kelgan yoki kelmaganini belgilamoq 32                                                                   @destination_vocabulary
defEn: To check which students are present in class.
defUz: Sinfda qaysi o'quvchilar borligini tekshirmoq, yo'qlama qilmoq.

examples.en: The teacher takes the register every morning to see who's absent.
examples.uz: O'qituvchi kim darsda yo'q
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'takes' uchinchi shaxs birlikda '-s' oladi; 'to see who's absent' - 'to' infinitiv maqsadni bildiradi.

examples.en: Our teacher takes the register at the start of the lesson.
examples.uz: O'qituvchimiz dars boshida yo'qlama qiladi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'takes' uchinchi shaxs birlikda '-s' oladi; 'at the start of' - predlogli ibora vaqtni bildiradi.

defEn: Not at school or not in a place.
defUz: Maktabda yoki biror joyda yo'q bo'lgan, kelmagan.

examples.en: Carl was absent from school again today
examples.uz: is he sick? – Karl bugun yana maktabga kelmadi–u
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'was absent'; 'absent from school' - sifat + 'from' predlogi; 'again' va 'today' - vaqtni bildiruvchi ravishlar.

examples.en: Three students were absent from class today.
examples.uz: Bugun uchta o'quvchi darsga kelmadi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'were absent' o'tgan zamonda; 'from class' - sifatdan keyingi predlog.

defEn: Hard to understand because there are many parts.
defUz: Ko'p qismlardan iborat bo'lgani uchun tushunish qiyin, murakkab.

examples.en: A good teacher knows how to explain a complicated subject simply.
examples.uz: Yaxshi o'qituvchi qanday
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'knows'; 'how to explain' - so'roq so'z + infinitiv usulni bildiradi; 'complicated' - 'subject' otini aniqlaydi.

examples.en: This Maths problem is too complicated for me.
examples.uz: Bu matematika masalasi men uchun juda ham murakkab.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'is' bog'lama fe'l; 'too' - sifatdan oldin kelgan kuchaytiruvchi ravish.

defEn: The one that you like the most.
defUz: Eng yoqtiradiganingiz, sevimli.

examples.en: English is my favourite subject
examples.uz: I love it! – Ingliz tili mening sevimli fanim–u menga yoqadi!
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'is'; 'my favourite subject' - egalik olmoshi + sifat + ot tartibi.

examples.en: History is my favourite subject at school.
examples.uz: Tarix maktabdagi eng sevimli fanimdir.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'is' bog'lama fe'l; 'favourite' - 'subject' otini aniqlovchi sifat.

defEn: Having a big effect or a lot of value.
defUz: Katta ahamiyatga yoki qadrga ega bo'lgan, muhim.

examples.en: Catherine the Great is an important figure in Russian history.
examples.uz: Buyuk Kasrin Rossiya tarixida
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'is'; 'an important figure' - 'an' artikli unli tovush oldidan; 'in Russian history' - predlog sohani bildiradi.

examples.en: It is important to do your homework every day.
examples.uz: Har kuni uy vazifangizni bajarish muhim.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'is important' bog'lama + sifat; 'to do' - infinitiv mavhum ish-harakatni bildiradi.

defEn: Able to learn and understand things well.
defUz: Narsalarni yaxshi o'rganadigan va tushunadigan, aqlli.

examples.en: John's intelligent and always gets high marks.
examples.uz: Jo'n zukko va u doim yuqori baholar oladi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'is intelligent' bog'lama + sifat; 'and always gets' - 'and' bog'lovchi, 'always' chastota ravishi.

examples.en: She is a very intelligent student in our class.
examples.uz: U bizning sinfimizdagi juda aqlli o'quvchi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'is' bog'lama fe'l; 'very' - sifatdan oldin kelgan kuchaytiruvchi ravish.

defEn: Correct or true.
defUz: To'g'ri yoki haqiqatga mos.

examples.en: Does anyone know the right answer?
examples.uz: Kimdir to'g'ri javobni biladimi?
examples.grammar: So'roq gap - Present Simple, 'Does anyone know' yordamchi 'does' bilan; 'the right answer' - sifat + ot tartibi.

examples.en: You gave the right answer to the question.
examples.uz: Siz savolga to'g'ri javob berdingiz.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'gave' o'tgan zamonda; 'right' - 'answer' otini aniqlovchi sifat.

defEn: Bad or dangerous, not small.
defUz: Jiddiy, kichik bo'lmagan, xavfli.

examples.en: My best friend is sick today. I hope it's nothing serious.
examples.uz: Mening eng yaxshi do'stim bugun
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'is sick' va 'hope'; 'I hope it's nothing serious' - ergash gapda 'nothing + sifat' tartibi.

examples.en: The teacher had a serious talk with the noisy students.
examples.uz: O'qituvchi shovqin qilayotgan o'quvchilar bilan jiddiy suhbat o'tkazdi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'had' o'tgan zamonda; 'serious' - 'talk' otini aniqlovchi sifat.

defEn: Not correct or not true.
defUz: To'g'ri emas, noto'g'ri.

examples.en: I was so embarrassed when I gave the wrong answer to an easy question.
examples.uz: Oson savolga
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'was' va 'gave'; 'when I gave the wrong answer' - vaqt bildiruvchi ergash gap; 'so' - daraja ravishi.

examples.en: I wrote the wrong date on my homework.
examples.uz: Men uy vazifamga noto'g'ri sanani yozib qo'ydim.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'wrote' o'tgan zamonda; 'wrong' - 'date' otini aniqlovchi sifat.

defEn: Words that say you are sorry.
defUz: Kechirim so'rab aytilgan so'zlar, uzr.

examples.en: I think you should make an apology to your teacher for your rudeness.
examples.uz: O'ylashimcha,
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'should make' modal 'should' maslahatni bildiradi; 'make an apology to' - turg'un ibora, 'for' predlogi sababni bildiradi.

examples.en: He wrote a short apology to his teacher.
examples.uz: U o'qituvchisiga qisqa uzr xati yozdi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'wrote' o'tgan zamonda; 'to his teacher' - predlog yo'nalishni bildiradi.

defEn: To say that you are sorry.
defUz: Kechirim so'ramoq, uzr so'ramoq.

examples.en: Why should I apologise?
examples.uz: Nima uchun men uzr so'rashim kerak?
examples.grammar: So'roq gap - modal 'should', 'Why should I apologise' tartibida; 'apologise' asosiy fe'l infinitiv shaklda.

examples.en: She apologised to her friend for being late.
examples.uz: U kechikkani uchun do'stidan uzr so'radi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'apologised' o'tgan zamonda; 'for being late' - 'for' predlogi sababni bildiradi.

defEn: To start something.
defUz: Biror narsani boshlamoq.

examples.en: I began piano lessons at the age of six.
examples.uz: Men olti yoshimda pianino saboqlarini boshlaganman.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'began' 'begin' fe'lining o'tgan zamon shakli; 'at the age of six' - predlogli ibora yoshni bildiradi.

examples.en: The lesson begins at eight o'clock every day.
examples.uz: Dars har kuni soat sakkizda boshlanadi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'begins' uchinchi shaxs birlikda '-s' oladi; 'at eight o'clock' - predlog vaqtni bildiradi.

uz: biror narsani o'rganishni endigina boshlagan odam 33                                                                   @destination_vocabulary
defEn: A person who is just starting to learn something.
defUz: Biror narsani endigina o'rganishni boshlagan kishi, boshlovchi.

examples.en: I'm only a beginner at tennis, so I'm not very good yet.
examples.uz: Tennisda bor yo'g'i boshlovchiman,
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'am' va 'am not'; 'only a beginner' - 'a' artikli birlik otni; 'so' - natija bog'lovchisi.

examples.en: He is a beginner, so the lessons are easy for him.
examples.uz: U boshlovchi, shuning uchun darslar u uchun oson.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'is' bog'lama fe'l; 'so' - natija bog'lovchisi ikki gapni bog'laydi.

defEn: The first part of something.
defUz: Biror narsaning birinchi qismi, boshlanish.

examples.en: Tell me the story from the beginning. How did it start?
examples.uz: Hikoyani boshidan aytib bering. U
examples.grammar: Buyruq gap - 'Tell me the story'; 'from the beginning' - predlog boshlanish nuqtasini bildiradi; ikkinchi gap so'roq gap.

examples.en: At the beginning of the lesson, the teacher took the register.
examples.uz: Dars boshlanishida o'qituvchi yo'qlama qildi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'took' o'tgan zamonda; 'At the beginning of' - predlogli ibora vaqtni bildiradi.

defEn: To make something right by changing it.
defUz: Biror narsani o'zgartirib to'g'rilamoq.

examples.en: Read through your work and correct any mistakes that you find.
examples.uz: Ishingizni o'qib chiqing va
examples.grammar: Buyruq gap - 'Read through' phrasal fe'l va 'correct'; 'any mistakes that you find' - 'that' bilan boshlangan ergash gap.

examples.en: The teacher corrected our spelling mistakes in red.
examples.uz: O'qituvchi imlo xatolarimizni qizil rangda to'g'riladi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'corrected' o'tgan zamonda; 'in red' - predlog tarzni bildiradi.

defEn: A change that makes something right.
defUz: Biror narsani to'g'ri qiladigan o'zgartirish, tuzatish.

examples.en: I've made a few small corrections to your report.
examples.uz: Hisobotingizga bir nechta kichik to'g'rilashlar
examples.grammar: Present Perfect - 'have made' yaqin o'tmishdagi natijani bildiradi; 'a few small corrections' - 'a few' ko'plik sanaladigan ot bilan.

examples.en: I made one small correction to my essay.
examples.uz: Men inshomga bitta kichik tuzatish kiritdim.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'made' o'tgan zamonda; 'to my essay' - predlog yo'nalishni bildiradi.

defEn: Not correct, wrong.
defUz: To'g'ri emas, noto'g'ri.

examples.en: That's incorrect, Martin
examples.uz: the right answer is 25. – Bu noto'g'ri, Martin–to'g'ri javob 25.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'That's incorrect' bog'lama + sifat; ikkinchi gap 'the right answer is 25' Present Simple.

examples.en: Your answer is incorrect, so please try again.
examples.uz: Sizning javobingiz noto'g'ri, shuning uchun qaytadan urinib ko'ring.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'is incorrect' bog'lama + sifat; 'so' - natija bog'lovchisi.

defEn: In the right way.
defUz: To'g'ri tarzda, to'g'ri qilib.

examples.en: A tick shows you answered the question correctly.
examples.uz: Ptichka belgisi ( ) savolga to'g'ri javob ✓
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'shows'; 'you answered the question correctly' - ergash gap, 'correctly' tarz ravishi fe'ldan keyin keladi.

examples.en: She answered all the questions correctly in the test.
examples.uz: U testdagi barcha savollarga to'g'ri javob berdi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'answered' o'tgan zamonda; 'correctly' - tarz ravishi fe'lni izohlaydi.

defEn: In the wrong way.
defUz: Noto'g'ri tarzda, xato qilib.

examples.en: Of course the program doesn't work
examples.uz: you installed it incorrectly. – Albatta dastur ishlamaydida–
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'doesn't work' inkor; ikkinchi gap Past Simple 'installed' + 'incorrectly' tarz ravishi.

examples.en: He spelled the word incorrectly on the board.
examples.uz: U so'zni doskaga noto'g'ri yozdi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'spelled' o'tgan zamonda; 'incorrectly' - tarz ravishi fe'lni izohlaydi.

defEn: To teach someone over a long time.
defUz: Birovga uzoq vaqt davomida ta'lim bermoq.

examples.en: Films can entertain and educate, make you laugh or cry.
examples.uz: Filmlar ko'ngilni ko'tarishi va ta'lim
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'can entertain and educate' modal 'can' + ikki fe'l; 'make you laugh or cry' - 'make somebody do' konstruksiyasi.

examples.en: Good schools educate children to think for themselves.
examples.uz: Yaxshi maktablar bolalarni mustaqil fikrlashga o'rgatadi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'educate' odatiy harakatni bildiradi; 'to think' - infinitiv maqsadni ko'rsatadi.

defEn: The teaching and learning that happens at school.
defUz: Maktabda yuz beradigan o'qitish va o'rganish jarayoni, ta'lim.

examples.en: He got a good education in one of the best schools in the country.
examples.uz: U mamlakatdagi eng zo'r
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'got'; 'a good education' - 'a' artikli + sifat + ot; 'in one of the best schools' - predlog joyni bildiradi.

examples.en: A good education helps you find a good job.
examples.uz: Yaxshi ta'lim sizga yaxshi ish topishga yordam beradi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'helps' uchinchi shaxs birlikda '-s' oladi; 'find' - infinitiv ('to' tushib qolgan) natijani bildiradi.

defEn: Helping people to learn something.
defUz: Odamlarga biror narsa o'rganishga yordam beradigan, ta'limiy.

examples.en: We brought the children on an educational trip to the Science Museum.
examples.uz: Biz bolalarni Ilm-fan
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'brought'; 'an educational trip' - 'an' artikli + sifat + ot; 'to the Science Museum' - predlog yo'nalishni bildiradi.

examples.en: This game is fun and very educational for children.
examples.uz: Bu o'yin qiziqarli va bolalar uchun juda ta'limiy.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'is' bog'lama fe'l; 'and' - bog'lovchi ikki sifatni bog'laydi.

defEn: Words or actions that give someone hope or support.
defUz: Birovga umid yoki dalda beradigan so'z yoki harakat, ruhlantirish.

examples.en: Children need the encouragement of their parents to do well.
examples.uz: Bolalar yaxshi harakat qilishlari
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'need'; 'the encouragement of their parents' - 'of' predlogi tegishlilikni; 'to do well' - infinitiv maqsadni bildiradi.

examples.en: With her teacher's encouragement, she passed the exam.
examples.uz: O'qituvchisining daldasi bilan u imtihondan o'tdi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'passed' o'tgan zamonda; 'With' predlogi vositani bildiradi.

defEn: Giving someone hope or support.
defUz: Birovga umid yoki dalda beradigan, ruhlantiruvchi.

examples.en: I try to be encouraging of my son's plans, even if I don't agree with them.
examples.uz: Men o'g'limning
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'try to be encouraging' fe'l + infinitiv + sifat; 'even if I don't agree' - shart bildiruvchi ergash gap.

examples.en: The teacher gave us an encouraging smile before the test.
examples.uz: O'qituvchi testdan oldin bizga dalda beruvchi tabassum qildi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'gave' o'tgan zamonda; 'encouraging' - 'smile' otini aniqlovchi sifat.

defEn: Not important.
defUz: Muhim bo'lmagan, ahamiyatsiz.

examples.en: Your mark is unimportant to me as long as you do your best.
examples.uz: Qo'lingizdan kelgancha yaxshi
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'is unimportant' bog'lama + sifat; 'as long as you do your best' - shart bildiruvchi ergash gap.

examples.en: This small mistake is unimportant in your essay.
examples.uz: Bu kichik xato sizning inshongizda ahamiyatsizdir.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'is unimportant' bog'lama + sifat; 'in your essay' - predlog joyni bildiradi.

defEn: The quality of being important.
defUz: Muhim bo'lish xususiyati, ahamiyat.

examples.en: An education is of great importance to a child.
examples.uz: Ta'lim yosh bola uchun ulkan ahamiyatga ega.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'is of great importance' - 'of + sifat + ot' tuzilishi muhimlikni bildiradi; 'to a child' - predlog yo'nalishni bildiradi.

examples.en: The teacher explained the importance of reading every day.
examples.uz: O'qituvchi har kuni o'qishning ahamiyatini tushuntirdi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'explained' o'tgan zamonda; 'of reading' - 'of' predlogi tegishlilikni bildiradi.

defEn: What a word or thing tells you.
defUz: So'z yoki narsa anglatadigan mazmun, ma'no.

examples.en: What is the exact meaning of the word?
examples.uz: So'zning aniq ma'nosi nima?
examples.grammar: So'roq gap - Present Simple, 'What is the exact meaning' tartibida; 'of the word' - 'of' predlogi tegishlilikni bildiradi.

examples.en: I looked up the meaning of the new word in a dictionary.
examples.uz: Men yangi so'zning ma'nosini lug'atdan qidirib topdim.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'looked up' phrasal fe'l o'tgan zamonda; 'of the new word' - 'of' predlogi tegishlilikni bildiradi.

uz: so'zni harflab yozmoq yoki aytmoq: D-E-S-T-I-N-A-T-I-O-N
defEn: To say or write the letters of a word in the right order.
defUz: So'zning harflarini to'g'ri tartibda aytmoq yoki yozmoq.

examples.en: Can you spell your last name, please?
examples.uz: Familyangizni harflab ayta olasizmi, iltimos?
examples.grammar: So'roq gap - modal 'can', 'Can you spell' tartibida; 'please' xushmuomalalik so'zi gap oxirida keladi.

examples.en: Can you spell the word school for me?
examples.uz: Menga school so'zini harflab ayta olasizmi?
examples.grammar: So'roq gap - modal 'can' bilan; 'for me' - predlog manfaatni bildiradi.

defEn: The way the letters of a word are put together.
defUz: So'z harflarining birga yozilish tartibi, imlo.

examples.en: This word has a different spelling in American and British English.
examples.uz: Bu so'z Amerika va Britaniya
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'has a different spelling'; 'in American and British English' - predlog va 'and' bog'lovchisi ikki turni bog'laydi.

examples.en: The teacher checked the spelling of every word.
examples.uz: O'qituvchi har bir so'zning imlosini tekshirdi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'checked' o'tgan zamonda; 'of every word' - 'of' predlogi tegishlilikni bildiradi.

defEn: To learn about a subject, usually at school.
defUz: Odatda maktabda biror fanni o'rganmoq, tahsil olmoq.

examples.en: My brother studied photography at the Royal College of Art.
examples.uz: Mening akam Qirollik San'at
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'studied'; 'at the Royal College of Art' - 'at' predlogi joyni, 'of' predlogi nomni bildiradi.

examples.en: I study English for two hours every evening.
examples.uz: Men har oqshom ikki soat ingliz tilini o'rganaman.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'study' odatiy harakatni bildiradi; 'for two hours' - predlog davomiylikni bildiradi.

defEn: The work you do to learn at school or university.
defUz: Maktab yoki universitetda o'rganish uchun qiladigan ishingiz, tahsil.

examples.en: He's going to an American university to continue his studies.
examples.uz: U o'qishini davom ettirish uchun
examples.grammar: Future - 'is going to' rejalashtirilgan kelajak ishni bildiradi; 'to continue his studies' - infinitiv maqsadni bildiradi.

examples.en: He works hard at his studies to get good marks.
examples.uz: U yaxshi baholar olish uchun o'qishida tirishqoqlik bilan harakat qiladi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'works' uchinchi shaxs birlikda '-s' oladi; 'to get' - infinitiv maqsadni bildiradi.

defEn: A person whose job is to teach.
defUz: Ishi o'qitish bo'lgan kishi, o'qituvchi.

examples.en: His mother's a teacher at his school.
examples.uz: Uning oyisi u o'qiydigan maktabda o'qituvchi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'is' bog'lama fe'l; 'His mother's a teacher' - egalik (apostrof + s); 'at his school' - predlog joyni bildiradi.

examples.en: Our new teacher is very kind and patient.
examples.uz: Bizning yangi o'qituvchimiz juda mehribon va sabrli.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'is' bog'lama fe'l; 'and' - bog'lovchi ikki sifatni bog'laydi.

defEn: the person who is in charge of you at work
defUz: ish joyida sizga rahbarlik qiladigan kishi

examples.en: Sean asked his boss if he could take Friday off work.
examples.uz: Sho'n boshlig'idan juma kuni ishdan dam
examples.grammar: 'asked + someone + if + clause' - Past Simple va 'if' bilan bilvosita so'roq qurilishi - 'could' modal fe'l o'tmishdagi iltimosni bildiradi.

examples.en: My boss is very kind and always helps the new workers.
examples.uz: Boshlig'im juda mehribon va doim yangi ishchilarga yordam beradi.
examples.grammar: 'My boss + is + sifat' - Present Simple - egalik olmoshi 'my' ot oldida keladi.

defEn: the work you do for a long time in your life
defUz: inson hayoti davomida uzoq vaqt qiladigan ishi

examples.en: You have to study hard if you want to go on to a career in law.
examples.uz: Agar huquqshunoslik sohasida
examples.grammar: 'You have to + infinitiv' - majburiyatni bildiradi - 'if' bilan shart mayli ergash gapi qo'shilgan.

examples.en: She wants a career as a doctor in a big hospital.
examples.uz: U katta shifoxonada shifokor sifatida karyera qurishni xohlaydi.
examples.grammar: 'wants + a + ot' - Present Simple - 'a' artikli birlikdagi otdan oldin keladi.

defEn: the possibility that something will happen
defUz: biror narsaning yuz berish ehtimoli

examples.en: Is there any chance of me getting a pay rise?
examples.uz: Maoshimni oshirish imkoni bormi?
examples.grammar: 'Is there + any + ot' - Present Simple so'roq gap - 'any' aniqlanmagan miqdorni bildiradi.

examples.en: I think we have a good chance of winning the game.
examples.uz: Menimcha, bizning o'yinda yutib chiqish imkonimiz katta.
examples.grammar: 'have a chance of + V-ing' - Present Simple - 'of' predlogidan keyin fe'lga -ing qo'shiladi.

defEn: a business that makes or sells things
defUz: narsa ishlab chiqaradigan yoki sotadigan korxona

examples.en: The company Frank works for makes sports equipment.
examples.uz: Frenk ishlaydigan kompaniya sport
examples.grammar: 'The company + (relative clause) + makes' - Present Simple - 'Frank works for' ergash gap 'company' otini aniqlaydi.

examples.en: Many people work for that big company in the city.
examples.uz: Ko'p odamlar shaharda o'sha katta kompaniyada ishlaydi.
examples.grammar: 'work for + ot' - Present Simple - 'for' predlogi ish joyini bildiradi.

defEn: a problem or something that is hard to do
defUz: muammo yoki bajarish qiyin bo'lgan narsa

examples.en: You won't have any difficulty with the work. It's very simple.
examples.uz: Ish bilan hech qanday qiyinchilik
examples.grammar: 'won't have + any + ot' - Future ('will' inkori) - 'any' inkor gapda noaniq miqdorni bildiradi.

examples.en: We had some difficulty finding the new office.
examples.uz: Yangi ofisni topishda biroz qiyinchilikka duch keldik.
examples.grammar: 'difficulty + V-ing' - Past Simple - 'difficulty' otidan keyin fe'l -ing shaklida keladi.

defEn: an official card that lets you drive a car
defUz: avtomobil haydashga ruxsat beruvchi rasmiy hujjat

examples.en: The driving licence for a lorry is much harder to get than the one for a car.
examples.uz: Yuk mashinasi uchun
examples.grammar: 'much + harder + than' - qiyosiy daraja - 'much' qiyosni kuchaytiradi, 'than' ikki narsani solishtiradi.

examples.en: You need a driving licence before you can drive on the road.
examples.uz: Yo'lda mashina haydashdan oldin sizga haydovchilik guvohnomasi kerak.
examples.grammar: 'need + a + ot' - Present Simple - 'before' bog'lovchisi vaqt ergash gapini boshlaydi.

defEn: the energy you use to do something hard
defUz: biror og'ir ishni qilish uchun sarflanadigan kuch

examples.en: If we make a real effort, we can get the work finished by Friday.
examples.uz: Agar rostmanasiga urinsak,
examples.grammar: 'If we make + ..., we can + infinitiv' - shart mayli (first conditional) - 'by Friday' tugash vaqtini bildiradi.

examples.en: He made a big effort to learn English this year.
examples.uz: U bu yil ingliz tilini o'rganish uchun katta urinish qildi.
examples.grammar: 'made an effort + to + infinitiv' - Past Simple - 'to' infinitivdan oldin maqsadni bildiradi.

defEn: a person who designs or builds machines or roads
defUz: mashina yoki yo'llarni loyihalovchi va quruvchi kishi

examples.en: The engineer who designed that machine did a wonderful job.
examples.uz: Ushbu mashinani yaratgan
examples.grammar: 'The engineer + who + (clause) + did' - Past Simple - 'who' bog'lovchisi 'engineer' otini aniqlovchi ergash gap boshlaydi.

examples.en: My uncle is an engineer and he builds bridges.
examples.uz: Tog'am muhandis bo'lib, u ko'priklar quradi.
examples.grammar: 'is + an + ot' - Present Simple - 'an' artikli unli tovush bilan boshlanuvchi otdan oldin keladi.

defEn: a building where workers make things with machines
defUz: ishchilar mashinalar yordamida narsa ishlab chiqaradigan bino

examples.en: Yuri works in the paint shop of a car factory.
examples.uz: Yuriy avtomobil zavodining bo'yoq sexida ishlaydi.
examples.grammar: 'works + in + the + ot' - Present Simple - 'in' predlogi joyni bildiradi, 'of' egalikni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: The factory makes hundreds of cars every day.
examples.uz: Zavod har kuni yuzlab avtomobillar ishlab chiqaradi.
examples.grammar: 'makes + ot (ko'plik)' - Present Simple - 'every day' takroriy harakatni bildiradi.

defEn: the work a person does to earn money
defUz: kishi pul topish uchun qiladigan ishi

examples.en: His father's first job was cooking in a café.
examples.uz: Uning otasining birinchi ishi kafeda taom pishirish
examples.grammar: 'first job + was + V-ing' - Past Simple ('was') - egalik shakli 'father's' apostrof bilan yasalgan.

examples.en: She is looking for a new job in the city.
examples.uz: U shaharda yangi ish qidiryapti.
examples.grammar: 'is looking for' - Present Continuous - hozir davom etayotgan harakatni bildiradi.

defEn: a person who writes news for newspapers or TV
defUz: gazeta yoki televideniye uchun yangiliklar yozadigan kishi

examples.en: Roger works as a journalist for the local newspaper.
examples.uz: Ro'jer mahalliy gazetada jurnalist bo'lib
examples.grammar: 'works + as + a + ot' - Present Simple - 'as' kasb yoki rolni bildiradi, 'for' egalik joyini ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: The journalist asked the mayor many questions.
examples.uz: Jurnalist hokimga ko'plab savollar berdi.
examples.grammar: 'asked + someone + ot (ko'plik)' - Past Simple - to'ldiruvchi fe'ldan keyin keladi.

defEn: a person who controls a business or a team
defUz: korxona yoki jamoani boshqaradigan kishi

examples.en: I asked the manager for a day off on Monday.
examples.uz: Men ish boshqaruvchidan dushanba kuni dam
examples.grammar: 'asked + someone + for + ot' - Past Simple - 'for' predlogi nimaga so'rov yuborilganini bildiradi.

examples.en: The manager told us to come to work early.
examples.uz: Menejer bizga ishga erta kelishni aytdi.
examples.grammar: 'told + someone + to + infinitiv' - Past Simple - bilvosita buyruqni bildiradi.

defEn: a person who repairs cars and machines
defUz: mashina va asbob-uskunalarni tuzatadigan kishi

examples.en: A mechanic is looking at my car at the moment.
examples.uz: Mexanik ayni damda mashinamga qarayapti.
examples.grammar: 'is looking + at' - Present Continuous - 'at the moment' ayni hozirgi vaqtni bildiradi.

examples.en: The mechanic fixed my car in one hour.
examples.uz: Mexanik mashinamni bir soatda tuzatdi.
examples.grammar: 'fixed' - Past Simple - tugagan harakatni bildiradi, 'in one hour' davomiylikni ko'rsatadi.

defEn: a time when people come together to talk about work
defUz: odamlar ish haqida gaplashish uchun yig'iladigan vaqt

examples.en: The boss held a meeting in his office this morning, but I was late!
examples.uz: Boshliq bugun ertalab ofisida
examples.grammar: 'held + a + ot' - Past Simple - 'but' bog'lovchisi qarama-qarshi gapni qo'shadi.

examples.en: We have a meeting with the new clients tomorrow.
examples.uz: Ertaga yangi mijozlar bilan uchrashuvimiz bor.
examples.grammar: 'have a meeting + with' - Present Simple - 'tomorrow' kelasi rejani bildiradi.

examples.en: The boss called a meeting at work today, so I have to wear a suit.
examples.uz: Boshliq bugun ish joyida
examples.grammar: 'ega + called a + ot + at work + today, so + ega + have to + wear' - Past Simple, 'so' sabab-natija, 'have to' majburiyat.

examples.en: I have an important meeting at work tomorrow.
examples.uz: Ertaga ishda muhim uchrashuvim bor.
examples.grammar: 'have + a + sifat + ot + at work + tomorrow' - Present Simple, 'tomorrow' kelasi vaqtni bildiradi.

defEn: the coins and notes that people use to buy things
defUz: odamlar narsa sotib olish uchun ishlatadigan tanga va pullar

examples.en: She makes very good money in her new job.
examples.uz: U yangi ishida juda yaxshi pul topadi.
examples.grammar: 'makes + good + money' - Present Simple - 'money' sanalmaydigan ot, artikl olmaydi.

examples.en: I save some money every month for my holiday.
examples.uz: Men ta'tilim uchun har oy bir oz pul jamg'araman.
examples.grammar: 'save + some + money' - Present Simple - 'some' sanalmaydigan ot oldida noaniq miqdorni bildiradi.

defEn: printed pages with news that you read every day
defUz: har kuni o'qiladigan yangiliklar bosilgan varaqlar

examples.en: I read about the fire in the newspaper.
examples.uz: Men yong'in to'g'risida gazetada o'qidim.
examples.grammar: 'read about + ... + in + the + ot' - Past Simple - 'about' mavzuni, 'in' joyni bildiradi.

examples.en: My father reads the newspaper every morning with his coffee.
examples.uz: Otam har kuni ertalab qahvasi bilan gazeta o'qiydi.
examples.grammar: 'reads + the + ot' - Present Simple - 'every morning' takroriy odatni bildiradi.

defEn: a person's job or the work they do
defUz: kishining kasbi yoki bajaradigan ishi

examples.en: A good occupation for a caring person is nurse.
examples.uz: G'amxo'r inson uchun yaxshi kasb bu
examples.grammar: 'A good + ot + for + ... + is' - Present Simple - 'for' kimga mosligini bildiradi.

examples.en: Please write your name and occupation on this form.
examples.uz: Iltimos, bu blankaga ismingiz va kasbingizni yozing.
examples.grammar: 'write + ot' - buyruq gap (imperative) - 'please' iltimosni yumshatadi.

defEn: a room or building where people do paper work
defUz: odamlar qog'oz ishlarini bajaradigan xona yoki bino

examples.en: I work in an office and wear a suit and tie to work.
examples.uz: Men ofisda ishlayman va ishga kostyum-
examples.grammar: 'work + in + an + ot' - Present Simple - 'and' bog'lovchisi ikki harakatni bog'laydi.

examples.en: There are ten people working in our office.
examples.uz: Bizning ofisimizda o'n kishi ishlaydi.
examples.grammar: 'There are + son + ot (ko'plik)' - Present Simple - mavjudlikni bildiradi.

defEn: a person whose job is to keep people safe and follow the law
defUz: odamlar xavfsizligini ta'minlash va qonunni saqlash kasbidagi kishi

examples.en: The police officer stopped the car and asked for the driving licence.
examples.uz: Politsiya ofitseri mashinani
examples.grammar: 'stopped + ... + and + asked for' - Past Simple - 'and' ikki o'tmish harakatini bog'laydi.

examples.en: A police officer helped the lost child find her mother.
examples.uz: Politsiya ofitseri adashib qolgan bolaga onasini topishga yordam berdi.
examples.grammar: 'helped + someone + infinitiv' - Past Simple - 'help' fe'lidan keyin 'to'siz infinitiv keladi.

defEn: the people who work for a company or place
defUz: korxona yoki joyda ishlaydigan xodimlar

examples.en: The restaurant staff are friendly and helpful.
examples.uz: Restoran xodimlari samimiy va foydali.
examples.grammar: 'staff + are + sifat' - Present Simple - 'staff' jamoa oti ko'plik fe'l bilan keladi.

examples.en: The hotel staff work hard to help the guests.
examples.uz: Mehmonxona xodimlari mehmonlarga yordam berish uchun tirishib ishlaydi.
examples.grammar: 'staff + work' - Present Simple - jamoa oti ko'plikda fe'l oladi.

defEn: a group of things that are the same in some way
defUz: biror jihatdan bir xil bo'lgan narsalar guruhi

examples.en: What type of person are we looking for to fill the position?
examples.uz: Ish o'rnini to'ldirish uchun qanday
examples.grammar: 'What type of + ot' - Present Simple so'roq gap - 'to fill' infinitiv maqsadni bildiradi.

examples.en: What type of music do you like best?
examples.uz: Qaysi turdagi musiqani eng yaxshi ko'rasiz?
examples.grammar: 'What type of + ot + do you' - Present Simple so'roq gap - 'do' yordamchi fe'l savol yasaydi.

defEn: a job or the things you do to earn money
defUz: ish yoki pul topish uchun qilinadigan mehnat

examples.en: Joe can't find work
examples.uz: do you know of a job he can do? – Jo' ish topolmayapti–u qila oladigan biror
examples.grammar: 'can't find + ot' - Present Simple inkor - 'can' modal fe'l, 'work' sanalmaydigan ot.

examples.en: He starts work at nine o'clock every day.
examples.uz: U har kuni soat to'qqizda ishni boshlaydi.
examples.grammar: 'starts + work' - Present Simple - 'at nine o'clock' aniq vaqtni bildiradi.

defEn: to say yes to something that is offered to you
defUz: sizga taklif qilingan narsaga rozi bo'lmoq

examples.en: They offered me the job and I accepted
examples.uz: I start on Monday! – Ular menga ishni taklif qilishdi va
examples.grammar: 'offered + me + ot + and + accepted' - Past Simple - ikki o'tmish harakati 'and' bilan bog'langan.

examples.en: She accepted the gift with a big smile.
examples.uz: U sovg'ani katta tabassum bilan qabul qildi.
examples.grammar: 'accepted + ot' - Past Simple - 'with' predlogi tarzni bildiradi.

defEn: to make something by putting parts together
defUz: qismlarni birlashtirib biror narsa yasamoq

examples.en: Our company is building 100 new houses.
examples.uz: Bizning kompaniyamiz 100 ta yangi uylar qurmoqda.
examples.grammar: 'is building + ot (ko'plik)' - Present Continuous - hozir davom etayotgan harakatni bildiradi.

examples.en: They are going to build a new school near our house.
examples.uz: Ular uyimiz yonida yangi maktab quradilar.
examples.grammar: 'going to + build' - Future ('going to') - rejalashtirilgan harakatni bildiradi.

examples.en: They have permission to build 200 new homes.
examples.uz: 200 ta yangi uy qurish uchun ularda ruxsat bor.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'have permission' egalikni bildiradi; 'to build' - infinitiv, ruxsat nima uchun ekanini bildiradi.

examples.en: They are going to build a new school in the village.
examples.uz: Ular qishloqda yangi maktab qurmoqchi.
examples.grammar: Future - 'are going to build' rejalashtirilgan kelajak harakatni bildiradi.

defEn: to telephone someone
defUz: kimgadir telefon orqali bog'lanmoq

examples.en: Olive's not here yet
examples.uz: can you call her and see if she's all right? – Oliv hali bu yerda emas–unga
examples.grammar: 'can you + call + her' - Present Simple so'roq gap - 'can' modal fe'l iltimosni bildiradi.

examples.en: Please call me when you get home tonight.
examples.uz: Bugun kechqurun uyga yetganingizda menga qo'ng'iroq qiling.
examples.grammar: 'call + me' - buyruq gap - 'when' bog'lovchisi vaqt ergash gapini boshlaydi.

defEn: to hold something and move it from one place to another
defUz: biror narsani ushlab bir joydan boshqasiga olib bormoq

examples.en: Can you carry some of these files? They're very heavy.
examples.uz: Mana bu fayllarning ba'zilarini ko'tarib
examples.grammar: 'Can you + carry' - Present Simple so'roq gap - 'They're' qisqargan shakl 'they are' demakdir.

examples.en: The waiter carried four plates at the same time.
examples.uz: Ofitsiant bir vaqtning o'zida to'rtta likopni ko'tarib yurdi.
examples.grammar: 'carried + ot (ko'plik)' - Past Simple - undosh + y bilan tugagan fe'lda -ied qo'shiladi.

defEn: to finish doing something
defUz: biror ishni oxirigacha yakunlamoq

examples.en: When we complete the project, I can relax.
examples.uz: Loyihani bitirganimizda, men dam ola olaman.
examples.grammar: 'When we + complete + ..., I can + infinitiv' - Present Simple - 'when' bog'lovchisi vaqt ergash gapini boshlaydi.

examples.en: We completed the report before the meeting started.
examples.uz: Biz majlis boshlanishidan oldin hisobotni yakunladik.
examples.grammar: 'completed + ot' - Past Simple - 'before' bog'lovchisi vaqt ergash gapini boshlaydi.

defEn: to make something new
defUz: yangi biror narsa yaratmoq

examples.en: My brother's job is to create websites for small companies.
examples.uz: Akamning ishi kichik kompaniyalar
examples.grammar: 'job + is + to + create' - Present Simple - 'to create' infinitiv ish mazmunini bildiradi.

examples.en: The artist created a beautiful picture for the school.
examples.uz: Rassom maktab uchun chiroyli rasm yaratdi.
examples.grammar: 'created + ot' - Past Simple - 'for' predlogi kimga atalganini bildiradi.

defEn: to control a car or other vehicle
defUz: avtomobil yoki boshqa transportni boshqarmoq

examples.en: Steven can drive a car and he's learning to drive a van now.
examples.uz: Stiven mashina hayday oladi va u
examples.grammar: 'can drive + ... + and + is learning to drive' - Present Simple va Present Continuous birga - 'can' modal fe'l.

examples.en: My sister drives to work every morning.
examples.uz: Singlim har kuni ertalab ishga mashinada boradi.
examples.grammar: 'drives + to' - Present Simple - 'to work' yo'nalishni bildiradi.

examples.en: Have you ever driven a racing car?
examples.uz: Hayotingiz davomida qachondir poyga mashinasi haydab
examples.grammar: 'Have you ever driven ...?' - Present Perfect so'roq gap, hayotiy tajriba; 'ever' - 'biror marta' ma'nosida; 'driven' - 'drive' fe'lining uchinchi shakli.

examples.en: My father drives to work every day.
examples.uz: Otam har kuni ishga mashinada boradi.
examples.grammar: 'drives' - Present Simple, birlikdagi ega; 'to work' - yo'nalish iborasi; 'every day' - takrorlanishni bildiradi.

defEn: to get money for the work you do
defUz: qilgan ishingiz uchun pul olmoq

examples.en: Do you earn more money in your new job than in the old one?
examples.uz: Yangi ishingizda eskisidan ko'ra
examples.grammar: 'Do you + earn + more + ... + than' - Present Simple so'roq gap - 'than' bilan qiyosiy daraja.

examples.en: He earns enough money to support his family.
examples.uz: U oilasini boqish uchun yetarli pul ishlab topadi.
examples.grammar: 'earns + ot' - Present Simple - 'to support' infinitiv maqsadni bildiradi.

defEn: to come to the end of doing something
defUz: biror ishni oxiriga yetkazmoq

examples.en: We can leave when we finish the work.
examples.uz: Ishni tugatganimizda ketsak bo'ladi.
examples.grammar: 'can leave + when we + finish' - Present Simple - 'when' bog'lovchisi vaqt ergash gapini boshlaydi.

examples.en: I finished my homework before dinner yesterday.
examples.uz: Men kecha kechki ovqatdan oldin uy vazifamni tugatdim.
examples.grammar: 'finished + ot' - Past Simple - 'before' bog'lovchisi vaqtni bildiradi.

defEn: to move something up with your hands
defUz: biror narsani qo'l bilan yuqoriga ko'tarmoq

examples.en: Don't lift that heavy box or you'll hurt your back!
examples.uz: U og'ir qutini ko'tarmang, aks holda belingizni
examples.grammar: 'Don't + lift + ... + or + you'll' - buyruq gap inkori - 'or' natijani ogohlantiruvchi bog'lovchi.

examples.en: He lifted the heavy bag onto the table easily.
examples.uz: U og'ir sumkani stol ustiga osongina ko'tardi.
examples.grammar: 'lifted + ot + onto' - Past Simple - 'onto' yo'nalishli predlog.

defEn: to control or be in charge of something
defUz: biror narsani boshqarmoq yoki nazorat qilmoq

examples.en: How does she manage a company and bring up three kids?
examples.uz: U qanday qilib kompaniya
examples.grammar: 'How does she + manage' - Present Simple so'roq gap - 'does' yordamchi fe'l savol yasaydi.

examples.en: She manages a small shop in the town centre.
examples.uz: U shahar markazidagi kichik do'konni boshqaradi.
examples.grammar: 'manages + ot' - Present Simple - uchinchi shaxs birlikda fe'lga -s qo'shiladi.

uz: xursand qilmoq, mamnun qilmoq 37                                                                   @destination_vocabulary · mamnun qilmoq, xursand qilmoq
defEn: to make someone feel happy
defUz: kimnidir xursand qilmoq

examples.en: It pleases me to see your work is getting better.
examples.uz: Ishingiz yaxshilanib borayotganini ko'rish meni
examples.grammar: 'It pleases + me + to + infinitiv' - Present Simple - 'it' biriktiruvchi olmosh sifatida xizmat qiladi.

examples.en: It pleased my parents to see me pass the exam.
examples.uz: Ota-onamni imtihondan o'tganimni ko'rish xursand qildi.
examples.grammar: 'pleased + someone + to + infinitiv' - Past Simple - 'to see' infinitiv sababni bildiradi.

examples.en: You can't please everybody.
examples.uz: Hammani ham xursand qilolmaysiz.
examples.grammar: 'You can't please everybody' - modal fe'l inkorda ('can't'); 'please' infinitiv 'can' dan keyin keladi.

examples.en: It is hard to please everyone at the same time.
examples.uz: Bir vaqtning o'zida hammani mamnun qilish qiyin.
examples.grammar: 'It is hard to please' - 'It is + sifat + infinitiv' qurilmasi; 'to please' infinitiv.

defEn: to say words and talk to someone
defUz: so'zlamoq, kimgadir gapirmoq

examples.en: Can you speak to Janine about her lateness, please?
examples.uz: Janin bilan uning kechikishi to'g'risida
examples.grammar: 'Can you + speak + to' - Present Simple so'roq gap - 'about' suhbat mavzusini bildiradi.

examples.en: I can speak two languages at home.
examples.uz: Men uyda ikkita tilda gaplasha olaman.
examples.grammar: 'can speak' - Present Simple - 'can' modal fe'l qobiliyatni bildiradi.

defEn: to begin doing something
defUz: biror ishni boshlamoq

examples.en: The manager asked me if I could start the job on Monday!
examples.uz: Ish boshqaruvchi mendan ishni
examples.grammar: 'asked me + if + I could + start' - Past Simple - 'if' bilvosita so'roqni boshlaydi, 'could' modal fe'l.

examples.en: The film starts at eight o'clock tonight.
examples.uz: Film bugun kechqurun soat sakkizda boshlanadi.
examples.grammar: 'starts + at' - Present Simple - 'at' aniq vaqtni bildiradi.

defEn: to make an effort to do something
defUz: biror ishni qilishga urinmoq

examples.en: She's trying hard to get the work finished on time.
examples.uz: U ishni o'z vaqtida tugatish uchun qattiq
examples.grammar: 'is trying + hard + to + infinitiv' - Present Continuous - 'to get' infinitiv maqsadni bildiradi.

examples.en: I will try to call you again tomorrow.
examples.uz: Men ertaga sizga yana qo'ng'iroq qilishga harakat qilaman.
examples.grammar: 'will try + to + infinitiv' - Future ('will') - kelajakdagi niyatni bildiradi.

defEn: to return to a place
defUz: biror joyga qaytib kelmoq

examples.en: Their dad gets back from work at 8 pm.
examples.uz: Ularning dadasi ishdan kechki soat 8 da qaytadi.
examples.grammar: 'gets back + from' - Present Simple - 'from work' qaytish joyini bildiradi, 'at 8 pm' vaqtni.

examples.en: We got back from our holiday late last night.
examples.uz: Biz kecha kechqurun ta'tildan kech qaytdik.
examples.grammar: 'got back + from' - Past Simple - 'get back' iborali fe'l, 'got' tartibsiz shakl.

defEn: to get out of bed in the morning
defUz: ertalab to'shakdan turmoq

examples.en: He works as a milkman, and gets up at 5 in the morning.
examples.uz: U sut tarqatuvchi bo'lib ishlaydi va
examples.grammar: 'works + ..., and + gets up' - Present Simple - ikki harakat 'and' bilan bog'langan.

examples.en: I get up early every day to go to school.
examples.uz: Men har kuni maktabga borish uchun erta turaman.
examples.grammar: 'get up + early' - Present Simple - 'to go' infinitiv maqsadni bildiradi.

defEn: to make a place clean and neat
defUz: biror joyni toza va tartibli holatga keltirmoq

examples.en: She can't find anything on her desk, so she's tidying it up.
examples.uz: U stolidan hech narsani topa
examples.grammar: 'can't find + ..., so + she's tidying' - Present Continuous - 'so' natija bog'lovchisi.

examples.en: Please tidy up your room before you go out.
examples.uz: Tashqariga chiqishdan oldin xonangizni yig'ishtiring.
