examples.grammar: 'tidy up + ot' - buyruq gap - 'before' bog'lovchisi vaqtni bildiradi.

defEn: to stop sleeping
defUz: uyqudan uyg'onmoq

examples.en: He wakes up at 6 so he can catch the 7.30 train to work.
examples.uz: U ishga borish uchun 7.30 dagi
examples.grammar: 'wakes up + ... + so + he can + catch' - Present Simple - 'so' maqsad-natija bog'lovchisi.

examples.en: I wake up at six o'clock every morning.
examples.uz: Men har kuni ertalab soat oltida uyg'onaman.
examples.grammar: 'wake up + at' - Present Simple - 'at six o'clock' aniq vaqtni bildiradi.

defEn: in the place where you do your job
defUz: ish bajaradigan joyda bo'lish

examples.en: Don't call him at work
examples.uz: he's usually too busy to talk. – Ishdaligida unga qo'ng'iroq qilmang–u
examples.grammar: 'Don't call + him + at work' - buyruq gap inkori - 'at work' joy holini bildiradi.

examples.en: My mother is at work until five o'clock.
examples.uz: Onam soat beshgacha ishda bo'ladi.
examples.grammar: 'is + at work' - Present Simple - 'until' predlogi vaqt chegarasini bildiradi.

uz: (biror narsa) qila olmoq, qilishga qodir bo'lmoq
defEn: to have the power or skill to do something
defUz: biror ishni qilishga kuch yoki ko'nikmaga ega bo'lmoq

examples.en: I'm afraid I won't be able to finish the work on time.
examples.uz: Ishni o'z vaqtida tugata olmayman deb
examples.grammar: 'won't be able to + infinitiv' - Future ('will' inkori) - 'be able to' qobiliyatni bildiradi.

examples.en: I am able to speak English with my friends.
examples.uz: Men do'stlarim bilan ingliz tilida gaplasha olaman.
examples.grammar: 'am able to + infinitiv' - Present Simple - 'be able to' 'can' o'rnida qobiliyatni bildiradi.

uz: (biror narsa) to'g'risida bir qarorga kelmoq, tanlamoq
defEn: to choose something after thinking
defUz: o'ylab ko'rib biror narsani tanlamoq

examples.en: We need to decide on which chairs to buy.
examples.uz: Qaysi stullarni sotib olishni tanlashimiz kerak.
examples.grammar: 'need to + decide on' - Present Simple - 'on' predlogi tanlov ob'ektini bildiradi.

examples.en: We decided on the blue car after a long talk.
examples.uz: Uzoq suhbatdan keyin biz ko'k mashinani tanladik.
examples.grammar: 'decided on + ot' - Past Simple - 'after' predlogi vaqtni bildiradi.

uz: kun kechirishi uchun yetarli pul ishlab topmoq
defEn: to get enough money to live
defUz: kun kechirish uchun yetarli pul topmoq

examples.en: Mike earns a living as a taxi driver.
examples.uz: Mayk taksi haydovchisi sifatida kun ko'radi.
examples.grammar: 'earns + a living + as' - Present Simple - 'as' kasb yoki rolni bildiradi.

examples.en: She earns a living by teaching music to children.
examples.uz: U bolalarga musiqa o'rgatib tirikchilik qiladi.
examples.grammar: 'earns a living + by + V-ing' - Present Simple - 'by' vositani bildiradi.

defEn: to get money for working
defUz: ishlash evaziga pul topmoq

examples.en: Do you earn a lot of money in your job?
examples.uz: Siz ishingizda ko'p pul topasizmi?
examples.grammar: 'Do you + earn + ... + money' - Present Simple so'roq gap - 'a lot of' ko'p miqdorni bildiradi.

examples.en: He earns money by working in a shop after school.
examples.uz: U maktabdan keyin do'konda ishlab pul topadi.
examples.grammar: 'earns money + by + V-ing' - Present Simple - 'by' vositani bildiradi.

uz: tirikchilik qilish uchun yetarli pul ishlab topmoq = earn a living
defEn: to get enough money to live
defUz: tirikchilik qilish uchun yetarli pul topmoq

examples.en: I don't want a job that makes me rich. I just want to make a living.
examples.uz: Men boy-badavlat qilib
examples.grammar: 'don't want + ... + I just want to + infinitiv' - Present Simple - 'just' istakni yumshatadi.

examples.en: He makes a living by selling fruit at the market.
examples.uz: U bozorda meva sotib tirikchilik qiladi.
examples.grammar: 'makes a living + by + V-ing' - Present Simple - 'by' vositani bildiradi.

defEn: to get money, often from a business
defUz: ko'pincha biznesdan pul topmoq

examples.en: He chose that career because he wants to make money.
examples.uz: U o'sha karyerani tanladi chunki u pul
examples.grammar: 'chose + ..., because + he wants to + make money' - Past va Present Simple - 'because' sabab bog'lovchisi.

examples.en: They make money by selling clothes online.
examples.uz: Ular kiyimlarni internet orqali sotib pul topadi.
examples.grammar: 'make money + by + V-ing' - Present Simple - 'by' usulni bildiradi.

defEn: travelling for work, not for fun
defUz: dam olish uchun emas, ish yuzasidan safar qilish

examples.en: Michelle isn't in this week
examples.uz: she's in Paris on business. – Mishel bu hafta ish joyida emas–u ish
examples.grammar: 'isn't in + ... + she's + ... + on business' - Present Simple - 'on business' maqsadni bildiradi.

examples.en: My father is in London on business this week.
examples.uz: Otam bu hafta ish yuzasidan Londonda.
examples.grammar: 'is + ... + on business' - Present Simple - 'on business' safar maqsadini bildiradi.

defEn: not late, at the right time
defUz: kechikmasdan, kerakli vaqtda

examples.en: The manager told the staff to get to work on time in the morning.
examples.uz: Ish boshqaruvchi xodimlarga
examples.grammar: 'told + ... + to get to work + on time' - Past Simple - bilvosita buyruq, 'on time' tarzni bildiradi.

examples.en: The train arrived on time this morning.
examples.uz: Poyezd bugun ertalab o'z vaqtida keldi.
examples.grammar: 'arrived + on time' - Past Simple - 'on time' holni bildiradi.

defEn: feeling tired because something is not interesting
defUz: biror narsa qiziq emasligidan zerikkan his qilish

examples.en: The students were bored with doing Maths problems on a warm summer day.
examples.uz: O'quvchilar issiq
examples.grammar: 'were + bored + with + V-ing' - Past Simple - 'bored' sifati 'with' predlogi bilan ishlatiladi.

examples.en: The children were bored because it rained all day.
examples.uz: Bolalar kun bo'yi yomg'ir yoqqani uchun zerikishdi.
examples.grammar: 'were + bored' - Past Simple - 'because' sabab bog'lovchisi ergash gapni boshlaydi.

defEn: not interesting and making you feel tired
defUz: qiziq emas va sizni zeriktiradigan

examples.en: When you do the same job for years, it gets boring.
examples.uz: Bir xil ishni yillab qilsangiz, u zerikarli bo'lib
examples.grammar: 'do + ..., it gets + boring' - Present Simple - 'boring' sifati harakatning xususiyatini bildiradi.

examples.en: The long film was very boring, so we left early.
examples.uz: Uzoq film juda zerikarli edi, shuning uchun biz erta ketdik.
examples.grammar: 'was + boring' - Past Simple - 'so' natija bog'lovchisi.

defEn: having a lot to do or full of people
defUz: qiladigan ishi ko'p yoki odam gavjum

examples.en: The high street is always busy on Saturdays, full of shoppers.
examples.uz: Markaziy ko'cha shanba kunlari
examples.grammar: 'is always + busy' - Present Simple - 'always' chastotani bildiradi, 'full of' to'liqlikni.

examples.en: The doctor is very busy and has no free time today.
examples.uz: Shifokor juda band va bugun bo'sh vaqti yo'q.
examples.grammar: 'is + busy' - Present Simple - 'and' bog'lovchisi ikki holatni bog'laydi.

defEn: happening every day
defUz: har kuni sodir bo'ladigan

examples.en: Liam gets a daily wage of £60, but he doesn't work every day.
examples.uz: Liem kunlik 60 funt sterling
examples.grammar: 'gets + a + daily + ot' - Present Simple - 'daily' sifati otdan oldin keladi, 'but' qarama-qarshilik.

examples.en: Reading is part of my daily routine before bed.
examples.uz: Kitob o'qish uyqu oldidan kunlik odatimning bir qismi.
examples.grammar: 'daily + ot' - Present Simple - 'daily' sifati 'routine' otini aniqlaydi.

defEn: not easy to do or understand
defUz: bajarish yoki tushunish oson bo'lmagan

examples.en: I'm so tired
examples.uz: I had a difficult day at work. – Men juda charchadim–ishda qiyin kun bo'ldi.
examples.grammar: 'had + a + difficult + ot' - Past Simple - 'difficult' sifati 'day' otini aniqlaydi.

examples.en: This exam was very difficult for the students.
examples.uz: Bu imtihon o'quvchilar uchun juda qiyin edi.
examples.grammar: 'was + difficult' - Past Simple - 'for' predlogi kimga qiyinligini bildiradi.

defEn: needed and important
defUz: kerakli va muhim

examples.en: It's necessary to get very high marks to get into medical school.
examples.uz: Tibbiyot oliygohiga kirish
examples.grammar: 'It's necessary + to + infinitiv' - Present Simple - 'it' biriktiruvchi olmosh, 'to get' infinitiv.

examples.en: It is necessary to wear a coat in cold weather.
examples.uz: Sovuq havoda palto kiyish zarur.
examples.grammar: 'is necessary + to + infinitiv' - Present Simple - 'it' rasmiy ega vazifasini bajaradi.

defEn: very good and making you feel happy
defUz: juda yaxshi va sizni xursand qiladigan

examples.en: Teaching is the most wonderful job in the world
examples.uz: I love it! – Dars berish dunyodagi eng ajoyib ish–
examples.grammar: 'the most + wonderful + ot' - Present Simple - 'the most' eng yuqori darajani (superlativ) bildiradi.

examples.en: We had a wonderful time at the party last night.
examples.uz: Kecha kechqurun ziyofatda ajoyib vaqt o'tkazdik.
examples.grammar: 'had a wonderful + ot' - Past Simple - 'wonderful' sifati 'time' otini aniqlaydi.

defEn: without other people
defUz: boshqalar yo'q holda, yolg'iz

examples.en: I prefer to work alone as I don't like to depend on others.
examples.uz: Men yolg'iz ishlashni afzal ko'raman
examples.grammar: 'prefer to + work + alone' - Present Simple - 'as' sabab bog'lovchisi, 'alone' tarzni bildiradi.

examples.en: She lives alone in a small flat in the city.
examples.uz: U shahardagi kichik kvartirada yolg'iz yashaydi.
examples.grammar: 'lives + alone' - Present Simple - 'alone' ravishi harakat tarzini bildiradi.

defEn: surely and without doubt
defUz: shubhasiz, albatta

examples.en: Yes, Kelly is certainly in a good position to get the job.
examples.uz: Ha, Keli albatta ishni olish uchun yaxshi
examples.grammar: 'is + certainly + in a good position' - Present Simple - 'certainly' ravishi fikrni kuchaytiradi.

examples.en: I will certainly help you with the work tomorrow.
examples.uz: Men ertaga ishda sizga albatta yordam beraman.
examples.grammar: 'will certainly + infinitiv' - Future ('will') - 'certainly' ravishi modal fe'ldan keyin keladi.

defEn: with a lot of effort
defUz: ko'p kuch sarflab, tirishib

examples.en: There were very few customers in the shop today, so we didn't have to work very hard.
examples.uz: Bugun
examples.grammar: 'didn't have to + work + ... + hard' - Past Simple - 'so' natija bog'lovchisi, 'hard' tarzni bildiradi.

examples.en: She works hard every day to learn new things.
examples.uz: U yangi narsalarni o'rganish uchun har kuni tirishib ishlaydi.
examples.grammar: 'works + hard' - Present Simple - 'hard' ravishi harakat tarzini bildiradi.

defEn: having the power or skill to do something
defUz: biror ishni qilishga qodir

examples.en: Are you able to come on Saturday?
examples.uz: Shanba kuni kela olasizmi?
examples.grammar: 'Are you + able + to + infinitiv' - Present Simple so'roq gap - 'able to' qobiliyatni bildiradi.

examples.en: She is able to drive a big bus.
examples.uz: U katta avtobus hayday oladi.
examples.grammar: 'is able to + infinitiv' - Present Simple - 'able to' qobiliyatni bildiradi.

defEn: not having the power or skill to do something
defUz: biror ishni qilishga qodir emas

examples.en: After my illness, I was unable to get out of bed by myself.
examples.uz: Xastaligimdan keyin, men yotoqdan
examples.grammar: 'was + unable + to + infinitiv' - Past Simple - 'unable' inkor sifat, 'to get out' infinitiv.

examples.en: He was unable to come to work because he was ill.
examples.uz: U kasal bo'lgani uchun ishga kela olmadi.
examples.grammar: 'was unable to + infinitiv' - Past Simple - 'because' sabab bog'lovchisi.

defEn: the power or skill to do something
defUz: biror ishni bajarish kuchi yoki ko'nikmasi

examples.en: I don't think he has the ability to do the job, unfortunately.
examples.uz: Afsuski, u ishni bajarish uchun
examples.grammar: 'has + the + ability + to + infinitiv' - Present Simple - 'to do' infinitiv qobiliyat mazmunini bildiradi.

examples.en: She has the ability to learn languages quickly.
examples.uz: Uning tillarni tez o'rganish qobiliyati bor.
examples.grammar: 'has the ability + to + infinitiv' - Present Simple - 'to learn' infinitiv qobiliyatni izohlaydi.

defEn: to plan or organise something
defUz: biror narsani rejalashtirmoq yoki tashkillashtirmoq

examples.en: Can I arrange an appointment for Monday?
examples.uz: Dushanba kuni uchun uchrashuv belgilatsam
examples.grammar: 'Can I + arrange + an + ot' - Present Simple so'roq gap - 'can' modal fe'l ruxsat so'raydi.

examples.en: We arranged a party for our teacher last week.
examples.uz: O'tgan hafta o'qituvchimiz uchun ziyofat tashkil qildik.
examples.grammar: 'arranged + ot' - Past Simple - 'for' predlogi kimga atalganini bildiradi.

defEn: a plan or preparation for something
defUz: biror narsa uchun reja yoki tayyorgarlik

examples.en: Can you make the arrangements for our trip to New York?
examples.uz: Nyu Yorkka sayohatimiz uchun
examples.grammar: 'make + the + arrangements + for' - Present Simple so'roq gap - 'for' maqsadni bildiradi.

examples.en: We made all the arrangements for the wedding.
examples.uz: Biz to'y uchun barcha tayyorgarliklarni ko'rdik.
examples.grammar: 'made + arrangements (ko'plik)' - Past Simple - 'for' predlogi maqsadni bildiradi.

defEn: sure about something
defUz: biror narsaga ishonchi komil

examples.en: Are you absolutely certain about this?
examples.uz: Bu haqida ishonchingiz komilmi?
examples.grammar: 'Are you + certain + about' - Present Simple so'roq gap - 'about' predlogi mavzuni bildiradi.

examples.en: I am certain that he will pass the test.
examples.uz: Men u testdan o'tishiga aminman.
examples.grammar: 'am certain + that + clause' - Present Simple - 'that' ergash gapni boshlaydi.

defEn: to pick one thing from many
defUz: ko'p narsadan birini tanlamoq

examples.en: The children chose milk over juice.
examples.uz: Bolalar sharbatni emas, sutni tanladilar.
examples.grammar: 'chose + ... + over' - Past Simple - 'over' bir narsani boshqasidan afzal ko'rishni bildiradi.

examples.en: You can choose any book you like from the shelf.
examples.uz: Tokchadan o'zingizga yoqqan istalgan kitobni tanlashingiz mumkin.
examples.grammar: 'can choose + ot' - Present Simple - 'can' modal fe'l imkoniyatni bildiradi.

defEn: the act of choosing or the thing chosen
defUz: tanlash harakati yoki tanlangan narsa

examples.en: You can't do both jobs, so you need to make a choice.
examples.uz: Ikkala ishni bajara olmaysiz, shuning
examples.grammar: 'can't do + both + ..., so + you need to + make a choice' - Present Simple - 'so' natija bog'lovchisi.

examples.en: There is a big choice of food in the new shop.
examples.uz: Yangi do'konda ovqatning katta tanlovi bor.
examples.grammar: 'a choice of + ot' - Present Simple - 'of' predlogi tanlov turini bildiradi.

defEn: a period of twenty-four hours
defUz: yigirma to'rt soatlik vaqt

examples.en: We spent five days in Paris.
examples.uz: Biz Parijda besh kun o'tkazdik.
examples.grammar: 'spent + son + ot (ko'plik)' - Past Simple - 'days' ko'plikda davomiylikni bildiradi.

examples.en: We will see each other again in three days.
examples.uz: Biz uch kundan keyin yana ko'rishamiz.
examples.grammar: 'in + son + days' - Future ('will') - 'in' predlogi kelajakdagi vaqtni bildiradi.

uz: qaror qabul qilmoq · qaror qabul qilmoq, bir qarorga kelmoq
defEn: to make a choice after thinking
defUz: o'ylab ko'rib qaror qabul qilmoq

examples.en: Why did you decide to look for a new job?
examples.uz: Nima uchun yangi ish izlashga qaror qildingiz?
examples.grammar: 'did you + decide + to + infinitiv' - Past Simple so'roq gap - 'did' yordamchi fe'l, 'to look' infinitiv.

examples.en: We decided to stay at home this weekend.
examples.uz: Biz bu dam olish kunlari uyda qolishga qaror qildik.
examples.grammar: 'decided + to + infinitiv' - Past Simple - 'to stay' infinitiv qarorni izohlaydi.

examples.en: I can't decide which shirt to buy.
examples.uz: Qaysi ko'ylakni sotib olish haqida bir qarorga kelolmayapman.
examples.grammar: 'I can't decide which + ot + to + infinitiv' - 'can't' modal fe'l inkor shakli, 'which shirt to buy' bilvosita so'roqni bildiradi.

examples.en: We decided to buy the cheaper television.
examples.uz: Biz arzonroq televizorni sotib olishga qaror qildik.
examples.grammar: 'decided + to + infinitiv' - Past Simple, 'cheaper' qiyosiy daraja, arzonroq ekanini bildiradi.

defEn: a choice that you make
defUz: siz qabul qiladigan qaror

examples.en: It was a difficult decision to make, but I chose Sam.
examples.uz: U qarorni qabul qilish qiyin bo'ldi, lekin men
examples.grammar: 'was + a + difficult + decision + to make' - Past Simple - 'to make' infinitiv otni aniqlaydi.

examples.en: It was a good decision to buy the new car.
examples.uz: Yangi mashinani sotib olish yaxshi qaror bo'ldi.
examples.grammar: 'was a + ot + to + infinitiv' - Past Simple - 'to buy' infinitiv qarorni izohlaydi.

defEn: the part of a car that makes it move
defUz: avtomobilni harakatga keltiradigan qism

examples.en: I got in the car and started the engine.
examples.uz: Men mashinaga o'tirdim va motorni o't oldirdim.
examples.grammar: 'got in + ... + and + started + the + ot' - Past Simple - ikki harakat 'and' bilan bog'langan.

examples.en: The car would not start because the engine was broken.
examples.uz: Motor buzilgani uchun mashina yurmadi.
examples.grammar: 'engine + was + broken' - Past Simple - 'because' sabab bog'lovchisi ergash gapni boshlaydi.

defEn: the work of designing machines, roads or buildings
defUz: mashina, yo'l yoki binolarni loyihalash ishi

examples.en: She works in engineering
examples.uz: mostly factory machinery design. – U muhandislik sohasida ishlaydi–
examples.grammar: 'works + in + engineering' - Present Simple - 'in' predlogi soha yoki yo'nalishni bildiradi.

examples.en: He studies engineering at the university.
examples.uz: U universitetda muhandislikni o'qiyapti.
examples.grammar: 'studies + engineering' - Present Simple - uchinchi shaxs birlikda fe'lga -es qo'shiladi.

defEn: the control of a business or group of people
defUz: korxona yoki bir guruh odamlarni boshqarish

examples.en: The management of the company is poor, so everything's badly organised.
examples.uz: Kompaniya
examples.grammar: 'management + ... + is + poor, so + everything's + badly organised' - Present Simple - 'so' natija bog'lovchisi.

examples.en: Good management helps a company grow fast.
examples.uz: Yaxshi boshqaruv kompaniyaning tez o'sishiga yordam beradi.
examples.grammar: 'management + helps' - Present Simple - 'management' sanalmaydigan ot birlik fe'l oladi.

defEn: a person who plays or writes music
defUz: musiqa chaladigan yoki yozadigan kishi

examples.en: How many musicians are there in the orchestra?
examples.uz: Orkestrada nechta musiqachi bor?
examples.grammar: 'How many + musicians + are there' - Present Simple so'roq gap - 'how many' sanaladigan ot miqdorini so'raydi.

examples.en: My brother is a musician and plays the guitar.
examples.uz: Akam musiqachi bo'lib, gitara chaladi.
examples.grammar: 'is a + ot + and + plays' - Present Simple - 'and' bog'lovchisi ikki ma'lumotni bog'laydi.

defEn: connected with music
defUz: musiqaga bog'liq bo'lgan

examples.en: Can you play a musical instrument?
examples.uz: Biror musiqiy asbob chala olasizmi?
examples.grammar: 'Can you + play + a + musical + ot' - Present Simple so'roq gap - 'musical' sifati 'instrument' otini aniqlaydi.

examples.en: She comes from a very musical family.
examples.uz: U juda musiqiy oiladan.
examples.grammar: 'musical + ot' - Present Simple - 'musical' sifati 'family' otini aniqlaydi.

defEn: to look good on someone
defUz: kimgadir yarashmoq, mos kelmoq

examples.en: Blue suits you. You should wear it more often.
examples.uz: Ko'k rang sizga yarashadi. Siz uni ko'proq
examples.grammar: 'Blue + suits + you' - Present Simple - 'should + wear' modal fe'l maslahatni bildiradi.

examples.en: That hat suits you very well.
examples.uz: U shlyapa sizga juda yarashadi.
examples.grammar: 'suits + you' - Present Simple - uchinchi shaxs birlikda fe'lga -s qo'shiladi.

examples.en: My brother has to wear a suit and tie to work every day.
examples.uz: Akam har kuni ishga kostyum-shim va
examples.grammar: 'has to + wear + a + ot and + ot + to work + every day' - Present Simple, 'has to' majburiyatni bildiradi.

examples.en: He bought a new suit for his brother's wedding.
examples.uz: U akasining to'yi uchun yangi kostyum-shim sotib oldi.
examples.grammar: 'bought + a + sifat + ot + for + egalik + ot' - Past Simple, egalik 's bilan ifodalangan.

defEn: right or good for a purpose
defUz: biror maqsad uchun to'g'ri yoki mos

examples.en: We believe you are the suitable person for the job
examples.uz: do you want it? – Siz ish uchun munosib odam
examples.grammar: 'are + the + suitable + ot + for' - Present Simple - 'suitable' sifati 'person' otini aniqlaydi.

examples.en: This film is suitable for young children.
examples.uz: Bu film yosh bolalar uchun mos.
examples.grammar: 'is suitable + for' - Present Simple - 'for' predlogi kimga mosligini bildiradi.

defEn: not right or not good for a purpose
defUz: biror maqsad uchun to'g'ri yoki mos emas

examples.en: He's unsuitable as a manager
examples.uz: he's much too young, for one thing. – U ish boshqaruvchi
examples.grammar: 'is + unsuitable + as + a + ot' - Present Simple - 'unsuitable' inkor sifat, 'as' rolni bildiradi.

examples.en: These shoes are unsuitable for a long walk.
examples.uz: Bu oyoq kiyimlar uzoq sayr uchun nomunosib.
examples.grammar: 'are unsuitable + for' - Present Simple - 'for' predlogi maqsadni bildiradi.

defEn: A picture or message that tries to sell something.
defUz: Biror narsani sotishga uringan rasm yoki xabar.

examples.en: There was an advert for coffee on the side of the bus.
examples.uz: Avtobusning yon tomonida kofe
examples.grammar: 'There was + an + advert' - Past Simple, 'there was' o'tmishda biror narsa borligini bildiradi, 'on the side of' predlogli birikma joyni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: I saw a funny advert for shoes on TV last night.
examples.uz: Kecha kechqurun televizorda poyabzal uchun kulgili reklamani ko'rdim.
examples.grammar: 'saw + an + advert' - Past Simple, 'for shoes' predlogli birikma reklama nima haqida ekanini bildiradi.

defEn: A shop that sells meat.
defUz: Go'sht sotadigan do'kon.

examples.en: Go to the butcher's and get me some sausages.
examples.uz: Go'sht do'koniga borib, menga ozgina sosiska
examples.grammar: 'Go + to the + butcher's' - buyruq gap, 'go to' predlogi yo'nalishni bildiradi, 'get me' qism iltimosni ifodalaydi.

examples.en: The butcher's near my house sells very fresh meat.
examples.uz: Uyimga yaqin go'sht do'koni juda yangi go'sht sotadi.
examples.grammar: 'The butcher's + sells' - Present Simple, ega birlikda bo'lgani uchun fe'lga '-s' qo'shilgan.

defEn: Money in the form of coins and notes.
defUz: Tanga va qog'oz pul shaklidagi pul.

examples.en: They don't accept credit cards in that shop
examples.uz: only cash. – U do'konda plastik kartochkalar qabul
examples.grammar: 'They don't accept + ot' - Present Simple inkor shakli, 'don't' yordamchi fe'l harakat bo'lmasligini bildiradi.

examples.en: I always pay in cash at the small market.
examples.uz: Men kichik bozorda har doim naqd pulda to'layman.
examples.grammar: 'pay + in cash' - Present Simple, 'in cash' predlogli birikma to'lov usulini bildiradi.

uz: kiyimni sotib olishdan avval uni kiyib ko'radigan xona, kiyim almashtirish xonasi
defEn: A small room in a shop where you try on clothes.
defUz: Do'konda kiyimni kiyib ko'radigan kichik xona.

examples.en: Where are the changing rooms? I want to try on these trousers.
examples.uz: Kiyim almashtirish xonalari
examples.grammar: 'Where are + the + changing rooms?' - so'roq gap, 'where' joyni so'raydi, 'I want to try on' qismida 'want + to + infinitiv' tuzilishi bor.

examples.en: She is in the changing room and she is trying on a dress.
examples.uz: U kiyim almashtirish xonasida va u ko'ylakni kiyib ko'ryapti.
examples.grammar: 'is trying on' - Present Continuous, ayni damdagi harakatni bildiradi, 'in the changing room' joyni ko'rsatadi.

defEn: A shop that sells medicine.
defUz: Dori sotadigan do'kon.

examples.en: When you're at the chemist's, will you get me some aspirin?
examples.uz: Dorixonada ekanligingizda menga
examples.grammar: 'When you're at the + chemist's, will you + infinitiv?' - 'when' bilan boshlangan ergash gap va Future ('will') so'roq gap birga kelgan.

examples.en: I need to go to the chemist's because I have a headache.
examples.uz: Boshim og'rigani uchun dorixonaga borishim kerak.
examples.grammar: 'because' - sabab bog'lovchisi, ikki gapni bog'laydi, 'need to go' da 'need + to + infinitiv' tuzilishi bor.

defEn: A plastic card you use to pay for things.
defUz: Narsalar uchun to'lashda ishlatiladigan plastik karta.

examples.en: Can I pay by credit card here?
examples.uz: Bu yerda plastik kartochka orqali to'lasam bo'ladimi?
examples.grammar: 'Can I pay by + ot?' - so'roq gap, 'can' modal fe'l ruxsat so'rashda ishlatilgan, 'by credit card' to'lov vositasini bildiradi.

examples.en: She paid for the new shoes with her credit card.
examples.uz: U yangi poyabzal uchun plastik kartochkasi bilan to'ladi.
examples.grammar: 'paid for + ot + with' - Past Simple, 'with her credit card' to'lov vositasini bildiradi.

defEn: A person who buys things from a shop.
defUz: Do'kondan narsa sotib oladigan kishi.

examples.en: He's the shop's best customer. He comes in and buys something nearly every day.
examples.uz: U do'konning
examples.grammar: 'He's the + sifat + ot' - Present Simple, 'best' eng yuqori darajani bildiradi, ikkinchi gapda 'comes' va 'buys' fe'llari birlikda '-s' oladi.

examples.en: The shop was full of customers on Saturday morning.
examples.uz: Do'kon shanba kuni ertalab xaridorlarga to'la edi.
examples.grammar: 'was full of + ot (ko'plik)' - Past Simple, 'customers' ko'plik shaklida '-s' olgan.

uz: nonvoyxona, qandolat do'koni: non mahsulotlari, to'rt, bulochka, pishiriqlar tayyorlanadigan joy
defEn: A shop that sells bread and cakes.
defUz: Non va pishiriqlar sotadigan do'kon.

examples.en: I went to the baker's to buy some bread.
examples.uz: Ozgina non sotib olish uchun nonvoyxonaga bordim.
examples.grammar: 'I went to the + baker's + to + infinitiv' - Past Simple, 'went' 'go' fe'lining o'tgan zamon shakli, 'to buy' maqsadni bildiruvchi infinitiv.

examples.en: The baker's opens early and the bread smells lovely.
examples.uz: Nonvoyxona erta ochiladi va nonning hidi juda yoqimli.
examples.grammar: 'opens + ravish' va 'smells + sifat' - Present Simple, 'and' bog'lovchisi ikki gapni bog'laydi.

uz: scho't, xizmat yoki iste'mol uchun to'lov
defEn: A piece of paper that shows how much money you must pay.
defUz: Qancha pul to'lashingiz kerakligini ko'rsatadigan qog'oz.

examples.en: Let me pay the bill for the meal this time.
examples.uz: Bu safar taom uchun to'lovni men to'lashimga ruxsat
examples.grammar: 'Let me + infinitiv' - buyruq tuzilishi, 'let me pay' biror ishni qilishga ruxsat so'rashni bildiradi, 'for the meal' maqsadni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: We asked for the bill after we finished our dinner.
examples.uz: Kechki ovqatni tugatganimizdan keyin to'lovni so'radik.
examples.grammar: 'asked for + the + bill' - Past Simple, 'after' bilan boshlangan ergash gap vaqtni bildiradi.

defEn: A shop that sells books.
defUz: Kitob sotadigan do'kon.

examples.en: Alex went into the bookshop to buy a book.
examples.uz: Aleks kitob sotib olish uchun kitob do'koniga kirdi.
examples.grammar: 'Alex went into the + ot + to + infinitiv' - Past Simple, 'went into' yo'nalishni bildiradi, 'to buy' maqsadni bildiruvchi infinitiv.

examples.en: There is a big bookshop in the city centre.
examples.uz: Shahar markazida katta kitob do'koni bor.
examples.grammar: 'There is + a + ot' - Present Simple, birlikda biror narsa borligini bildiradi, 'in the city centre' joyni ko'rsatadi.

uz: univermag, savdo markazi: birgina katta do'kon ichida barcha turdagi mahsulotlar sotiladi
defEn: A big shop that sells many different kinds of things.
defUz: Ko'p turdagi narsalarni sotadigan katta do'kon.

examples.en: You can buy nearly anything in a department store.
examples.uz: Univermagda deyarli istalgan narsani sotib
examples.grammar: 'You can buy + olmosh + in a + ot' - 'can' modal fe'l imkoniyatni bildiradi, 'nearly anything' deyarli har narsani anglatadi.

examples.en: We bought new clothes and shoes at the department store.
examples.uz: Biz univermagdan yangi kiyim va poyabzal sotib oldik.
examples.grammar: 'bought + ot + at the + ot' - Past Simple, 'and' bog'lovchisi ikki otni bog'laydi.

defEn: Something you give to a person to make them happy.
defUz: Birovni xursand qilish uchun beradigan narsa.

examples.en: Fred bought his dad a gift for his birthday.
examples.uz: Fred dadasiga tug'ilgan kuni uchun bir sovg'a sotib
examples.grammar: 'Fred bought his dad a + ot' - Past Simple, ikki to'ldiruvchi bor: 'his dad' (kimga) va 'a gift' (nima), 'for his birthday' sababni bildiradi.

examples.en: I want to buy a nice gift for my best friend.
examples.uz: Eng yaqin do'stimga chiroyli sovg'a sotib olmoqchiman.
examples.grammar: 'want to buy + a + ot' - 'want + to + infinitiv' tuzilishi, 'for my best friend' kimga ekanini bildiradi.

defEn: A shop that sells fruit and vegetables.
defUz: Meva va sabzavot sotadigan do'kon.

examples.en: I bought some bananas and apples at the greengrocer's.
examples.uz: Men meva va sabzavotlar do'konida
examples.grammar: 'I bought some + ot + at the + greengrocer's' - Past Simple, 'some' sanab bo'lmaydigan yoki ko'plik narsa miqdorini bildiradi, 'at' joyni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: The greengrocer's sells fresh tomatoes every day.
examples.uz: Meva va sabzavotlar do'koni har kuni yangi pomidor sotadi.
examples.grammar: 'sells + ot' - Present Simple, ega birlikda bo'lgani uchun fe'lga '-s' qo'shilgan, 'every day' odatiy harakatni bildiradi.

defEn: Buying things from the internet.
defUz: Narsalarni internetdan sotib olish.

examples.en: Online shopping is much easier than going out to the shops.
examples.uz: Internetda xarid qilish do'konga
examples.grammar: 'Online shopping is + qiyosiy daraja + than' - Present Simple, 'easier than' qiyosiy daraja, ikki narsani solishtiradi.

examples.en: My mother does her online shopping on Sunday evenings.
examples.uz: Onam internetda xaridini yakshanba kechalari qiladi.
examples.grammar: 'does + online shopping' - Present Simple, ega birlikda bo'lgani uchun 'do' fe'li 'does' shaklida kelgan.

uz: cho'ntak puli: ota-onalar farzandiga ehtiyoj tug'ilganda biror yegulik, o'quv qurollari va hokazolar uchun sarflashi uchun beradi
defEn: A small amount of money that parents give to children.
defUz: Ota-onalar bolalariga beradigan ozgina pul.

examples.en: Do your parents give you pocket money every week?
examples.uz: Ota-onangiz sizga har hafta cho'ntak puli
examples.grammar: 'Do your parents give you + ot?' - Present Simple so'roq gap, 'do' yordamchi fe'l savol yasaydi, 'every week' takrorlanuvchi harakatni bildiradi.

examples.en: I save my pocket money to buy a new game.
examples.uz: Yangi o'yin sotib olish uchun cho'ntak pulimni jamg'araman.
examples.grammar: 'save + ot + to + infinitiv' - Present Simple, 'to buy' maqsadni bildiruvchi infinitiv.

defEn: A thing you give to someone on a special day.
defUz: Maxsus kunda birovga beradigan narsa.

examples.en: Yvonne bought her mother a lovely present for Mother's Day.
examples.uz: Ivo'n onasiga Onalar Kuni
examples.grammar: 'Yvonne bought her mother a + sifat + ot' - Past Simple, ikki to'ldiruvchi 'her mother' va 'a present' bor, 'for Mother's Day' sababni bildiradi.

examples.en: She opened her birthday presents in the morning.
examples.uz: U tug'ilgan kun sovg'alarini ertalab ochdi.
examples.grammar: 'opened + ot (ko'plik)' - Past Simple, 'presents' ko'plik shaklida '-s' olgan, 'in the morning' vaqtni bildiradi.

defEn: The amount of money you pay for something.
defUz: Biror narsa uchun to'laydigan pul miqdori.

examples.en: All the shops bring their prices down after Christmas.
examples.uz: Hamma do'konlar Rojdestvodan so'ng
examples.grammar: 'All the shops bring their prices down' - Present Simple, 'bring down' phrasal fe'l pasaytirishni bildiradi, 'prices' ko'plik shaklida.

examples.en: The price of this jacket is too high for me.
examples.uz: Bu kurtkaning narxi men uchun juda baland.
examples.grammar: 'The price + is + ravish + sifat' - Present Simple, 'too high' juda balandligini bildiradi, 'for me' kimga nisbatan ekanini ko'rsatadi.

defEn: A line of people waiting for something.
defUz: Biror narsani kutib turgan odamlar qatori.

examples.en: There was a long queue in the bank, so I went to do my shopping instead.
examples.uz: Bankda uzun navbat
examples.grammar: 'There was a + sifat + queue' - Past Simple, 'there was' o'tmishda biror narsa borligini bildiradi, 'so' bog'lovchisi natijani ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: We waited in a long queue to pay for our food.
examples.uz: Biz ovqatimiz uchun to'lash maqsadida uzun navbatda kutdik.
examples.grammar: 'waited in a + queue' - Past Simple, 'to pay' maqsadni bildiruvchi infinitiv.

defEn: A person who helps customers in a shop.
defUz: Do'konda xaridorlarga yordam beradigan kishi.

examples.en: The shop assistant in the clothes shop asked Greg if he needed any help.
examples.uz: Kiyim do'konidagi
examples.grammar: 'The shop assistant asked Greg if he needed + olmosh' - Past Simple, 'asked ... if' bilvosita so'roqni bildiradi, 'needed' o'tgan zamon fe'li.

examples.en: The shop assistant showed me a cheaper coat.
examples.uz: Sotuvchi menga arzonroq palto ko'rsatdi.
examples.grammar: 'showed + olmosh + a + ot' - Past Simple, 'cheaper' qiyosiy daraja, arzonroq ekanini bildiradi.

uz: savdo majmuasi: turli-tuman mahsulotlar sotishga mo'ljallangan ko'plab do'konlardan tashkil topgan bo'ladi
defEn: A big place with many shops under one roof.
defUz: Bir tom ostida ko'plab do'konlari bor katta joy.

examples.en: They go to the shopping mall every weekend to shop and eat.
examples.uz: Ular har hafta oxirida xarid qilish
examples.grammar: 'They go to the + ot + every weekend' - Present Simple, 'every weekend' takrorlanuvchi harakatni bildiradi, 'to shop and eat' maqsadni bildiruvchi infinitivlar.

examples.en: There are many clothes shops in the new shopping mall.
examples.uz: Yangi savdo majmuasida ko'plab kiyim do'konlari bor.
examples.grammar: 'There are + ot (ko'plik)' - Present Simple, 'are' ko'plik bilan ishlatiladi, 'in the new shopping mall' joyni ko'rsatadi.

defEn: An outdoor market on a street where people sell things.
defUz: Odamlar narsa sotadigan ko'chadagi ochiq bozor.

examples.en: Tourists love shopping in this street market in Istanbul.
examples.uz: Sayyohlar Istanbuldagi ushbu
examples.grammar: 'Tourists love shopping in this + ot' - Present Simple, 'love + -ing' shaklida fe'l keladi, 'in Istanbul' joyni bildiradi.

examples.en: We bought fresh fruit at the street market this morning.
examples.uz: Biz bugun ertalab bozorchadan yangi meva sotib oldik.
examples.grammar: 'bought + ot + at the + street market' - Past Simple, 'this morning' vaqtni bildiradi.

defEn: A big shop where you can buy food and other things.
defUz: Oziq-ovqat va boshqa narsalar sotib oladigan katta do'kon.

examples.en: He went to the supermarket with his mum to help with the shopping.
examples.uz: U xarid qilishda yordam
examples.grammar: 'He went to the + ot + with his mum' - Past Simple, 'with his mum' birgalikni bildiradi, 'to help' maqsadni bildiruvchi infinitiv.

examples.en: I buy milk and bread at the supermarket every week.
examples.uz: Men har hafta supermarketdan sut va non sotib olaman.
examples.grammar: 'buy + ot + at the + supermarket' - Present Simple, 'every week' takrorlanuvchi harakatni bildiradi.

defEn: To get something by paying money for it.
defUz: Pul to'lab biror narsani olmoq.

examples.en: Jane went shopping but she didn't buy anything.
examples.uz: Jeyn xarid qilishga bordi, lekin hech narsa
examples.grammar: 'she didn't buy + olmosh' - Past Simple inkor shakli, 'didn't' yordamchi fe'l harakat bo'lmaganini bildiradi, 'but' bog'lovchisi qarama-qarshilikni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: I want to buy a new bag for school.
examples.uz: Maktab uchun yangi sumka sotib olmoqchiman.
examples.grammar: 'want to buy + a + ot' - 'want + to + infinitiv' tuzilishi, 'for school' maqsadni bildiradi.

defEn: To take something back to a shop and get another one.
defUz: Biror narsani do'konga qaytarib boshqasiga almashtirmoq.

examples.en: I want to change this top because it's too small for me.
examples.uz: Men mana bu ustki kiyimni
examples.grammar: 'I want to change this + ot + because + ergash gap' - 'want + to + infinitiv', 'because' sabab bog'lovchisi, 'it's too small' sababni bildiradi.

examples.en: Can I change these shoes for a bigger size, please?
examples.uz: Bu poyabzalni kattaroq o'lchamga almashtirsam bo'ladimi?
examples.grammar: 'Can I change + ot?' - so'roq gap, 'can' modal fe'l ruxsat so'rashda ishlatilgan, 'bigger' qiyosiy daraja.

defEn: To ask someone to pay a certain amount of money.
defUz: Birovdan ma'lum miqdorda pul to'lashni so'ramoq.

examples.en: How much do they charge for a haircut here?
examples.uz: Bu yerda soch olish uchun necha pul olishadi?
examples.grammar: 'How much do they charge for + ot?' - Present Simple so'roq gap, 'how much' miqdorni so'raydi, 'for a haircut' nima uchun ekanini bildiradi.

examples.en: The shop charges five pounds for delivery.
examples.uz: Do'kon yetkazib berish uchun besh funt haq oladi.
examples.grammar: 'charges + ot + for' - Present Simple, ega birlikda bo'lgani uchun fe'lga '-s' qo'shilgan.

defEn: To stop being open.
defUz: Ochiq bo'lishni to'xtatmoq, yopilmoq.

examples.en: Do the shops close at 5 pm or 6 pm today?
examples.uz: Bugun do'konlar kechki soat 5 da yopiladimi yoki 6
examples.grammar: 'Do the shops close at + vaqt?' - Present Simple so'roq gap, 'do' yordamchi fe'l savol yasaydi, 'or' bog'lovchisi tanlovni bildiradi.

examples.en: The shops close early on Sunday in our town.
examples.uz: Bizning shaharchada do'konlar yakshanba kuni erta yopiladi.
examples.grammar: 'close + ravish' - Present Simple, 'shops' ko'plik bo'lgani uchun fe'l '-s' olmaydi, 'on Sunday' vaqtni bildiradi.

defEn: To have a certain price.
defUz: Ma'lum narxda bo'lmoq.

examples.en: How much does a loaf of bread cost?
examples.uz: Bir buxanka non necha pul turadi?
examples.grammar: 'How much does + ot + cost?' - Present Simple so'roq gap, 'does' yordamchi fe'l birlikda savol yasaydi, asosiy fe'l 'cost' o'zgarmaydi.

examples.en: How much does this red jacket cost?
examples.uz: Bu qizil kurtka necha pul turadi?
examples.grammar: 'does + ot + cost' - Present Simple so'roq gap, 'does' birlik ega bilan ishlatilgan, asosiy fe'l asl shaklida.

defEn: To start being open so people can come in.
defUz: Odamlar kirishi uchun ochilmoq.

examples.en: What time do the shops open here in the morning?
examples.uz: Bu yerda do'konlar tongda soat nechada
examples.grammar: 'What time do the shops open + ravish?' - Present Simple so'roq gap, 'what time' vaqtni so'raydi, 'in the morning' vaqtni bildiradi.

examples.en: The new shop opens at nine o'clock tomorrow.
examples.uz: Yangi do'kon ertaga soat to'qqizda ochiladi.
examples.grammar: 'opens + at + vaqt' - Present Simple, ega birlikda bo'lgani uchun fe'lga '-s' qo'shilgan.

defEn: To ask for food or things to be brought to you.
defUz: Ovqat yoki narsalarni keltirishni so'ramoq, buyurtma bermoq.

examples.en: Well, I know what I want to eat
examples.uz: are you ready to order? – Xo'sh, men nima yeyishni
examples.grammar: 'I know what I want to eat' - Present Simple, 'what I want to eat' bilvosita so'roqni bildiradi, 'want + to + infinitiv' tuzilishi bor.

examples.en: We ordered two pizzas and some juice for dinner.
examples.uz: Biz kechki ovqatga ikkita pitsa va ozgina sharbat buyurtma berdik.
examples.grammar: 'ordered + ot + and + ot' - Past Simple, 'and' bog'lovchisi ikki buyurtmani bog'laydi.

defEn: To give money for something.
defUz: Biror narsa uchun pul bermoq.

examples.en: Ruth's dad always pays for the meal when they go out.
examples.uz: Rusning dadasi ular aylanishga
examples.grammar: 'Ruth's dad always pays for the + ot' - Present Simple, 'always' takrorlanuvchi harakatni bildiradi, 'pay for' predlogli birikma nima uchun to'lanishini ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: I paid for the books with cash yesterday.
examples.uz: Men kecha kitoblar uchun naqd pulda to'ladim.
examples.grammar: 'paid for + ot + with' - Past Simple, 'with cash' to'lov usulini bildiradi.

defEn: To take something back to the shop.
defUz: Biror narsani do'konga qaytarib bermoq.

examples.en: Henry returned the MP3 player because it stopped working.
examples.uz: Henri MP3 pleyerni qaytarib berdi
examples.grammar: 'Henry returned the + ot + because + ergash gap' - Past Simple, 'because' sabab bog'lovchisi, 'it stopped working' sababni bildiradi.

examples.en: She returned the dress because it was the wrong size.
examples.uz: U ko'ylakni noto'g'ri o'lchamda bo'lgani uchun qaytarib berdi.
examples.grammar: 'returned + the + ot' - Past Simple, 'because' sabab ergash gapini boshlaydi.

examples.en: We leave for France on the 8th and return on the 17th.
examples.uz: Biz Fransiyaga 8-da jo'naymiz va 17-da
examples.grammar: 'leave for + somewhere + and + ot' - jo'nash va qaytishni bildiradi - Present Simple (rejalashtirilgan kelajak).

examples.en: They returned home very late after the long journey.
examples.uz: Ular uzoq safardan keyin uyga juda kech qaytdilar.
examples.grammar: 'ot + home' - uyga qaytishni bildiradi - Past Simple.

defEn: To give something to someone for money.
defUz: Biror narsani pulga evaziga birovga bermoq.

examples.en: They sell great steaks  🥩  in that butcher's.
examples.uz: Anavi go'sht do'konida ajoyib lahm go'shtlar
examples.grammar: 'They sell great + ot + in that + ot' - Present Simple, 'sell' ko'plik ega bilan o'zgarmaydi, 'in that butcher's' joyni bildiradi.

examples.en: That shop sells fresh bread every morning.
examples.uz: Anavi do'kon har tongda yangi non sotadi.
examples.grammar: 'sells + ot' - Present Simple, ega birlikda bo'lgani uchun fe'lga '-s' qo'shilgan, 'every morning' odatiy harakatni bildiradi.

defEn: To use money to buy things.
defUz: Narsalar sotib olish uchun pul ishlatmoq.

examples.en: Julie spent all her pocket money on one top.
examples.uz: Juli hamma cho'ntak pulini bittagina ustki kiyimga
examples.grammar: 'Julie spent all her + ot + on + ot' - Past Simple, 'spent' 'spend' fe'lining o'tgan zamon shakli, 'on one top' nimaga sarflanganini bildiradi.

examples.en: I spent all my money on new shoes last week.
examples.uz: O'tgan haftada bor pulimni yangi poyabzalga sarfladim.
examples.grammar: 'spent + olmosh + money + on + ot' - Past Simple, 'on new shoes' nimaga sarflanganini bildiradi.

defEn: To cover something with paper.
defUz: Biror narsani qog'ozga o'ramoq.

examples.en: Did you get paper to wrap the Christmas presents with?
examples.uz: Rojdestvo sovg'alarini o'rash uchun
examples.grammar: 'Did you get paper to wrap the + ot + with?' - Past Simple so'roq gap, 'did' yordamchi fe'l savol yasaydi, 'to wrap' maqsadni bildiruvchi infinitiv.

examples.en: I will wrap the gift in pretty paper for her.
examples.uz: Sovg'ani uning uchun chiroyli qog'ozga o'rayman.
examples.grammar: 'will wrap + the + ot' - Future ('will'), kelajakdagi harakatni bildiradi, 'in pretty paper' qanday o'ralishini ko'rsatadi.

defEn: To become lower, for example prices.
defUz: Pasaymoq, masalan narxlar.

examples.en: Wait for the prices to go down in the sales.
examples.uz: Chegirmada narxlar pasayishini kuting.
examples.grammar: 'Wait for the prices to go down' - buyruq gap, 'wait for' predlogli birikma, 'to go down' phrasal fe'l pasayishni bildiradi.

examples.en: The price of fruit always comes down in summer.
examples.uz: Mevaning narxi yozda har doim pasayadi.
examples.grammar: 'comes down' - Present Simple phrasal fe'l, 'always' takrorlanuvchi harakatni bildiradi, ega birlikda fe'l '-s' olgan.

defEn: To become higher, for example prices.
defUz: Ko'tarilmoq, masalan narxlar.

examples.en: Prices always go up before Christmas.
examples.uz: Rojdestvodan avval narxlar har doim ko'tariladi.
examples.grammar: 'Prices always go up + before + ot' - Present Simple, 'go up' phrasal fe'l ko'tarilishni bildiradi, 'before Christmas' vaqtni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: Petrol prices went up again last month.
examples.uz: O'tgan oyda benzin narxlari yana ko'tarildi.
examples.grammar: 'went up' - Past Simple phrasal fe'l, 'again' takrorlanganini bildiradi, 'last month' vaqtni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: Let's go up to the top floor of the house.
examples.uz: Keling uyning eng yuqori qavatiga chiqamiz.
examples.grammar: 'Let us go up to the top floor' - buyruq/taklif gap; 'Let us + infinitiv' taklifni, 'go up to' yo'nalishni bildiradi.

examples.en: We went up to the roof to see the city.
examples.uz: Biz shaharni ko'rish uchun tomga chiqdik.
examples.grammar: 'We went up' - Past Simple; 'go up' phrasal fe'li o'tgan zamonda 'went up', 'to see' infinitiv maqsadni bildiradi.

defEn: To decide something.
defUz: Biror narsa haqida qaror qabul qilmoq.

examples.en: I can't make up my mind
examples.uz: which shirt is better? – Men bir qarorga kelolmayapman–qaysi ko'ylak
examples.grammar: 'I can't make up my mind' - 'can't' modal fe'l inkor shakli, 'make up one's mind' ibora qaror qila olmaslikni bildiradi.

examples.en: She cannot make up her mind about the new phone.
examples.uz: U yangi telefon haqida bir qarorga kelolmayapti.
examples.grammar: 'cannot make up + egalik olmoshi + mind' - 'cannot' modal fe'l inkor shakli, 'about the new phone' nima haqida ekanini bildiradi.

uz: sotib olgan narsani do'konga qaytarib olib bormoq
defEn: To return something to the shop where you bought it.
defUz: Sotib olgan do'koningga biror narsani qaytarib olib bormoq.

examples.en: That dress doesn't fit. You should take it back.
examples.uz: Bu ko'ylak mos tushmadi. Uni do'konga qaytarib
examples.grammar: 'You should take it back' - 'should' modal fe'l maslahatni bildiradi, 'take back' phrasal fe'l qaytarishni anglatadi, 'it' o'rtada keladi.

examples.en: I will take the broken radio back tomorrow.
examples.uz: Buzilgan radioni ertaga do'konga qaytarib olib boraman.
examples.grammar: 'will take + ot + back' - Future ('will'), phrasal fe'l, to'ldiruvchi 'the broken radio' o'rtada kelgan.

defEn: To move something from a high place to a lower place.
defUz: Biror narsani baland joydan pastga olmoq.

examples.en: He took the teddy bear 🧸 down from the shelf for his daughter.
examples.uz: U yumshoq ayiqchani qizi
examples.grammar: 'He took the + ot + down from the shelf' - Past Simple, 'take down' phrasal fe'l, 'from the shelf' qayerdan olinganini bildiradi.

examples.en: The shop assistant took the box down from the top shelf.
examples.uz: Sotuvchi qutini eng yuqori javondan pastga oldi.
examples.grammar: 'took + ot + down + from' - Past Simple phrasal fe'l, to'ldiruvchi 'the box' o'rtada kelgan.

defEn: To cover something completely with paper.
defUz: Biror narsani qog'oz bilan to'liq o'ramoq.

examples.en: Let's wrap up the presents and put them under the tree.
examples.uz: Keling sovg'alarni o'raymiz va
examples.grammar: 'Let's wrap up the + ot' - 'let's' birgalikda ish qilishga taklif, 'wrap up' phrasal fe'l o'rashni bildiradi, 'and' bog'lovchisi ikki harakatni bog'laydi.

examples.en: Please wrap up these books before you send them.
examples.uz: Bu kitoblarni jo'natishdan oldin o'rab qo'ying.
examples.grammar: 'wrap up + ot' - buyruq gap, phrasal fe'l, 'before' bilan boshlangan ergash gap vaqtni bildiradi.

defEn: A small number of things, usually two or three.
defUz: Bir nechta narsa, odatda ikki yoki uchta.

examples.en: Can you get a couple of things for me at the supermarket?
examples.uz: Supermarketda men uchun bir
examples.grammar: 'Can you get a couple of + ot?' - so'roq gap, 'can you' iltimosni bildiradi, 'a couple of things' ozgina narsani anglatadi.

examples.en: I need to buy a couple of things at the shop.
examples.uz: Do'kondan bir nechta narsa sotib olishim kerak.
examples.grammar: 'need to buy + a couple of + ot' - 'need + to + infinitiv' tuzilishi, ibora ozgina narsa miqdorini bildiradi.

defEn: The way that two things are not the same.
defUz: Ikki narsaning bir xil emasligi, ular o'rtasidagi farq.

examples.en: There's no difference between those two shirts
examples.uz: buy either. – Bu ikki ko'ylak o'rtasida hech
examples.grammar: 'There's no difference between + ot' - Present Simple, 'there's no' biror narsa yo'qligini bildiradi, 'between those two shirts' nima o'rtasida ekanini ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: What is the difference between these two phones?
examples.uz: Bu ikki telefon o'rtasidagi farq nima?
examples.grammar: 'the difference between + ot (ko'plik)' - so'roq gap, 'between' predlogi ikki narsani solishtirishni bildiradi.

defEn: Something that you can buy.
defUz: Sotib olish mumkin bo'lgan narsa.

examples.en: The coat on the counter wasn't for sale
examples.uz: it was the shop assistant's. – Peshtaxtadagi palto
examples.grammar: 'The coat on the counter wasn't for sale' - Past Simple inkor shakli, 'wasn't' biror narsa shunday emasligini bildiradi, 'for sale' sotuvda ekanini anglatadi.

examples.en: The house next to ours is for sale now.
examples.uz: Bizning yonimizdagi uy hozir sotuvda.
examples.grammar: 'is for sale' - Present Simple, 'for sale' sotuvda ekanini bildiradi, 'now' hozirgi holatni ko'rsatadi.

defEn: To get your money back for something you return.
defUz: Qaytarib bergan narsang uchun pulingni qaytarib olmoq.

examples.en: Bring the DVD player back and get a refund
examples.uz: it doesn't work. – DVR pleyerni qaytarib olib keling
examples.grammar: 'Bring the + ot + back and get a refund' - buyruq gap, 'bring back' phrasal fe'l, 'and' bog'lovchisi ikki buyruqni bog'laydi.

examples.en: You can get a refund if the shoes do not fit.
examples.uz: Agar poyabzal mos kelmasa, to'lagan pulingizni qaytarib olishingiz mumkin.
examples.grammar: 'can get a refund + if + ergash gap' - 'can' modal fe'l imkoniyatni bildiradi, 'if' shart mayli ergash gapini boshlaydi.

defEn: To travel somewhere together with another person.
defUz: Biror kishi bilan birga bir joyga bormoq.

examples.en: Go with your father to the supermarket, Diane.
examples.uz: Dayan, dadangiz bilan supermarketga boring.
examples.grammar: 'Go with your father to the + ot' - buyruq gap, 'go with' birgalikni bildiradi, 'to the supermarket' yo'nalishni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: Will you go with me to the shopping centre?
examples.uz: Men bilan savdo majmuasiga borasizmi?
examples.grammar: 'Will you go with + olmosh?' - Future ('will') so'roq gap, 'with me' birgalikni bildiradi.

defEn: Paying with coins and notes, not a card.
defUz: Karta bilan emas, tanga va qog'oz pul bilan to'lash.

examples.en: Are you paying by credit card or in cash?
examples.uz: Plastik kartochka orqali to'laysizmi yoki naqd pul
examples.grammar: 'Are you paying by credit card or in cash?' - Present Continuous so'roq gap, 'or' bog'lovchisi tanlovni bildiradi, 'in cash' to'lov usulini ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: I would like to pay in cash, please.
examples.uz: Men naqd pulda to'lamoqchiman.
examples.grammar: 'would like to pay + in cash' - 'would like + to + infinitiv' tuzilishi xushmuomala iltimosni bildiradi.

uz: uning narxi... (biror narsaning narxi/qiymatini aytishda foydalaniladi)
defEn: Used to say the price of something.
defUz: Biror narsaning narxini aytishda ishlatiladi.

examples.en: It costs £15 to watch a film in that cinema.
examples.uz: U kinoteatrda film tomosha qilishning narxi 15 funt
examples.grammar: 'It costs + narx + to + infinitiv' - Present Simple, 'it costs' narxni bildiradi, 'to watch a film' nima uchun ekanini ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: It costs ten pounds to buy a ticket for the show.
examples.uz: Tomosha uchun chipta sotib olishning narxi o'n funt.
examples.grammar: 'It costs + narx + to + infinitiv' - Present Simple, 'to buy a ticket' maqsadni bildiruvchi infinitiv.

defEn: To go to the shops to buy things.
defUz: Narsa sotib olish uchun do'konlarga bormoq.

examples.en: Do you go shopping in town every Saturday?
examples.uz: Shaharda xarid qilish uchun har shanba kuni
examples.grammar: 'Do you go shopping + ravish?' - Present Simple so'roq gap, 'do' yordamchi fe'l savol yasaydi, 'go shopping' xaridga borishni bildiradi.

examples.en: We go shopping for food on Saturdays.
examples.uz: Biz shanba kunlari oziq-ovqat uchun xaridga boramiz.
examples.grammar: 'go shopping for + ot' - Present Simple, 'for food' nima uchun ekanini bildiradi, 'on Saturdays' takrorlanuvchi harakatni ko'rsatadi.

defEn: Showing what material something is.
defUz: Biror narsa qanday materialdan ekanini ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: What is this shirt made of
examples.uz: cotton or polyester? – Bu ko'ylak qanday materialdan tikilgan–
examples.grammar: 'What is this shirt made of?' - Present Simple so'roq gap, passiv tuzilish, 'made of' material nima ekanini so'raydi.

examples.en: This bag is made of leather and it is very strong.
examples.uz: Bu sumka teridan tayyorlangan va u juda mustahkam.
examples.grammar: 'is made of + ot' - Present Simple passiv, 'and' bog'lovchisi ikki gapni bog'laydi.

defEn: To give money to buy something.
defUz: Biror narsani sotib olish uchun pul bermoq.

examples.en: Pay for lunch today and I will tomorrow.
examples.uz: Tushlik uchun bugun siz to'lang, men esa ertaga
examples.grammar: 'Pay for lunch today and I will tomorrow' - buyruq gap, 'pay for' predlogli birikma, 'and' bog'lovchisi ikki qismni bog'laydi.

examples.en: My brother paid for the tickets last night.
examples.uz: Akam kecha kechqurun chiptalar uchun to'ladi.
examples.grammar: 'paid for + ot' - Past Simple, 'for the tickets' nima uchun to'langanini bildiradi.

defEn: Completely new and never used before.
defUz: Mutlaqo yangi va avval ishlatilmagan.

examples.en: She's got a brand-new mobile phone
examples.uz: it was her birthday last week. – U zamonaviy telefon oldi–
examples.grammar: 'She's got a brand-new + ot' - Present Perfect ('has got'), 'brand-new' sifat ot oldidan kelib uni tasvirlaydi.

examples.en: He bought a brand-new car last month.
examples.uz: U o'tgan oyda yap-yangi mashina sotib oldi.
examples.grammar: 'bought a brand-new + ot' - Past Simple, 'brand-new' sifat ot oldidan kelib mashinani tasvirlaydi.

defEn: Not expensive, costing little money.
defUz: Qimmat emas, oz pul turadigan.

examples.en: The clothes are so cheap
examples.uz: I bought all these for £10! – Bu kiyimlar rosa arzon–bularning barini 10
examples.grammar: 'The clothes are so cheap' - Present Simple, 'so cheap' juda arzon ekanini bildiradi, 'are' to'g'ri 'to be' fe'lining ko'plik shakli.

examples.en: These shoes are very cheap, so I will buy two pairs.
examples.uz: Bu poyabzal juda arzon, shuning uchun ikki juft sotib olaman.
examples.grammar: 'are + sifat' - Present Simple, 'so' bog'lovchisi natijani bildiradi, 'will buy' Future ('will').

defEn: Costing a lot of money.
defUz: Ko'p pul turadigan.

examples.en: The clothes there are too expensive for her to buy.
examples.uz: U yerdagi kiyimlar u sotib olishi uchun
examples.grammar: 'The clothes there are too expensive for her to + infinitiv' - Present Simple, 'too expensive' juda qimmat ekanini bildiradi, 'for her to buy' kim uchun ekanini ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: This watch is too expensive for me to buy.
examples.uz: Bu soat men sotib olishim uchun juda qimmat.
examples.grammar: 'is too expensive + for + olmosh + to + infinitiv' - Present Simple, 'too ... to' juda qimmatligi sababli sotib bo'lmasligini bildiradi.

uz: ochiq havoda joylashgan, tom ostida emas, tepasi o'ralmagan
defEn: Outside, not inside a building.
defUz: Bino ichida emas, ochiq havoda.

examples.en: We visited an open-air market while we were in Thailand.
examples.uz: Biz Tailandda bo'lgan paytimizda
examples.grammar: 'We visited an open-air + ot + while + ergash gap' - Past Simple, 'open-air' sifat ot oldidan keladi, 'while' bilan boshlangan ergash gap vaqtni bildiradi.

examples.en: There is a big open-air market in our city every Sunday.
examples.uz: Shahrimizda har yakshanba katta ochiq bozor bo'ladi.
examples.grammar: 'There is + an + open-air + ot' - Present Simple, 'open-air' sifat ot oldidan kelib bozorni tasvirlaydi.

defEn: Very much, to a high degree.
defUz: Juda ham, yuqori darajada.

examples.en: Mark always takes an extremely long time to choose clothes.
examples.uz: Mark har doim kiyim tanlash
examples.grammar: 'Mark always takes an extremely + sifat + ot' - Present Simple, 'extremely' ravish sifatni kuchaytiradi, 'always' takrorlanuvchi harakatni bildiradi.

examples.en: This shop is extremely busy on Saturday afternoons.
examples.uz: Bu do'kon shanba tushdan keyinlari nihoyatda gavjum.
examples.grammar: 'extremely + sifat' - Present Simple, 'extremely' ravish 'busy' sifatini kuchaytiradi.

defEn: Quite, but not very.
defUz: Anchagina, lekin juda emas.

examples.en: The shoes were fairly expensive, but not too much.
examples.uz: Oyoq kiyimlar anchagina qimmat edi, lekin
examples.grammar: 'The shoes were fairly + sifat, but not too much' - Past Simple, 'fairly' ravish darajani bildiradi, 'but' bog'lovchisi qarama-qarshilikni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: The shopping centre is fairly big, but it is not the biggest.
examples.uz: Savdo majmuasi anchagina katta, lekin u eng kattasi emas.
examples.grammar: 'fairly + sifat' - Present Simple, 'fairly' ravish 'big' sifatini biroz kuchaytiradi, 'biggest' eng yuqori daraja.

defEn: A little or a lot, but not completely.
defUz: Biroz yoki ancha, lekin to'liq emas.

examples.en: It's quite cheap to eat in that restaurant, but the food's great.
examples.uz: U restoranda ovqatlanish
examples.grammar: 'It's quite cheap to + infinitiv' - Present Simple, 'quite' ravish darajani bildiradi, 'to eat' maqsadni bildiruvchi infinitiv, 'but' bog'lovchisi qarama-qarshilikni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: The market is quite cheap, so we shop there often.
examples.uz: Bozor anchagina arzon, shuning uchun u yerda tez-tez xarid qilamiz.
examples.grammar: 'quite + sifat' - Present Simple, 'quite' ravish 'cheap' sifatini darajalaydi, 'so' natijani bildiradi.

defEn: To help someone.
defUz: Birovga yordam bermoq.

examples.en: Your job will be to assist the production manager.
examples.uz: Sizning ishingiz ishlab chiqarish menejeriga
examples.grammar: 'Your job will be to assist the + ot' - Future ('will'), 'will be' kelajakdagi holatni bildiradi, 'to assist' infinitiv vazifani ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: She will assist the new shop assistant today.
examples.uz: U bugun yangi sotuvchiga yordam beradi.
examples.grammar: 'will assist + ot' - Future ('will'), kelajakdagi harakatni bildiradi, 'today' vaqtni ko'rsatadi.

defEn: A person who helps someone in their work.
defUz: Ishda birovga yordam beradigan kishi.

examples.en: My mum works as an assistant to the manager.
examples.uz: Mening oyim ish boshqaruvchi yordamchisi
examples.grammar: 'My mum works as an assistant to the + ot' - Present Simple, 'works as' biror lavozimda ishlashni bildiradi, 'to the manager' kimga ekanini ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: The assistant showed us the new winter coats.
examples.uz: Yordamchi bizga yangi qishki paltolarni ko'rsatdi.
examples.grammar: 'The assistant + showed + ot' - Past Simple, ega birlikda, 'us' va 'the new winter coats' ikki to'ldiruvchi.

defEn: Help that you give to someone.
defUz: Birovga beriladigan yordam.

examples.en: Can I give you any assistance with choosing a suit, sir?
examples.uz: Kostyum-shim tanlashda biror yordam
examples.grammar: 'Can I give you any assistance with + ot?' - so'roq gap, 'can I' xushmuomala taklifni bildiradi, 'with choosing a suit' nima borasida yordam ekanini ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: The shop assistant offered me some assistance with my bags.
examples.uz: Sotuvchi menga sumkalarim borasida yordam taklif qildi.
examples.grammar: 'offered + olmosh + some + ot' - Past Simple, 'with my bags' nima borasida yordam ekanini bildiradi.

defEn: The middle part of a town or city.
defUz: Shahar yoki shaharchaning o'rta qismi.

examples.en: We both work in the city centre.
examples.uz: Biz ikkovimiz ham shahar marzkazida ishlaymiz.
examples.grammar: 'We both work in the city + ot' - Present Simple, 'both' ikkalasini bildiradi, 'in the city centre' joyni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: There are many shops in the centre of the town.
examples.uz: Shaharchaning markazida ko'plab do'konlar bor.
examples.grammar: 'There are + ot (ko'plik)' - Present Simple, 'in the centre of' joyni bildiradi.

defEn: In or near the middle of a place.
defUz: Biror joyning o'rtasida yoki unga yaqin.

examples.en: The shop does well because it's in a central part of the city.
examples.uz: Do'kon yaxshi ishlaydi (= savdo
examples.grammar: 'The shop does well because it's in a central + ot' - Present Simple, 'because' sabab bog'lovchisi, 'central' sifat ot oldidan keladi.

examples.en: The hotel is in a central area near all the shops.
examples.uz: Mehmonxona barcha do'konlarga yaqin markaziy hududda joylashgan.
examples.grammar: 'is in a central + ot' - Present Simple, 'central' sifat ot oldidan kelib hududni tasvirlaydi.

examples.en: The central street in the town is the shopping street.
examples.uz: Shahardagi markaziy ko'cha–savdo
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'is' bog'lovchi fe'l; 'central' - sifat otdan oldin keladi.

examples.en: Their house is in a central part of the town.
examples.uz: Ularning uyi shaharning markaziy qismida joylashgan.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'is'; 'central' - sifat 'part' otini aniqlaydi.

defEn: In a central place.
defUz: Markaziy joyda.

examples.en: Restaurants that are centrally located do better.
examples.uz: Markaziy joyda joylashgan restoranlar
examples.grammar: 'Restaurants that are centrally located do better' - Present Simple, 'that are centrally located' ergash gap restoranlarni aniqlaydi, 'centrally' ravish.

examples.en: The new shop is centrally located in the town.
examples.uz: Yangi do'kon shaharchaning markaziy joyida joylashgan.
examples.grammar: 'is centrally located' - Present Simple passiv, 'centrally' ravish joylashuvni bildiradi.

defEn: Not open.
defUz: Ochiq emas, yopiq.

examples.en: We got to the shop at 5.30 and it was closed.
examples.uz: Biz do'konga soat 5.30 da bordik va u yopiq edi.
examples.grammar: 'We got to the shop at + vaqt + and it was closed' - Past Simple, 'and' bog'lovchisi ikki gapni bog'laydi, 'was closed' yopiq holatni bildiradi.

examples.en: The bookshop is closed on Mondays.
examples.uz: Kitob do'koni dushanba kunlari yopiq.
examples.grammar: 'is closed' - Present Simple, 'closed' sifat holatni bildiradi, 'on Mondays' takrorlanuvchi vaqtni ko'rsatadi.

defEn: To be not the same as something else.
defUz: Boshqa narsadan farqli bo'lmoq.

examples.en: The models differ in size and shape.
examples.uz: Modellar o'lchami va shakli jihatdan farq qiladi.
examples.grammar: 'The models differ in + ot + and + ot' - Present Simple, 'differ in' nimada farq qilishini bildiradi, 'models' ko'plik bo'lgani uchun fe'l '-s' olmaydi.

examples.en: The two phones differ in price and colour.
examples.uz: Ikki telefon narxi va rangi jihatdan farq qiladi.
examples.grammar: 'differ in + ot + and + ot' - Present Simple, 'and' bog'lovchisi ikki jihatni bog'laydi.

defEn: The way that two things are not the same.
defUz: Ikki narsaning bir xil emasligi, farq.

examples.en: What's the difference between a grocer's and a greengrocer's?
examples.uz: Oziq-ovqat do'koni va meva-
examples.grammar: 'What's the difference between a + ot + and a + ot?' - so'roq gap, 'difference between' farqni bildiradi, 'and' ikki narsani bog'laydi.

examples.en: There is a big difference between the two prices.
examples.uz: Ikki narx o'rtasida katta farq bor.
examples.grammar: 'There is a + sifat + difference between' - Present Simple, 'between' predlogi ikki narsani solishtirishni bildiradi.

defEn: Not the same.
defUz: Bir xil emas, boshqacha.

examples.en: She's tired of wearing the same old clothes
examples.uz: she wants something different. – U bir xil eski
examples.grammar: 'She's tired of wearing the same old + ot' - Present Simple, 'tired of + -ing' shaklida fe'l keladi, 'same' bir xillikni bildiradi.

examples.en: I want a different colour because this one is too dark.
examples.uz: Boshqa rang istayman, chunki bunisi juda to'q.
examples.grammar: 'want a different + ot' - Present Simple, 'because' sabab bog'lovchisi, 'too dark' juda to'q ekanini bildiradi.

defEn: In a way that is not the same.
defUz: Bir xil bo'lmagan tarzda, boshqacha.

examples.en: The two sisters are dressed very differently, but their hair is the same.
examples.uz: Ikki opa-singil juda ham
examples.grammar: 'The two sisters are dressed very differently' - Present Simple passiv, 'are dressed' kiyinishni bildiradi, 'differently' ravish, 'but' qarama-qarshilikni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: The two shops sell the same shoes but price them differently.
examples.uz: Ikki do'kon bir xil poyabzal sotadi, lekin ularni har xil narxlaydi.
examples.grammar: 'price them differently' - Present Simple, 'differently' ravish narxlash usulini bildiradi, 'but' qarama-qarshilikni ko'rsatadi.

defEn: Very great or very strong.
defUz: Juda kuchli yoki juda katta.

examples.en: The heat in the desert was extreme.
examples.uz: Sahrodagi issiqlik o'ta kuchli edi.
examples.grammar: 'The heat in the desert was extreme' - Past Simple, 'was extreme' o'ta kuchli ekanini bildiradi, 'in the desert' joyni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: The cold weather today is extreme, so the shops are empty.
examples.uz: Bugungi sovuq havo o'ta kuchli, shuning uchun do'konlar bo'sh.
examples.grammar: 'is extreme' - Present Simple, 'extreme' sifat holatni bildiradi, 'so' bog'lovchisi natijani ko'rsatadi.

defEn: To have an emotion or a thought about yourself.
defUz: O'zing haqingda biror tuyg'u yoki fikrga ega bo'lmoq.

examples.en: I felt like a complete idiot.
examples.uz: Men o'zimni butunlay ahmoqdek his qildim.
examples.grammar: 'I felt like a complete + ot' - Past Simple, 'felt' 'feel' fe'lining o'tgan zamon shakli, 'like' o'xshatishni bildiradi.

examples.en: I feel happy when I find a good price in the shop.
examples.uz: Do'konda yaxshi narx topganimda o'zimni baxtli his qilaman.
examples.grammar: 'feel + sifat' - Present Simple, 'when' bilan boshlangan ergash gap vaqtni bildiradi.

examples.en: Your cheek is very hot
examples.uz: do you feel ill? – Yuzingiz (asosan yonoq qismi) juda issiq–o'zingizni betob
examples.grammar: 'Your cheek is very hot' - Present Simple, 'is' yordamchi fe'li sifat 'hot' bilan holatni bildiradi.

examples.en: I feel much better after a good night of sleep.
examples.uz: Yaxshi uxlaganimdan keyin o'zimni ancha yaxshi his qilaman.
examples.grammar: Present Simple 'feel', 'much better' qiyosiy darajani kuchaytiradi; 'after' vaqtni bildiradi.

defEn: An emotion that you have inside you.
defUz: Ichingda his qiladigan hissiyot.

examples.en: Finding exactly the right dress for the party was a great feeling.
examples.uz: Bazm uchun aynan kerakli
examples.grammar: 'Finding the right dress was a great + ot' - Past Simple, 'finding' ravishdosh ega vazifasida, 'was a great feeling' yoqimli tuyg'u ekanini bildiradi.

examples.en: Getting a refund gave me a good feeling.
examples.uz: Pulni qaytarib olish menga yaxshi tuyg'u berdi.
examples.grammar: 'gave + olmosh + a + sifat + feeling' - Past Simple, 'getting' ravishdosh ega vazifasida kelgan.

defEn: As good as it can be, with no problems.
defUz: Hech qanday kamchiliksiz, eng yaxshi holatda.

examples.en: Hawaii is the perfect place for a honeymoon.
examples.uz: Havayi (= o'zbeklar Gavayi deyishadi, ammo
examples.grammar: 'Hawaii is the perfect + ot + for + ot' - Present Simple, 'perfect' sifat ot oldidan keladi, 'for a honeymoon' nima uchun ekanini bildiradi.

examples.en: This jacket is the perfect gift for my father.
examples.uz: Bu kurtka dadam uchun eng mos sovg'a.
examples.grammar: 'is the perfect + ot + for' - Present Simple, 'perfect' sifat ot oldidan kelib sovg'ani tasvirlaydi.

defEn: In a perfect way.
defUz: Mukammal tarzda.

examples.en: That shirt fits you perfectly
examples.uz: you have to buy it! – U ko'ylak sizga mutlaqo mos tushdi–uni sotib
examples.grammar: 'That shirt fits you perfectly' - Present Simple, 'fits' fe'l birlik ega bilan '-s' olgan, 'perfectly' ravish fe'lni izohlaydi.

examples.en: These new shoes fit me perfectly.
examples.uz: Bu yangi poyabzal menga mutlaqo mos tushadi.
examples.grammar: 'fit + olmosh + perfectly' - Present Simple, 'perfectly' ravish 'fit' fe'lini izohlaydi.

defEn: The act of selling something.
defUz: Biror narsani sotish jarayoni.

examples.en: We made three sales in the car showroom today.
examples.uz: Bugun mashina ko'rgazmasida uchta sotuvni
examples.grammar: 'We made three sales in the + ot + today' - Past Simple, 'made sales' sotuvni amalga oshirishni bildiradi, 'sales' ko'plik shaklida.

examples.en: The shop had a big sale before the New Year.
examples.uz: Do'konda Yangi yildan oldin katta savdo bo'ldi.
examples.grammar: 'had a + sifat + sale' - Past Simple, 'before the New Year' vaqtni bildiradi.

defEn: A person who sells something.
defUz: Biror narsa sotadigan kishi.

examples.en: The seller is not allowed to lie to the buyer.
examples.uz: Sotuvchi xaridorga yolg'on gapirishiga ruxsat
examples.grammar: 'The seller is not allowed to + infinitiv' - Present Simple passiv, 'is not allowed to' ruxsat yo'qligini bildiradi, 'to lie' infinitiv harakatni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: The seller gave me a good price for the old phone.
examples.uz: Sotuvchi eski telefon uchun menga yaxshi narx aytdi.
examples.grammar: 'gave + olmosh + a + sifat + ot' - Past Simple, ega birlikda, ikki to'ldiruvchi 'me' va 'a good price'.

defEn: To buy things from shops.
defUz: Do'konlardan narsa sotib olmoq.

examples.en: I shop for clothes every season.
examples.uz: Men har faslda kiyim xarid qilaman.
examples.grammar: 'I shop for + ot + every season' - Present Simple, 'shop for' nima xarid qilishni bildiradi, 'every season' takrorlanuvchi harakatni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: We shop for food at the supermarket on Fridays.
examples.uz: Biz juma kunlari supermarketdan oziq-ovqat xarid qilamiz.
examples.grammar: 'shop for + ot' - Present Simple, 'on Fridays' takrorlanuvchi harakatni bildiradi.

defEn: A person who is buying things.
defUz: Narsa sotib olayotgan kishi.

examples.en: The mall is full of shoppers on Saturdays.
examples.uz: Savdo markazi shanba kunlari xaridorlarga to'la.
examples.grammar: 'The mall is full of shoppers on + vaqt' - Present Simple, 'full of' to'la ekanini bildiradi, 'shoppers' ko'plik shaklida.

examples.en: Many shoppers come to the market every morning.
examples.uz: Ko'plab xaridorlar har tongda bozorga keladi.
examples.grammar: 'shoppers + come' - Present Simple, 'shoppers' ko'plik ega bo'lgani uchun fe'l '-s' olmaydi.

defEn: The activity of buying things in shops.
defUz: Do'konlarda narsa sotib olish faoliyati.

examples.en: I hate shopping with my mum because she takes me to about fifty different shops.
examples.uz: Men oyim
examples.grammar: 'I hate shopping with my mum because + ergash gap' - Present Simple, 'hate + -ing' shaklida fe'l keladi, 'because' sabab bog'lovchisi.

examples.en: Shopping for new clothes is fun for my sister.
examples.uz: Yangi kiyim xarid qilish opam uchun qiziqarli.
examples.grammar: 'Shopping + is + sifat' - Present Simple, 'shopping' ega vazifasida, 'for new clothes' nima xarid qilishni bildiradi.

defEn: thick, stiff paper used to make boxes and other things
defUz: qutilar va boshqa narsalar yasash uchun ishlatiladigan qalin qog'oz

examples.en: The boy's mother cut him a mask out of cardboard.
examples.uz: Yigitchaning onasi unga kartondan niqob
examples.grammar: 'cut + somebody + something + out of + ot' - o'tgan zamonda biror narsadan biror narsa kesib olishni bildiradi - Past Simple.

examples.en: We made a small house out of cardboard for the school project.
examples.uz: Maktab loyihasi uchun kartondan kichkina uy yasadik.
examples.grammar: 'make + something + out of + ot' - bir narsadan boshqa narsa yasashni bildiradi - Past Simple.

defEn: a show with clowns, acrobats and trained animals
defUz: masxarabozlar, akrobatlar va o'rgatilgan hayvonlar ishtirokidagi tomosha

examples.en: My favourite act in the circus are the clowns.
examples.uz: Sirkdagi mening sevimli sahna ko'rinishim bu
examples.grammar: 'My favourite + ot + are + ot (ko'plik)' - egalik va sevimli narsani bildiradi - Present Simple.

examples.en: We took the children to the circus on Sunday afternoon.
examples.uz: Yakshanba kuni tushdan keyin bolalarni sirkka olib bordik.
examples.grammar: 'take + somebody + to + the + ot' - kimnidir biror joyga olib borishni bildiradi - Past Simple.

defEn: special clothes that you wear to look like someone or something
defUz: biror kim yoki narsaga o'xshash ko'rinish uchun kiyiladigan maxsus kiyim

examples.en: What costume will you dress up in at Halloween?
examples.uz: Halevin bayramida qanday libosda kiyinasiz
examples.grammar: 'What + ot + will + you...' - kelajakdagi tanlovni so'roq gap shaklida bildiradi - Future ('will').

examples.en: She made a beautiful costume for the school play herself.
examples.uz: U maktab spektakli uchun chiroyli libosni o'zi tikdi.
examples.grammar: 'make + a + sifat + ot' - chiroyli libos tikishni bildiradi - Past Simple.

defEn: something pretty that you add to make a place look nicer
defUz: biror joyni chiroyli ko'rsatish uchun qo'shiladigan bezakli narsa

examples.en: There were balloons hanging everywhere as decoration.
examples.uz: Bezak sifatida hamma yerda sharlar
examples.grammar: 'There were + ot (ko'plik) + ...ing' - o'tmishda narsalar borligini va ularning holatini bildiradi - Past Simple.

examples.en: We put up the decorations the night before the party.
examples.uz: Biz bezaklarni bazmdan oldingi kechasi osib qo'ydik.
examples.grammar: 'put up + the + ot (ko'plik)' - bezaklarni osib qo'yishni bildiradi - Past Simple.

defEn: an outdoor event with rides, games and things to buy
defUz: atraksionlar, o'yinlar va sotiladigan narsalar bo'lgan ochiq havodagi tadbir

examples.en: Her favourite ride at the fair is the carousel .🎠
examples.uz: Uning yarmarkadagi sevimli atraksioni bu
examples.grammar: 'Her favourite + ot + is + the + ot' - eng sevimli narsani aniqlashni bildiradi - Present Simple.

examples.en: Every summer a big fair comes to our town for a week.
examples.uz: Har yozda bizning shaharimizga bir haftaga katta yarmarka keladi.
examples.grammar: 'a + sifat + ot + comes to' - takrorlanadigan voqeani bildiradi - Present Simple.

defEn: a special time when people celebrate something together
defUz: odamlar biror narsani birga nishonlaydigan maxsus payt

examples.en: They have a spring festival here every year.
examples.uz: Bu yerda har yili bahoriy shodiyona qilishadi.
examples.grammar: 'They have + a + ot + here + every year' - har yili takrorlanadigan odatni bildiradi - Present Simple.

examples.en: Thousands of people come to the music festival every July.
examples.uz: Har iyulda musiqa festivaliga minglab odamlar keladi.
examples.grammar: 'come to + the + ot + every July' - takrorlanadigan vaqtli voqeani bildiradi - Present Simple.

defEn: a feeling of enjoyment and pleasure
defUz: zavq va xursandchilik hissi

examples.en: We had a lot of fun at the fair
examples.uz: it was great! – Yarmarkada rosa vaqtichog'lik qildik–ajoyib bo'ldi!
examples.grammar: 'have + a lot of + ot' - ko'p zavqlanishni bildiradi; fun sanalmaydigan ot - Past Simple.

examples.en: The children had a lot of fun at the birthday party.
examples.uz: Bolalar tug'ilgan kun bazmida juda ko'p xursandchilik qildilar.
examples.grammar: 'have + a lot of + ot' - ko'p zavqlanishni bildiradi - Past Simple.

defEn: something that you do often, almost without thinking
defUz: tez-tez, deyarli o'ylamasdan qiladigan ishingiz

examples.en: It's Grandad's habit to take a walk every morning.
examples.uz: Har tongda piyoda sayr qilish bu bobomning
examples.grammar: 'It is + somebody's + ot + to + infinitiv' - kimningdir odatini bildiradi - Present Simple.

examples.en: Reading before bed is a good habit for children.
examples.uz: Uxlashdan oldin kitob o'qish bolalar uchun yaxshi odat.
examples.grammar: 'a + sifat + ot' - yaxshi odat ekanini bildiradi - Present Simple.

defEn: the way you feel at a particular time
defUz: ma'lum bir paytda o'zingizni qanday his qilishingiz

examples.en: Why are you in a bad mood? Did something go wrong?
examples.uz: Nima uchun yomon kayfiyatdasiz?
examples.grammar: 'Why are you in + a + sifat + ot' - hozirgi holat haqidagi so'roq gap - Present Simple.

examples.en: A good song always puts me in a happy mood.
examples.uz: Yaxshi qo'shiq doim mening kayfiyatimni ko'taradi.
examples.grammar: 'put + somebody + in + a + sifat + ot' - kayfiyatga ta'sir qilishni bildiradi - Present Simple.

defEn: a loud or unpleasant sound
defUz: baland yoki yoqimsiz tovush

examples.en: The children are making a lot of noise. Tell them to be quiet.
examples.uz: Bolalar rosa shovqin qilishyapti.
examples.grammar: 'make + a lot of + ot' - ko'p shovqin chiqarishni bildiradi - Present Continuous.

examples.en: The traffic outside makes a lot of noise at night.
examples.uz: Tashqaridagi transport kechasi ko'p shovqin chiqaradi.
examples.grammar: 'make + a lot of + ot' - shovqin chiqarishni bildiradi - Present Simple.

defEn: a person who plans and arranges an event
defUz: tadbirni rejalashtiradigan va uyushtiradigan odam

examples.en: The mayor is a good organiser, so the carnival went perfectly.
examples.uz: Shahar hokimi yaxshi ish
examples.grammar: 'is + a + sifat + ot' - kimnidir qanday tashkilotchi ekanini bildiradi - Present Simple.

examples.en: The festival organiser worked hard for many months.
examples.uz: Festival tashkilotchisi ko'p oylar davomida tinmay ishladi.
examples.grammar: 'ot + worked hard' - tashkilotchining mehnatini bildiradi - Past Simple.

defEn: a public event where people walk through the streets to celebrate
defUz: odamlar nishonlash uchun ko'chalar bo'ylab yuradigan ommaviy tadbir

examples.en: We watched the dancers in the parade go by.
examples.uz: Biz paraddagi raqqoslarni o'tib ketishini kuzatdik.
examples.grammar: 'watch + somebody + go by' - kimnidir o'tib ketishini kuzatishni bildiradi (infinitiv tosiz) - Past Simple.

examples.en: A long parade moved slowly down the main street.
examples.uz: Uzun parad bosh ko'cha bo'ylab sekin harakatlandi.
examples.grammar: 'a + sifat + ot + moved' - paradning harakatini bildiradi - Past Simple.

defEn: why something happens or why you do something
defUz: biror narsaning sababi yoki biror ishni qilish sababi

examples.en: The reason for the festival is to welcome the return of spring.
examples.uz: Shodiyonaning sababi bu
examples.grammar: 'The + ot + for + something + is + to + infinitiv' - sababni tushuntirishni bildiradi - Present Simple.

examples.en: Please tell me the reason for your decision.
examples.uz: Iltimos, qaroringizning sababini menga ayting.
examples.grammar: 'the + ot + for + something' - sababni so'rashni bildiradi - buyruq gap.

defEn: a loud, high cry that you make when afraid or excited
