defUz: qo'rqqan yoki hayajonlangan paytda chiqaradigan baland, o'tkir qichqiriq

examples.en: The screams of the fans got louder and louder.
examples.uz: Muxlislarning qichqiriqlari tobora balandlashib
examples.grammar: 'The + ot (ko'plik) + of + somebody + got louder' - qichqiriqlarning kuchayishini bildiradi - Past Simple.

examples.en: We heard a loud scream coming from the dark house.
examples.uz: Biz qorong'i uydan kelayotgan baland qichqiriqni eshitdik.
examples.grammar: 'hear + a + sifat + ot + ...ing' - qichqiriqni eshitishni bildiradi - Past Simple.

defEn: a performance for people to watch, often on a stage
defUz: odamlar tomosha qilishi uchun, ko'pincha sahnada o'tkaziladigan tomosha

examples.en: Let's go in and sit down because the show's about to start.
examples.uz: Keling ichkariga kirib o'tiramiz,
examples.grammar: 'the + ot + is about to + infinitiv' - tomosha boshlanay deb turganini bildiradi - Present Simple.

examples.en: The evening show starts at eight o'clock.
examples.uz: Kechki tomosha soat sakkizda boshlanadi.
examples.grammar: 'the + sifat + ot + starts at' - boshlanish vaqtini bildiradi - Present Simple.

defEn: a talk that someone gives to a group of people
defUz: kimningdir bir guruh odamlarga aytadigan nutqi

examples.en: The mayor made a speech to the people of the town.
examples.uz: Shahar hokimi shahar ahliga nutq
examples.grammar: 'make + a + ot + to + somebody' - kimgadir nutq so'zlashni bildiradi - Past Simple.

examples.en: The president gave a short speech after the ceremony.
examples.uz: Prezident marosimdan keyin qisqa nutq so'zladi.
examples.grammar: 'give + a + sifat + ot' - nutq so'zlashni bildiradi - Past Simple.

defEn: a weapon with a long, sharp metal blade
defUz: uzun va o'tkir metall tig'i bo'lgan qurol

examples.en: That sword was carried by a king in the past.
examples.uz: U qilich o'tmishda bir qirol tomonidan olib
examples.grammar: 'was carried + by + somebody' - passiv qurilish, o'tmishda kim tomonidan olib yurilganini bildiradi - Past Simple (passiv).

examples.en: The old sword hung on the wall above the fireplace.
examples.uz: Eski qilich kamin tepasidagi devorga osig'liq turardi.
examples.grammar: 'the + sifat + ot + hung on' - qilichning joyini bildiradi - Past Simple.

defEn: the building where the local government works
defUz: mahalliy hokimiyat ishlaydigan bino

examples.en: The mayor's office is in the town hall.
examples.uz: Merning ofisi shahar hokimiyati binosida.
examples.grammar: 'is + in + the + ot' - biror narsaning joyini bildiradi - Present Simple.

examples.en: The meeting will take place in the town hall tomorrow.
examples.uz: Yig'ilish ertaga shahar hokimiyati binosida bo'lib o'tadi.
examples.grammar: 'take place + in + the + ot' - joy va kelajakdagi voqeani bildiradi - Future ('will').

defEn: a collection of gold, money or other valuable things
defUz: oltin, pul yoki boshqa qimmatbaho narsalar to'plami

examples.en: The two boys were looking for pirates' treasure on the beach.
examples.uz: Ikki yigitcha plyajda qaroqchilar
examples.grammar: 'were looking for + ot' - o'tmishda biror narsani izlash jarayonini bildiradi - Past Continuous.

examples.en: The children dug in the garden to find the hidden treasure.
examples.uz: Bolalar yashirin xazinani topish uchun bog'da kovladilar.
examples.grammar: 'find + the + sifat + ot' - xazinani topishni bildiradi - Past Simple.

defEn: the sound you make when you speak or sing
defUz: gapirgan yoki kuylaganingizda chiqaradigan ovoz

examples.en: He was shouting so much that he lost his voice.
examples.uz: U shu qadar ko'p baqirayotgan ediki, natijada
examples.grammar: 'so much that + ergash gap' - shu qadar ... ediki natijasini bildiradi - Past Simple.

examples.en: She has a beautiful voice and sings in the choir.
examples.uz: Uning ovozi chiroyli va u xorda kuylaydi.
examples.grammar: 'have + a + sifat + ot' - ovoz xususiyatini bildiradi - Present Simple.

defEn: to surprise someone very much
defUz: kimnidir juda hayratga solmoq

examples.en: That magician's tricks always amaze me.
examples.uz: O'sha fokuschining fokuslari doim meni hayratga
examples.grammar: 'something + ot + me' - biror narsa kimnidir hayratga solishini bildiradi - Present Simple.

examples.en: The size of the old castle amazed all of us.
examples.uz: Eski qasrning kattaligi hammamizni hayratga soldi.
examples.grammar: 'something + ot + somebody' - hayratga solishni bildiradi - Past Simple.

defEn: to break open suddenly, often with a loud sound
defUz: to'satdan, ko'pincha baland tovush bilan yorilmoq

examples.en: The balloon burst and made a loud bang.
examples.uz: Shar yorildi va baland bang'illagan tovush chiqardi.
examples.grammar: 'ot + and + ot' - ikki o'tgan zamon ish-harakatini bog'lashni bildiradi - Past Simple (burst shakli o'zgarmaydi).

examples.en: The water pipe burst and flooded the kitchen.
examples.uz: Suv quvuri yorilib, oshxonani suv bosdi.
examples.grammar: 'ot + and + ot' - ketma-ket sodir bo'lgan voqealarni bildiradi - Past Simple.

defEn: to keep doing something without stopping
defUz: biror ishni to'xtamasdan davom ettirmoq

examples.en: The parade goes through the square and continues up the hill.
examples.uz: Parad maydon bo'ylab o'tadi va
examples.grammar: 'go through + something + and + ot + up the hill' - harakatning davom etishini bildiradi - Present Simple.

examples.en: The teacher continued the lesson after a short break.
examples.uz: O'qituvchi qisqa tanaffusdan keyin darsni davom ettirdi.
examples.grammar: 'ot + the + ot' - ishni davom ettirishni bildiradi - Past Simple.

defEn: to give an answer that you think is right without being sure
defUz: aniq bilmagan holda to'g'ri deb o'ylagan javobni aytmoq

examples.en: Can you guess where we're going on holiday this year?
examples.uz: Bu yil ta'tilda qayerga
examples.grammar: 'Can you + ot + where + ergash gap' - taxmin qilishni so'roq gap shaklida bildiradi; can modal fe'l - Present Simple.

examples.en: Can you guess how old this building is?
examples.uz: Bu bino necha yoshda ekanligini taxmin qila olasizmi?
examples.grammar: 'Can you + ot + how old + ergash gap' - taxmin qilishni so'rashni bildiradi - so'roq gap.

defEn: to ask someone to come to an event or your home
defUz: kimnidir tadbirga yoki uyingizga kelishga taklif qilmoq

examples.en: If Laura invites you to her party, will you go?
examples.uz: Agar Lo'ra sizni o'z bazmiga taklif qilsa,
examples.grammar: 'If + somebody + ot + you...' - shart mayli, agar taklif qilsa natijasini bildiradi - Present Simple.

examples.en: I want to invite all my friends to my party.
examples.uz: Men barcha do'stlarimni bazmimga taklif qilmoqchiman.
examples.grammar: 'want to + ot + somebody + to' - taklif qilish istagini bildiradi - infinitiv.

defEn: to say funny things to make people laugh
defUz: odamlarni kuldirish uchun kulgili gaplar aytmoq

examples.en: My dad jokes about his weight, but he's worried really.
examples.uz: Dadam vazni to'g'risida hazillashadi,
examples.grammar: 'ot + about + something' - biror narsa to'g'risida hazillashishni bildiradi - Present Simple.

examples.en: My uncle always jokes during family dinners.
examples.uz: Amakim oilaviy kechki ovqatlar paytida doim hazillashadi.
examples.grammar: 'always + ot' - takrorlanadigan odatni bildiradi - Present Simple.

defEn: to decide who or what is the best in a competition
defUz: musobaqada kim yoki nima eng yaxshi ekanini hal qilmoq

examples.en: Who is judging the best costume?
examples.uz: Eng yaxshi libosni kim aniqlab beryapti?
examples.grammar: 'Who is + ...ing' - hozir kim hakamlik qilayotganini so'roq gap shaklida bildiradi - Present Continuous.

examples.en: Three teachers will judge the singing competition.
examples.uz: Uchta o'qituvchi qo'shiq musobaqasiga hakamlik qiladi.
examples.grammar: 'will + ot + the + ot' - kelajakdagi hakamlikni bildiradi - Future ('will').

defEn: to plan and arrange an event or activity
defUz: tadbir yoki faoliyatni rejalashtirib uyushtirmoq

examples.en: Do you know a good company that organises children's parties?
examples.uz: Bolalar bazmini
examples.grammar: 'a + ot + that + ot (ko'plik)' - kompaniyani aniqlovchi ergash gap - Present Simple.

examples.en: Our class organised a trip to the museum last week.
examples.uz: Bizning sinf o'tgan hafta muzeyga sayohat uyushtirdi.
examples.grammar: 'ot + a + ot' - sayohat uyushtirishni bildiradi - Past Simple.

defEn: to get something ready for use or for an event
defUz: biror narsani foydalanish yoki tadbir uchun tayyorlamoq

examples.en: It took two hours to prepare all the food for fifty guests.
examples.uz: Ellikta mehmon uchun hamma ovqatni
examples.grammar: 'It took + vaqt + to + infinitiv' - biror ishga ketgan vaqtni bildiradi - Past Simple.

examples.en: My mother prepared a big dinner for the guests.
examples.uz: Onam mehmonlar uchun katta kechki ovqat tayyorladi.
examples.grammar: 'ot + a + sifat + ot' - ovqat tayyorlashni bildiradi - Past Simple.

uz: mug'ombirlik qilib o'zini biror ko'yga solmoq, ...dek tutmoq
defEn: to act as if something is true when it is not
defUz: biror narsa rost bo'lmasa-da, rostdek o'zini tutmoq

examples.en: The footballer pretended to be hurt, but he was fine.
examples.uz: Futbolchi o'zini jarohatlangandek tutdi,
examples.grammar: 'ot + to be + sifat' - kimningdir o'zini biror holatda ko'rsatishini bildiradi - Past Simple.

examples.en: The little boy pretended to be asleep when his mother came in.
examples.uz: Onasi kirib kelganda kichkina bola o'zini uxlayotgandek tutdi.
examples.grammar: 'ot + to be + sifat' - o'zini biror holatda ko'rsatishini bildiradi - Past Simple.

defEn: to make a happy expression with your mouth
defUz: og'zingiz bilan baxtli ifoda yaratmoq

examples.en: The clowns always make me smile.
examples.uz: Masxarabozlar doim meni tabassum qilishga majbur qiladi.
examples.grammar: 'make + somebody + ot' - kimnidir tabassum qilishga undashni bildiradi (infinitiv tosiz) - Present Simple.

examples.en: The baby smiled at me when I waved.
examples.uz: Men qo'l silkitganimda chaqaloq menga jilmaydi.
examples.grammar: 'ot + at + somebody' - kimgadir qarata jilmayishni bildiradi - Past Simple.

defEn: to send out small drops of liquid over something
defUz: biror narsa ustiga mayda suyuqlik tomchilarini sepmoq

examples.en: The gardener sprayed his plants with water.
examples.uz: Bog'bon o'simliklariga suv sepdi.
examples.grammar: 'ot + something + with + something' - biror narsani suyuqlik bilan sepishni bildiradi - Past Simple.

examples.en: She sprayed some perfume on her neck before leaving.
examples.uz: U ketishdan oldin bo'yniga bir oz atir sepdi.
examples.grammar: 'ot + something + on + somewhere' - biror joyga sepishni bildiradi - Past Simple.

uz: tepaga osmoq, ilmoq, yuqoriga o'rnatmoq = hang, mount
defEn: to fix something in a high place so people can see it
defUz: biror narsani odamlar ko'rishi uchun yuqori joyga o'rnatmoq

examples.en: The organisers put decorations up everywhere.
examples.uz: Tashkillashtiruvchilar hamma yerga bezaklar
examples.grammar: 'ot + something + somewhere' - biror narsani biror joyga osishni bildiradi; put up phrasal fe'l - Past Simple.

examples.en: We put up a big poster on the school wall.
examples.uz: Biz maktab devoriga katta plakat osib qo'ydik.
examples.grammar: 'ot + a + sifat + ot + on' - plakat osishni bildiradi - Past Simple.

defEn: to chase someone or something
defUz: kimnidir yoki biror narsani quvib yugurmoq

examples.en: They run after the horses shouting and screaming.
examples.uz: Ular baqirib va qichqirib otlarni quvishadi.
examples.grammar: 'ot + something + ...ing' - quvish va ayni paytdagi harakatni bildiradi; run after phrasal fe'l - Present Simple.

examples.en: The dog ran after the ball across the park.
examples.uz: It koptokni quvib park bo'ylab yugurdi.
examples.grammar: 'ot + something + across' - biror narsani quvishni bildiradi - Past Simple.

defEn: immediately when something happens
defUz: biror narsa sodir bo'lishi bilanoq

examples.en: As soon as we get home, I'm calling your father!
examples.uz: Uyga yetib borishimiz bilanoq, dadangizga
examples.grammar: 'ot + ergash gap, + bosh gap' - biror voqea bo'lishi bilanoq ikkinchisi sodir bo'lishini bildiradi - Present Simple.

examples.en: As soon as the rain stopped, we went outside to play.
examples.uz: Yomg'ir to'xtashi bilanoq, biz o'ynagani tashqariga chiqdik.
examples.grammar: 'ot + ergash gap' - bir voqeadan keyin darhol ikkinchisi bo'lishini bildiradi - Past Simple.

uz: chiroyli va bashang libos/antiqa kiyimlar kiyib boriladigan bazm
defEn: a party where people wear costumes to look like other people or things
defUz: odamlar boshqalarga o'xshab antiqa kiyimlar kiyib boriladigan bazm

examples.en: Who are you dressing up as for the fancy dress party?
examples.uz: Antiqa kiyimlar kiyib boriladigan bazm
examples.grammar: 'Who are you + ...ing as + for + the + ot' - kim bo'lib kiyinishni so'roq gap shaklida bildiradi - Present Continuous.

examples.en: We are going to a fancy dress party as superheroes.
examples.uz: Biz antiqa kiyimlar kiyib boriladigan bazmga superqahramonlar bo'lib boramiz.
examples.grammar: 'going to + a + ot' - rejalashtirilgan tadbirni bildiradi - Future ('going to').

defEn: to try hard to stop or defeat something
defUz: biror narsani to'xtatish yoki yengish uchun qattiq kurashmoq

examples.en: My grandfather fought against the Fascists in Spain.
examples.uz: Mening bobom Ispaniyada fashistlarga
examples.grammar: 'ot + somebody + in + somewhere' - biror narsaga qarshi kurashni bildiradi; fight against ibora - Past Simple.

examples.en: Doctors fight against many dangerous diseases every day.
examples.uz: Shifokorlar har kuni ko'plab xavfli kasalliklarga qarshi kurashadilar.
examples.grammar: 'ot + something' - biror narsaga qarshi kurashni bildiradi - Present Simple.

defEn: to hold a social event with food, music and guests
defUz: ovqat, musiqa va mehmonlar bilan bazm o'tkazmoq

examples.en: I always have a party for my birthday.
examples.uz: Men har doim tug'ilgan kunim uchun bazm o'tkazaman.
examples.grammar: 'always + ot + for + something' - takrorlanadigan odatni bildiradi; have a party ibora - Present Simple.

examples.en: We are going to have a party when the exams finish.
examples.uz: Imtihonlar tugagach, biz bazm o'tkazmoqchimiz.
examples.grammar: 'going to + ot' - rejalashtirilgan bazmni bildiradi - Future ('going to').

uz: biror kimni biror yerga taklif qilmoq
defEn: to ask a person to come to an event
defUz: biror odamni tadbirga kelishga taklif qilmoq

examples.en: My cousin invited me to his summer house this weekend.
examples.uz: Amakivachcham meni shu hafta
examples.grammar: 'ot + somebody + to + somewhere' - kimnidir biror joyga taklif qilishni bildiradi - Past Simple.

examples.en: They invited us to their wedding next month.
examples.uz: Ular bizni keyingi oygi to'ylariga taklif qilishdi.
examples.grammar: 'ot + somebody + to + something' - taklif qilishni bildiradi - Past Simple.

defEn: a type or sort of something
defUz: biror narsaning bir turi yoki navi

examples.en: A pavlova is a kind of dessert.
examples.uz: Pavlova shirinlikning bir turi.
examples.grammar: 'something + is + a + ot + of + something' - biror narsaning turini bildiradi - Present Simple.

examples.en: A violin is a kind of musical instrument.
examples.uz: Skripka cholg'u asbobining bir turi.
examples.grammar: 'something + is + a + ot + of + something' - turini bildiradi - Present Simple.

defEn: to laugh because someone or something is funny
defUz: kimdir yoki biror narsa kulgili bo'lgani uchun kulmoq

examples.en: We laughed at the clowns at the circus.
examples.uz: Biz sirkda masxarabozlarning ustidan kuldik.
examples.grammar: 'ot + somebody/something' - kimningdir ustidan kulishni bildiradi; laugh at ibora - Past Simple.

examples.en: Everyone laughed at the funny photo on the wall.
examples.uz: Hamma devordagi kulgili rasm ustidan kuldi.
examples.grammar: 'ot + something' - biror narsa ustidan kulishni bildiradi - Past Simple.

defEn: to feel happy and excited about something that will happen
defUz: kelajakda bo'ladigan biror narsani xursandlik bilan intiqib kutmoq

examples.en: I'm looking forward to the parade next week
examples.uz: it'll be great! – Keyingi haftadagi paradni intiqib
examples.grammar: 'be + ...ing + ot + something' - biror narsani intiqib kutishni bildiradi; todan keyin ...ing keladi - Present Continuous.

examples.en: I am looking forward to my summer holiday.
examples.uz: Men yozgi ta'tilimni intiqib kutyapman.
examples.grammar: 'be + ...ing + ot + something' - intiqib kutishni bildiradi - Present Continuous.

defEn: used to say yes in a strong and certain way
defUz: kuchli va ishonchli tarzda ha deyish uchun ishlatiladi

examples.en: Of course I'm coming to the party. I wouldn't miss it!
examples.uz: Albatta men bazmga boraman. Uni
examples.grammar: 'ot + bosh gap' - tasdiqni kuchaytirib bildiradi - Present Simple.

examples.en: Of course you can borrow my pen.
examples.uz: Albatta, ruchkamni olib turishingiz mumkin.
examples.grammar: 'ot + bosh gap' - tasdiqni kuchaytirishni bildiradi - Present Simple (can modal fe'l).

defEn: to use a camera to make pictures
defUz: rasm olish uchun fotoapparatdan foydalanmoq

examples.en: She took some lovely photos of the dancers for the newspaper.
examples.uz: U raqqoslarni gazeta uchun
examples.grammar: 'ot + of + somebody' - kimningdir rasmini olishni bildiradi - Past Simple.

examples.en: We took photos of the beautiful old buildings.
examples.uz: Biz chiroyli eski binolarning rasmini oldik.
examples.grammar: 'ot + of + something' - rasm olishni bildiradi - Past Simple.

defEn: to happen, especially after being planned
defUz: ayniqsa rejalashtirilgandan keyin sodir bo'lmoq

examples.en: The festival takes place on the last weekend in November.
examples.uz: Tantana Noyabr oyining eng so'nggi
examples.grammar: 'ot + on + vaqt' - biror voqeaning qachon sodir bo'lishini bildiradi; take place ibora - Present Simple.

examples.en: The concert will take place in the city park.
examples.uz: Konsert shahar bog'ida bo'lib o'tadi.
examples.grammar: 'will + ot + in + somewhere' - kelajakdagi voqea va joyni bildiradi - Future ('will').

defEn: to walk by someone or something
defUz: kimningdir yoki biror narsaning yonidan yurib o'tmoq

examples.en: A man just walked past me dressed as a monkey!
examples.uz: Maymunga o'xshab kiyingan bir erkak
examples.grammar: 'ot + somebody + ...ed as' - kimningdir yonidan o'tishni bildiradi; walk past ibora - Past Simple.

examples.en: I walked past the old shop on my way to school.
examples.uz: Maktabga ketayotib eski do'kon yonidan o'tib ketdim.
examples.grammar: 'ot + something' - yonidan o'tishni bildiradi - Past Simple.

defEn: happening often or seen in many places
defUz: tez-tez sodir bo'ladigan yoki ko'p joyda uchraydigan

examples.en: It's very common for American boys to dress up as cowboys.
examples.uz: Amerikalik o'g'il bolalar uchun
examples.grammar: 'It is + sifat + for + somebody + to + infinitiv' - biror ishning odatiy ekanini bildiradi - Present Simple.

examples.en: It is very common to see snow here in winter.
examples.uz: Bu yerda qishda qor ko'rish juda odatiy hol.
examples.grammar: 'It is + sifat + to + infinitiv' - odatiy holni bildiradi - Present Simple.

defEn: full of people
defUz: odamlar bilan to'lib-toshgan

examples.en: It was so crowded on the bus that we couldn't get on.
examples.uz: Avtobus shu qadar tiqilinch ediki, biz
examples.grammar: 'so + sifat + that + ergash gap' - shu qadar ... ediki natijasini bildiradi - Past Simple.

examples.en: The market was very crowded on Saturday morning.
examples.uz: Shanba kuni ertalab bozor juda gavjum edi.
examples.grammar: 'was + sifat' - gavjumlikni bildiradi - Past Simple.

defEn: wanting to know or learn about something
defUz: biror narsani bilishni yoki o'rganishni xohlaydigan

examples.en: I'm curious to see who wins the prize.
examples.uz: Kim yutuqni yutib olishini ko'rishga qiziqib ketyapman.
examples.grammar: 'be + sifat + to + infinitiv' - biror narsani ko'rish yoki bilishga qiziqishni bildiradi - Present Simple.

examples.en: The children were curious about the new teacher.
examples.uz: Bolalar yangi o'qituvchiga qiziqib qolishdi.
examples.grammar: 'be + sifat + about + something' - biror narsaga qiziqishni bildiradi - Past Simple.

defEn: unusual or surprising
defUz: g'ayrioddiy yoki ajablanarli

examples.en: It was such a strange show that I couldn't understand it.
examples.uz: U shunaqangi g'alati tomosha ediki,
examples.grammar: 'such a + sifat + ot + that + ergash gap' - shunday g'alati ... ediki natijasini bildiradi - Past Simple.

examples.en: I heard a strange sound coming from the garden.
examples.uz: Bog'dan kelayotgan g'alati tovushni eshitdim.
examples.grammar: 'a + sifat + ot' - g'alati tovushni bildiradi - Past Simple.

defEn: following old customs that have been used for a long time
defUz: uzoq vaqtdan beri saqlanib kelayotgan eski urf-odatlarga amal qiladigan

examples.en: It's a traditional festival that first took place 500 years ago.
examples.uz: U ilk bor 500 yil avval bo'lib o'tgan
examples.grammar: 'a + sifat + ot + that + first took place...' - an'anaviy bayramni aniqlovchi ergash gap - Present Simple va Past Simple.

examples.en: We ate a traditional meal at my grandmother's house.
examples.uz: Buvimning uyida an'anaviy taom yedik.
examples.grammar: 'a + sifat + ot' - an'anaviy taomni bildiradi - Past Simple.

defEn: all of something; complete
defUz: biror narsaning hammasi; butun

examples.en: The whole town takes part in the parade
examples.uz: men, women and children. – Butun shahar paradda
examples.grammar: 'The + sifat + ot + takes part in' - butun narsaning ishtirok etishini bildiradi - Present Simple.

examples.en: I read the whole book in just two days.
examples.uz: Men butun kitobni atigi ikki kunda o'qib chiqdim.
examples.grammar: 'the + sifat + ot' - butun narsani bildiradi - Past Simple.

defEn: in the direction behind you
defUz: orqa tomonga qarab

examples.en: He fell over backwards and bumped the back of his head.
examples.uz: U orqaga qarab yiqilib tushdi va
examples.grammar: 'fell over + ravish' - orqaga yiqilishni bildiradi - Past Simple.

examples.en: She took a few steps backwards to see the picture better.
examples.uz: U rasmni yaxshiroq ko'rish uchun bir necha qadam orqaga tashladi.
examples.grammar: 'a few steps + ravish' - orqaga harakatni bildiradi - Past Simple.

defEn: more than usual; particularly
defUz: odatdagidan ko'ra; ayniqsa

examples.en: She loves all parties, but especially fancy dress parties.
examples.uz: Unga barcha bazmlar yoqadi, lekin
examples.grammar: '..., but + ravish + something' - biror narsani alohida ta'kidlashni bildiradi - Present Simple.

examples.en: I love fruit, especially fresh oranges.
examples.uz: Men mevani, ayniqsa yangi apelsinlarni yaxshi ko'raman.
examples.grammar: '..., + ravish + something' - alohida ta'kidlashni bildiradi - Present Simple.

defEn: in the direction in front of you
defUz: oldinga qarab

examples.en: The parade stopped and then moved forwards again.
examples.uz: Parad to'xtadi, keyin esa yana oldinga
examples.grammar: 'moved + ravish + again' - oldinga harakatni bildiradi - Past Simple.

examples.en: The driver moved the car slowly forwards into the garage.
examples.uz: Haydovchi mashinani sekin oldinga, garajga olib kirdi.
examples.grammar: 'moved + something + ravish' - oldinga harakatni bildiradi - Past Simple.

defEn: used to add force to a statement; really
defUz: fikrni kuchaytirish uchun ishlatiladi; haqiqatdan ham

examples.en: Their mother promised to take them fishing and indeed she did.
examples.uz: Ularning onasi ularni baliq
examples.grammar: '... and + ravish + somebody + did' - aytilgan narsa rostligini kuchaytirishni bildiradi - Past Simple.

examples.en: It was indeed a very cold winter this year.
examples.uz: Bu yil qish haqiqatdan ham juda sovuq bo'ldi.
examples.grammar: 'was + ravish + sifat' - tasdiqni kuchaytirishni bildiradi - Past Simple.

defEn: a feeling of great surprise
defUz: katta hayrat hissi

examples.en: We looked at the sight with amazement
examples.uz: we couldn't believe it. – Biz manzaraga hayrat bilan
examples.grammar: 'with + ot' - hayrat bilan biror ishni qilishni bildiradi - Past Simple.

examples.en: To our amazement, the small boy lifted the heavy box.
examples.uz: Hayratimizga qaramay, kichkina bola og'ir qutini ko'tardi.
examples.grammar: 'To + somebody's + ot' - hayratni bildiruvchi kirish ibora - Past Simple.

defEn: very surprising and wonderful
defUz: juda hayratlanarli va ajoyib

examples.en: What an amazing show!
examples.uz: Naqadar ajoyib tomosha!
examples.grammar: 'What + a/an + sifat + ot' - his-hayajonni bildiruvchi undov gap - Present Simple.

examples.en: We saw an amazing show at the theatre last night.
examples.uz: Kecha teatrda ajoyib tomosha ko'rdik.
examples.grammar: 'an + sifat + ot' - ajoyib tomoshani bildiradi - Past Simple.

uz: ajablanarlisi shuki, hayratga soladigan jihati shuki
defEn: in a way that is very surprising
defUz: juda ajablanarli tarzda

examples.en: Amazingly, no one got hurt when the lions escaped.
examples.uz: Ajablanarli jihati shundaki, sherlar qochib
examples.grammar: 'ravish, + bosh gap' - gapni boshlab, ajablanishni bildiruvchi kirish so'z - Past Simple.

examples.en: Amazingly, the old car still works perfectly.
examples.uz: Ajablanarlisi, eski mashina hali ham mukammal ishlaydi.
examples.grammar: 'ravish, + bosh gap' - ajablanishni bildiruvchi kirish so'z - Present Simple.

defEn: to listen and watch carefully; to pay attention
defUz: diqqat bilan tinglab va kuzatib turmoq; diqqatini qaratmoq

examples.en: She hadn't been attending during the lesson.
examples.uz: Dars davomida u diqqatini qaratmayotgandi.
examples.grammar: 'had not been + ...ing' - o'tmishda ma'lum paytgacha davom etmagan ish-harakatni bildiradi - Past Perfect Continuous.

examples.en: Please attend carefully while I explain the rules.
examples.uz: Men qoidalarni tushuntirayotganimda, iltimos, diqqat bilan qarang.
examples.grammar: 'ot + ravish' - diqqat qaratishni bildiradi - buyruq gap.

defEn: the act of carefully watching or listening to something
defUz: biror narsani diqqat bilan kuzatish yoki tinglash

examples.en: Please pay attention to the rules that I'm telling you.
examples.uz: Iltimos, sizga aytayotgan qoidalarimga
examples.grammar: 'pay + ot + to + something' - biror narsaga e'tibor qaratishni bildiradi - buyruq gap.

examples.en: The teacher asked for our full attention.
examples.uz: O'qituvchi bizdan to'liq e'tibor talab qildi.
examples.grammar: 'somebody's + sifat + ot' - to'liq e'tiborni bildiradi - Past Simple.

defEn: a large group of people in one place
defUz: bir joyda to'plangan katta guruh odamlar

examples.en: If you want to avoid the crowds, get there early.
examples.uz: Agar olomonni oldini olishni istasangiz, u
examples.grammar: 'avoid + the + ot (ko'plik)' - olomondan qochishni bildiradi; If bilan shart mayli - Present Simple.

examples.en: A big crowd gathered to watch the football match.
examples.uz: Futbol o'yinini tomosha qilish uchun katta olomon to'plandi.
examples.grammar: 'a + sifat + ot + gathered' - olomon to'planishini bildiradi - Past Simple.

defEn: to add pretty things to make a place look nicer
defUz: biror joyni chiroyli ko'rsatish uchun bezakli narsalar qo'shmoq

examples.en: They decorated the room with flowers and balloons.
examples.uz: Ular xonani gullar va sharlar bilan
examples.grammar: 'ot + something + with + something' - biror narsani boshqa narsa bilan bezashni bildiradi - Past Simple.

examples.en: We decorated the tree with bright lights for the holiday.
examples.uz: Biz bayram uchun daraxtni yorqin chiroqlar bilan bezadik.
examples.grammar: 'ot + something + with + something' - bezashni bildiradi - Past Simple.

defEn: going straight from one place to another without stopping
defUz: bir joydan boshqasiga to'xtamasdan to'g'ri boradigan

examples.en: There's a direct train to Leeds.
examples.uz: Lidzga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri olib boradigan poyezd bor.
examples.grammar: 'There is + a + sifat + ot' - to'g'ridan-to'g'ri qatnov borligini bildiradi - Present Simple.

examples.en: Is there a direct flight from London to Tashkent?
examples.uz: Londondan Toshkentga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri parvoz bormi?
examples.grammar: 'a + sifat + ot' - to'g'ridan-to'g'ri parvozni bildiradi - so'roq gap.

defEn: the way that someone or something moves or points
defUz: kimdir yoki biror narsa harakatlanadigan yoki ko'rsatadigan tomon

examples.en: What direction is the food tent in?
examples.uz: Oziq-ovqat chodiri qaysi yo'nalishda?
examples.grammar: 'What + ot + is + something + in' - yo'nalishni so'roq gap shaklida bildiradi - Present Simple.

examples.en: We walked in the wrong direction and got lost.
examples.uz: Biz noto'g'ri yo'nalishda yurdik va adashib qoldik.
examples.grammar: 'in + the + sifat + ot' - yo'nalishni bildiradi - Past Simple.

defEn: in a straight line, without stopping anywhere
defUz: hech qayerda to'xtamasdan, to'g'ri

examples.en: I went directly home after the show because I was tired.
examples.uz: Tomoshadan keyin men to'g'ri uyga
examples.grammar: 'go + ravish + somewhere' - to'g'ri biror joyga borishni bildiradi - Past Simple.

examples.en: After work she went directly to the hospital.
examples.uz: Ishdan keyin u to'g'ri kasalxonaga bordi.
examples.grammar: 'go + ravish + to + somewhere' - to'g'ri borishni bildiradi - Past Simple.

defEn: to make someone feel afraid
defUz: kimnidir qo'rqitmoq

examples.en: Spiders frighten him to death.
examples.uz: O'rgimchaklar uni o'lgudek qo'rqitadi.
examples.grammar: 'something (ko'plik) + ot + somebody' - biror narsa kimnidir qo'rqitishini bildiradi - Present Simple.

examples.en: Loud thunder always frightens our little dog.
examples.uz: Baland momaqaldiroq doim kichkina itimizni qo'rqitadi.
examples.grammar: 'something + ot + somebody' - qo'rqitishni bildiradi - Present Simple.

defEn: feeling afraid
defUz: qo'rqib ketgan

examples.en: The children were frightened by the strange people.
examples.uz: Bolalar notanish odamlardan qo'rqib
examples.grammar: 'were + ot + by + something' - kimningdir nima sababdan qo'rqqanini bildiradi - Past Simple (passiv).

examples.en: The little girl was frightened of the dark room.
examples.uz: Kichkina qiz qorong'i xonadan qo'rqib ketdi.
examples.grammar: 'was + ot + of + something' - biror narsadan qo'rqishni bildiradi - Past Simple.

defEn: making you feel afraid
defUz: qo'rquv uyg'otadigan

examples.en: Grandpa told us a frightening story about ghosts.
examples.uz: Bobom bizga arvohlar to'g'risida bir
examples.grammar: 'a + sifat + ot + about + something' - qo'rqinchli hikoyani bildiradi - Past Simple.

examples.en: The film was too frightening for young children.
examples.uz: Film yosh bolalar uchun juda qo'rqinchli edi.
examples.grammar: 'was + ravish + sifat' - qo'rqinchli ekanini bildiradi - Past Simple.

defEn: making you laugh; amusing
defUz: kuldiradigan; quvnoq

examples.en: The joke was so funny that I couldn't stop laughing.
examples.uz: Hazil shu qadar kulguli ediki men kulishdan
examples.grammar: 'so + sifat + that + ergash gap' - shu qadar kulguli ... ediki natijasini bildiradi - Past Simple.

examples.en: My friend told me a really funny story.
examples.uz: Do'stim menga juda kulgili voqeani aytib berdi.
examples.grammar: 'a + ravish + sifat + ot' - kulgili voqeani bildiradi - Past Simple.

defEn: to make sounds that show you are happy or think something is funny
defUz: xursandligingizni yoki biror narsa kulgili ekanini ko'rsatadigan tovush chiqarmoq

examples.en: When I heard her excuse, I just laughed.
examples.uz: Uning bahonasini eshitganimda, men shunchaki kulib
examples.grammar: 'When + ergash gap, + bosh gap' - bir voqeadan keyin ikkinchisi bo'lganini bildiradi - Past Simple.

examples.en: The whole class laughed when the teacher told a joke.
examples.uz: O'qituvchi hazil aytganda butun sinf kuldi.
examples.grammar: 'When + ergash gap, + ot' - kulishni bildiradi - Past Simple.

defEn: the sound or act of laughing
defUz: kulish tovushi yoki harakati

examples.en: The laughter of the kids told me they were having a great time.
examples.uz: Bolalarning kulayotgan ovozi
examples.grammar: 'The + ot + of + somebody + told me that...' - kulgi ovozi nimadir bildirganini ko'rsatadi - Past Simple.

examples.en: We could hear the children's laughter from the garden.
examples.uz: Biz bog'dan bolalarning kulgi ovozini eshita olardik.
examples.grammar: 'somebody's + ot' - kulgi ovozini bildiradi - Past Simple (could modal fe'l).

defEn: good things that happen by chance
defUz: tasodifan yuz beradigan yaxshi narsalar

examples.en: We wish her luck in her new career.
examples.uz: Uning yangi ish faoliyatida omad tilaymiz.
examples.grammar: 'wish + somebody + ot + in + something' - kimgadir omad tilashni bildiradi - Present Simple.

examples.en: With a bit of luck, we will win the game.
examples.uz: Bir oz omad bilan, biz o'yinda yutib chiqamiz.
examples.grammar: 'with + a bit of + ot' - omad yordamini bildiradi - Future ('will').

defEn: having good luck
defUz: omadi bor

examples.en: One lucky woman won £300.
examples.uz: Bir omadli ayol 300 funt sterling yutib oldi.
examples.grammar: 'One + sifat + ot + won...' - omadli kishi yutganini bildiradi - Past Simple.

examples.en: You are very lucky to have such good friends.
examples.uz: Bunday yaxshi do'stlaringiz borligi omadli ish.
examples.grammar: 'be + sifat + to + infinitiv' - omadli ekanini bildiradi - Present Simple.

defEn: having bad luck
defUz: omadi yo'q

examples.en: You were very unlucky to break your leg.
examples.uz: Oyog'ingizni sindirib olganingiz omadsiz ish bo'libdi.
examples.grammar: 'be + sifat + to + infinitiv' - omadsiz hodisani bildiradi - Past Simple.

examples.en: He was unlucky to miss the last bus by one minute.
examples.uz: U so'nggi avtobusni bir daqiqaga o'tkazib yuborgani omadsizlik bo'ldi.
examples.grammar: 'be + sifat + to + infinitiv' - omadsizlikni bildiradi - Past Simple.

defEn: in a way that is good because of good luck
defUz: omad tufayli yaxshi natija bilan

examples.en: Luckily, someone found my bag and gave it to a policeman.
examples.uz: Baxtimga, kimdir mening
examples.grammar: 'ravish, + bosh gap' - gapni boshlab, yaxshi natijani bildiruvchi kirish so'z - Past Simple.

examples.en: Luckily, the rain stopped before the parade started.
examples.uz: Baxtimizga, parad boshlanishidan oldin yomg'ir to'xtadi.
examples.grammar: 'ravish, + bosh gap' - yaxshi natijani bildiruvchi kirish so'z - Past Simple.

defEn: making a lot of noise; loud
defUz: ko'p shovqin chiqaradigan; baland

examples.en: Don't be so noisy while I'm trying to sleep.
examples.uz: Men uxlashga urinayotgan paytimda unaqa
examples.grammar: 'Do not be so + sifat + while + ergash gap' - shovqin qilmaslikni bildiradi - buyruq gap.

examples.en: The classroom was very noisy before the teacher arrived.
examples.uz: O'qituvchi kelishidan oldin sinfxona juda shovqinli edi.
examples.grammar: 'was + ravish + sifat' - shovqinli ekanini bildiradi - Past Simple.

defEn: in a way that makes a lot of noise
defUz: ko'p shovqin chiqaradigan tarzda

examples.en: Someone in the cinema was eating crisps noisily.
examples.uz: Kinoteatrda kimdir shovqin chiqarib chips
examples.grammar: 'eat + something + ravish' - shovqin chiqarib ovqatlanishni bildiradi - Past Continuous.

examples.en: The boys ran noisily down the stairs.
examples.uz: O'g'il bolalar shovqin chiqarib zinapoyadan pastga yugurdilar.
examples.grammar: 'ot + ravish + down' - shovqinli harakatni bildiradi - Past Simple.

defEn: the way an event is planned and arranged
defUz: tadbir rejalashtirilib uyushtirilish tarzi

examples.en: The organisation of the parade was terrible and nobody knew where to go.
examples.uz: Paradni
examples.grammar: 'The + ot + of + something + was + sifat' - tashkiliy ishlarni baholashni bildiradi - Past Simple.

examples.en: The organisation of the trip took many weeks of work.
examples.uz: Sayohatni uyushtirish ko'p haftalik mehnatni talab qildi.
examples.grammar: 'The + ot + of + something' - uyushtirishni bildiradi - Past Simple.

defEn: the work you do to get ready for something
defUz: biror narsaga tayyorlanish uchun qiladigan ishingiz

examples.en: We finished the preparations for the party just before the kids arrived.
examples.uz: Biz bazmga
examples.grammar: 'finish + the + ot (ko'plik) + for + something' - tayyorgarlik ishini tugatishni bildiradi - Past Simple.

examples.en: The preparation for the exam took several weeks.
examples.uz: Imtihonga tayyorgarlik bir necha haftani oldi.
examples.grammar: 'The + ot + for + something' - tayyorgarlikni bildiradi - Past Simple.

defEn: a person who writes or tells news
defUz: yangiliklarni yozadigan yoki aytadigan odam

examples.en: He works as a reporter for the town newspaper.
examples.uz: U shahar gazetasida muxbir bo'lib ishlaydi.
examples.grammar: 'work as + a + ot + for + something' - kasbni bildiradi - Present Simple.

examples.en: A young reporter asked the mayor many questions.
examples.uz: Yosh muxbir hokimga ko'plab savollar berdi.
examples.grammar: 'a + sifat + ot + asked' - muxbirning ishini bildiradi - Past Simple.

defEn: a custom that people have followed for a long time
defUz: odamlar uzoq vaqtdan beri amal qilib kelayotgan urf-odat

examples.en: By tradition, children play tricks on 1 April.
examples.uz: An'anaga ko'ra, bolalar 1-aprelda xiyla-nayranglar
examples.grammar: 'By + ot, + bosh gap' - an'anaga ko'ra odatni bildiruvchi kirish ibora - Present Simple.

examples.en: It is a family tradition to eat together on Sundays.
examples.uz: Yakshanba kunlari birga ovqatlanish oilaviy an'ana.
examples.grammar: 'a + ot + to + infinitiv' - an'anani bildiradi - Present Simple.

defEn: in a way that follows old customs
defUz: eski urf-odatlarga amal qilingan tarzda

examples.en: Traditionally, the women dress in white and enter the village singing songs.
examples.uz: Urf-odatga ko'ra,
examples.grammar: 'Ravish, + bosh gap' - urf-odatga ko'ra odatni bildiruvchi kirish so'z - Present Simple.

examples.en: Traditionally, people give flowers on this special day.
examples.uz: Urf-odatga ko'ra, odamlar bu maxsus kunda gul sovg'a qiladilar.
examples.grammar: 'Ravish, + bosh gap' - urf-odatga ko'ra odatni bildiradi - Present Simple.

uz: aksessuar, qo'shimcha qism: kiyimingizga mos tushadigan biror narsa, masalan kamar yoki sumka
defEn: a small extra item you wear or carry, such as a belt or a bag.
defUz: kiyimga qo'shimcha taqiladigan yoki olib yuriladigan kichik narsa, masalan kamar yoki sumka.

examples.en: The shop sells accessories like belts and bags.
examples.uz: Bu do'kon kamar va sumka kabi aksessuarlar
examples.grammar: 'sells + accessories like + X and Y' - Present Simple, ko'plikdagi otni misollar bilan tushuntiradi.

examples.en: She bought a new bag and some other accessories for the party.
examples.uz: U bazm uchun yangi sumka va boshqa bir nechta aksessuarlar sotib oldi.
examples.grammar: 'bought + a + ot va + some + ko'plik ot' - Past Simple, otlar 'and' bog'lovchisi bilan bog'langan.

uz: yomg'irli sovuq havoda kiyiladigan kapyushonkali kurtka
defEn: a warm waterproof jacket with a hood for cold, rainy weather.
defUz: sovuq va yomg'irli havoda kiyiladigan kapyushonkali iliq, suv o'tkazmaydigan kurtka.

examples.en: I need to buy an anorak
examples.uz: it's going to be a rainy winter. – Men kurtka sotib olishim kerak–bu qish
examples.grammar: 'need to + buy + an + ot' - Present Simple, 'need to' modal ma'noli ibora, 'an' artikli unli tovushdan oldin keladi.

examples.en: He put on his anorak before going out into the rain.
examples.uz: U yomg'ir ostiga chiqishdan oldin kapyushonkali kurtkasini kiydi.
examples.grammar: 'put on + egalik + ot' - Past Simple, 'before + V-ing' vaqt ergash gapi harakat tartibini bildiradi.

defEn: a strip of leather or cloth that you wear around your waist.
defUz: belga taqiladigan teri yoki matodan tayyorlangan tasma.

examples.en: You need to buy a brown belt to go with those brown trousers.
examples.uz: Bu jigarrang shimga mos
examples.grammar: 'need to + buy + a + sifat + ot + to go with' - Present Simple, 'to go with' maqsad infinitivi yarashishni bildiradi.

examples.en: My trousers are too big, so I wear a belt with them.
examples.uz: Shimim juda katta, shuning uchun men uni kamar bilan kiyaman.
examples.grammar: 'too + sifat, so + gap' - 'so' bog'lovchisi sabab-natija munosabatini bildiradi, fe'l Present Simpleda.

defEn: a strong shoe that covers your foot and part of your leg.
defUz: oyoqni va oyoqning bir qismini qoplaydigan mustahkam oyoq kiyim.

examples.en: She was wearing a pair of leather boots that came up to her knees.
examples.uz: U tizzalarigacha chiqqan
examples.grammar: 'was wearing + a pair of + ot' - Past Continuous, 'a pair of' juft narsani bildiradi, 'that' ergash gap boshlaydi.

examples.en: In winter I always wear warm boots to keep my feet dry.
examples.uz: Qishda men oyoqlarimni quruq saqlash uchun doimo iliq etik kiyaman.
examples.grammar: 'In winter + ega + ravish + fe'l' - Present Simple, vaqt holi gap boshida, 'to keep' maqsad infinitivi.

defEn: a small round object you push through a hole to fasten clothes.
defUz: kiyimni mahkamlash uchun teshikdan o'tkaziladigan kichik dumaloq narsa.

examples.en: One of the buttons came off the front of my shirt.
examples.uz: Ko'ylagimning old qismidagi tugmalardan
examples.grammar: 'One of the + ko'plik ot + came off' - Past Simple, 'one of the' ko'plikdan bittasini ajratadi, 'come off' ajralib tushishni bildiradi.

examples.en: I need to sew a new button on my coat tomorrow.
examples.uz: Men ertaga paltomga yangi tugma tikishim kerak.
examples.grammar: 'need to + sew + a + sifat + ot' - Present Simple, 'tomorrow' kelasi vaqtni bildiruvchi ravish.

uz: kofta, kardigan: to'qilgan, odatda yoqasiz kiyim turi
defEn: a knitted jacket with buttons at the front.
defUz: oldida tugmalari bo'lgan to'qilgan kofta.

examples.en: My granddad was wearing a woolly cardigan buttoned all the way up.
examples.uz: Bobom tugmalari
examples.grammar: 'was wearing + a + sifat + ot' - Past Continuous, 'buttoned all the way up' sifatdosh oldingi otni izohlaydi.

examples.en: It is cold today, so I will wear a warm cardigan.
examples.uz: Bugun havo sovuq, shuning uchun men iliq kofta kiyaman.
examples.grammar: 'will + wear + a + sifat + ot' - Future ('will'), 'so' bog'lovchisi sabab-natijani ko'rsatadi.

defEn: the things people wear, such as shirts and trousers.
defUz: odamlar kiyadigan narsalar, masalan ko'ylak va shim.

examples.en: He's got so many clothes that they don't fit in his wardrobe.
examples.uz: Uning shunchalar ko'p kiyimlari
examples.grammar: 'has got + so many + ko'plik ot + that' - 'so ... that' ergash gap natijani bildiradi, 'has got' egalikni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: I always wash my clothes at the weekend.
examples.uz: Men kiyimlarimni doimo dam olish kunlari yuvaman.
examples.grammar: 'always + wash + egalik + ot' - Present Simple, 'always' takrorlanishni bildiruvchi ravish.

defEn: a piece of clothing for a woman that covers the body and legs.
defUz: ayolning tanasi va oyoqlarini qoplaydigan kiyim.

examples.en: Kate is wearing a long flowery summer dress.
examples.uz: Keyt uzun, gulli yozgi ko'ylak kiyib olgan.
examples.grammar: 'is wearing + a + sifat + sifat + sifat + ot' - Present Continuous, bir nechta sifat otdan oldin ketma-ket keladi.

examples.en: She wore a beautiful red dress to the party.
examples.uz: U bazmga chiroyli qizil ko'ylak kiyib bordi.
examples.grammar: 'wore + a + sifat + sifat + ot + to' - Past Simple, 'to' predlogi yo'nalishni bildiradi.

defEn: an event where models show new clothes to people.
defUz: modellar odamlarga yangi kiyimlarni namoyish qiladigan tadbir.

examples.en: She loves fashion and spends all her money on clothes.
examples.uz: U modani sevadi va hamma pulini
examples.grammar: 'loves + ot + and + spends + all + egalik + ot + on' - Present Simple, 'spend money on' pul sarflashni bildiruvchi ibora.

examples.en: We watched a fashion show with new summer clothes.
examples.uz: Biz yangi yozgi kiyimlar namoyish etilgan moda shousini tomosha qildik.
examples.grammar: 'watched + a + ot + with' - Past Simple, 'with' predlogi qo'shimcha ma'lumot beradi.

defEn: a bag that a woman uses to carry her things.
defUz: ayol o'z narsalarini olib yurish uchun ishlatadigan sumka.

examples.en: She was carrying a small black leather handbag under her arm.
examples.uz: U qo'lining ostida kichik bir
examples.grammar: 'was carrying + a + sifat + sifat + sifat + ot + under her arm' - Past Continuous, 'under' joy predlogi.

examples.en: She keeps her keys and phone in her handbag.
examples.uz: U kalit va telefonini sumkasida saqlaydi.
examples.grammar: 'keeps + ot and ot + in + egalik + ot' - Present Simple, 'in' joy predlogi.

defEn: a short coat with sleeves that you wear on top.
defUz: ustdan kiyiladigan yengli kalta kurtka.

examples.en: The trousers of the suit fit you, but the jacket's too small.
examples.uz: Kostyum-shimning shimi sizga mos
examples.grammar: 'fit you, but + ot + is too + sifat' - Present Simple, 'but' qarama-qarshi bog'lovchi, 'too' ortiqcha darajani bildiradi.

examples.en: He took off his jacket because the room was warm.
examples.uz: Xona issiq bo'lgani uchun u pidjagini yechdi.
examples.grammar: 'took off + egalik + ot + because + gap' - Past Simple, 'because' sabab ergash gapini boshlaydi.

defEn: rings, necklaces and other items people wear for decoration.
defUz: odamlar bezak uchun taqadigan uzuk, marjon va boshqa narsalar.

examples.en: The shop sells jewellery like necklaces and rings.
examples.uz: Bu do'kon marjon va uzuk kabi taqinchoqlar
examples.grammar: 'sells + ot + like + X and Y' - Present Simple, 'like' misol keltirish uchun ishlatiladi, jewellery sanalmaydigan ot.

examples.en: She wears beautiful jewellery on special days.
examples.uz: U maxsus kunlarda chiroyli taqinchoqlar taqadi.
examples.grammar: 'wears + sifat + ot + on + ko'plik ot' - Present Simple, 'on' vaqtni bildiruvchi predlog.

defEn: creams and colours people put on the face to look nicer.
defUz: odamlar chiroyliroq ko'rinish uchun yuzga suradigan kremlar va bo'yoqlar.

examples.en: My mum doesn't put on much make-up
examples.uz: just lipstick. – Oyim ko'p pardoz-andoz qilmaydilar–
examples.grammar: 'does not put on + much + ot' - Present Simple inkor shakli, 'much' sanalmaydigan ot bilan ishlatiladi.

examples.en: She wears make-up only at parties.
examples.uz: U faqat bazmlarda pardoz-andoz qiladi.
examples.grammar: 'wears + ot + only + at + ko'plik ot' - Present Simple, 'only' chegaralovchi ravish, 'at' joy predlogi.

defEn: a liquid with a nice smell that you put on your skin.
defUz: teriga suriladigan, yoqimli hidli suyuqlik.

examples.en: Your perfume smells beautiful
examples.uz: what's it called? – Atiringiz chiroyli hid taratarkan–u qanday
examples.grammar: 'ega + smells + sifat' - Present Simple, 'smell' his fe'li sifat bilan keladi (link verb).

examples.en: My sister bought a new perfume that smells of roses.
examples.uz: Singlim atirgul hidi keladigan yangi atir sotib oldi.
examples.grammar: 'bought + a + sifat + ot + that smells of' - Past Simple, 'that' ergash gap, 'smell of' hidni bildiradi.

defEn: a liquid soap you use to wash your hair.
defUz: sochni yuvish uchun ishlatiladigan suyuq sovun.

examples.en: Your hair's so shiny! What shampoo do you use?
examples.uz: Sochingiz juda yorqin ekan! Qanday
examples.grammar: 'What + ot + do you + use' - Present Simple so'roq gap, 'do' yordamchi fe'l, 'what' so'roq olmoshi.

examples.en: I buy a new shampoo every month for my hair.
examples.uz: Men sochim uchun har oy yangi shampun sotib olaman.
examples.grammar: 'buy + a + sifat + ot + every month' - Present Simple, 'every month' takrorlanishni bildiradi.

defEn: a piece of clothing for the top of the body, with a collar and buttons.
defUz: tananing yuqori qismiga kiyiladigan, yoqasi va tugmalari bo'lgan kiyim.

examples.en: Why don't you buy a brown tie to wear with that yellow shirt?
examples.uz: 1) U sariq ko'ylak bilan kiyish
examples.grammar: 'Why do not you + buy + a + ot + to wear with' - so'roq gap, 'why do not you' taklif beradi, 'to wear with' maqsad infinitivi.

examples.en: He wears a white shirt to the office every day.
examples.uz: U ofisga har kuni oq ko'ylak kiyib boradi.
examples.grammar: 'wears + a + sifat + ot + to + ot + every day' - Present Simple, 'every day' kunlik odatni bildiradi.

defEn: something you wear on your foot, made of leather or cloth.
defUz: oyoqqa kiyiladigan, teri yoki matodan tayyorlangan narsa.

examples.en: I have to take off these shoes because they're hurting my feet.
examples.uz: Bu oyoq kiyimlarni yechishga
examples.grammar: 'have to + take off + these + ko'plik ot + because' - Present Simple, 'have to' majburiyatni, 'because' sababni bildiradi.

examples.en: These shoes are new, so they are still a little tight.
examples.uz: Bu oyoq kiyimlar yangi, shuning uchun ular hali biroz tor.
examples.grammar: 'ko'plik ot + are + sifat, so + gap' - Present Simple, 'so' sabab-natija bog'lovchisi.

defEn: how big or small something like clothes or shoes is.
defUz: kiyim yoki oyoq kiyim kabi narsaning qanchalik katta yoki kichikligi.

examples.en: What size shoes do you take
examples.uz: ten? – Qanday o'lchamdagi oyoq kiyim olasiz–o'nmi?
examples.grammar: 'What + ot + ot + do you + take' - Present Simple so'roq gap, 'do' yordamchi fe'l, 'take' bu yerda 'kiyish' ma'nosida.

examples.en: This jacket is the wrong size, so I need a bigger one.
examples.uz: Bu kurtka noto'g'ri o'lchamda, shuning uchun menga kattaroq kerak.
examples.grammar: 'is the + sifat + ot, so + gap' - Present Simple, 'a bigger one' qiyosiy daraja bilan ifodalangan.

defEn: tight trousers made of denim that fit close to the legs.
defUz: oyoqqa yopishib turadigan, denimdan tikilgan tor jinsi.

examples.en: He was wearing a pair of skinny jeans in black denim.
examples.uz: U qora denimdan tikilgan bir juft tor jinsi
examples.grammar: 'was wearing + a pair of + ot + in + ot' - Past Continuous, 'a pair of' juft kiyimni, 'in' materialni bildiradi.

examples.en: She likes to wear skinny jeans with a long top.
examples.uz: U tor jinsini uzun ustki kiyim bilan kiyishni yoqtiradi.
examples.grammar: 'likes to + wear + ot + with + ot' - Present Simple, 'like to + infinitiv' yoqtirishni bildiradi.

defEn: a piece of clothing for a woman that hangs from the waist.
defUz: ayol uchun beldan pastga osilib turadigan kiyim.

examples.en: What top are you thinking of wearing with that skirt?
examples.uz: U yubka bilan qanday ustki kiyim kiyishni
examples.grammar: 'What + ot + are you + thinking of + wearing + with' - Present Continuous so'roq gap, 'think of + V-ing' rejani bildiradi.

examples.en: She wore a short black skirt to the party.
examples.uz: U bazmga kalta qora yubka kiyib bordi.
examples.grammar: 'wore + a + sifat + sifat + ot + to' - Past Simple, sifatlar ketma-ket otdan oldin keladi.

defEn: a particular way of dressing or doing something.
defUz: kiyinishning yoki biror ishni qilishning o'ziga xos uslubi.

examples.en: She says I've got no style, but I think her clothes look bad.
examples.uz: Uning aytishicha mening hech
examples.grammar: 'says + ergash gap, but + ega + think + ergash gap' - Present Simple, 'but' qarama-qarshi bog'lovchi, ergash gaplar fikrni ifodalaydi.

examples.en: I really like her style of dressing.
examples.uz: Menga uning kiyinish uslubi juda yoqadi.
examples.grammar: 'really + like + egalik + ot + of + V-ing' - Present Simple, 'really' kuchaytiruvchi ravish.

defEn: a warm top made of soft cotton, often worn for sport.
defUz: yumshoq paxtadan tikilgan, ko'pincha sport uchun kiyiladigan iliq ustki kiyim.

examples.en: Put a sweatshirt on after your run so you don't get cold.
examples.uz: Sovuqqotmaslik uchun, yugurishdan
examples.grammar: 'Put on + a + ot + after + egalik + ot + so + gap' - buyruq gap, 'after' vaqt predlogi, 'so' maqsadni bildiradi.

examples.en: He wears a grey sweatshirt when he goes running.
examples.uz: U yugurgani borganda kulrang fufayka kiyadi.
examples.grammar: 'wears + a + sifat + ot + when + gap' - Present Simple, 'when' vaqt ergash gapini boshlaydi.

defEn: a long thin piece of cloth men wear around the neck with a shirt.
defUz: erkaklar ko'ylak bilan bo'yniga taqadigan uzun ingichka mato.

examples.en: Many companies ask men to wear a shirt and tie to work.
examples.uz: Ko'plab kompaniyalar erkaklardan
examples.grammar: 'ask + men + to wear + a + ot and + ot + to work' - Present Simple, 'ask + somebody + to do' birovdan iltimos qilishni bildiradi.

examples.en: He chose a blue tie to wear with his white shirt.
examples.uz: U oq ko'ylagi bilan taqish uchun ko'k galstuk tanladi.
examples.grammar: 'chose + a + sifat + ot + to wear with' - Past Simple, 'to wear with' maqsad infinitivi.

defEn: soft shoes that people wear for sport or running.
defUz: odamlar sport yoki yugurish uchun kiyadigan yumshoq oyoq kiyim.

examples.en: He wears basketball trainers on and off the court.
examples.uz: U maydonda ham, maydondan tashqarida
examples.grammar: 'wears + ot + on and off + the + ot' - Present Simple, 'on and off' joyni bildiruvchi ibora, trainers ko'plikda.

examples.en: I bought new trainers for my morning runs.
examples.uz: Men ertalabki yugurishlarim uchun yangi krossovka sotib oldim.
examples.grammar: 'bought + sifat + ot + for + egalik + ko'plik ot' - Past Simple, 'for' maqsadni bildiradi.

defEn: a popular style or way of doing something at a certain time.
defUz: ma'lum bir vaqtda mashhur bo'lgan uslub yoki narsa.

examples.en: Spiky hair is the trend in hair styles these days.
examples.uz: Uchli soch turmagi hozirgi kunlarda
examples.grammar: 'ega + is the + ot + in + ot + these days' - Present Simple, 'these days' hozirgi davrni bildiradi.

examples.en: Wearing bright colours is a new trend this summer.
examples.uz: Yorqin ranglar kiyish bu yozda yangi urf bo'lib bormoqda.
examples.grammar: 'V-ing + is a + sifat + ot' - Present Simple, gerundiy (V-ing) gap egasi vazifasida keladi.

defEn: a piece of clothing that covers both legs from the waist down.
defUz: beldan pastga ikkala oyoqni qoplaydigan kiyim.

examples.en: The trousers of this suit fit well and are the right length.
examples.uz: Bu kostyumning shimi yaxshi mos
examples.grammar: 'ot + fit well and are + the + sifat + ot' - Present Simple, trousers ko'plik ot, fe'l ko'plikda kelishadi.

examples.en: These trousers are too long, so I will make them shorter.
examples.uz: Bu shim juda uzun, shuning uchun men uni kaltaroq qilaman.
examples.grammar: 'ko'plik ot + are too + sifat, so + gap' - Present Simple, 'shorter' qiyosiy daraja shakli.

defEn: a simple cotton top with short sleeves and no collar.
defUz: kalta yengli, yoqasiz oddiy paxta ustki kiyim.

examples.en: Most teenagers wear jeans and T-shirts.
examples.uz: Ko'pchilik o'smirlar jinsi va futbolkalar kiyadi.
examples.grammar: 'Most + ot + wear + ko'plik ot' - Present Simple, 'most' ko'pchilikni bildiradi, otlar ko'plikda.

examples.en: He wears a plain white T-shirt in summer.
examples.uz: U yozda oddiy oq futbolka kiyadi.
examples.grammar: 'wears + a + sifat + sifat + ot + in summer' - Present Simple, 'in summer' fasl holini bildiradi.

defEn: to take and use something for a short time and then give it back.
defUz: biror narsani qisqa vaqtga olib turib, keyin qaytarib bermoq.

examples.en: Can I borrow your suit? I have to go to a wedding.
examples.uz: Sizni kostyum-shimingizni vaqtinchalik olib
examples.grammar: 'Can I + borrow + egalik + ot' - so'roq gap, 'can' ruxsat so'rovchi modal fe'l, infinitiv 'to'siz keladi.

examples.en: Can I borrow your tie for the meeting tomorrow?
examples.uz: Ertangi uchrashuv uchun galstugingizni vaqtincha olib tursam bo'ladimi?
examples.grammar: 'Can I + borrow + egalik + ot + for' - so'roq gap, 'can' ruxsat so'raydi, 'for' maqsadni bildiradi.

defEn: to close or join something firmly, such as a coat or a belt.
defUz: biror narsani, masalan palto yoki kamarni mahkam yopmoq yoki bog'lamoq.

examples.en: The dress fastens with buttons all the way up the side.
examples.uz: Ko'ylak yon tomondan yuqoriga
examples.grammar: 'ot + fastens with + ko'plik ot + all the way up' - Present Simple, 'with' vositani, 'fasten' mahkamlanishni bildiradi.

examples.en: Please fasten your coat because it is windy outside.
examples.uz: Iltimos, paltongizni mahkamlang, chunki tashqarida shamol.
examples.grammar: 'Please + fasten + egalik + ot + because + gap' - buyruq gap, 'because' sabab ergash gapini boshlaydi.

uz: o'lchami mos tushmoq · jismonan sog'lom va baquvvat, tetik
defEn: to be the right size and shape for someone.
defUz: kimgadir to'g'ri o'lcham va shaklda bo'lmoq.

examples.en: Those shoes don't fit you
examples.uz: they're too big. – Bu oyoq kiyimlar sizga mos tushmadi–ular haddan
examples.grammar: 'ko'plik ot + do not + fit + you' - Present Simple inkor, 'do not' yordamchi fe'l, 'fit' o'lcham mosligini bildiradi.

examples.en: This jacket fits me well and feels comfortable.
examples.uz: Bu kurtka menga yaxshi mos keladi va qulay seziladi.
examples.grammar: 'ega + fits + me + well and + feels + sifat' - Present Simple, ikki fe'l 'and' bilan bog'langan.

examples.en: She's very fit
examples.uz: she goes running every day. – U jismonan juda tetik–u har kuni yugurishga chiqadi.
examples.grammar: 'She's very fit' - Present Simple, 'is' + ravish 'very' + sifat 'fit' holatni kuchaytirib bildiradi.

examples.en: He stays fit by running and swimming every week.
examples.uz: U har hafta yugurish va suzish orqali tetik bo'lib turadi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple 'stays', 'by + -ing' usulni bildiradi; 'fit' sifat 'stays' bilan keladi.

defEn: to bend cloth or paper so one part lies on top of another.
defUz: matoni yoki qog'ozni bir qismi boshqasining ustiga tushadigan qilib bukmoq.

examples.en: If you fold your clothes, they won't need ironing all the time.
examples.uz: Agar kiyimlaringizni taxlasangiz,
examples.grammar: 'If you + fold + egalik + ot, they will not + need' - shart mayli, 'if' ergash gap, bosh gapda Future ('will').

examples.en: She folds the clean clothes and puts them in the wardrobe.
examples.uz: U toza kiyimlarni taxlab, ularni shkafga joylaydi.
examples.grammar: 'folds + ot + and + puts + them + in' - Present Simple, ikki fe'l 'and' bilan bog'langan.

defEn: to watch or keep up with something, such as the latest fashions.
defUz: biror narsani, masalan oxirgi modalarni kuzatib bormoq.

examples.en: Carl follows all the latest fashions.
examples.uz: Karl barcha oxirgi modalarni kuzatib boradi.
examples.grammar: 'ega + follows + all the + sifat + ko'plik ot' - Present Simple, 'follow' bu yerda kuzatib borishni bildiradi.

examples.en: Many young people follow fashion on the internet.
examples.uz: Ko'plab yoshlar internetda modani kuzatib boradi.
examples.grammar: 'Many + ot + follow + ot + on the internet' - Present Simple, 'on' joy predlogi vazifasida.

defEn: to find the size, length or amount of something.
defUz: biror narsaning o'lchami, uzunligi yoki miqdorini aniqlamoq.

examples.en: They measured my feet at the shoe shop and they were two sizes bigger!
examples.uz: Oyoq kiyim do'konida
examples.grammar: 'measured + egalik + ot + at the + ot + and they were' - Past Simple, ikki gap 'and' bilan bog'langan.

examples.en: The tailor measured me before he made the suit.
examples.uz: Tikuvchi kostyum-shim tikishdan oldin meni o'lchadi.
examples.grammar: 'measured + me + before + ega + made' - Past Simple, 'before' vaqt ergash gapini boshlaydi.

defEn: to open something that is fastened, such as a button.
defUz: mahkamlangan narsani, masalan tugmani ochmoq.

examples.en: It was hot, so I undid the top button on my shirt.
examples.uz: Havo issiq edi, shuning uchun men
examples.grammar: 'It was hot, so + ega + undid + the + sifat + ot' - Past Simple, 'undo' tartibsiz fe'l (undid), 'so' sabab-natijani bildiradi.

examples.en: She undid her coat as soon as she came inside.
examples.uz: U ichkariga kirishi bilan paltosini yechdi.
examples.grammar: 'undid + egalik + ot + as soon as + gap' - Past Simple, 'as soon as' vaqt ergash gapini boshlaydi.

defEn: to have clothes or other things on your body.
defUz: kiyim yoki boshqa narsalarni tanada saqlamoq.

examples.en: In this photo, I'm wearing a fancy dress costume.
examples.uz: Bu rasmda, men chiroyli libos kiyganman.
examples.grammar: 'In this photo, + ega + am wearing + a + ot + ot' - Present Continuous, 'In this photo' joy holi gap boshida keladi.

examples.en: She wears a warm coat when the weather is cold.
examples.uz: Havo sovuq bo'lganda u iliq palto kiyadi.
examples.grammar: 'wears + a + sifat + ot + when + gap' - Present Simple, 'when' vaqt ergash gapini boshlaydi.

defEn: to fasten a piece of clothing, such as a coat or buttons.
defUz: kiyimni, masalan palto yoki tugmalarni mahkamlamoq.

examples.en: Do up your coat to the top
examples.uz: it's cold out. – Paltoyingizni yuqori qismigacha tugmasini taqing–
examples.grammar: 'Do up + egalik + ot + to the top' - buyruq gap, 'do up' ibora fe'l tugmasini taqishni bildiradi.

examples.en: Do up your jacket before you go outside.
examples.uz: Tashqariga chiqishdan oldin kurtkangizning tugmalarini taqing.
examples.grammar: 'Do up + egalik + ot + before + gap' - buyruq gap, 'before' vaqt ergash gapini boshlaydi.

defEn: to put on smart or special clothes for an occasion.
defUz: biror tadbir uchun bejirim yoki maxsus kiyim kiymoq.

examples.en: Weddings are a chance to dress up in smart clothes.
examples.uz: To'ylar bejirim kiyimlar kiyish uchun
examples.grammar: 'ot + are + a chance + to dress up in + sifat + ot' - Present Simple, 'to dress up' maqsad infinitivi, 'in' kiyimni bildiradi.

examples.en: The children love to dress up in funny costumes.
examples.uz: Bolalar kulgili liboslar kiyib olishni yaxshi ko'radi.
examples.grammar: 'love to + dress up in + sifat + ot' - Present Simple, 'love to + infinitiv' yoqtirishni bildiradi.

uz: biror kiyim boshqa bir kiyimga yarashmoq = match
defEn: to look good together with something else, such as clothes.
defUz: biror narsa bilan, masalan kiyimlar bilan yaxshi yarashmoq.

examples.en: No, blue shoes do not go with green socks.
examples.uz: Yo'q, ko'k rangdagi oyoq kiyimlar yashil rangdagi
examples.grammar: 'No, + ko'plik ot + do not + go with + ko'plik ot' - Present Simple inkor, 'do not' yordamchi fe'l, 'go with' yarashishni bildiradi.

examples.en: This red belt goes with your black trousers.
examples.uz: Bu qizil kamar sizning qora shimingizga yarashadi.
examples.grammar: 'ega + goes with + egalik + ot' - Present Simple, 'go with' birlikda 's qo'shimchasi oladi.

defEn: to put clothes on a hook or hanger so they do not fall.
defUz: kiyimni tushib ketmasligi uchun ilgak yoki ilgichga osmoq.

examples.en: Don't leave your shirt on the floor
examples.uz: hang it up. – Ko'ylagingizni polga tashlab ketmang–uni ilib
examples.grammar: 'Do not + leave + egalik + ot + on the floor' - buyruq gap inkor, 'do not' taqiqni bildiradi, 'on' joy predlogi.

examples.en: Please hang up your coat in the wardrobe.
examples.uz: Iltimos, paltongizni shkafga osib qo'ying.
examples.grammar: 'Please + hang up + egalik + ot + in' - buyruq gap, 'in' joy predlogi vazifasida.

defEn: to start wearing a piece of clothing.
defUz: biror kiyimni kiya boshlamoq.

examples.en: I put on my pyjamas and went to bed.
examples.uz: Men pijamamni kiydim va uyquga yotdim.
examples.grammar: 'ega + put on + egalik + ot + and + went to bed' - Past Simple, 'put' tartibsiz fe'l shaklini o'zgartirmaydi.

examples.en: She put on her coat and left the house.
examples.uz: U paltosini kiydi va uydan chiqib ketdi.
examples.grammar: 'put on + egalik + ot + and + left' - Past Simple, ikki harakat 'and' bilan bog'langan.

uz: yechmoq · (samalyot va vertalyotga nisbatan) havoga ko'tarilmoq
defEn: to remove a piece of clothing.
defUz: biror kiyimni yechmoq.

examples.en: He took off his pyjamas and got dressed for school.
examples.uz: U pijamasini yechdi va maktabga borish
examples.grammar: 'ega + took off + egalik + ot + and + got dressed' - Past Simple, 'take off' ibora fe'l yechishni bildiradi.

examples.en: He took off his shoes before entering the house.
examples.uz: U uyga kirishdan oldin oyoq kiyimini yechdi.
examples.grammar: 'took off + egalik + ot + before + V-ing' - Past Simple, 'before + V-ing' vaqt holini bildiradi.

examples.en: The plane took off and flew up into the sky.
examples.uz: Samalyot havoga ko'tarildi va osmonga uchib
examples.grammar: 'The plane took off and flew up ...' - Past Simple ketma-ket harakatlar; 'take off' - phrasal fe'l; 'flew' - 'fly' fe'lining o'tgan zamoni.

examples.en: Our plane took off two hours late because of the storm.
examples.uz: Samalyotimiz bo'ron tufayli ikki soat kech havoga ko'tarildi.
examples.grammar: 'took off' - Past Simple; 'two hours late' - kechikishni bildiruvchi ibora; 'because of' - sabab predlogi.

uz: kiyib ko'rmoq: kiyim yarashgan yoki yarashmaganligini ko'rish uchun
defEn: to put on clothes in a shop to see if they fit.
defUz: kiyim mosligini bilish uchun do'konda kiyib ko'rmoq.

examples.en: Do you have a changing room where I can try on this shirt?
examples.uz: Bu ko'ylakni kiyib ko'rishim mumkin
examples.grammar: 'Do you have + a + ot + where I can + try on + this + ot' - so'roq gap, 'where' ergash gap, 'can' modal fe'l.

examples.en: Can I try on these shoes before I buy them?
examples.uz: Sotib olishdan oldin bu oyoq kiyimlarni kiyib ko'rsam bo'ladimi?
examples.grammar: 'Can I + try on + these + ot + before + gap' - so'roq gap, 'before' vaqt ergash gapini boshlaydi.

defEn: to close a piece of clothing with a zip.
defUz: kiyimni zamok bilan yopmoq.

examples.en: Zip up your jacket
examples.uz: it's very cold outside. – Kurtkangizning zamogini taqing–tashqari juda sovuq.
examples.grammar: 'Zip up + egalik + ot' - buyruq gap, 'zip up' ibora fe'l zamokni taqishni bildiradi.

examples.en: Zip up your coat because it is snowing.
examples.uz: Paltongizning zamogini taqing, chunki qor yog'yapti.
examples.grammar: 'Zip up + egalik + ot + because + gap' - buyruq gap, 'because' sabab ergash gapini boshlaydi.

defEn: in addition to something else; and also.
defUz: biror narsadan tashqari; shuningdek.

examples.en: As well as coats, this shop has some nice handbags.
examples.uz: Paltolardan tashqari, bu do'konda chiroyli
examples.grammar: 'As well as + ko'plik ot, + this + ot + has + some + sifat + ko'plik ot' - 'as well as' qo'shimcha narsani bildiradi.

examples.en: As well as shoes, this shop sells bags and belts.
examples.uz: Oyoq kiyimlardan tashqari, bu do'kon sumka va kamar ham sotadi.
examples.grammar: 'As well as + ot, + ega + sells + ot and ot' - Present Simple, 'as well as' qo'shimchani bildiradi.

defEn: to become heavier and put on body weight.
defUz: tana vazni ortib, og'irlashmoq.

examples.en: I gained weight and now I can't zip up these jeans.
examples.uz: Men vazn orttirdim, endi esa mana bu jinsi
examples.grammar: 'gained weight + and now + ega + can not + zip up + these + ot' - Past Simple va Present aralash, 'can not' modal fe'l.

examples.en: I gained weight in winter and my trousers feel tight now.
examples.uz: Men qishda vazn orttirdim va endi shimim tor seziladi.
examples.grammar: 'gained weight + and + ot + feel + sifat' - Past Simple va Present Simple aralash qo'llangan.

defEn: to put on your clothes.
defUz: kiyimlaringizni kiymoq.

examples.en: Go and get dressed for school, kids.
examples.uz: Boringlar, maktabga kiyininglar, bolalar.
examples.grammar: 'Go and + get dressed + for school' - buyruq gap, 'go and' ketma-ket harakatni, 'get dressed' kiyinishni bildiradi.

examples.en: I get dressed quickly every morning before work.
examples.uz: Men har kuni ertalab ishdan oldin tez kiyinaman.
examples.grammar: 'get dressed + quickly + every morning + before work' - Present Simple, 'quickly' tarz ravishi.

defEn: to think that something is true, even without proof.
defUz: biror narsa to'g'ri ekanini, hatto dalilsiz ham his qilmoq.

examples.en: I have a feeling that something great will happen today.
examples.uz: Bugun ajoyib bir narsa ro'y berishini
examples.grammar: 'have a feeling + that + gap' - Present Simple, 'that' ergash gapni boshlaydi, ichida Future ('will') bor.

examples.en: I have a feeling that it will rain this evening.
examples.uz: Bu kuni kechqurun yomg'ir yog'adigandek tuyulyapti.
examples.grammar: 'have a feeling + that + ega + will + rain' - 'that' ergash gap, Future ('will') ishlatilgan.

defEn: in the position directly before someone or something.
defUz: kimnidir yoki nimanidir to'g'risida, oldida.

examples.en: Joan stood in front of the shop window, looking at the jacket.
examples.uz: Jo'un do'kon derazasi oldida
examples.grammar: 'stood + in front of + the + ot, + looking at' - Past Simple, 'in front of' joy predlogi, 'looking at' ravishdosh.

examples.en: She waited in front of the shop for her friend.
examples.uz: U do'kon oldida dugonasini kutdi.
examples.grammar: 'waited + in front of + the + ot + for' - Past Simple, 'in front of' joy predlogi vazifasida.

uz: sog'lom, tetik va baquvvat holatini saqlamoq, jismoniy formasini yo'qotmaslik
defEn: to stay healthy and strong by exercising.
defUz: mashq qilish orqali sog'lom va baquvvat bo'lib turmoq.

examples.en: He goes running three times a week to keep fit.
examples.uz: U jismoniy formasini yo'qotmaslik uchun bir
examples.grammar: 'goes running + three times a week + to keep fit' - Present Simple, 'to keep fit' maqsad infinitivi.

examples.en: She walks every day to keep fit and feel good.
examples.uz: U jismoniy formasini saqlash va o'zini yaxshi his qilish uchun har kuni piyoda yuradi.
examples.grammar: 'walks + every day + to keep fit and feel good' - Present Simple, 'to keep ... and feel' maqsad infinitivi.

uz: makiyaj qilmoq, o'ziga oro bermoq, bo'yanmoq
defEn: to apply creams and colours to your face.
defUz: yuzga krem va bo'yoqlar surmoq.

examples.en: She put on her make-up in front of the mirror.
examples.uz: U ko'zguning qarshisida o'ziga oro berdi.
examples.grammar: 'put on + egalik + ot + in front of + the + ot' - Past Simple, 'in front of' joy predlogi vazifasida keladi.

examples.en: She puts on make-up before she goes to work.
examples.uz: U ishga borishidan oldin o'ziga oro beradi.
examples.grammar: 'puts on make-up + before + gap' - Present Simple, 'before' vaqt ergash gapini boshlaydi.

defEn: exactly like something else; not different.
defUz: boshqa narsa bilan aynan bir xil; farq qilmaydigan.

examples.en: Your dress is exactly the same as mine.
examples.uz: Ko'ylagingiz meniki bilan quyib-qo'ygandek bir xil ekan.
examples.grammar: 'ega + is exactly + the same as + mine' - Present Simple, 'the same as' tenglik munosabatini bildiradi, 'exactly' kuchaytiradi.

examples.en: My phone is the same as yours.
examples.uz: Mening telefonim sizniki bilan bir xil.
examples.grammar: 'ega + is the same as + yours' - Present Simple, 'the same as' tenglikni bildiradi, 'yours' egalik olmoshi.

defEn: comfortable and not formal, used about clothes.
defUz: qulay va norasmiy, kiyimga nisbatan ishlatiladi.

examples.en: You don't have to wear a suit
examples.uz: just casual clothes. – Kostyum-shim kiyishingiz shart emas–
examples.grammar: 'do not have to + wear + a + ot' - Present Simple, 'do not have to' majburiyat yo'qligini bildiradi.

examples.en: He wears casual clothes when he is at home.
examples.uz: U uyda bo'lganda odatiy kiyimlar kiyadi.
examples.grammar: 'wears + sifat + ot + when + gap' - Present Simple, 'when' vaqt ergash gapini boshlaydi.

defEn: having a pattern of squares, used about cloth.
defUz: kataklardan iborat naqshli, matoga nisbatan ishlatiladi.

examples.en: Do you prefer this checked shirt to the striped one?
examples.uz: Yo'l-yo'l chiziqlisidan ko'ra katak-katakli
examples.grammar: 'Do you + prefer + this + sifat + ot + to + the + sifat one' - so'roq gap, 'prefer ... to' afzal ko'rishni bildiradi.

examples.en: He wore a checked shirt to the picnic.
examples.uz: U sayohatga katak-katakli ko'ylak kiyib bordi.
examples.grammar: 'wore + a + sifat + ot + to + ot' - Past Simple, sifat otdan oldin keladi.

defEn: made from the soft white material of the cotton plant.
defUz: paxta o'simligining yumshoq oq tolasidan tayyorlangan.

examples.en: I prefer cotton socks because they're cooler than woolen ones.
examples.uz: Men paxtadan tikilgan
examples.grammar: 'prefer + ot + because + they are + qiyosiy daraja + than' - Present Simple, 'because' sabab, 'cooler than' qiyosiy daraja.

examples.en: I wear a light cotton shirt in summer.
examples.uz: Men yozda yengil paxta ko'ylak kiyaman.
examples.grammar: 'wear + a + sifat + sifat + ot + in summer' - Present Simple, sifatlar otdan oldin ketma-ket keladi.

defEn: made from the strong cotton cloth used for jeans.
defUz: jinsi tikiladigan mustahkam paxta matosidan tayyorlangan.

examples.en: Her blue denim jacket exactly matched her jeans.
examples.uz: Uning ko'k rangli jinsi kurtkasi jinsi shimiga
examples.grammar: 'egalik + sifat + ot + exactly matched + egalik + ot' - Past Simple, 'exactly' kuchaytiruvchi ravish.

examples.en: She bought a new denim jacket last week.
examples.uz: U o'tgan hafta yangi jinsi kurtka sotib oldi.
examples.grammar: 'bought + a + sifat + sifat + ot + last week' - Past Simple, 'last week' o'tgan vaqtni bildiradi.

defEn: having had its colour changed using a special liquid.
defUz: maxsus suyuqlik yordamida rangi o'zgartirilgan.

examples.en: I have a dyed green T-shirt and I wear it to environmental events.
examples.uz: Mening yashil rangda
examples.grammar: 'have a + sifat + sifat + ot + and + wear it to' - Present Simple, ikki gap 'and' bilan bog'langan.

examples.en: She wore a dyed red shirt to the concert.
examples.uz: U konsertga bo'yalgan qizil ko'ylak kiyib bordi.
examples.grammar: 'wore + a + sifat + sifat + ot + to + ot' - Past Simple, sifatlar otdan oldin keladi.

defEn: very large; a bigger clothing size than large.
defUz: juda katta; kattadan ham kattaroq kiyim o'lchami.

examples.en: My son's so big now that he wears tops that are extra large.
examples.uz: O'g'lim hozir shunchalik kattaki, u
examples.grammar: 'ega + is so + sifat + that + ega + wears + ko'plik ot + that are extra large' - 'so ... that' natijani bildiradi.

examples.en: This shop has shirts in extra large sizes too.
examples.uz: Bu do'konda katta o'lchamdagi ko'ylaklar ham bor.
examples.grammar: 'has + ko'plik ot + in + sifat + ko'plik ot + too' - Present Simple, 'too' qo'shimchani bildiradi.

defEn: made from animal skin; used for shoes and bags.
defUz: hayvon terisidan tayyorlangan; oyoq kiyim va sumka uchun ishlatiladi.

examples.en: Are those boots made of real leather or plastic?
examples.uz: Anavi etik haqiqiy charmdan tikilganmi yoki
examples.grammar: 'Are those + ko'plik ot + made of + real + ot + or + ot' - so'roq gap, 'made of' materialni, 'or' tanlovni bildiradi.

examples.en: He bought a black leather belt at the shop.
examples.uz: U do'kondan qora charm kamar sotib oldi.
examples.grammar: 'bought + a + sifat + sifat + ot + at the + ot' - Past Simple, 'at' joy predlogi.

defEn: of average or middle size, not big and not small.
defUz: o'rtacha o'lchamdagi, na katta na kichik.

examples.en: Do you wear a medium shirt or a large one usually?
examples.uz: Siz odatda o'rtacha o'lchamli ko'ylak
examples.grammar: 'Do you + wear + a + sifat + ot + or + a + sifat one + usually' - so'roq gap, 'or' tanlovni, 'usually' odatni bildiradi.

examples.en: I usually buy medium shirts because they fit me well.
examples.uz: Men odatda o'rtacha o'lchamli ko'ylak olaman, chunki ular menga yaxshi mos keladi.
examples.grammar: 'buy + sifat + ko'plik ot + because + gap' - Present Simple, 'because' sabab ergash gapini boshlaydi.

defEn: new and using the latest style or ideas.
defUz: yangi va eng so'nggi uslub yoki g'oyalardan foydalanadigan.

examples.en: That shop sells really modern clothes
examples.uz: nothing old-fashioned. – U do'kon juda zamonaviy kiyimlar
examples.grammar: 'ot + sells + really + sifat + ko'plik ot' - Present Simple, 'really' kuchaytiruvchi ravish sifatdan oldin keladi.

examples.en: She likes modern clothes with simple colours.
examples.uz: U sodda ranglardagi zamonaviy kiyimlarni yoqtiradi.
examples.grammar: 'likes + sifat + ko'plik ot + with + sifat + ot' - Present Simple, 'with' qo'shimcha xususiyatni bildiradi.

defEn: in a style from the past; no longer modern.
defUz: o'tmish uslubidagi; endi zamonaviy bo'lmagan.

examples.en: Those trousers are so old-fashioned. My granddad has a pair!
examples.uz: Bu shim juda urfdan qolib
examples.grammar: 'ko'plik ot + are so + sifat' - Present Simple, 'so' darajani kuchaytiradi, 'old-fashioned' qo'shma sifat.

examples.en: My grandmother wears old-fashioned dresses.
examples.uz: Buvim eskicha ko'ylaklar kiyadi.
examples.grammar: 'wears + sifat + ko'plik ot' - Present Simple, qo'shma sifat otdan oldin keladi.

defEn: with no pattern or decoration; simple.
defUz: naqsh yoki bezaksiz; oddiy.

examples.en: He wears a plain white T-shirt and blue jeans every day.
examples.uz: U har kuni oddiy oq futbolka va ko'k
examples.grammar: 'wears + a + sifat + sifat + ot + and + sifat + ko'plik ot + every day' - Present Simple, 'every day' kunlik odatni bildiradi.

examples.en: She likes plain shirts in one colour.
examples.uz: U bir rangli oddiy ko'ylaklarni yoqtiradi.
examples.grammar: 'likes + sifat + ko'plik ot + in + ot' - Present Simple, sifat otdan oldin keladi.

defEn: smooth and bright, reflecting light.
defUz: silliq va yorqin, nurni qaytaradigan.

examples.en: Her leather handbag is so shiny that I can see my face in it!
examples.uz: Uning charm sumkasi shu qadar
examples.grammar: 'egalik + ot + is so + sifat + that + ega + can + see' - 'so ... that' natijani bildiradi, 'can' modal fe'l.

examples.en: She wore shiny black shoes to the party.
examples.uz: U bazmga yaltiroq qora oyoq kiyim kiyib bordi.
examples.grammar: 'wore + sifat + sifat + ko'plik ot + to' - Past Simple, sifatlar otdan oldin ketma-ket keladi.

defEn: neat and stylish in appearance, used about clothes or people.
defUz: tashqi ko'rinishi ozoda va bejirim, kiyim yoki odamga nisbatan ishlatiladi.

examples.en: You look very smart in that suit, Gerry!
examples.uz: Bu kostyum-shimda juda bejirim ko'rinarkansiz, Jeri!
examples.grammar: 'You look very + sifat + in that + ot' - Present Simple, 'look' link verb sifat bilan keladi, 'in' kiyimni bildiradi.

examples.en: He looks very smart in his new suit.
examples.uz: U yangi kostyum-shimida juda bejirim ko'rinadi.
examples.grammar: 'looks very + sifat + in + egalik + ot' - Present Simple, 'look' his fe'li sifat bilan keladi.

defEn: having a pattern of small round marks.
defUz: kichik dumaloq belgilar naqshiga ega.

examples.en: You can't wear a spotted tie with a striped shirt!
examples.uz: Yo'l-yo'l chiziqli ko'ylak bilan nuqta-nuqtali
examples.grammar: 'You can not + wear + a + sifat + ot + with a + sifat + ot' - Present Simple, 'can not' modal fe'l, 'with' birga ishlatishni bildiradi.

examples.en: She bought a spotted dress for the party.
examples.uz: U bazm uchun nuqta-nuqtali ko'ylak sotib oldi.
examples.grammar: 'bought + a + sifat + ot + for + ot' - Past Simple, sifat otdan oldin keladi.

defEn: having a pattern of lines, used about cloth.
defUz: chiziqlar naqshiga ega, matoga nisbatan ishlatiladi.

examples.en: His team wears a red and white striped shirt and white shorts.
examples.uz: Uning jamoasi qizil va oq chiziqli
