examples.grammar: 'egalik + ot + wears + a + sifat + sifat + ot + and + sifat + ko'plik ot' - Present Simple, sifatlar otdan oldin keladi.

examples.en: He wore a blue striped shirt to the meeting.
examples.uz: U uchrashuvga ko'k yo'l-yo'l chiziqli ko'ylak kiyib bordi.
examples.grammar: 'wore + a + sifat + sifat + ot + to + ot' - Past Simple, sifatlar otdan oldin ketma-ket keladi.

defEn: fitting very closely to the body, not loose.
defUz: tanaga juda yopishib turadigan, keng bo'lmagan.

examples.en: This shirt's too tight around the neck
examples.uz: I can't breathe. – Bu ko'ylakni bo'yin qismi haddan tashqari
examples.grammar: 'ega + is too + sifat + around the + ot' - Present Simple, 'too' ortiqcha darajani, 'around' joy predlogini bildiradi.

examples.en: These jeans are too tight for me now.
examples.uz: Bu jinsi endi menga juda tor.
examples.grammar: 'ko'plik ot + are too + sifat + for me + now' - Present Simple, 'too' ortiqcha darajani bildiradi.

defEn: very fashionable and modern in style.
defUz: uslubi juda zamonaviy va urfdagi.

examples.en: He always looks trendy, like he stepped out of a fashion shop.
examples.uz: U doimo mo'dniy ko'rinadi, xuddi
examples.grammar: 'always looks + sifat, like + gap' - Present Simple, 'look' link verb, 'like' o'xshatishni bildiradi.

examples.en: She wears trendy clothes that everyone likes.
examples.uz: U hammaga yoqadigan urfdagi kiyimlar kiyadi.
examples.grammar: 'wears + sifat + ko'plik ot + that + gap' - Present Simple, 'that' ergash gap otni izohlaydi.

defEn: in a relaxed, informal way, used about dressing.
defUz: bemalol, norasmiy tarzda, kiyinishga nisbatan ishlatiladi.

examples.en: He was casually dressed in jeans and a polo shirt.
examples.uz: U odatdagidek jinsi shim va yoqali futbolka
examples.grammar: 'was + sifatdosh + dressed + in + ko'plik ot' - Past Simple passiv, 'casually' tarz ravishi, 'in' kiyimni bildiradi.

examples.en: He always dresses casually at the weekend.
examples.uz: U dam olish kunlari doimo odatiy tarzda kiyinadi.
examples.grammar: 'dresses + casually + at the weekend' - Present Simple, 'casually' tarz ravishi fe'lni izohlaydi.

defEn: in a way that is relaxed and pleasant.
defUz: bemalol va yoqimli tarzda.

examples.en: She was comfortably dressed in a sweatshirt and old jeans.
examples.uz: U qulay tarzda sviter va eski jinsi
examples.grammar: 'was + comfortably + dressed + in + a + ot + and + sifat + ko'plik ot' - Past Simple, 'comfortably' tarz ravishi.

examples.en: She was comfortably dressed in soft warm clothes.
examples.uz: U yumshoq va iliq kiyimlarda qulay tarzda kiyingan edi.
examples.grammar: 'was + comfortably + dressed + in + ko'plik ot' - Past Simple passiv, 'comfortably' tarz ravishi.

defEn: in a neat and stylish way.
defUz: ozoda va bejirim tarzda.

examples.en: Why can't you dress smartly and throw away those old jeans?
examples.uz: Nima uchun bu eski jinsi shimni
examples.grammar: 'Why can not you + dress + smartly + and + throw away + those + ot' - so'roq gap, 'can not' modal fe'l, 'smartly' tarz ravishi.

examples.en: He always dresses smartly for important meetings.
examples.uz: U muhim uchrashuvlar uchun doimo bejirim kiyinadi.
examples.grammar: 'dresses + smartly + for + sifat + ko'plik ot' - Present Simple, 'smartly' tarz ravishi fe'lni izohlaydi.

defEn: to write about your life or ideas on a website.
defUz: veb-saytda hayoting yoki fikrlaring haqida yozmoq.

examples.en: Finley blogs about his life in Ireland.
examples.uz: Finley Irlandiyadagi hayoti to'g'risida blog yuritadi.
examples.grammar: 'ega + blogs about + egalik + ot + in + joy' - Present Simple, 'blog about' biror mavzuda yozishni bildiradi.

examples.en: She blogs about fashion and new clothes every week.
examples.uz: U har hafta moda va yangi kiyimlar haqida blog yuritadi.
examples.grammar: 'blogs about + ot + every week' - Present Simple, 'every week' takrorlanishni bildiradi.

defEn: a person who writes about a topic on a website.
defUz: veb-saytda biror mavzu haqida yozadigan shaxs.

examples.en: She's a blogger who writes about fashion shows.
examples.uz: U mo'da tomoshalari to'g'risida yozadigan
examples.grammar: 'ega + is a + ot + who + writes about' - Present Simple, 'who' ergash gap shaxsni izohlaydi.

examples.en: He is a famous blogger who writes about clothes.
examples.uz: U kiyimlar haqida yozadigan mashhur blogger.
examples.grammar: 'is a + sifat + ot + who + writes about' - Present Simple, 'who' ergash gap shaxsni izohlaydi.

defEn: to make someone feel less sad or worried.
defUz: kimnidir kamroq xafa yoki tashvishli his qildirmoq.

examples.en: She comforted herself with the thought that it would soon be spring.
examples.uz: U tez orada bahor keladi
examples.grammar: 'ega + comforted + herself + with the thought + that + gap' - Past Simple, 'that' ergash gap fikrni bildiradi.

examples.en: She comforted her friend after the bad news.
examples.uz: U yomon xabardan keyin dugonasini yupatdi.
examples.grammar: 'comforted + egalik + ot + after + ot' - Past Simple, 'after' vaqt predlogi vazifasida.

defEn: pleasant to wear and not causing any pain.
defUz: kiyish yoqimli va hech qanday og'riq keltirmaydigan.

examples.en: I don't care about style
examples.uz: I just want to be comfortable. – Menga mo'daning farqi yo'q–men
examples.grammar: 'do not + care about + ot' - Present Simple inkor, 'care about' qiziqishni bildiradi, 'do not' yordamchi fe'l.

examples.en: These shoes are very comfortable for long walks.
examples.uz: Bu oyoq kiyimlar uzoq sayrlar uchun juda qulay.
examples.grammar: 'ko'plik ot + are very + sifat + for + sifat + ko'plik ot' - Present Simple, 'very' kuchaytiruvchi ravish.

defEn: not pleasant to wear and sometimes causing pain.
defUz: kiyish yoqimsiz va ba'zan og'riq keltiradigan.

examples.en: These shoes are really uncomfortable
examples.uz: do you have a bigger size? – Bu oyoq kiyim juda noqulay
examples.grammar: 'These + ko'plik ot + are really + sifat' - Present Simple, 'really' kuchaytiruvchi ravish sifatdan oldin keladi.

examples.en: This jacket is uncomfortable because it is too tight.
examples.uz: Bu kurtka noqulay, chunki u juda tor.
examples.grammar: 'is + sifat + because + gap' - Present Simple, 'because' sabab ergash gapini boshlaydi.

defEn: in a way that is not relaxed or pleasant.
defUz: bemalol yoki yoqimli bo'lmagan tarzda.

examples.en: She slept uncomfortably and woke with a pain in her back.
examples.uz: U noqulay tarzda uxladi va belida
examples.grammar: 'ega + slept + uncomfortably + and + woke + with' - Past Simple, 'uncomfortably' tarz ravishi, ikki fe'l 'and' bilan bog'langan.

examples.en: He sat uncomfortably in the tight jacket all evening.
examples.uz: U butun kech tor kurtkada noqulay tarzda o'tirdi.
examples.grammar: 'sat + uncomfortably + in + the + sifat + ot' - Past Simple, 'uncomfortably' tarz ravishi fe'lni izohlaydi.

defEn: a popular style of clothes at a certain time.
defUz: ma'lum bir vaqtda mashhur bo'lgan kiyim uslubi.

examples.en: Long skirts have come into fashion again.
examples.uz: Uzun yubkalar yana urfga qaytdi.
examples.grammar: 'sifat + ko'plik ot + have come into + ot + again' - Present Perfect, 'come into fashion' urfga kirishni bildiradi.

examples.en: Bright colours are in fashion this year.
examples.uz: Yorqin ranglar bu yil urfda.
examples.grammar: 'ko'plik ot + are in + ot + this year' - Present Simple, 'in fashion' urfda ekanligini bildiradi.

defEn: popular and in style at the present time.
defUz: hozirgi vaqtda mashhur va urfda bo'lgan.

examples.en: Maurice wears fashionable clothes but they never look good on him.
examples.uz: Mo'ris urfdagi kiyimlarni
examples.grammar: 'wears + sifat + ko'plik ot + but + they never look good on him' - Present Simple, 'but' qarama-qarshi bog'lovchi, 'never' inkor ravishi.

examples.en: She always wears fashionable clothes to work.
examples.uz: U ishga doimo urfdagi kiyimlar kiyib boradi.
examples.grammar: 'always wears + sifat + ko'plik ot + to work' - Present Simple, 'always' takrorlanishni bildiradi.

defEn: measuring a large distance from one end to the other.
defUz: bir uchidan ikkinchisigacha katta masofani o'lchaydigan.

examples.en: That dress looks a bit long to me.
examples.uz: Bu ko'ylak men uchun biroz uzun ko'rinadi.
examples.grammar: 'ega + looks a bit + sifat + to me' - Present Simple, 'look' link verb sifat bilan keladi, 'a bit' darajani yumshatadi.

examples.en: She bought a long coat for the cold winter.
examples.uz: U sovuq qish uchun uzun palto sotib oldi.
examples.grammar: 'bought + a + sifat + ot + for + ot' - Past Simple, sifat otdan oldin keladi.

defEn: how long something is from one end to the other.
defUz: biror narsaning bir uchidan ikkinchisigacha bo'lgan uzunligi.

examples.en: Those trousers aren't the right length
examples.uz: they're too short. – Bu shim kerakli uzunlikda emas–u
examples.grammar: 'Those + ko'plik ot + are not + the + sifat + ot' - Present Simple inkor, 'right length' kerakli uzunlikni bildiradi.

examples.en: The length of this skirt is just right for me.
examples.uz: Bu yubkaning uzunligi men uchun aynan to'g'ri.
examples.grammar: 'The + ot + of + ot + is just right' - Present Simple, 'of' egalik munosabatini bildiradi.

defEn: to come together with someone at the same place.
defUz: kimdir bilan bir joyda birga kelmoq.

examples.en: The three sisters rarely meet in person, but spend hours on the phone.
examples.uz: Uch opa-singil kamdan-
examples.grammar: 'ko'plik ot + rarely + meet + in person, but + spend' - Present Simple, 'but' qarama-qarshi bog'lovchi, 'rarely' chastota ravishi.

examples.en: I meet my friends at the shopping centre every Saturday.
examples.uz: Men har shanba do'stlarim bilan savdo markazida uchrashaman.
examples.grammar: 'meet + egalik + ko'plik ot + at + ot + every Saturday' - Present Simple, 'every Saturday' takrorlanishni bildiradi.

uz: modellik qilmoq, kiyimlarni yoki mo'da mahsulotlarini o'zida kiyib ko'rsatmoq 61                                                                   @destination_vocabulary
defEn: to show clothes by wearing them for people to see.
defUz: kiyimlarni kiyib, odamlarga ko'rsatib bermoq.

examples.en: Brad and Cindy are modelling chunky knitwear on the beach.
examples.uz: Bred va Sindi plyajda qalin
examples.grammar: 'ega + are + modelling + sifat + ot + on the + ot' - Present Continuous, 'model' bu yerda kiyim ko'rsatishni bildiradi.

examples.en: She is modelling new summer dresses at the show.
examples.uz: U shouda yangi yozgi ko'ylaklarni kiyib ko'rsatmoqda.
examples.grammar: 'is modelling + sifat + ko'plik ot + at the + ot' - Present Continuous, hozirgi davom etayotgan harakatni bildiradi.

uz: modelyerlik sohasi, kiyimlarni yoki mo'da mahsulotlarini o'zida kiyib ko'rsatish
defEn: the job of showing clothes by wearing them.
defUz: kiyimlarni kiyib ko'rsatish kasbi.

examples.en: She would like a career in modelling.
examples.uz: U modelyerlik sohasida karyera qilishni xohlaydi.
examples.grammar: 'would like + a + ot + in + ot' - Present Simple, 'would like' xohishni xushmuomala bildiradi, 'in' sohani ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: She studies modelling at a special school.
examples.uz: U maxsus maktabda modelyerlikni o'rganadi.
examples.grammar: 'studies + ot + at + a + sifat + ot' - Present Simple, 'at' joy predlogi vazifasida.

defEn: to have an idea or opinion about something.
defUz: biror narsa haqida fikr yoki g'oyaga ega bo'lmoq.

examples.en: I didn't think you liked sports.
examples.uz: Sizga sport yoqadi deb o'ylamagandim.
examples.grammar: 'did not + think + ega + liked + ot' - Past Simple inkor, 'did not' yordamchi fe'l, ergash gap fikrni bildiradi.

examples.en: I think this jacket looks great on you.
examples.uz: Menimcha, bu kurtka sizga juda yarashadi.
examples.grammar: 'think + ergash gap' - Present Simple, 'that' tushirib qoldirilgan ergash gap fikrni bildiradi.

defEn: an idea or opinion in your mind.
defUz: ongdagi g'oya yoki fikr.

examples.en: You have clearly put a lot of thought into your costume.
examples.uz: Ko'rinib turibdiki, libosingizga ancha
examples.grammar: 'have clearly put + a lot of + ot + into + egalik + ot' - Present Perfect, 'put thought into' o'ylab bajarishni bildiradi.

examples.en: She gave a lot of thought to her new dress.
examples.uz: U yangi ko'ylagi haqida ko'p o'yladi.
examples.grammar: 'gave a lot of + ot + to + egalik + ot' - Past Simple, 'give thought to' o'ylab ko'rishni bildiradi.

defEn: kind and thinking about other people's feelings.
defUz: mehribon va boshqa odamlarning his-tuyg'ulari haqida o'ylaydigan.

examples.en: She's a very thoughtful girl and always remembers my birthday.
examples.uz: U rosa mehribon qiz va doimo
examples.grammar: 'ega + is a very + sifat + ot + and + always remembers' - Present Simple, 'and' bog'lovchi, 'always' takrorlanishni bildiradi.

examples.en: He is a thoughtful friend who always helps me.
examples.uz: U doimo menga yordam beradigan mehribon do'st.
examples.grammar: 'is a + sifat + ot + who + helps' - Present Simple, 'who' ergash gap shaxsni izohlaydi.

defEn: not thinking about other people or the results of actions.
defUz: boshqa odamlar yoki ish oqibatlari haqida o'ylamaydigan.

examples.en: It was thoughtless of you to lose my jacket!
examples.uz: Mening pidjakimni yo'qotib qo'yishingiz
examples.grammar: 'It was + sifat + of you + to lose + egalik + ot' - Past Simple, 'It was ... of you to' xatti-harakatga baho beradi.

examples.en: It was thoughtless of him to forget her birthday.
examples.uz: Uning tug'ilgan kunini unutgani bemulohazalik bo'ldi.
examples.grammar: 'It was + sifat + of him + to forget + ot' - Past Simple, baho beruvchi tuzilma 'to + infinitiv' bilan keladi.

uz: o'yga botib, xayol surib, o'ychan holda
defEn: in a quiet way, as if thinking carefully.
defUz: diqqat bilan o'ylayotgandek, sokin tarzda.

examples.en: She stood in front of the mirror, looking thoughtfully at the dress.
examples.uz: U ko'zguning qarshisida
examples.grammar: 'stood + in front of + the + ot, + looking + thoughtfully at' - Past Simple, 'thoughtfully' tarz ravishi, 'looking' ravishdosh.

examples.en: She looked thoughtfully at the old photo.
examples.uz: U eski rasmga o'ychan tarzda qaradi.
examples.grammar: 'looked + thoughtfully + at + the + sifat + ot' - Past Simple, 'thoughtfully' tarz ravishi fe'lni izohlaydi.

defEn: in a way that does not think about the results.
defUz: oqibatini o'ylamaydigan tarzda.

examples.en: Thoughtlessly, I went out without a jacket and got very cold.
examples.uz: Men oqibatini o'ylamay kurtkasiz
examples.grammar: 'Thoughtlessly, + ega + went out + without + a + ot + and + got + sifat' - Past Simple, ravish gap boshida, 'without' predlog.

examples.en: He thoughtlessly left the door open all night.
examples.uz: U bemulohaza ravishda eshikni tun bo'yi ochiq qoldirdi.
examples.grammar: 'thoughtlessly + left + the + ot + open' - Past Simple, 'thoughtlessly' tarz ravishi fe'lni izohlaydi.

defEn: the soft hair of sheep, used to make warm clothes.
defUz: iliq kiyim tayyorlash uchun ishlatiladigan qo'yning yumshoq juni.

examples.en: How many balls of wool did you need to knit that sweater?
examples.uz: Bu sviterni to'qish uchun sizga
examples.grammar: 'How many + balls of + ot + did you + need + to knit' - Past Simple so'roq gap, 'how many' miqdorni, 'to knit' maqsadni bildiradi.

examples.en: She bought some wool to make a warm scarf.
examples.uz: U iliq sharf to'qish uchun ozgina jun sotib oldi.
examples.grammar: 'bought + some + ot + to make + a + sifat + ot' - Past Simple, 'some' sanalmaydigan ot bilan keladi.

defEn: made from wool, the soft hair of sheep.
defUz: qo'yning yumshoq junidan tayyorlangan.

examples.en: I don't like woolen clothes because they make me too hot.
examples.uz: Menga hayvon junidan to'qilgan
examples.grammar: 'do not + like + sifat + ko'plik ot + because + they make me too hot' - Present Simple inkor, 'because' sabab ergash gapini boshlaydi.

examples.en: She wears a warm woolen hat in winter.
examples.uz: U qishda iliq jundan to'qilgan shapka kiyadi.
examples.grammar: 'wears + a + sifat + sifat + ot + in winter' - Present Simple, sifatlar otdan oldin ketma-ket keladi.

defEn: a place where people go to look at paintings and other art
defUz: odamlar rasm va boshqa san'at asarlarini tomosha qilish uchun boradigan joy

examples.en: There were some beautiful paintings at the art gallery.
examples.uz: San'at galareyasida bir qancha chiroyli
examples.grammar: 'There were + some + ko'plik ot' - Past Simple, o'tmishda mavjud bo'lgan narsalarni bildiradi; 'at' - predlog joyni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: There is a new art gallery in the city centre.
examples.uz: Shahar markazida yangi san'at galareyasi bor.
examples.grammar: 'There is + a + ot' - Present Simple, birlikda biror narsa borligini bildiradi.

defEn: a place where people keep and take out money
defUz: odamlar pul saqlaydigan va pul oladigan joy

examples.en: I went into the bank to take out some money.
examples.uz: Men (bank hisob raqamimdan) ozgina pul yechib
examples.grammar: 'went into' - Past Simple (go fe'lining shakli); 'to take out' - infinitiv maqsadni bildiradi.

examples.en: The bank opens at nine o'clock in the morning.
examples.uz: Bank ertalab soat to'qqizda ochiladi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'opens' fe'liga -s qo'shimchasi birlik uchinchi shaxsda qo'shiladi; 'at' - predlog vaqtni ko'rsatadi.

defEn: a place with walls and a roof, such as a house or office
defUz: devor va tomi bo'lgan inshoot, masalan uy yoki ofis

examples.en: I live on the fourth floor of that building on the corner.
examples.uz: Men burchakdagi anavi binoning
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'live' fe'li doimiy holatni bildiradi; 'on the fourth floor of' - predloglar joyni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: That tall building near the river is a hotel.
examples.uz: Daryo yonidagi anavi baland bino mehmonxonadir.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'is' bog'lovchi fe'l; 'near' - predlog joyni ko'rsatadi.

defEn: a place where people leave their cars
defUz: odamlar mashinalarini qoldiradigan joy

examples.en: The car park was full, so she had to park on the street.
examples.uz: Mashinalar turargohi to'lib bo'lgan edi,
examples.grammar: 'was full' - Past Simple, holatni bildiradi; 'so' - bog'lovchi natijani ko'rsatadi; 'had to' - majburiyatni bildiruvchi modal ibora.

examples.en: We left the car in the car park near the museum.
examples.uz: Biz mashinani muzey yonidagi mashinalar turargohiga qoldirdik.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'left' (leave) o'tmish zamon shakli; 'in' va 'near' - joy predloglari.

defEn: a large strong old building, often the home of a king or queen
defUz: katta va mustahkam qadimiy bino, ko'pincha shoh yoki malikaning uyi

examples.en: At the top of the hill is a 500-year-old castle.
examples.uz: Tepalikning eng yuqorisida 500 yillik qal'a bor.
examples.grammar: 'At the top of the hill is a castle' - joy iborasi gap boshida kelib, egasi oxirda keladi; '500-year-old' - qo'shma sifat.

examples.en: We walked up the hill to visit the old castle.
examples.uz: Biz qadimiy qal'ani ko'rish uchun tepalikka chiqdik.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'walked' o'tmish zamon; 'to visit' - infinitiv maqsadni bildiradi.

uz: shahar markazi Shanba kunlari shahar markazida hech qanday mashinaga ruxsat berilmaydi, shunday ekan xaridorlar bemalol yurishlari mumkin.
defEn: the main part of a city or town with shops and offices
defUz: shahar yoki shaharchaning do'kon va ofislari bo'lgan asosiy qismi

examples.en: There are many shops in the town centre.
examples.uz: Shahar markazida ko'plab do'konlar bor.
examples.grammar: 'There are + many + ko'plik ot' - Present Simple, ko'p narsa borligini bildiradi.

examples.en: We took a bus to the city centre on Saturday.
examples.uz: Biz shanba kuni shahar markaziga avtobusda bordik.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'took' (take) o'tmish zamon shakli; 'to' - predlog yo'nalishni ko'rsatadi.

defEn: a small house in the countryside
defUz: qishloq joyidagi kichkina uy

examples.en: Our grandma lives in a tiny cottage in the Welsh countryside.
examples.uz: Bizning buvimiz Uels qishlog'idagi
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'lives' fe'liga birlik uchinchi shaxsda -s qo'shiladi; 'in' - predlog joyni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: They spent the weekend in a small cottage by the lake.
examples.uz: Ular dam olish kunini ko'l bo'yidagi kichik uychada o'tkazishdi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'spent' (spend) o'tmish zamon; 'by' - predlog yaqinlikni bildiradi.

uz: qishloq hududi, shahar tashqarisi: tabiat qo'yni
defEn: land outside towns and cities, with fields and farms
defUz: dala va fermalari bo'lgan, shahardan tashqaridagi hudud

examples.en: The countryside around here is full of rivers and forests.
examples.uz: Bu yerdagi qishloq hududi daryolar va
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'is full of' iborasi to'laligini bildiradi; 'around here' - joyni ko'rsatuvchi ibora.

examples.en: We love walking in the quiet countryside.
examples.uz: Biz tinch qishloq hududida sayr qilishni yaxshi ko'ramiz.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'love + -ing' shakli, yoqtirilgan harakatni bildiradi.

defEn: a set of rooms to live in, on one floor of a building
defUz: binoning bir qavatidagi yashash uchun mo'ljallangan xonalar

examples.en: They live in a flat on the fifth floor.
examples.uz: Ular beshinchi qavatdagi bir kvartirada yashashadi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'live' fe'li doimiy holatni bildiradi; 'in a flat on the fifth floor' - joy predloglari.

examples.en: She is looking for a small flat near her office.
examples.uz: U ofisi yaqinidagi kichik kvartira qidirmoqda.
examples.grammar: Present Continuous - 'is looking' hozir davom etayotgan harakatni bildiradi; 'near' - joy predlogi.

defEn: a small place like a hotel where people pay to stay
defUz: odamlar pul to'lab tunaydigan, mehmonxonaga o'xshash kichik joy

examples.en: We stayed in a little guesthouse run by a German couple.
examples.uz: Biz Germaniyalik juftlik tomonidan
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'stayed' o'tmish zamon; 'run by' - passiv ma'noli sifatdosh, kim boshqarishini bildiradi.

examples.en: We stayed in a cheap guesthouse near the beach.
examples.uz: Biz dengiz bo'yi yaqinidagi arzon mehmonxonada tunadik.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'stayed' o'tmish zamon; 'in' va 'near' - joy predloglari.

defEn: a place where people go to look at old and important things
defUz: odamlar qadimiy va muhim narsalarni tomosha qilish uchun boradigan joy

examples.en: The children went to the castle museum to see the exhibits.
examples.uz: Bolalar eksponatlarni (=
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'went' (go) o'tmish zamon shakli; 'to see' - infinitiv maqsadni bildiradi.

examples.en: The museum is closed on Mondays.
examples.uz: Muzey dushanba kunlari yopiq.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'is' bog'lovchi fe'l; 'on Mondays' - takrorlanuvchi vaqtni bildiradi.

uz: ofis binosi: bir nechta kompaniyalarga tegishli bo'lgan ofislarni o'z ichiga oluvchi bino 63                                                                   @destination_vocabulary
defEn: a large building with many offices
defUz: ko'plab ofislari bo'lgan katta bino

examples.en: John works on the sixteenth floor of that office block.
examples.uz: Jo'n anavi ofis binosining o'n oltinchi
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'works' fe'liga birlik uchinchi shaxsda -s qo'shiladi; 'on the sixteenth floor of' - joy predloglari.

examples.en: They built a new office block in the city centre.
examples.uz: Ular shahar markazida yangi ofis binosi qurishdi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'built' (build) o'tmish zamon shakli.

defEn: a large open place in a town where people walk and relax
defUz: shahardagi odamlar sayr qiladigan va dam oladigan katta ochiq joy

examples.en: She takes her dog to the park to run every day.
examples.uz: U itini har kuni yugurishga parkka olib boradi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'takes' fe'liga -s qo'shiladi; 'every day' - takror harakatni bildiruvchi ravish ibora; 'to run' - infinitiv maqsad.

examples.en: The children are playing football in the park.
examples.uz: Bolalar parkda futbol o'ynashmoqda.
examples.grammar: Present Continuous - 'are playing' hozir davom etayotgan harakatni bildiradi; 'in' - joy predlogi.

examples.en: You can't park the car here.
examples.uz: Mashinani bu yerga qo'ya olmaysiz.
examples.grammar: 'You can't park the car here' - modal fe'l 'can' inkori ruxsat yo'qligini bildiradi; 'here' - joy ravishi.

examples.en: He parked the car in front of the hotel.
examples.uz: U mashinani mehmonxona oldiga qo'ydi.
examples.grammar: 'parked' - Past Simple; 'the car' - to'ldiruvchi; 'in front of the hotel' - joy predlogi iborasi.

defEn: the number of people who live in a place
defUz: biror joyda yashaydigan odamlar soni

examples.en: The population of the town is 255,000.
examples.uz: Shahar aholisi 255,000 nafar.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'is' bog'lovchi fe'l; 'of the town' - egalik bildiruvchi 'of' predlogi.

examples.en: The population of the city is growing fast.
examples.uz: Shahar aholisi tez o'smoqda.
examples.grammar: Present Continuous - 'is growing' davom etayotgan jarayonni bildiradi; 'fast' - ravish.

defEn: a place where people send letters and parcels
defUz: odamlar xat va posilkalar jo'natadigan joy

examples.en: Can you go to the post office and send a parcel for me?
examples.uz: Pochtaga borib, mening o'rnimga
examples.grammar: So'roq gap - 'Can you...?' modal fe'l bilan iltimosni bildiradi; 'and send' - bog'lovchi orqali ikkinchi harakat qo'shiladi.

examples.en: I bought some stamps at the post office.
examples.uz: Men pochtadan bir nechta marka sotib oldim.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'bought' (buy) o'tmish zamon; 'some' - noaniq miqdorni bildiradi.

uz: savdo majmuasi: turli-tuman mahsulotlar sotishga mo'ljallangan ko'plab do'konlardan tashkil topgan bo'ladi
defEn: a large building with many shops inside it
defUz: ichida ko'plab do'konlar bo'lgan katta bino

examples.en: We go to the shopping centre once a month and do all our shopping.
examples.uz: Biz bir oyda bir marta
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'go' va 'do' fe'llari odat harakatni bildiradi; 'once a month' - takrorlanish chastotasini bildiradi.

examples.en: The new shopping centre has a cinema and many shops.
examples.uz: Yangi savdo majmuasida kinoteatr va ko'plab do'konlar bor.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'has' (have) birlik uchinchi shaxs shakli, egalikni bildiradi.

defEn: an open place with buildings around it in a town
defUz: shaharda atrofi binolar bilan o'ralgan ochiq joy

examples.en: There was only one hotel in the village and it was in the square.
examples.uz: Qishloqda faqatgina bitta
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'was' bog'lovchi fe'l o'tmishda; 'There was only one + ot' - birlikda mavjudlikni bildiradi.

examples.en: People meet their friends in the town square.
examples.uz: Odamlar do'stlari bilan shahar maydonida uchrashishadi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'meet' fe'li odat harakatni bildiradi; 'in' - joy predlogi.

defEn: a lot of different kinds of something
defUz: biror narsaning juda ko'p turli xil ko'rinishlari

examples.en: The shop offers a great variety of different clothes.
examples.uz: Do'kon juda ko'p xilma-xil kiyimlarni taqdim
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'offers' fe'liga -s qo'shiladi; 'a great variety of' - ko'p turini bildiruvchi ibora.

examples.en: The market sells a wide variety of fresh fruit.
examples.uz: Bozorda turli xil yangi mevalar sotiladi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'sells' fe'liga -s qo'shiladi; 'a wide variety of' - xilma-xillikni bildiradi.

defEn: a very small town in the countryside
defUz: qishloq joyidagi juda kichik aholi punkti

examples.en: Only 100 people still live in the village.
examples.uz: Bor yo'g'i 100 nafar odam hali-hanuz qishloqda
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'live' fe'li doimiy holatni bildiradi; 'still' - hali ham davom etishni bildiruvchi ravish.

examples.en: My grandparents live in a small village in the mountains.
examples.uz: Bobom va buvim tog'lardagi kichik qishloqda yashashadi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'live' doimiy holatni bildiradi; 'in' - joy predlogi.

defEn: to put something over a thing so you cannot see it
defUz: biror narsani ko'rinmaydigan qilib ustini yopmoq

examples.en: Snow covers the top of the mountain in winter.
examples.uz: Qishda tog'ning cho'qqisini qor qoplaydi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'covers' fe'liga birlik uchinchi shaxsda -s qo'shiladi; 'in winter' - vaqtni bildiruvchi ibora.

examples.en: She covered the table with a clean cloth.
examples.uz: U stolni toza mato bilan yopdi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'covered' o'tmish zamon; 'with' - predlog vositani bildiradi.

defEn: to go from one side of a road, bridge or river to the other
defUz: yo'l, ko'prik yoki daryoning bir tarafidan boshqa tarafiga o'tmoq

examples.en: Look left and right before you cross the road.
examples.uz: Mashina yo'lidan o'tishdan avval, chapga va
examples.grammar: Buyruq gap - 'Look' buyruq shaklida; 'before you cross' - ergash gap, harakatdan oldingi vaqtni bildiradi.

examples.en: Be careful when you cross the busy road.
examples.uz: Gavjum yo'ldan o'tayotganingizda ehtiyot bo'ling.
examples.grammar: Buyruq gap - 'Be careful'; 'when you cross' - ergash gap vaqtni bildiradi.

uz: topib olmoq, duch kelmoq, kashf etmoq
defEn: to find something for the first time
defUz: biror narsani birinchi marta topmoq

examples.en: We got lost in Paris yesterday and discovered a lovely café.
examples.uz: Biz kecha Parijda adashib qoldik va
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'got lost' va 'discovered' o'tmish zamon; 'and' - bog'lovchi ikki harakatni bog'laydi.

examples.en: We discovered a small park behind the museum.
examples.uz: Biz muzey orqasidan kichik bir park topib oldik.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'discovered' o'tmish zamon; 'behind' - joy predlogi.

defEn: to separate something into two or more parts
defUz: biror narsani ikki yoki undan ortiq qismga ajratmoq

examples.en: A wide river divides the two halves of the town.
examples.uz: Bir keng daryo shaharning ikki yarmini ajratib
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'divides' fe'liga -s qo'shiladi; 'the two halves of' - egalik 'of' predlogi.

examples.en: The teacher divided the class into four groups.
examples.uz: O'qituvchi sinfni to'rt guruhga ajratdi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'divided' o'tmish zamon; 'into' - predlog bo'linish natijasini bildiradi.

defEn: to think that something is probably not true or will not happen
defUz: biror narsa rost emas yoki sodir bo'lmaydi deb o'ylamoq

examples.en: I doubt I can come to Spain with you, I'm afraid.
examples.uz: Qo'rqamanki, siz bilan birga Ispaniyaga bora
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'I doubt' fikr bildiradi; ergash gap bog'lovchisiz qo'shilgan; 'I'm afraid' - yumshatuvchi ibora.

examples.en: I doubt that the shop is open so late.
examples.uz: Do'kon shu qadar kech ochiq ekaniga shubha qilaman.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'doubt'; 'that' - ergash gap bog'lovchisi.

defEn: to forgive someone for a small mistake
defUz: kimnidir kichik xatosi uchun kechirmoq

examples.en: Excuse me, sir, do you know where the town hall is?
examples.uz: Ma'zur tuting, janob, shahar hokimiyati
examples.grammar: Buyruq gap - 'Excuse me' xushmuomalalik iborasi; 'do you know...' - so'roq gap, ko'makchi 'do' bilan.

examples.en: Please excuse me for being late this morning.
examples.uz: Iltimos, bugun ertalab kechikkanim uchun meni kechiring.
examples.grammar: Buyruq gap - 'excuse me'; 'for being' - 'for + -ing' sababni bildiradi.

defEn: to notice a sound with your ears
defUz: ovozni quloq bilan sezmoq

examples.en: Can you hear the sound of water? We're near the river!
examples.uz: Suvning ovozini eshityapsizmi? Biz
examples.grammar: So'roq gap - 'Can you hear...?' modal fe'l bilan; 'We're near' - qisqartma shakl (we are).

examples.en: I can hear the birds singing in the park.
examples.uz: Men parkda qushlarning sayrashini eshityapman.
examples.grammar: Modal fe'l 'can' + 'hear'; 'singing' - sifatdosh harakatni bildiradi.

defEn: to do something or go somewhere quickly
defUz: biror ishni tez qilmoq yoki tez bormoq

examples.en: We have to hurry because the show's about to start.
examples.uz: Shoshilishimiz lozim chunki tomosha
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'have to hurry' majburiyatni bildiradi; 'because' - bog'lovchi sababni ko'rsatadi; 'is about to' - yaqin harakatni bildiradi.

examples.en: We had to hurry to catch the last bus home.
examples.uz: Uyga oxirgi avtobusga ulgurish uchun shoshilishimizga to'g'ri keldi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'had to' o'tmishdagi majburiyat; 'to catch' - infinitiv maqsad.

defEn: to see or feel something
defUz: biror narsani ko'rmoq yoki sezmoq

examples.en: Did you notice how tall that woman was?
examples.uz: U ayolning bo'yi qanchalik balandligini
examples.grammar: So'roq gap - 'Did you notice...?' Past Simple ko'makchi 'did' bilan; 'how tall' - bilvosita so'roq iborasi.

examples.en: I noticed a new shop on the corner today.
examples.uz: Men bugun burchakda yangi do'konni payqadim.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'noticed' o'tmish zamon; 'on the corner' - joy predlogi.

defEn: to say that you will give or do something for someone
defUz: kimgadir biror narsani berish yoki qilishni taklif qilmoq

examples.en: My aunt offered to show me around the city while I was there.
examples.uz: Xolam men shaharda bo'lgan
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'offered' o'tmish zamon; 'to show' - infinitiv; 'while I was there' - ergash gap vaqtni bildiradi.

examples.en: She offered to help me find the hotel.
examples.uz: U menga mehmonxonani topishda yordam berishni taklif qildi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'offered'; 'to help' - infinitiv harakatni bildiradi.

defEn: to go past a place when you are going somewhere
defUz: biror joyga ketayotganda boshqa joyning yonidan o'tib ketmoq

examples.en: To get to the museum, pass the bank and take the first right.
examples.uz: Muzeyga borish uchun, bankdan
examples.grammar: Buyruq gap - 'pass' va 'take' buyruq shaklida; 'To get to' - infinitiv maqsadni bildiradi.

examples.en: You pass the supermarket on the way to school.
examples.uz: Maktabga ketishda supermarketning yonidan o'tasiz.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'pass'; 'on the way to' - yo'nalishni bildiruvchi ibora.

defEn: to know someone or something because you have seen it before
defUz: kimnidir yoki biror narsani avval ko'rganingiz uchun tanimoq

examples.en: I recognise this building from the magazine article about the town.
examples.uz: Men bu binoni shahar
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'recognise' fe'li hozirgi holatni bildiradi; 'from the article' - manbani bildiruvchi 'from' predlogi.

examples.en: I recognised my old teacher in the town square.
examples.uz: Men eski o'qituvchimni shahar maydonida tanidim.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'recognised' o'tmish zamon; 'in' - joy predlogi.

defEn: to tell someone that something is good and they should try it
defUz: kimgadir biror narsa yaxshi ekanini va sinab ko'rish kerakligini aytmoq

examples.en: If you visit the town, I recommend that you visit the museum.
examples.uz: Agar shaharga tashrif
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'recommend'; 'If you visit...' - shart mayli, shart ergash gapi; 'that you visit' - ergash gap.

examples.en: I recommend this small cafe near the park.
examples.uz: Men park yonidagi bu kichik kafeni tavsiya qilaman.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'recommend'; 'near' - joy predlogi.

uz: rad etmoq, qarshi bo'lmoq, bosh tortmoq
defEn: to say firmly that you will not do something
defUz: biror ishni qilmasligingizni qat'iy aytmoq

examples.en: I refuse to walk another step
examples.uz: I'm exhausted. – Men yana bir qadam tashlashdan bosh
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'refuse' fe'li; 'to walk' - infinitiv, nimani rad etishni bildiradi.

examples.en: He refused to leave the old house.
examples.uz: U eski uydan ketishdan bosh tortdi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'refused' o'tmish zamon; 'to leave' - infinitiv harakatni bildiradi.

defEn: to pay money to use a house or thing for some time
defUz: uy yoki biror narsadan bir muddat foydalanish uchun pul to'lamoq

examples.en: They rent a house in town for £500 a month.
examples.uz: Shaharda bitta uyni bir oy uchun 500 funt
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'rent' fe'li odat harakatni bildiradi; 'for 500 a month' - narx va davrni bildiruvchi ibora.

examples.en: We rented a small flat in the city centre.
examples.uz: Biz shahar markazidan kichik kvartira ijaraga oldik.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'rented' o'tmish zamon; 'in' - joy predlogi.

defEn: to learn some information for the first time
defUz: biror ma'lumotni birinchi marta bilib olmoq

examples.en: Where did you find out about this wonderful restaurant?
examples.uz: Ushbu ajoyib restoran to'g'risida
examples.grammar: So'roq gap - 'Where did you find out...?' Past Simple ko'makchi 'did' bilan; 'find out' - frazaviy fe'l.

examples.en: I found out that the museum is free on Sundays.
examples.uz: Men muzey yakshanba kunlari bepul ekanini bilib oldim.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'found out' (find out) frazaviy fe'lning o'tmish shakli; 'that' - ergash gap bog'lovchisi.

defEn: weather that is bad (rain, storm) or good (sun, warm)
defUz: yomon (yomg'ir, bo'ron) yoki yaxshi (quyosh, iliq) bo'lgan ob-havo

examples.en: We can't play tennis today because of the bad weather.
examples.uz: Yomon havo tufayli bugun tennis
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'can't play' modal fe'l 'can' inkori; 'because of' - sababni bildiruvchi predlogli ibora.

examples.en: We stayed at home because of the bad weather.
examples.uz: Yomon havo tufayli biz uyda qoldik.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'stayed'; 'because of' - sababni bildiruvchi ibora.

defEn: a tall building with many flats inside it
defUz: ichida ko'plab kvartiralar bo'lgan baland bino

examples.en: We live on the fifth floor of a block of flats.
examples.uz: Biz ko'p qavatli yashash majmuasining beshinchi
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'live'; 'on the fifth floor of a block of flats' - joy predloglari va egalik 'of'.

examples.en: A new block of flats is being built near the river.
examples.uz: Daryo yonida yangi ko'p qavatli yashash majmuasi qurilmoqda.
examples.grammar: Present Continuous passiv - 'is being built' davom etayotgan passiv harakat; 'near' - joy predlogi.

defEn: to continue forward without turning
defUz: burilmasdan oldinga davom etmoq

examples.en: To find the museum, go straight on through the square.
examples.uz: Muzeyni topish uchun, maydon bo'ylab
examples.grammar: Buyruq gap - 'go straight on' yo'nalish ko'rsatmasi; 'To find the museum' - infinitiv maqsadni bildiradi.

examples.en: Go straight ahead until you reach the bank.
examples.uz: Bankka yetib borguningizcha to'g'riga yuring.
examples.grammar: Buyruq gap - 'go straight ahead'; 'until' - ergash gap, vaqt chegarasini bildiradi.

defEn: to move past a place without stopping
defUz: to'xtamasdan biror joyning yonidan o'tib ketmoq

examples.en: Go past the post office and take the first left.
examples.uz: Pochtadan o'ting va birinchi ko'chadan chapga
examples.grammar: Buyruq gap - 'Go past' va 'take' buyruq shaklida; 'and' - bog'lovchi ikki ko'rsatmani bog'laydi.

examples.en: Walk past the school and you will see the park.
examples.uz: Maktabning yonidan o'ting va parkni ko'rasiz.
examples.grammar: Buyruq gap - 'walk past'; 'and you will see' - Future ('will') natijani bildiradi.

defEn: needing to do something quickly because there is little time
defUz: vaqt kamligi sababli biror ishni tez qilish kerak bo'lgan holatda

examples.en: He was in a hurry and didn't see the car coming.
examples.uz: U shoshilayotgan edi va mashinani
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'was' va 'didn't see' o'tmish zamon; 'in a hurry' - holatni bildiruvchi ibora; 'and' - bog'lovchi.

examples.en: She was in a hurry and forgot her keys.
examples.uz: U shoshib turgandi va kalitlarini unutib qoldirdi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'was' va 'forgot'; 'in a hurry' - holat iborasi.

defEn: on the right or left part of something
defUz: biror narsaning o'ng yoki chap qismida

examples.en: The bank is on the right-hand side of the street.
examples.uz: Bank ko'chaning o'ng tarafida.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'is' bog'lovchi fe'l; 'on the right-hand side of' - joyni bildiruvchi predloglar.

examples.en: The post office is on the left-hand side of the square.
examples.uz: Pochta maydonning chap tarafida joylashgan.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'is'; 'on the left-hand side of' - joy predloglari.

uz: bir tomonlama ko'cha: mashinalar qarama-qarshi yo'nalishda hayday olmaydi
defEn: a street where cars can go in only one direction
defUz: mashinalar faqat bir tomonga yura oladigan ko'cha

examples.en: You can't drive down there
examples.uz: it's a one-way street! – U yerga hayday olmaysiz–u bir tomonlama
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'can't drive' modal fe'l inkori; 'one-way street' - qo'shma ot.

examples.en: Be careful, this is a one-way street.
examples.uz: Ehtiyot bo'ling, bu bir tomonlama ko'cha.
examples.grammar: Buyruq gap - 'Be careful'; 'this is' - Present Simple bog'lovchi fe'l.

defEn: to change direction to the right or left
defUz: o'ng yoki chap tomonga yo'nalishni o'zgartirmoq

examples.en: Turn left at the lights and the bank is on your left.
examples.uz: Svetofordan chapga buriling va bank sizning
examples.grammar: Buyruq gap - 'Turn left' yo'nalish ko'rsatmasi; 'at the lights' - joyni bildiruvchi predlogli ibora; 'and' - bog'lovchi.

examples.en: Turn right after the bridge to reach the village.
examples.uz: Qishloqqa yetib borish uchun ko'prikdan keyin o'ngga buriling.
examples.grammar: Buyruq gap - 'turn right'; 'to reach' - infinitiv maqsadni bildiradi.

defEn: with a lot of fog so you cannot see well
defUz: ko'p tuman tushgan, yaxshi ko'rib bo'lmaydigan

examples.en: It was foggy and we couldn't see ten feet in front of the car.
examples.uz: Havo tumanli edi va biz
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'was' va 'couldn't see' o'tmish zamon; 'so... that' - natijani bildiruvchi ergash gap.

examples.en: The morning was cold and foggy.
examples.uz: Tong sovuq va tumanli edi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'was'; 'cold' va 'foggy' - sifatlar holatni bildiradi.

defEn: very big
defUz: juda katta

examples.en: A huge rock came down the mountain and nearly crushed the car!
examples.uz: Ulkan qoyatosh tog'dan
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'came down' va 'crushed' o'tmish zamon; 'nearly' - ravish harakatga yaqinlikni bildiradi.

examples.en: There is a huge shopping centre near our town.
examples.uz: Shahrimiz yaqinida ulkan savdo majmuasi bor.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'There is'; 'huge' - sifat 'shopping centre'ni aniqlaydi.

defEn: covered with ice; very cold
defUz: muz bilan qoplangan; juda sovuq

examples.en: I slipped over on the icy street.
examples.uz: Men muzlagan ko'chada sirg'alib tushdim.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'slipped over' o'tmish zamon, 'over' yo'nalishni kuchaytiradi; 'on' - joy predlogi.

examples.en: The roads were icy after the cold night.
examples.uz: Sovuq tundan keyin yo'llar muzlagan edi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'were'; 'after' - vaqt predlogi; 'icy' - sifat holatni bildiradi.

defEn: with little or no noise
defUz: kam yoki umuman shovqinsiz

examples.en: It's a quiet town with not much going on.
examples.uz: U unchalik ko'p narsa sodir bo'lmaydigan tinch bir
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'It's' bog'lovchi fe'l (it is); 'with not much going on' - oz hodisa bo'lishini bildiruvchi ibora.

examples.en: We found a quiet street away from the traffic.
examples.uz: Biz harakatdan uzoqdagi tinch ko'chani topdik.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'found'; 'away from' - uzoqlikni bildiruvchi ibora; 'quiet' - sifat.

defEn: not wide; small from one side to the other
defUz: keng emas; bir tomondan ikkinchi tomonga kichik

examples.en: The road is too narrow for more than one car here.
examples.uz: Bu yerdagi mashina yo'li bittadan ko'p
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'is' bog'lovchi fe'l; 'too narrow for' - haddan ortiqlikni bildiruvchi ibora.

examples.en: The old town has many narrow streets.
examples.uz: Eski shaharda ko'plab tor ko'chalar bor.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'has' egalikni bildiradi; 'narrow' - sifat 'streets'ni aniqlaydi.

defEn: very small
defUz: juda kichkina

examples.en: Just 50 people lived in the tiny mountain village.
examples.uz: Tog'da joylashgan kichik qishloqchada bor
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'lived' o'tmish zamon; 'Just' - ravish miqdorni kamaytiradi; 'tiny' - sifat otdan oldin keladi.

examples.en: They live in a tiny house at the end of the road.
examples.uz: Ular yo'l oxiridagi juda kichkina uyda yashashadi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'live'; 'tiny' - sifat 'house'ni aniqlaydi; 'at the end of' - joy predloglari.

defEn: big from one side to the other; not narrow
defUz: bir tomondan ikkinchi tomonga katta; tor emas

examples.en: It takes five minutes to cross the wide river.
examples.uz: Bu keng daryodan o'tishga besh daqiqa ketadi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'It takes' vaqt sarfini bildiradi; 'to cross' - infinitiv; 'wide' - sifat otdan oldin keladi.

examples.en: They built a wide road through the town.
examples.uz: Ular shahar bo'ylab keng yo'l qurishdi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'built'; 'wide' - sifat 'road'ni aniqlaydi; 'through' - predlog.

defEn: with a lot of wind
defUz: ko'p shamol bo'lgan

examples.en: It was so windy that I could hardly stand up.
examples.uz: Havo shu qadar shamolli ediki men bazo'r tik tura
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'was' va 'could hardly stand' o'tmish zamon; 'so... that' - natijani bildiruvchi ergash gap.

examples.en: It was windy and cold by the sea.
examples.uz: Dengiz bo'yida havo shamolli va sovuq edi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'was'; 'by' - joy predlogi; 'windy' va 'cold' - sifatlar.

defEn: in or to any place
defUz: biror joyga yoki biror joyda

examples.en: Are you going anywhere this weekend or staying at home?
examples.uz: Bu hafta oxirida biror yerga
examples.grammar: Present Continuous - 'are you going' so'roq gap, yaqin rejani bildiradi; 'or staying' - bog'lovchi muqobilni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: I can't find my keys anywhere.
examples.uz: Kalitlarimni hech qayerdan topa olmayapman.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'can't find' modal inkori; inkor gapda 'anywhere' hech qayerni bildiradi.

defEn: in or to no place
defUz: hech qayerda yoki hech qayerga

examples.en: There's nowhere better than London to visit, I think.
examples.uz: O'ylashimcha, tashrif buyurish uchun
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'There's' (there is) mavjudlikni bildiradi; 'nowhere better than' - qiyosiy daraja bilan inkor ma'no.

examples.en: We had nowhere to stay in the small village.
examples.uz: Kichik qishloqda bizning tunaydigan hech qayerimiz yo'q edi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'had'; 'nowhere to stay' - 'nowhere + infinitiv' joy yo'qligini bildiradi.

defEn: a person whose job is to build houses and other buildings
defUz: uy va boshqa binolar quradigan kishi

examples.en: He works as a builder, mostly building office blocks.
examples.uz: U quruvchi bo'lib ishlaydi, asosan ofis
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'works' fe'liga -s qo'shiladi; 'as a builder' - kasbni bildiruvchi 'as' predlogi; 'building' - sifatdosh harakat.

examples.en: The builders are working on the new office block.
examples.uz: Quruvchilar yangi ofis binosida ishlashmoqda.
examples.grammar: Present Continuous - 'are working' davom etayotgan harakat; 'on' - joy predlogi.

uz: kesib o'tmoq, (yo'lning, daryoning) narigi tarafiga o'tmoq
defEn: to go from one side of something to the other
defUz: biror narsaning bir tomonidan ikkinchi tomoniga o'tmoq

examples.en: Give me your hand while we cross the road.
examples.uz: Mashina yo'lidan kesib o'tayotganimizda
examples.grammar: Buyruq gap - 'Give me your hand' iltimos; 'while we cross' - ergash gap, bir vaqtda bo'layotgan harakatni bildiradi.

examples.en: We crossed the bridge to get to the old town.
examples.uz: Biz eski shaharga borish uchun ko'prikdan o'tdik.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'crossed' o'tmish zamon; 'to get to' - infinitiv maqsadni bildiradi.

uz: kesib o'tish, (yo'lning, daryoning) narigi tarafiga o'tish
defEn: a place where you can safely cross a road, or the act of crossing
defUz: yo'ldan xavfsiz o'tish mumkin bo'lgan joy yoki o'tish jarayoni

examples.en: The crossing of the river takes about twenty minutes on the boat.
examples.uz: Daryoni qayiqda kesib o'tish
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'takes' fe'liga -s qo'shiladi; 'of the river' - egalik 'of' predlogi; 'on the boat' - joy predlogi.

examples.en: Wait at the crossing until the light turns green.
examples.uz: Chiroq yashilga aylanguncha o'tish joyida kuting.
examples.grammar: Buyruq gap - 'Wait'; 'until' - ergash gap vaqt chegarasini bildiradi.

defEn: not sure that something is true or possible
defUz: biror narsa rost yoki mumkin ekaniga ishonchi yo'q

examples.en: I am doubtful that I could live in such a tiny village.
examples.uz: Men bu qadar kichik qishloqchada yashay
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'am doubtful' holatni bildiradi; 'that I could live' - ergash gap shubhani izohlaydi.

examples.en: She was doubtful about the long journey.
examples.uz: U uzoq sayohat borasida ikkilanardi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'was'; 'about' - mavzuni bildiruvchi predlog; 'doubtful' - sifat.

defEn: in a way that shows you are not sure
defUz: ishonchsiz ekaningizni ko'rsatadigan tarzda

examples.en: I looked doubtfully at my friend
examples.uz: I didn't think we could make it up the mountain. – Men
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'looked' o'tmish zamon; 'doubtfully' - ravish, harakat tarzini bildiradi; 'at' - predlog yo'nalishni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: He looked at the map doubtfully and shook his head.
examples.uz: U xaritaga shubhalanib qaradi va boshini chayqadi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'looked' va 'shook'; 'doubtfully' - ravish harakat tarzini bildiradi.

defEn: to shine suddenly and brightly for a short time
defUz: qisqa vaqtga to'satdan va yorqin yonmoq

examples.en: Start crossing when the green WALK sign starts to flash.
examples.uz: Yashil rangli YURING belgisi yonishni
examples.grammar: Buyruq gap - 'Start crossing' buyruq; 'when... starts to flash' - ergash gap vaqtni bildiradi.

examples.en: The lights flashed red and the cars stopped.
examples.uz: Chiroqlar qizil rangda yondi va mashinalar to'xtadi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'flashed' va 'stopped'; 'and' - bog'lovchi ikki harakatni bog'laydi.

defEn: shining on and off quickly
defUz: tez-tez yonib-o'chib turadigan

examples.en: We saw some flashing lights ahead and stopped the car
examples.uz: it was the police. – Biz oldimizda
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'saw' va 'stopped' o'tmish zamon; 'flashing' - sifatdosh, chiroqlarni aniqlaydi.

examples.en: We saw the flashing lights of an ambulance.
examples.uz: Biz tez yordam mashinasining yonib-o'chayotgan chiroqlarini ko'rdik.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'saw'; 'flashing' - sifatdosh 'lights'ni aniqlaydi.

defEn: thick cloud near the ground that is hard to see through
defUz: yer yuzasiga yaqin, ko'rishni qiyinlashtiruvchi quyuq bulut

examples.en: We drove slowly through the fog.
examples.uz: Biz tuman oralab sekinlik bilan haydadik.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'drove' (drive) o'tmish zamon; 'slowly' - ravish harakat tarzini bildiradi; 'through' - predlog.

examples.en: There was thick fog over the town in the morning.
examples.uz: Ertalab shahar ustida quyuq tuman bor edi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'was'; 'over' - joy predlogi; 'thick' - sifat tumanni aniqlaydi.

defEn: water that has become hard because it is very cold
defUz: juda sovuq bo'lgani uchun qattiqlashgan suv

examples.en: There was ice on the windows.
examples.uz: Derazalarda muz bor edi. (= Derazalar muzlagan edi).
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'was' mavjudlikni o'tmishda bildiradi; 'on the windows' - joy predlogi.

examples.en: Be careful, there is ice on the road today.
examples.uz: Ehtiyot bo'ling, bugun yo'lda muz bor.
examples.grammar: Buyruq gap - 'Be careful'; 'there is' - Present Simple mavjudlikni bildiradi.

defEn: when water falls from the sky in drops
defUz: osmondan tomchilar bo'lib suv tushishi

examples.en: It rained and rained and didn't stop for days.
examples.uz: Yomg'ir yog'averdi, yog'averdi va kunlab
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'rained' va 'didn't stop' o'tmish zamon; 'and' takrori harakat davomiyligini ta'kidlaydi.

examples.en: It is raining hard, so take an umbrella.
examples.uz: Qattiq yomg'ir yog'yapti, shuning uchun soyabon oling.
examples.grammar: Present Continuous - 'is raining' davom etayotgan harakat; 'so' - bog'lovchi natijani bildiradi.

defEn: with a lot of rain
defUz: ko'p yomg'ir yog'adigan

examples.en: I'm tired of the rainy weather
examples.uz: I want to see some sun. – Yomg'irli havodan charchadim–biroz
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'am tired of' holatni bildiradi; 'of the rainy weather' - sababni bildiruvchi 'of' predlogi.

examples.en: It was a cold and rainy day in the village.
examples.uz: Qishloqda kun sovuq va yomg'irli edi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'was'; 'rainy' va 'cold' - sifatlar 'day'ni aniqlaydi.

defEn: in a way that makes little or no noise
defUz: kam yoki umuman shovqin chiqarmasdan

examples.en: He came into the room so quietly that I didn't notice him.
examples.uz: U xonaga shu qadar shovqin
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'came' va 'didn't notice' o'tmish zamon; 'so quietly that' - natijani bildiruvchi ergash gap; 'quietly' - ravish.

examples.en: She closed the door quietly so the baby could sleep.
examples.uz: Chaqaloq uxlay olishi uchun u eshikni shovqin chiqarmay yopdi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'closed'; 'quietly' - ravish harakat tarzini bildiradi; 'so' - maqsadni bildiradi.

defEn: to make something wider, or to become wider
defUz: biror narsani kengaytirmoq yoki kengaymoq

examples.en: They are going to widen the river to let bigger boats down.
examples.uz: Kattaroq qayiqlarni o'tkazish uchun
examples.grammar: Future - 'are going to widen' rejalashtirilgan kelajak harakatni bildiradi; 'to let... down' - infinitiv maqsad.

examples.en: The city plans to widen the main road next year.
examples.uz: Shahar kelasi yili asosiy yo'lni kengaytirishni rejalashtirmoqda.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'plans'; 'to widen' - infinitiv; 'next year' - kelajak vaqtni bildiradi.

defEn: how wide something is from one side to the other
defUz: biror narsaning bir tomondan ikkinchi tomonga qadar kengligi

examples.en: The width of the road is 10 metres.
examples.uz: Yo'lning kengligi 10 metr.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'is' bog'lovchi fe'l; 'of the road' - egalik 'of' predlogi.

examples.en: The width of the bridge is enough for two cars.
examples.uz: Ko'prikning kengligi ikki mashina uchun yetarli.
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'is'; 'of the bridge' - egalik 'of' predlogi; 'enough for' - yetarlilikni bildiradi.

defEn: by many people or in many places
defUz: ko'p odamlar tomonidan yoki ko'p joylarda

examples.en: They speak Spanish widely in South America.
examples.uz: Janubiy Amerikada ispan tilida keng miqyosda
examples.grammar: Present Simple - 'speak' fe'li umumiy holatni bildiradi; 'widely' - ravish keng tarqalganlikni bildiradi.

examples.en: English is widely spoken in many cities.
examples.uz: Ingliz tili ko'plab shaharlarda keng qo'llaniladi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple passiv - 'is spoken' passiv qurilma; 'widely' - ravish.

defEn: air that moves quickly outside
defUz: tashqarida tez harakatlanadigan havo

examples.en: The wind is blowing from the south.
examples.uz: Shamol janubdan esmoqda.
examples.grammar: Present Continuous - 'is blowing' hozir davom etayotgan harakatni bildiradi; 'from the south' - yo'nalishni bildiruvchi 'from' predlogi.

examples.en: The strong wind blew the leaves down the street.
examples.uz: Kuchli shamol barglarni ko'cha bo'ylab uchirib ketdi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple - 'blew' (blow) o'tmish zamon; 'down the street' - yo'nalishni bildiradi.

defEn: a place where planes take off and land.
defUz: samalyotlar uchadigan va qo'nadigan joy.

examples.en: The plane landed in Athens airport right on time.
examples.uz: Samalyot Asens aeroportiga o'z vaqtida
examples.grammar: 'landed in + joy nomi' - Past Simple, 'land' fe'lining o'tgan zamon shakli; 'right on time' - o'z vaqtida iborasi.

examples.en: We waited at the airport for two hours before our flight.
examples.uz: Biz parvozimizdan oldin aeroportda ikki soat kutib turdik.
examples.grammar: 'waited' - Past Simple; 'at the airport' - joyni bildiruvchi predlog 'at' bilan; 'before' - vaqt bog'lovchisi.

defEn: a time when something happens later than planned.
defUz: biror narsaning rejalashtirilganidan kechroq sodir bo'lishi.

examples.en: Our plane left after a short delay because of a late passenger.
examples.uz: Samalyotimiz kechikkan yo'lovchi
examples.grammar: 'left after + a + sifat + ot' - Past Simple; 'after' - vaqt predlogi; 'because of' - sabab predlogi.

examples.en: There was a long delay at the airport because of the snow.
examples.uz: Qor tufayli aeroportda uzoq kechikish bo'ldi.
examples.grammar: 'There was + a + ot' - o'tgan zamonda biror narsa borligini bildiradi; 'because of' - sabab predlogi.

defEn: a person who looks after passengers on a plane.
defUz: samalyotda yo'lovchilarga xizmat ko'rsatadigan xodim.

examples.en: The flight attendant said the plane was ready to take off.
examples.uz: Styuardessa samalyot havoga
examples.grammar: 'said + (that) + gap' - Past Simple; 'was ready to take off' - 'be ready to + infinitiv' qurilishi tayyor holatni bildiradi.

examples.en: The flight attendant brought us water and a small meal.
examples.uz: Styuardessa bizga suv va kichik bir taom olib keldi.
examples.grammar: 'brought' - 'bring' fe'lining Past Simple shakli; 'us' - vositali to'ldiruvchi; 'and' - bog'lovchi.

defEn: a person who stays at a hotel or visits someone.
defUz: mehmonxonada turadigan yoki kimningdir uyiga mehmon bo'lib boradigan kishi.

examples.en: Guests in this hotel come here to relax and enjoy themselves.
examples.uz: Ushbu mehmonxonadagi
examples.grammar: 'Guests + come + to + infinitiv' - Present Simple, ko'plikdagi ega; 'to relax and enjoy' - maqsadni bildiruvchi infinitiv.

examples.en: The hotel has many guests during the summer.
examples.uz: Mehmonxonada yoz davomida ko'plab mehmonlar bo'ladi.
examples.grammar: 'has' - Present Simple, birlikdagi ega; 'many guests' - ko'plik; 'during the summer' - vaqt predlogi.

defEn: a building where you pay to stay and sleep.
defUz: pul to'lab tunaydigan va dam oladigan bino.

examples.en: We don't have enough money to stay in a five-star hotel.
examples.uz: Bizda besh yulduzli mehmonxonada
examples.grammar: 'don't have enough money to + infinitiv' - Present Simple inkor; 'enough + ot' - yetarli miqdorni bildiradi; 'to stay' - maqsad infinitivi.

examples.en: Our hotel was near the beach, so we walked there every day.
examples.uz: Mehmonxonamiz plyaj yaqinida edi, shuning uchun biz u yerga har kuni piyoda bordik.
examples.grammar: 'was' - Past Simple, 'be' fe'li; 'so' - natija bog'lovchisi; 'every day' - takrorlanishni bildiradi.

uz: talabalar, ishchilar yoki sayyohlar uchun maxsus, arzon narxlardagi yotoqxona
defEn: a cheap place to sleep, often shared with other travellers.
defUz: ko'pincha boshqa sayyohlar bilan birga tunaydigan arzon joy.

examples.en: The students are staying in hostels as they tour Europe to save money.
examples.uz: Yevropa bo'ylab
examples.grammar: 'are staying' - Present Continuous, hozirgi vaqtinchalik holat; 'as' - sabab bog'lovchisi; 'to save money' - maqsad infinitivi.

examples.en: We stayed in a cheap hostel near the city centre.
examples.uz: Biz shahar markazi yaqinidagi arzon yotoqxonada tunadik.
examples.grammar: 'stayed' - Past Simple; 'in a cheap hostel' - joy predlogi 'in' va sifat 'cheap'; 'near' - joy predlogi.

defEn: the act of travelling from one place to another.
defUz: bir joydan boshqa joyga borish jarayoni.

examples.en: The train journey from London to Edinburgh takes 4-5 hours.
examples.uz: Londondan Edinburgga poyezd
examples.grammar: 'The + ot + takes + vaqt' - Present Simple, vaqt qancha olishini bildiradi; 'from ... to ...' - boshlanish va tugash joyini ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: The journey to the village was long and tiring.
examples.uz: Qishloqqa qilingan sayohat uzoq va charchatuvchi edi.
examples.grammar: 'was' - Past Simple, 'be' fe'li; 'long and tiring' - 'and' bog'lovchisi bilan ikki sifat; 'to the village' - yo'nalish predlogi.

defEn: the bags and cases you take when you travel.
defUz: sayohatga olib boradigan sumka va chamadonlar.

examples.en: The only luggage I have is a small suitcase that I can take on the plane with me.
examples.uz: Menda bor
examples.grammar: 'The only + ot + I have is ...' - Present Simple; 'that I can take' - 'that' bilan boshlangan ergash gap; 'on the plane' - joy predlogi.

examples.en: Please put your luggage near the door before you sleep.
examples.uz: Iltimos, uxlashdan oldin yukingizni eshik yoniga qo'ying.
examples.grammar: 'Please put' - buyruq gap; 'before' - vaqt bog'lovchisi; 'your luggage' - egalik olmoshi bilan.

uz: barcha xizmatlar uchun oldindan birdaniga to'lanadigan turistik sayohat: transport, yotoqxona va shunga o'xshash barcha narsalar avvaldan tashkillashtirib qo'yiladi
defEn: a holiday where travel and a hotel are paid for together.
defUz: transport va mehmonxona birgalikda to'lanadigan sayohat.

examples.en: We went on a package holiday to Egypt and it was so cheap!
examples.uz: Biz Misrga sayohat qildik va u
examples.grammar: 'went on + a + ot' - Past Simple; 'to Egypt' - yo'nalish predlogi; 'and it was so cheap' - 'and' bog'lovchisi va 'so + sifat' kuchaytiruv.

examples.en: A package holiday is easy because the hotel and flights are ready.
examples.uz: Paket sayohat oson, chunki mehmonxona va parvozlar tayyor bo'ladi.
examples.grammar: 'is' - Present Simple; 'because' - sabab bog'lovchisi; 'are ready' - 'be' fe'li ko'plikda.

defEn: a person who travels in a car, bus, plane or train.
defUz: mashina, avtobus, samalyot yoki poyezdda sayohat qiluvchi kishi.

examples.en: One of the passengers was so ill that the plane had to turn back.
examples.uz: Yo'lovchilardan biri shu qadar
examples.grammar: 'One of the + ko'plik' - egadagi bo'lak; 'so + sifat + that ...' - natija ergash gapi; 'had to + infinitiv' - majburiyatni bildiradi.

examples.en: Every passenger must wear a seatbelt on the bus.
examples.uz: Avtobusda har bir yo'lovchi xavfsizlik kamarini taqishi shart.
examples.grammar: 'must wear' - modal fe'l 'must' majburiyatni bildiradi; 'every passenger' - birlikdagi ega; 'on the bus' - joy predlogi.

defEn: an official book that lets you travel to other countries.
defUz: boshqa mamlakatlarga sayohat qilish imkonini beruvchi rasmiy hujjat.

examples.en: We showed our passports and then went to get our luggage.
examples.uz: Biz pasportlarimizni ko'rsatdik, va
examples.grammar: 'showed ... and then went to + infinitiv' - Past Simple ketma-ket harakatlar; 'and then' - vaqt ketma-ketligini bog'laydi.

examples.en: Don't forget your passport when you travel abroad.
examples.uz: Chet elga sayohat qilganingizda pasportingizni unutmang.
examples.grammar: 'Don't forget' - buyruq gap inkori; 'when' - vaqt bog'lovchisi; 'your passport' - egalik olmoshi bilan.

defEn: a vehicle with wings that flies in the sky.
defUz: qanotlari bor va osmonda uchadigan transport vositasi.

examples.en: The plane landed in Gatwick Airport.
examples.uz: Samalyot Gatvik Aeroportiga qo'ndi.
examples.grammar: 'landed in + joy nomi' - Past Simple, 'land' fe'lining o'tgan zamoni; 'in Gatwick Airport' - joy predlogi 'in'.

examples.en: The plane was full of people going on holiday.
examples.uz: Samalyot ta'tilga ketayotgan odamlarga to'la edi.
examples.grammar: 'was full of' - Past Simple, to'laligini bildiradi; 'going on holiday' - sifatdosh, 'people' ni aniqlaydi.

defEn: the place at a station where you get on or off a train.
defUz: vokzalda poyezdga chiqadigan yoki tushadigan joy.

examples.en: What platform does the train to Glasgow leave from?
examples.uz: Glazgo'ga bo'lgan poyezd qaysi
examples.grammar: 'What platform does + ega + leave from?' - Present Simple so'roq gap; 'does' - yordamchi fe'l; 'from' - gap oxirida turuvchi predlog.

examples.en: The train to Paris leaves from platform five.
examples.uz: Parijga boradigan poyezd beshinchi platformadan jo'naydi.
examples.grammar: 'leaves' - Present Simple; 'to Paris' - yo'nalish predlogi; 'from platform five' - boshlanish joyini bildiradi.

defEn: a strap that keeps you safe in a car or plane.
defUz: mashina yoki samalyotda sizni xavfsiz ushlab turadigan kamar.

examples.en: The police officer stopped the driver for not wearing her seatbelt.
examples.uz: Politsiya ofitseri haydovchini
examples.grammar: 'stopped ... for not wearing' - Past Simple; 'for + -ing' - sabab predlogi; 'not wearing' - gerundiyning inkor shakli.

examples.en: Always put on your seatbelt before the car moves.
examples.uz: Mashina yurishidan oldin doimo xavfsizlik kamaringizni taqing.
examples.grammar: 'Always put on' - buyruq gap, 'always' ravish; 'before' - vaqt bog'lovchisi; 'your seatbelt' - egalik olmoshi bilan.

defEn: a large boat that travels on the sea.
defUz: dengizda yuradigan katta qayiq.

examples.en: The ship crosses the Atlantic Ocean from Southampton to New York.
examples.uz: Kema Sausampten
examples.grammar: 'The ship crosses + joy' - Present Simple, doimiy harakat; 'from ... to ...' - yo'nalishning boshi va oxirini bildiradi.

examples.en: The big ship carried hundreds of passengers across the sea.
examples.uz: Katta kema yuzlab yo'lovchini dengiz orqali olib o'tdi.
examples.grammar: 'carried' - Past Simple; 'hundreds of passengers' - ko'plikdagi to'ldiruvchi; 'across the sea' - joy predlogi.

defEn: a large bag with a handle for carrying clothes when you travel.
defUz: sayohatda kiyim olib yurish uchun dastasi bor katta sumka.

examples.en: You have too many things in your suitcase
examples.uz: it won't close. – Chamadoningizda haddan tashqari
examples.grammar: 'You have too many + ko'plik' - Present Simple; 'too many' - haddan ziyod miqdor; 'it won't close' - Future inkor, kelajakdagi natija.

examples.en: I put all my clothes in one big suitcase.
examples.uz: Men barcha kiyimlarimni bitta katta chamadonga joyladim.
examples.grammar: 'put' - Past Simple; 'all my clothes' - egalik olmoshi va ko'plik; 'in one big suitcase' - joy predlogi va sifat.

defEn: a person who shows tourists interesting places.
defUz: sayyohlarga qiziqarli joylarni ko'rsatadigan kishi.

examples.en: The tour guide showed us the best sights of the city.
examples.uz: Yo'l boshlovchi bizga shaharning eng
examples.grammar: 'showed + kishi + ot' - Past Simple, ikki to'ldiruvchili gap; 'the best sights' - 'the' artikli va sifatning ustunlik darajasi 'best'.

examples.en: The tour guide told us many stories about the old castle.
examples.uz: Yo'l boshlovchi bizga eski qasr haqida ko'plab voqealar aytib berdi.
examples.grammar: 'told' - 'tell' fe'lining Past Simple shakli; 'us' - vositali to'ldiruvchi; 'about the old castle' - mavzu predlogi 'about'.

defEn: a place that gives travellers maps and helpful information.
defUz: sayyohlarga xarita va foydali ma'lumot beradigan joy.

examples.en: We got a map of the town at the tourist information centre.
examples.uz: Biz sayyohlar uchun ma'lumot
examples.grammar: 'got + ot + at + joy' - Past Simple; 'a map of the town' - 'of' predlogi egalikni bildiradi; 'at the ... centre' - joy predlogi.

examples.en: You can ask for a hotel list at the tourist information centre.
examples.uz: Mehmonxonalar ro'yxatini sayyohlar uchun ma'lumot markazidan so'rashingiz mumkin.
examples.grammar: 'can ask' - modal fe'l 'can' imkoniyatni bildiradi; 'for a hotel list' - 'for' predlogi; 'at the ... centre' - joy predlogi.

defEn: a lot of cars on a road that move very slowly or stop.
defUz: yo'lda juda sekin harakatlanadigan yoki to'xtab qolgan ko'p mashinalar.

examples.en: They got stuck in a traffic jam and missed their flight.
examples.uz: Ular tirbandlikda turib qolishdi va
examples.grammar: 'got stuck in + ot + and missed + ot' - Past Simple ketma-ket harakatlar; 'in a traffic jam' - joy predlogi 'in'.

examples.en: We sat in a traffic jam for an hour on the way home.
examples.uz: Biz uyga qaytishda bir soat davomida tirbandlikda turib qoldik.
examples.grammar: 'sat' - 'sit' fe'lining Past Simple shakli; 'for an hour' - davomiylikni bildiruvchi 'for'; 'on the way home' - joy ibora.

defEn: the red, yellow and green lights that control traffic.
defUz: harakatni boshqaradigan qizil, sariq va yashil chiroqlar.

examples.en: The traffic lights turned green and the cars started moving.
examples.uz: Svetofor chiroqlari yashilga
examples.grammar: 'turned green and the cars started + -ing' - Past Simple; 'started moving' - 'start + gerundiy' qurilishi.

examples.en: Stop your car when the traffic lights are red.
examples.uz: Svetofor chiroqlari qizil bo'lganda mashinangizni to'xtating.
examples.grammar: 'Stop' - buyruq gap; 'when' - vaqt bog'lovchisi; 'are red' - 'be' fe'li ko'plikda.

defEn: a place where trains stop and people get on or off.
defUz: poyezdlar to'xtaydigan va odamlar chiqadigan yoki tushadigan joy.

examples.en: When we get to the train station, what platform do we go to?
examples.uz: Poyezd vokzaliga yetib
examples.grammar: 'When we get to ...' - vaqt ergash gapi, Present Simple; 'what platform do we go to?' - Present Simple so'roq gap, 'to' predlogi gap oxirida.

examples.en: The train station was busy with people in the morning.
examples.uz: Poyezd vokzali ertalab odamlar bilan gavjum edi.
examples.grammar: 'was busy' - Past Simple, 'be' fe'li; 'with people' - hamrohlik predlogi 'with'; 'in the morning' - vaqt predlogi.

defEn: a person whose job is to plan holidays and trips for people.
defUz: odamlar uchun ta'til va sayohatlarni tashkil qiluvchi kishi.

examples.en: The travel agent booked me a holiday in Italy.
examples.uz: Sayohat agentligi men uchun Italiyada ta'til
examples.grammar: 'booked + kishi + a + ot' - Past Simple, ikki to'ldiruvchili gap; 'a holiday in Italy' - 'in' joy predlogi.

examples.en: The travel agent found us cheap tickets to Spain.
examples.uz: Sayohat agenti biz uchun Ispaniyaga arzon chiptalar topib berdi.
examples.grammar: 'found' - 'find' fe'lining Past Simple shakli; 'us' - vositali to'ldiruvchi; 'to Spain' - yo'nalish predlogi.

defEn: a short journey to a place and back.
defUz: biror joyga borib qaytadigan qisqa sayohat.

examples.en: We're going on a three-day trip to Paris.
examples.uz: Biz Parijga uch kunlik sayohatga ketyapmiz.
examples.grammar: 'We're going on + a + ot' - Present Continuous kelasi rejani bildiradi; 'a three-day trip' - oldidan turgan birikma sifat 'three-day'.

examples.en: Our school trip to the museum was a lot of fun.
examples.uz: Muzeyga uyushtirilgan maktab sayohatimiz juda qiziqarli o'tdi.
examples.grammar: 'was a lot of fun' - Past Simple, holatni bildiradi; 'to the museum' - yo'nalish predlogi; 'our school trip' - egalik olmoshi bilan.

defEn: to get to a place at the end of a journey.
defUz: sayohat oxirida biror joyga yetib bormoq.

examples.en: The train leaves London at 6 pm and arrives in Edinburgh at 10.30.
examples.uz: Poyezd Londonni kechki
examples.grammar: 'leaves ... and arrives in ...' - Present Simple jadval bo'yicha harakat; 'in Edinburgh' - 'arrive in' shahar uchun predlog.

examples.en: We arrived at the hotel late in the evening.
examples.uz: Biz mehmonxonaga kechqurun kech yetib bordik.
examples.grammar: 'arrived' - Past Simple; 'at the hotel' - 'arrive at' bino uchun predlog; 'late in the evening' - vaqt iborasi.

defEn: to come down to the ground from the air.
defUz: havodan yerga tushmoq, qo'nmoq.

examples.en: The plane landed in Paris right on time and we got off.
examples.uz: Samalyot Parijga o'z vaqtida qo'ndi va
examples.grammar: 'The plane landed ... and we got off' - Past Simple ketma-ket harakatlar; 'right on time' - o'z vaqtida iborasi.

examples.en: The plane will land in London in twenty minutes.
examples.uz: Samalyot yigirma daqiqadan keyin Londonga qo'nadi.
examples.grammar: 'will land' - Future 'will' bilan; 'in London' - joy predlogi; 'in twenty minutes' - vaqt predlogi 'in'.

defEn: to go away from a place.
defUz: biror joydan jo'namoq, ketmoq.

examples.en: I packed my bags and left for the airport.
examples.uz: Men sumkalarimni tayyorladim (= ichiga barcha
examples.grammar: 'packed ... and left for ...' - Past Simple ketma-ket harakatlar; 'left for the airport' - 'leave for + joy' yo'nalishni bildiradi.

examples.en: We must leave the house early to catch the train.
examples.uz: Poyezdga ulgurish uchun uydan erta chiqishimiz kerak.
examples.grammar: 'must leave' - modal fe'l 'must' zaruratni bildiradi; 'to catch the train' - maqsad infinitivi; 'early' - ravish.

defEn: to put your things into a bag or case before you travel.
defUz: sayohatdan oldin narsalarni sumka yoki chamadonga solmoq.

examples.en: When you pack your suitcase, put in a warm top.
examples.uz: Chamadoningizni tayyorlayotganingizda,
examples.grammar: 'When you pack ..., put in ...' - vaqt ergash gapi Present Simple va bosh gapda buyruq; 'put in' - phrasal fe'l.

examples.en: She packed her bag the night before the trip.
examples.uz: U sayohatdan oldingi kechasi sumkasini joyladi.
examples.grammar: 'packed' - Past Simple; 'her bag' - egalik olmoshi bilan; 'the night before' - vaqt iborasi.

defEn: to rest and feel calm and happy.
defUz: dam olmoq va tinch, xotirjam his qilmoq.

examples.en: I work very hard and go on holiday to relax.
examples.uz: Men juda tirishib ishlayman va dam olish uchun
examples.grammar: 'work ... and go on holiday to + infinitiv' - Present Simple; 'to relax' - maqsad infinitivi.

examples.en: I like to relax on the beach with a good book.
examples.uz: Men plyajda yaxshi kitob bilan dam olishni yoqtiraman.
examples.grammar: 'like to relax' - Present Simple va 'like to + infinitiv'; 'on the beach' - joy predlogi; 'with a good book' - hamrohlik predlogi 'with'.

uz: biror joyda tunamoq, turmoq, vaqtinchalik yashamoq
defEn: to live in a place for a short time.
defUz: qisqa muddatga biror joyda yashamoq yoki turmoq.

examples.en: We are staying in a lovely hotel near the sea.
examples.uz: Biz dengiz yaqinidagi ajoyib bir mehmonxonada
examples.grammar: 'We are staying in ...' - Present Continuous, hozirgi vaqtinchalik holat; 'near the sea' - joy predlogi 'near'.

examples.en: We stayed with our friends for three days in Bukhara.
examples.uz: Biz Buxoroda do'stlarimiznikida uch kun turdik.
examples.grammar: 'stayed' - Past Simple; 'with our friends' - hamrohlik predlogi 'with'; 'for three days' - davomiylikni bildiradi.

defEn: to go from one place to another, often far away.
defUz: ko'pincha uzoq joyga, bir yerdan boshqa yerga bormoq.

examples.en: I love to travel, especially to countries that are far away.
examples.uz: Men sayohat qilishni sevaman,
examples.grammar: 'love to + infinitiv' - Present Simple; 'especially to countries that are far away' - 'that' bilan boshlangan ergash gap aniqlovchi.

examples.en: Many people travel by train because it is comfortable.
examples.uz: Ko'p odamlar poyezdda sayohat qilishadi, chunki u qulay.
examples.grammar: 'travel' - Present Simple ko'plikdagi ega; 'by train' - vosita predlogi; 'because' - sabab bog'lovchisi.

defEn: to take your things out of a bag or case.
defUz: narsalarni sumka yoki chamadondan olmoq.

examples.en: I unpacked my suitcase and put my clothes in the wardrobe.
examples.uz: Men chamadonimni bo'shatdim va
examples.grammar: 'unpacked ... and put ...' - Past Simple ketma-ket harakatlar; 'in the wardrobe' - joy predlogi 'in'.

examples.en: As soon as we arrived, I unpacked my clothes.
examples.uz: Yetib borishimiz bilanoq men kiyimlarimni chamadondan oldim.
examples.grammar: 'As soon as' - vaqt bog'lovchisi; 'arrived' va 'unpacked' - Past Simple; 'my clothes' - egalik olmoshi va ko'plik.

uz: (mehmonxona yoki aeroportda) ro'yxatdan o'tmoq/mehmonxona pulini to'lamoq va ro'yxatidan chiqmoq 71                                                                   @destination_vocabulary
defEn: to report you have arrived at, or are leaving, a hotel or airport.
defUz: mehmonxona yoki aeroportda ro'yxatdan o'tmoq yoki ro'yxatdan chiqmoq.

examples.en: When you get to the airport, you have to check in.
examples.uz: Aeroportga yetib borganingizda, ro'yxatdan
examples.grammar: 'When you get to ..., you have to + infinitiv' - vaqt ergash gapi va bosh gapda 'have to' zaruratni bildiradi; 'check in' - phrasal fe'l.

examples.en: We must check out of the hotel before twelve o'clock.
examples.uz: Biz mehmonxonadan soat o'n ikkidan oldin chiqishimiz kerak.
examples.grammar: 'must check out' - modal fe'l 'must' zaruratni bildiradi; 'check out' - phrasal fe'l; 'before' - vaqt predlogi.

defEn: to leave a bus, train, plane or other vehicle.
defUz: avtobus, poyezd, samalyot yoki boshqa transportdan tushmoq.

examples.en: The coach arrived at the station and the passengers got off.
examples.uz: Turistik avtobus stansiyaga yetib
examples.grammar: 'arrived ... and the passengers got off' - Past Simple ketma-ket harakatlar; 'get off' - phrasal fe'l.

examples.en: We get off the bus at the next stop.
examples.uz: Biz keyingi bekatda avtobusdan tushamiz.
examples.grammar: 'get off' - Present Simple; 'the bus' - to'ldiruvchi; 'at the next stop' - joy predlogi 'at'.

defEn: to step into a bus, train, plane or other vehicle.
defUz: avtobus, poyezd, samalyot yoki boshqa transportga chiqmoq.

examples.en: We got on the train at Coventry and travelled north.
examples.uz: Biz Koventri shahrida poyezdga chiqdik va
examples.grammar: 'got on ... and travelled north' - Past Simple ketma-ket harakatlar; 'get on' - phrasal fe'l; 'north' - yo'nalish ravishi.

examples.en: Please get on the train quickly before the doors close.
examples.uz: Iltimos, eshiklar yopilmasdan oldin poyezdga tez chiqing.
examples.grammar: 'Please get on' - buyruq gap; 'before' - vaqt bog'lovchisi; 'quickly' - tarz ravishi.

defEn: to enter a car or taxi.
defUz: mashina yoki taksiga o'tirmoq.

examples.en: The taxi stopped and I got in.
examples.uz: Taksi to'xtadi va men unga o'tirdim.
examples.grammar: 'The taxi stopped and I got in' - Past Simple ketma-ket harakatlar; 'get in' - phrasal fe'l, mashinaga o'tirishni bildiradi.

examples.en: She opened the car door and got in quickly.
examples.uz: U mashina eshigini ochdi va tez o'tirdi.
examples.grammar: 'opened' va 'got in' - Past Simple ketma-ket harakatlar; 'and' - bog'lovchi; 'quickly' - tarz ravishi.

defEn: to do something more quickly.
defUz: biror ishni tezroq qilmoq, shoshilmoq.

examples.en: Hurry up or we'll miss the plane!
examples.uz: Shoshiling, aks holda samalyotni o'tkazib yuboramiz!
examples.grammar: 'Hurry up or we'll miss ...' - buyruq gap va 'or' bilan ogohlantirish, Future 'will' bilan natijani bildiradi.

examples.en: Hurry up, the bus is leaving in two minutes!
examples.uz: Shoshiling, avtobus ikki daqiqadan keyin jo'naydi!
examples.grammar: 'Hurry up' - buyruq gap; 'is leaving' - Present Continuous yaqin kelajak rejasi; 'in two minutes' - vaqt predlogi.

defEn: to go more slowly than before.
defUz: avvalgidan sekinroq harakatlanmoq.

examples.en: Slow down! You nearly crashed!
examples.uz: Sekinlashing! Avariya bo'lishingizga sal qoldi!
