examples.grammar: 'Slow down! You nearly crashed!' - buyruq gap va Past Simple; 'nearly' - ravish, sal qolganini bildiradi.

examples.en: Please slow down when you drive near a school.
examples.uz: Maktab yonidan haydaganingizda iltimos sekinlashing.
examples.grammar: 'Please slow down' - buyruq gap; 'when' - vaqt bog'lovchisi; 'near a school' - joy predlogi 'near'.

defEn: to set up a tent so it stands.
defUz: chodirni tikmoq, uni tik holatda o'rnatmoq.

examples.en: You can't go camping. You can't put up a tent!
examples.uz: Siz kempingga chiqa olmaysiz. Siz chodir tika
examples.grammar: 'You can't ... You can't put up a tent!' - modal fe'l 'can' inkori imkonsizlikni bildiradi; 'put up' - phrasal fe'l.

examples.en: It started to rain before we could put up the tent.
examples.uz: Biz chodirni tikishga ulgurmasimizdan yomg'ir yog'a boshladi.
examples.grammar: 'started to rain' - Past Simple va 'start to + infinitiv'; 'before' - vaqt bog'lovchisi; 'could put up' - modal fe'l 'could'.

defEn: used to say how fast something moves.
defUz: biror narsaning qanchalik tez harakatlanishini bildirish uchun ishlatiladi.

examples.en: This car can go at 180 km per hour.
examples.uz: Bu mashina soatiga 180 km tezlikda yura oladi.
examples.grammar: 'can go at + son + km per hour' - modal fe'l 'can' imkoniyatni bildiradi; 'at ... per hour' - tezlikni bildiruvchi ibora.

examples.en: The train travels at 120 km per hour between the two cities.
examples.uz: Poyezd ikki shahar orasida soatiga 120 km tezlikda yuradi.
examples.grammar: 'travels' - Present Simple; 'at 120 km per hour' - tezlikni bildiruvchi ibora; 'between the two cities' - 'between' predlogi.

defEn: used to say how something travels, for example by plane or boat.
defUz: biror narsa qaysi yo'l bilan, masalan samalyot yoki kemada borishini bildiradi.

examples.en: The fastest way to travel is by air.
examples.uz: Sayohat qilishning eng tez yo'li–havo yo'li orqali.
examples.grammar: 'The fastest way to travel is by air' - 'the fastest' sifatning ustunlik darajasi; 'by air' - vositani bildiruvchi predlog 'by'.

examples.en: It is cheaper to send big boxes by sea than by air.
examples.uz: Katta qutilarni havo yo'li orqali emas, dengiz orqali jo'natish arzonroq.
examples.grammar: 'It is cheaper to + infinitiv' - qiyosiy daraja bilan; 'by sea' va 'by air' - vosita predlogi 'by'; 'than' - qiyoslash bog'lovchisi.

defEn: used to say which vehicle you use to travel.
defUz: sayohat uchun qaysi transportdan foydalanishni bildiradi.

examples.en: There's no time for a bus. We have to go by taxi.
examples.uz: Avtobus uchun vaqt yo'q. Taksida ketishga
examples.grammar: 'There's no time ... We have to go by taxi' - 'have to' zaruratni bildiradi; 'by taxi' - vosita predlogi 'by'.

examples.en: We usually go to school by bus in the morning.
examples.uz: Biz odatda ertalab maktabga avtobusda boramiz.
examples.grammar: 'go by bus' - Present Simple, 'by' vosita predlogi; 'usually' - takrorlanish ravishi; 'in the morning' - vaqt predlogi.

uz: ochiq havoda chodir tikib dam olishga bormoq
defEn: to go and sleep outside in a tent for fun.
defUz: ochiq havoda chodirda dam olish uchun bormoq.

examples.en: Let's just throw a tent in the car and go camping.
examples.uz: Keling mashinaga chodir solamiz va ochiq
examples.grammar: 'Let's just ... and go camping' - 'Let's + infinitiv' taklif gapi; 'go camping' - 'go + -ing' dam olish faoliyatini bildiradi.

examples.en: We go camping in the mountains every summer.
examples.uz: Biz har yoz tog'larda chodir tikib dam olishga boramiz.
examples.grammar: 'go camping' - Present Simple, 'go + -ing'; 'in the mountains' - joy predlogi; 'every summer' - takrorlanishni bildiradi.

defEn: to travel somewhere to rest and enjoy yourself.
defUz: dam olish va zavqlanish uchun biror joyga bormoq.

examples.en: We go on holiday to France every summer.
examples.uz: Biz har yoz faslida Fransiyaga dam olishga boramiz.
examples.grammar: 'We go on holiday to ... every summer' - Present Simple takrorlanuvchi harakat; 'to France' - yo'nalish predlogi; 'every summer' - takrorlanishni bildiradi.

examples.en: Next year we want to go on holiday to the sea.
examples.uz: Kelasi yili biz dengizga dam olishga borishni xohlaymiz.
examples.grammar: 'want to go' - Present Simple va 'want to + infinitiv'; 'Next year' - kelajak vaqt iborasi; 'to the sea' - yo'nalish predlogi.

defEn: while travelling to a place.
defUz: biror joyga safar yoki sayohat davomida.

examples.en: His wife's Chinese
examples.uz: they met on a trip of his to Hong Kong. – Uning rafiqasi xitoylik–ular uning
examples.grammar: 'they met on a trip' - Past Simple; 'on a trip' - sayohat davomida ekanini bildiruvchi predlog 'on'.

examples.en: We made many new friends on a trip to the mountains.
examples.uz: Biz tog'larga qilingan sayohatda ko'plab yangi do'stlar orttirdik.
examples.grammar: 'made' - 'make' fe'lining Past Simple shakli; 'on a trip' - vaqt va holat predlogi 'on'; 'to the mountains' - yo'nalish predlogi.

defEn: on or in a ship, plane, bus or train.
defUz: kema, samalyot, avtobus yoki poyezd ichida.

examples.en: Once all the passengers are on board, we can leave.
examples.uz: Barcha yo'lovchilar bo'rtga chiqib
examples.grammar: 'Once all the passengers are on board, we can leave' - 'Once' vaqt bog'lovchisi; 'are on board' - 'be' fe'li va 'on board' ibora; 'can leave' - modal fe'l.

examples.en: There were many families on board the big ship.
examples.uz: Katta kemada ko'plab oilalar bor edi.
examples.grammar: 'There were' - o'tgan zamonda ko'plikda borligini bildiradi; 'many families' - ko'plik; 'on board' - kema ichida ekanini bildiradi.

defEn: by walking.
defUz: piyoda, yurib.

examples.en: I had no money for a bus, so I got here on foot.
examples.uz: Avtobus uchun pulim yo'q edi, shuning uchun
examples.grammar: 'I had no money ..., so I got here on foot' - Past Simple; 'so' - natija bog'lovchisi; 'on foot' - piyoda ekanini bildiruvchi ibora.

examples.en: The shop is near, so we can go on foot.
examples.uz: Do'kon yaqin, shuning uchun piyoda borishimiz mumkin.
examples.grammar: 'is near' - Present Simple; 'so' - natija bog'lovchisi; 'can go on foot' - modal fe'l 'can' va 'on foot' ibora.

defEn: to visit the famous and interesting places of a town or city.
defUz: shaharning mashhur va qiziqarli joylarini aylanib ko'rmoq.

examples.en: On our first day in Paris we went to see the sights.
examples.uz: Parijdagi birinchi kunimizda biz diqqatga
examples.grammar: 'On our first day ... we went to + infinitiv' - Past Simple; 'to see the sights' - maqsad infinitivi.

examples.en: We had only one day to see the sights of the old city.
examples.uz: Eski shaharning diqqatga sazovor joylarini ko'rishga bizda atigi bir kun bor edi.
examples.grammar: 'had' - Past Simple; 'only one day' - chegaralangan miqdor; 'to see the sights' - maqsad infinitivi.

defEn: feeling fear or worry about something.
defUz: biror narsadan qo'rqish yoki xavotirlanish hissi.

examples.en: I'm afraid of dogs. They really scare me.
examples.uz: Men itlardan qo'rqaman. Ular meni juda qo'rqitadi.
examples.grammar: 'I'm afraid of + ot' - Present Simple, 'be afraid of' qurilishi qo'rquvni bildiradi; 'of dogs' - predlog 'of'.

examples.en: She was afraid to fly for the first time.
examples.uz: U birinchi marta uchishdan qo'rqqan edi.
examples.grammar: 'was afraid to + infinitiv' - Past Simple, qo'rquvni bildiradi; 'for the first time' - vaqt iborasi.

defEn: very good or wonderful.
defUz: juda yaxshi yoki ajoyib.

examples.en: That's a brilliant idea! Let's go camping!
examples.uz: Bu ajoyib fikr! Keling ochiq havoda chodir tikib dam
examples.grammar: 'That's a brilliant + ot!' - Present Simple, 'be' fe'lining qisqa shakli; 'Let's go camping!' - taklif gapi.

examples.en: The weather was brilliant during our whole holiday.
examples.uz: Butun ta'tilimiz davomida ob-havo ajoyib bo'ldi.
examples.grammar: 'was brilliant' - Past Simple, 'be' fe'li va sifat; 'during our whole holiday' - vaqt predlogi 'during'.

defEn: giving attention so you do not make a mistake or have an accident.
defUz: xato qilmaslik yoki baxtsiz hodisaga uchramaslik uchun e'tiborli bo'lish.

examples.en: Be careful when you cross the road because the cars go very fast.
examples.uz: Mashina yo'lidan o'tishda
examples.grammar: 'Be careful when ... because ...' - buyruq gap, 'when' vaqt bog'lovchisi va 'because' sabab bog'lovchisi.

examples.en: Be careful with your passport at the airport.
examples.uz: Aeroportda pasportingizga ehtiyot bo'ling.
examples.grammar: 'Be careful' - buyruq gap; 'with your passport' - predlog 'with' va egalik olmoshi; 'at the airport' - joy predlogi.

examples.en: Be careful
examples.uz: the buildings are ready to fall down. – Ehtiyotkor bo'ling–binolar qulay deb turibdi.
examples.grammar: 'Be careful, the buildings are ready to fall down' - buyruq gap; 'Be + sifat' (careful) ogohlantirishni bildiradi.

examples.en: Be careful when you cross the busy road.
examples.uz: Sergak yo'ldan o'tayotganingizda ehtiyot bo'ling.
examples.grammar: 'Be careful when you cross' - buyruq gap; 'when' vaqt ergash gapini boshlaydi.

defEn: a little cold but not too cold.
defUz: bir oz sovuq, lekin juda sovuq emas.

examples.en: Even though it's summer, it's still quite cool in the morning.
examples.uz: Hozir yoz bo'lishiga qaramay, hali
examples.grammar: 'Even though it's summer, it's still quite cool' - 'Even though' qarama-qarshilik bog'lovchisi; 'quite cool' - 'quite' kuchaytiruvchi ravish.

examples.en: The evening was cool, so I put on a light jacket.
examples.uz: Kechqurun salqin edi, shuning uchun men yengil kurtka kiydim.
examples.grammar: 'was cool' - Past Simple, 'be' fe'li va sifat; 'so' - natija bog'lovchisi; 'put on' - phrasal fe'l.

defEn: not clean.
defUz: toza emas, kir.

examples.en: Our hotel room was dirty, so mum asked them to clean it.
examples.uz: Bizning mehmonxonadagi xonamiz
examples.grammar: 'Our hotel room was dirty, so mum asked them to + infinitiv' - Past Simple; 'so' natija bog'lovchisi; 'asked them to clean' - 'ask + kishi + to + infinitiv'.

examples.en: My shoes were dirty after the long walk.
examples.uz: Uzoq yurganimdan keyin oyoq kiyimlarim kir bo'lib qoldi.
examples.grammar: 'were dirty' - Past Simple ko'plikda, 'be' fe'li va sifat; 'after the long walk' - vaqt predlogi 'after'.

defEn: happening before the usual or expected time.
defUz: odatdagi yoki kutilgan vaqtdan oldin sodir bo'ladigan.

examples.en: I've got an early flight tomorrow, so I'm going to bed.
examples.uz: Ertaga barvaqt parvozim bor, shuning
examples.grammar: 'I've got an early + ot ..., so I'm + -ing' - 'have got' egalikni bildiradi; 'so' natija bog'lovchisi; 'I'm going to bed' - Present Continuous yaqin kelajak.

examples.en: We took an early bus to reach the city before noon.
examples.uz: Shaharga tushlikdan oldin yetib borish uchun biz erta avtobusga chiqdik.
examples.grammar: 'took' - Past Simple; 'an early bus' - sifat 'early' otdan oldin; 'to reach' - maqsad infinitivi; 'before noon' - vaqt predlogi.

uz: chet elga, xorijga, xorijdagi, chet elda
defEn: in or to a foreign country.
defUz: chet elda yoki chet elga.

examples.en: This is my first holiday abroad
examples.uz: my other holidays were in Uzbekistan. – Bu mening chet eldagi
examples.grammar: 'This is my first holiday abroad' - Present Simple; 'my first holiday' - tartib son 'first' va egalik olmoshi; 'abroad' - joy ravishi.

examples.en: Many young people want to study abroad these days.
examples.uz: Hozirgi kunda ko'plab yoshlar chet elda o'qishni xohlaydi.
examples.grammar: 'want to study' - Present Simple va 'want to + infinitiv'; 'abroad' - joy ravishi; 'these days' - vaqt iborasi.

defEn: one more time.
defUz: yana bir marta, qaytadan.

examples.en: Let's go to Rome again. Last time it was great.
examples.uz: Keling yana Rimga boramiz. Oldingi safar ajoyib
examples.grammar: 'Let's go to Rome again' - 'Let's + infinitiv' taklif gapi; 'again' - takrorlanish ravishi; 'Last time it was great' - Past Simple.

examples.en: I would love to visit that beautiful island again.
examples.uz: Men o'sha go'zal orolga yana tashrif buyurishni juda xohlardim.
examples.grammar: 'would love to + infinitiv' - xohishni bildiradi; 'again' - takrorlanish ravishi; 'that beautiful island' - ko'rsatish olmoshi va sifat.

defEn: the act of reaching a place.
defUz: biror joyga yetib kelish.

examples.en: Our arrival in London was delayed by bad weather.
examples.uz: Londonga yetib borishimiz yomon ob-havo
examples.grammar: 'Our arrival ... was delayed by ...' - Past Simple passiv 'was delayed'; 'by bad weather' - passivda harakat bajaruvchisini bildiruvchi 'by'.

examples.en: Our arrival at the hotel was a happy moment for everyone.
examples.uz: Mehmonxonaga yetib borishimiz hamma uchun quvonchli daqiqa bo'ldi.
examples.grammar: 'was a happy moment' - Past Simple, 'be' fe'li; 'at the hotel' - joy predlogi; 'for everyone' - 'for' predlogi.

defEn: to leave a place, especially to start a journey.
defUz: biror joydan, ayniqsa sayohatni boshlash uchun jo'namoq.

examples.en: This train will depart in three minutes.
examples.uz: Bu poyezd uch daqiqada yo'lga chiqadi.
examples.grammar: 'This train will depart in three minutes' - Future 'will' bilan kelajakdagi harakat; 'in three minutes' - vaqt predlogi 'in'.

examples.en: The bus departs from the station at nine every morning.
examples.uz: Avtobus har kuni ertalab soat to'qqizda bekatdan jo'naydi.
examples.grammar: 'departs' - Present Simple, jadval bo'yicha harakat; 'from the station' - boshlanish joyini bildiradi; 'every morning' - takrorlanish.

defEn: the act of leaving, especially to start a journey.
defUz: biror joydan, ayniqsa sayohatni boshlash uchun jo'nash.

examples.en: The time of departure is 7.30, but from which platform?
examples.uz: Jo'nash vaqti 7.30, biroq qaysi
examples.grammar: 'The time of departure is 7.30, but from which platform?' - Present Simple; 'of departure' - egalikni bildiruvchi 'of'; 'but' - qarama-qarshilik bog'lovchisi.

examples.en: The departure of the train was ten minutes late.
examples.uz: Poyezdning jo'nashi o'n daqiqa kechikdi.
examples.grammar: 'was ten minutes late' - Past Simple, kechikishni bildiradi; 'of the train' - egalikni bildiruvchi 'of'.

uz: tadqiq etmoq: biror joy haqida ko'proq o'rganish uchun u yerni aylanmoq
defEn: to travel around a place to learn more about it.
defUz: biror joy haqida ko'proq bilish uchun u yerni aylanmoq.

examples.en: The best way to explore the countryside is on foot.
examples.uz: Shahar tashqarisini tadqiq etishning eng
examples.grammar: 'The best way to explore ... is on foot' - 'the best way' sifatning ustunlik darajasi; 'to explore' - infinitiv aniqlovchi; 'on foot' - ibora.

examples.en: We spent a whole day exploring the old town.
examples.uz: Biz eski shaharni aylanib o'rganishga to'liq bir kun sarfladik.
examples.grammar: 'spent' - 'spend' fe'lining Past Simple shakli; 'exploring' - gerundiy; 'a whole day' - vaqt iborasi.

defEn: a person who travels to new places to learn about them.
defUz: yangi joylarni o'rganish uchun u yerga sayohat qiluvchi kishi.

examples.en: He was an explorer who travelled through the Amazon.
examples.uz: U Amazonka o'rmoni bo'ylab sayohat
examples.grammar: 'He was an explorer who travelled ...' - Past Simple; 'who travelled through the Amazon' - 'who' bilan boshlangan aniqlovchi ergash gap.

examples.en: The young explorer found a new path through the forest.
examples.uz: Yosh tadqiqotchi o'rmon orqali yangi so'qmoq topdi.
examples.grammar: 'found' - 'find' fe'lining Past Simple shakli; 'a new path' - sifat 'new' otdan oldin; 'through the forest' - joy predlogi 'through'.

defEn: a person who controls a car, bus or other vehicle.
defUz: mashina, avtobus yoki boshqa transportni boshqaradigan kishi.

examples.en: The driver of the coach had to stop and ask for directions!
examples.uz: Turistik avtobus haydovchi to'xtab,
examples.grammar: 'The driver ... had to stop and ask ...' - Past Simple; 'had to + infinitiv' zaruratni bildiradi; 'stop and ask' - 'and' bilan bog'langan ikki fe'l.

examples.en: The bus driver was friendly and helped us with our bags.
examples.uz: Avtobus haydovchisi xushmuomala edi va bizga sumkalarimizda yordam berdi.
examples.grammar: 'was friendly' va 'helped' - Past Simple; 'with our bags' - predlog 'with' va egalik olmoshi; 'and' - bog'lovchi.

defEn: to travel through the air, especially in a plane.
defUz: havo orqali, ayniqsa samalyotda harakatlanmoq.

examples.en: Geese fly south in the autumn.
examples.uz: G'ozlar kuzda janubga uchishadi.
examples.grammar: 'Geese fly south in the autumn' - Present Simple, ko'plikdagi ega; 'south' - yo'nalish ravishi; 'in the autumn' - vaqt predlogi 'in'.

examples.en: We will fly to Istanbul early tomorrow morning.
examples.uz: Biz ertaga erta tongda Istanbulga uchamiz.
examples.grammar: 'will fly' - Future 'will' bilan; 'to Istanbul' - yo'nalish predlogi; 'early tomorrow morning' - vaqt iborasi.

defEn: a journey made by plane through the air.
defUz: samalyotda havo orqali qilingan sayohat.

examples.en: What airport does your flight to Paris leave from?
examples.uz: Sizning Parijga bo'lgan parvozingiz qaysi
examples.grammar: 'What airport does your flight ... leave from?' - Present Simple so'roq gap; 'does' yordamchi fe'l; 'from' predlog gap oxirida.

examples.en: Our flight to Dubai takes about four hours.
examples.uz: Bizning Dubayga parvozimiz taxminan to'rt soat davom etadi.
examples.grammar: 'takes' - Present Simple; 'to Dubai' - yo'nalish predlogi; 'about four hours' - taxminiy vaqtni bildiradi.

defEn: the act of leaving a car somewhere, or a place to do this.
defUz: mashinani biror joyga qo'yish yoki shu uchun mo'ljallangan joy.

examples.en: Parking at the airport is free for the first 30 minutes.
examples.uz: Aeroportda parkovka qilish dastlabki 30
examples.grammar: 'Parking ... is free for the first 30 minutes' - Present Simple; 'Parking' - ega vazifasidagi gerundiy; 'for the first 30 minutes' - vaqt iborasi.

examples.en: Parking near the train station is very difficult.
examples.uz: Poyezd vokzali yaqinida mashina qo'yish juda qiyin.
examples.grammar: 'is very difficult' - Present Simple; 'Parking' - ega vazifasidagi gerundiy; 'near the train station' - joy predlogi 'near'.

defEn: to travel on water in a boat or ship.
defUz: qayiq yoki kemada suv ustida harakatlanmoq.

examples.en: We sailed on a large ocean liner.
examples.uz: Biz ulkan okean kemasida suzdik.
examples.grammar: 'We sailed on a large ocean liner' - Past Simple; 'on a large ocean liner' - joy predlogi 'on' va sifat 'large'.

examples.en: They sailed across the lake in a small boat.
examples.uz: Ular kichik qayiqda ko'l bo'ylab suzdilar.
examples.grammar: 'sailed' - Past Simple; 'across the lake' - joy predlogi 'across'; 'in a small boat' - joy predlogi va sifat.

defEn: the sport or activity of travelling on water in a boat.
defUz: qayiqda suv ustida harakatlanish sporti yoki mashg'uloti.

examples.en: Sailing across the Atlantic in a small boat is difficult even today.
examples.uz: Atlantika okeanini kichik
examples.grammar: 'Sailing across ... is difficult even today' - 'Sailing' ega vazifasidagi gerundiy; 'across the Atlantic' joy predlogi; 'even today' - ravish ibora.

examples.en: Sailing is a popular sport in this seaside town.
examples.uz: Suzish bu dengiz bo'yidagi shaharda mashhur sport turi.
examples.grammar: 'is' - Present Simple; 'Sailing' - ega vazifasidagi gerundiy; 'in this seaside town' - joy predlogi va ko'rsatish olmoshi.

defEn: a person who works on a ship or boat.
defUz: kema yoki qayiqda ishlaydigan kishi.

examples.en: He works as a sailor of a passenger ship.
examples.uz: U yo'lovchi tashish kemasida matros bo'lib ishlaydi.
examples.grammar: 'He works as a sailor of a passenger ship' - Present Simple; 'works as' - kasbni bildiradi; 'of a passenger ship' - egalikni bildiruvchi 'of'.

examples.en: The young sailor sent letters to his family from every port.
examples.uz: Yosh dengizchi har bir bandargohdan oilasiga xatlar jo'natardi.
examples.grammar: 'sent' - 'send' fe'lining Past Simple shakli; 'to his family' - yo'nalish predlogi va egalik olmoshi; 'from every port' - boshlanish joyi.

defEn: to travel around a place or to several places.
defUz: biror joyni yoki bir nechta joyni aylanib sayohat qilmoq.

examples.en: He's toured across Europe, the UK and North America.
examples.uz: U Yevropa, Birlashgan Qirollik hamda
examples.grammar: 'He's toured across Europe ...' - Present Perfect, hayotiy tajriba; 'across Europe' - joy predlogi; 'and' - bog'lovchi sanaydi.

examples.en: The band will tour many countries next year.
examples.uz: Guruh kelasi yili ko'plab mamlakatlarni aylanib chiqadi.
examples.grammar: 'will tour' - Future 'will' bilan; 'many countries' - ko'plik; 'next year' - kelajak vaqt iborasi.

defEn: a person who visits a place for pleasure on holiday.
defUz: ta'tilda zavqlanish uchun biror joyga boruvchi kishi.

examples.en: Millions of tourists visit Greece every year.
examples.uz: Har yili millionlab sayyohlar Gretsiyaga tashrif
examples.grammar: 'Millions of tourists visit Greece every year' - Present Simple; 'Millions of tourists' - ko'plikdagi ega; 'every year' - takrorlanishni bildiradi.

examples.en: Many tourists take photos in front of the famous building.
examples.uz: Ko'plab sayyohlar mashhur bino oldida suratga tushadi.
examples.grammar: 'take photos' - Present Simple ko'plikdagi ega; 'in front of the famous building' - joy iborasi; 'famous' - sifat otdan oldin.

defEn: a person who travels, especially often or to many places.
defUz: sayohat qiluvchi, ayniqsa tez-tez yoki ko'p joyga boradigan kishi.

examples.en: She's a real traveller and has been to over fifty countries.
examples.uz: U haqiqiy sayohatchi va ellikdan ziyod
examples.grammar: 'She's a real traveller and has been to ...' - Present Simple va Present Perfect; 'has been to' tajribani bildiradi; 'over fifty countries' - taxminiy miqdor.

examples.en: A good traveller always carries a small bag of medicine.
examples.uz: Yaxshi sayohatchi doimo kichik dori sumkasini olib yuradi.
examples.grammar: 'carries' - Present Simple, birlikdagi ega; 'always' - takrorlanish ravishi; 'a small bag of medicine' - 'of' predlogi va sifat.

defEn: a person who comes to see a place or another person.
defUz: biror joyni yoki boshqa kishini ko'rgani keladigan kishi.

examples.en: We've got visitors from abroad staying with us at the moment.
examples.uz: Ayni damda biz bilan turgan
examples.grammar: 'We've got visitors ... staying with us at the moment' - Present Perfect 'have got'; 'staying with us' - sifatdosh; 'at the moment' - hozirgi vaqtni bildiradi.

examples.en: The museum welcomes thousands of visitors each month.
examples.uz: Muzey har oy minglab tashrif buyuruvchini qabul qiladi.
examples.grammar: 'welcomes' - Present Simple, birlikdagi ega; 'thousands of visitors' - ko'plik; 'each month' - takrorlanishni bildiradi.

defEn: how much of something there is
defUz: biror narsaning qanchaligi, miqdori

examples.en: What is a healthy amount of food for an adult?
examples.uz: Voyaga yetgan odam uchun sog'lom oziq-ovqat
examples.grammar: 'What is + a + ot ...?' - so'roq gap, Present Simple zamonida narsaning miqdorini so'rash uchun ishlatiladi.

examples.en: A small amount of salt is fine, but too much is bad for you.
examples.uz: Ozgina miqdordagi tuz yaxshi, lekin haddan ortig'i sog'liq uchun zararli.
examples.grammar: 'A small amount of + ot' - sanab bo'lmaydigan ot bilan miqdorni bildiradi; 'but' - bog'lovchi ikki fikrni qarshilantiradi.

uz: me'yorlashtirilgan ovqatlanish: sog'lom bo'lish uchun zarur bo'lgan ozuqaviy moddalarni ta'minlay oladigan mahsulotlarni iste'mol qilish
defEn: a healthy mix of different foods in the right amounts
defUz: to'g'ri miqdorda turli ozuqalardan iborat sog'lom ovqatlanish

examples.en: Eat a balanced diet to stay healthy.
examples.uz: Sog'lom holatda qolish uchun me'yorlashtirilgan tarzda
examples.grammar: 'Eat + a + balanced diet ...' - buyruq gap (imperative), maslahat berish uchun fe'l bosh shaklda turadi; 'to stay' - maqsadni bildiruvchi infinitiv.

examples.en: A balanced diet usually includes fruit, vegetables and grains.
examples.uz: Me'yorlashtirilgan ovqatlanish odatda meva, sabzavot va donli mahsulotlarni o'z ichiga oladi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple, 'includes' - uchinchi shaxs birlikda -s qo'shimchasini oladi; 'usually' - takrorlanishni bildiruvchi ravish.

defEn: the things that are inside something, or the list of chapters in a book
defUz: biror narsaning ichidagilar yoki kitobdagi boblar ro'yxati

examples.en: I looked through the contents page of the book.
examples.uz: Men kitobning mundarija berilgan varag'iga
examples.grammar: 'I looked through + the + ot' - Past Simple, 'looked through' - phrasal fe'l boshidan oxirigacha ko'rib chiqishni bildiradi.

examples.en: The contents of the box were broken after the long trip.
examples.uz: Quti ichidagi narsalar uzoq safardan keyin singan edi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple, passiv 'were broken' - ish-harakat predmet ustida bajarilganini bildiradi; 'contents' har doim ko'plikda turadi.

defEn: physical activity that you do to stay healthy and strong
defUz: sog'lom va baquvvat bo'lish uchun bajariladigan jismoniy mashq

examples.en: I'm going to the gym to do some exercise.
examples.uz: Ozroq mashq qilish uchun sport zaliga ketyapman.
examples.grammar: 'I'm going to + the + joy ...' - 'be going to' kelasi reja yoki niyatni bildiradi; 'to do some exercise' - maqsadni bildiruvchi infinitiv.

examples.en: Doctors say that gentle exercise is good for your heart.
examples.uz: Shifokorlarning aytishicha, yengil mashq yurak uchun foydali.
examples.grammar: Present Simple, 'say that' - ergash gapni boshlaydigan bog'lovchi; 'exercise' bu yerda sanab bo'lmaydigan ot.

defEn: responsibility for something bad that has happened
defUz: yuz bergan yomon ish uchun aybdorlik, ayb

examples.en: It's your fault that we missed the bus
examples.uz: you're so slow. – Avtobusni o'tkazib yuborishimiz sizning
examples.grammar: 'It's your fault that ...' - egalik olmoshi 'your' ot oldidan kelib tegishlilikni bildiradi; 'that' ergash gapni boshlaydi.

examples.en: I am sorry, the mistake was my fault, not yours.
examples.uz: Kechirasiz, bu xato meniki edi, sizniki emas.
examples.grammar: Past Simple 'was', egalik olmoshlari 'my' va 'yours' tegishlilikni qarama-qarshi qo'yadi.

defEn: a high body temperature when you are ill
defUz: kasal bo'lganda tananing yuqori harorati, isitma

examples.en: The thermometer says 39°C
examples.uz: you've got a fever. – Termometr 39°C deyapti–isitmangiz bor.
examples.grammar: 'The thermometer says ...' - Present Simple, jonsiz predmet ma'lumot ko'rsatayotganda 'says' fe'li -s qo'shimchasini oladi.

examples.en: The child has a high fever, so we should call a doctor.
examples.uz: Bolaning isitmasi baland, shuning uchun shifokor chaqirishimiz kerak.
examples.grammar: Present Simple 'has', 'so' - natijani bildiruvchi bog'lovchi; 'should' - maslahat beruvchi modal fe'l.

defEn: the state of being healthy and physically strong
defUz: sog'lom va jismonan baquvvat bo'lish holati, tetiklik

examples.en: I joined a gym because fitness is important to me.
examples.uz: Men sport zaliga qo'shildim chunki jismonan
examples.grammar: 'I joined ... because + fitness is ...' - Past Simple 'joined' bilan Present Simple 'is' qo'shilgan; 'because' - sababni bildiruvchi bog'lovchi.

examples.en: Running every morning has improved my fitness a lot.
examples.uz: Har kuni ertalab yugurish jismoniy tetikligimni ancha yaxshiladi.
examples.grammar: Present Perfect 'has improved' - o'tmishda boshlanib hozirgi natijaga ega ish-harakatni bildiradi; 'fitness' sanab bo'lmaydigan ot.

defEn: a sweet drink with gas bubbles in it
defUz: tarkibida gaz pufakchalari bo'lgan shirin ichimlik

examples.en: Ivan doesn't like the bubbles in fizzy drinks.
examples.uz: Gazli ichimliklardagi pufakchalar Ivanga yoqmaydi.
examples.grammar: 'Ivan doesn't like ...' - Present Simple inkor shakli, uchinchi shaxs birlikda 'does not' yordamchi fe'li ishlatiladi; 'fizzy drinks' - ko'plik.

examples.en: Fizzy drinks have a lot of sugar, so I drink water instead.
examples.uz: Gazli ichimliklarda ko'p shakar bor, shuning uchun men o'rniga suv ichaman.
examples.grammar: Present Simple, 'so' natijani bildiradi; 'instead' - o'rniga ma'nosida ravish.

defEn: food that is new and not old, kept very cold, or good for your health
defUz: yangi, muzlatilgan yoki sog'liq uchun foydali oziq-ovqat

examples.en: You need to eat more fresh food
examples.uz: go to the market. – Siz ko'proq yangi oziq-ovqat yeyishingiz
examples.grammar: 'You need to eat + more + ot' - 'need to' majburiyatni bildiradi; 'more' qiyosiy daraja ko'rsatadi; 'fresh food' sanab bo'lmaydigan ot.

examples.en: Fresh food is better for you than frozen food.
examples.uz: Yangi oziq-ovqat muzlatilganidan ko'ra siz uchun foydaliroq.
examples.grammar: Present Simple, 'better ... than' - qiyosiy daraja ikki narsani solishtiradi.

defEn: how tall a person or thing is
defUz: odam yoki narsaning balandligi, bo'yi

examples.en: His dad was very tall but he's of medium height.
examples.uz: Uning dadasi juda baland bo'yli edi, lekin
examples.grammar: 'His dad was ... but he's of medium height' - Past Simple 'was' bilan Present Simple 'is' qo'shilgan; 'but' qarshilantiruvchi bog'lovchi.

examples.en: The doctor measured my height and my weight today.
examples.uz: Shifokor bugun mening bo'yim va vaznimni o'lchadi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple 'measured', egalik olmoshi 'my' ikki ot oldida takrorlanadi; 'and' tenglashtiruvchi bog'lovchi.

defEn: a place where sick or hurt people get medical care
defUz: kasal yoki shikastlangan odamlar tibbiy yordam oladigan joy

examples.en: Henry is in hospital because he had a car crash.
examples.uz: Henri shifoxonada chunki u avariyaga uchradi.
examples.grammar: 'Henry is in hospital because ...' - Present Simple, 'in hospital' artiklsiz ibora davolanish holatini bildiradi; 'because' sababni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: My sister works as a nurse in a big hospital.
examples.uz: Mening singlim katta shifoxonada hamshira bo'lib ishlaydi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple 'works', 'as a nurse' - kasbni bildiruvchi ibora artikl bilan keladi.

defEn: a change that makes something better
defUz: biror narsani yaxshilaydigan o'zgarish, yaxshilanish

examples.en: That hair style is a great improvement on your last one.
examples.uz: Bu soch turmagi avvalgisiga
examples.grammar: 'That hair style is a great improvement on ...' - Present Simple, 'a great improvement on' qaysidir narsaga nisbatan yaxshilanishni bildiradi.

examples.en: There has been a big improvement in her health this year.
examples.uz: Bu yil uning sog'lig'ida katta yaxshilanish bo'ldi.
examples.grammar: Present Perfect 'has been', 'There has been' biror narsaning yuzaga kelganini bildiradi.

defEn: guidance from a doctor about your health
defUz: shifokorning sog'lig'ingiz haqidagi maslahati

examples.en: I heard you're a doctor and I need medical advice.
examples.uz: Sizni shifokor deb eshitdim va men tibbiy
examples.grammar: 'I heard you're a doctor and I need ...' - Past Simple 'heard' bilan Present Simple 'need' qo'shilgan; 'and' ikki gapni bog'laydi.

examples.en: You should ask a doctor for medical advice before you start the diet.
examples.uz: Parxezni boshlashdan oldin shifokordan tibbiy maslahat so'rashingiz kerak.
examples.grammar: 'should' - maslahat beruvchi modal fe'l; 'before' - vaqtni bildiruvchi ergash gap bog'lovchisi.

defEn: a very lucky or wonderful event that is hard to explain
defUz: tushuntirish qiyin bo'lgan g'ayrioddiy, ajoyib voqea, mo'jiza

examples.en: It's a miracle
examples.uz: my mum was so ill and now she's better. – Bu mo'jiza–mening oyim juda kasal edi,
examples.grammar: 'It's a miracle' - Present Simple, 'It is' + artikl 'a' + ot tuzilmasi biror narsaga baho berish uchun ishlatiladi.

examples.en: It was a miracle that he got better so quickly.
examples.uz: Uning shunchalik tez tuzalib ketgani mo'jiza edi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple 'was', 'that' ergash gapni boshlaydi; 'so quickly' - holatni bildiruvchi ravish.

defEn: how good or bad something is
defUz: biror narsaning qanchalik yaxshi yoki yomonligi, sifati

examples.en: Make sure the food you eat is top quality, not junk.
examples.uz: Iste'mol qiladigan ovqatingiz sog'liqqa
examples.grammar: 'Make sure + (that) ...' - buyruq gap, 'make sure' biror narsaga ishonch hosil qilishni bildiradi; 'not junk' qarama-qarshilikni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: This shop sells fruit of very good quality.
examples.uz: Bu do'kon juda yuqori sifatli meva sotadi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple 'sells', 'of very good quality' - otdan keyin sifatni bildiruvchi ibora.

defEn: an amount or number of something
defUz: biror narsaning miqdori yoki soni

examples.en: When you eat that quantity of food, you'll gain weight.
examples.uz: Buncha miqdorda ovqat yeganingizda,
examples.grammar: 'When you eat ..., you'll gain weight' - 'when' bilan boshlanuvchi vaqt ergash gapi, asosiy gapda Future 'will' ishlatiladi.

examples.en: We bought a large quantity of water for the trip.
examples.uz: Biz safar uchun katta miqdorda suv sotib oldik.
examples.grammar: Past Simple 'bought', 'a large quantity of' - miqdorni bildiruvchi ibora otdan oldin keladi.

defEn: something that happens because of an action or event
defUz: biror ish yoki voqea tufayli yuzaga keladigan narsa, natija

examples.en: Did you get the results of your medical tests?
examples.uz: Tibbiy tekshiruvlaringiz natijalarini oldingizmi?
examples.grammar: 'Did you get + the + ot ...?' - Past Simple so'roq gap, 'did' yordamchi fe'li bilan tuziladi; asosiy fe'l bosh shaklda qoladi.

examples.en: The result of the test was good, so the doctor was happy.
examples.uz: Tekshiruv natijasi yaxshi bo'ldi, shuning uchun shifokor xursand bo'ldi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple 'was', 'so' natijani bildiruvchi bog'lovchi.

defEn: the outer layer that covers the body
defUz: tanani qoplab turuvchi tashqi qatlam, teri

examples.en: I stayed in the sun too long and my skin is red.
examples.uz: Men haddan tashqari uzoq vaqt quyoshda
examples.grammar: 'I stayed ... too long and my skin is red' - Past Simple 'stayed' bilan Present Simple 'is' qo'shilgan; 'too long' ortiqchalikni bildiradi.

examples.en: Drinking water keeps your skin healthy and soft.
examples.uz: Suv ichish teringizni sog'lom va yumshoq saqlaydi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple 'keeps', 'Drinking water' - gerundiy bosh egasi vazifasida; egalik olmoshi 'your'.

defEn: a small red mark on the skin
defUz: teridagi kichik qizil dog', husnbuzar

examples.en: He has bad skin and his face is covered in spots.
examples.uz: Uning terisi yomon, yuzi esa husnbuzarlar bilan
examples.grammar: 'He has bad skin and his face is covered in spots' - Present Simple, passiv 'is covered in' qoplanganlik holatini bildiradi.

examples.en: She got a few spots on her face before the exam.
examples.uz: Imtihondan oldin uning yuzida bir nechta husnbuzar paydo bo'ldi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple 'got', 'a few + ko'plik ot' kam sondagi narsani bildiradi; 'before' vaqtni ko'rsatadi.

defEn: how hot or cold something or someone is
defUz: biror narsa yoki odamning issiq-sovuqlik darajasi, harorat

examples.en: You feel hot
examples.uz: I'm going to take your temperature. – O'zingizni issiq his qilyapsiz–haroratingizni
examples.grammar: 'You feel hot' - Present Simple, 'feel' his-tuyg'uni bildiruvchi fe'l sifat bilan birga keladi.

examples.en: The nurse checked his temperature with a thermometer.
examples.uz: Hamshira termometr bilan uning haroratini tekshirdi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple 'checked', 'with a thermometer' - vositani bildiruvchi predlogli ibora.

defEn: a method of doing something
defUz: biror ishni qilish usuli, yo'li

examples.en: Swimming is a great way to get fit.
examples.uz: Suzish jismonan tetik bo'lishning ajoyib yo'li.
examples.grammar: 'Swimming is a great way to get fit' - Present Simple, 'Swimming' gerundiy ega vazifasida; 'to get fit' maqsadni bildiruvchi infinitiv.

examples.en: Walking to work is a good way to stay active.
examples.uz: Ishga piyoda borish faol bo'lib qolishning yaxshi yo'li.
examples.grammar: Present Simple 'is', 'a good way to + fe'l' biror maqsadga erishish usulini bildiradi.

defEn: to let someone do something
defUz: kimgadir biror ishni qilishga ruxsat bermoq

examples.en: His doctor doesn't allow him to eat much sugar.
examples.uz: Uning shifokori unga ko'p shakar iste'mol
examples.grammar: 'His doctor doesn't allow him to eat ...' - Present Simple inkor, 'does not' yordamchi fe'li; 'allow somebody to do' tuzilmasi ishlatiladi.

examples.en: My parents allow me to stay up late at the weekend.
examples.uz: Ota-onam dam olish kunlari menga kechgacha uyg'oq o'tirishga ruxsat berishadi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple 'allow', 'allow somebody to do something' tuzilmasi ruxsatni bildiradi.

defEn: to make something separate into pieces, often by force
defUz: biror narsani bo'laklarga ajratmoq, sindirmoq

examples.en: John broke his leg while skiing.
examples.uz: Jo'n chang'ida uchayotganda oyog'ini sindirib oldi.
examples.grammar: 'John broke his leg while skiing' - Past Simple, 'broke' - 'break' fe'lining tartibsiz shakli; 'while + -ing' bir vaqtda sodir bo'lgan ish-harakatni bildiradi.

examples.en: Be careful with the glass, or you will break it.
examples.uz: Stakan bilan ehtiyot bo'ling, aks holda uni sindirib qo'yasiz.
examples.grammar: Buyruq gap 'Be careful', 'or' ogohlantirishdagi natijani bildiradi; Future 'will break'.

defEn: to hurt or damage something with fire or heat
defUz: olov yoki issiqlik bilan biror narsaga zarar yetkazmoq, kuydirmoq

examples.en: Wait till the food cools or you'll burn your tongue.
examples.uz: Ovqat sovuguncha kuting, aks holda
examples.grammar: 'Wait till the food cools or you'll burn your tongue' - buyruq gap, 'till' vaqt chegarasini bildiradi; 'or you'll' ogohlantiruvchi natijani ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: I burned my hand when I touched the hot pan.
examples.uz: Men issiq tovaga tegib qo'limni kuydirib oldim.
examples.grammar: Past Simple 'burned' va 'touched', 'when' vaqtni bildiruvchi ergash gap bog'lovchisi.

examples.en: I touched the hot oven and burned my finger.
examples.uz: Men qaynoq pechga tegindim va barmog'imni
examples.grammar: 'I touched the hot oven and burned my finger' - Past Simple; 'and' bog'lovchisi ikki harakatni bog'laydi.

examples.en: The hot soup burned my mouth.
examples.uz: Issiq sho'rva og'zimni kuydirdi.
examples.grammar: 'The hot soup burned' - Past Simple; 'burn' fe'li o'tgan zamonda 'burned' bo'ladi.

defEn: to look at something to see if it is correct or safe
defUz: biror narsaning to'g'ri yoki xavfsizligini ko'rib chiqmoq, tekshirmoq

examples.en: Get a dentist to check your teeth every six months.
examples.uz: Tishlaringizni har olti oyda tish shifokoriga
examples.grammar: 'Get a dentist to check ...' - buyruq gap, 'get somebody to do' kimnidir biror ishni qilishga undashni bildiradi; 'every six months' takrorlanishni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: The doctor checked my heart and said I was healthy.
examples.uz: Shifokor yuragimni tekshirdi va sog'lom ekanimni aytdi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple 'checked' va 'said'; 'and' ikki ish-harakatni bog'laydi.

uz: o'z ichiga olmoq, tarkibida ... bor bo'lmoq
defEn: to have something inside
defUz: ichida biror narsa bo'lmoq, tarkibida bo'lmoq

examples.en: The chewing gum doesn't contain any sugar.
examples.uz: Saqichning tarkibida hech qanday shakar yo'q.
examples.grammar: 'The chewing gum doesn't contain any sugar' - Present Simple inkor, 'any' inkor gapda sanab bo'lmaydigan ot bilan ishlatiladi.

examples.en: This drink contains a lot of sugar and is not healthy.
examples.uz: Bu ichimlik tarkibida ko'p shakar bor va sog'liq uchun foydali emas.
examples.grammar: Present Simple 'contains' uchinchi shaxs birlikda -s oladi; 'and' ikki kesimni bog'laydi.

defEn: to push air out of your throat with a loud sound when you are ill
defUz: kasal bo'lganda tomoqdan ovoz bilan havo chiqarmoq, yo'talmoq

examples.en: Why are you coughing
examples.uz: is something stuck in your throat? – Nima uchun yo'talyapsiz–
examples.grammar: 'Why are you coughing ...?' - Present Continuous so'roq gap, 'are + -ing' hozir davom etayotgan ish-harakatni bildiradi; 'why' sababni so'raydi.

examples.en: He coughs a lot at night because of his cold.
examples.uz: U shamollagani sababli kechasi ko'p yo'taladi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple 'coughs', 'because of + ot' sababni bildiruvchi ibora.

defEn: to cause pain or injury to a person or part of the body
defUz: odamga yoki tananing biror qismiga og'riq yoki shikast yetkazmoq

examples.en: I fell over and hurt my arm.
examples.uz: Men yiqilib tushdim va qo'limni shikastlab oldim.
examples.grammar: 'I fell over and hurt my arm' - Past Simple, 'fell' va 'hurt' tartibsiz fe'llar; 'and' ikki ketma-ket ish-harakatni bog'laydi.

examples.en: My back hurts when I lift heavy boxes.
examples.uz: Og'ir qutilarni ko'targanimda belim og'riydi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple 'hurts', 'when' vaqt-shart ergash gapini boshlaydi.

examples.en: The fire destroyed houses but luckily no one was hurt.
examples.uz: Yong'in uylarni vayron qildi, ammo
examples.grammar: 'no one was hurt' - Past Simple passiv; 'be + hurt' jabrlanmaganlikni, 'no one' inkor olmoshini bildiradi.

examples.en: She fell and hurt her arm.
examples.uz: U yiqilib qo'lini jarohatladi.
examples.grammar: 'She fell and hurt' - Past Simple; 'hurt' fe'lining o'tgan zamon shakli ham 'hurt' bo'ladi.

defEn: to have something as one of its parts
defUz: biror narsani o'z qismlaridan biri sifatida o'z ichiga olmoq

examples.en: A healthy diet includes fish.
examples.uz: Sog'lom ovqatlanish baliqni o'z ichiga oladi.
examples.grammar: 'A healthy diet includes fish' - Present Simple, 'includes' uchinchi shaxs birlikda -s qo'shimchasini oladi.

examples.en: The price of the room includes breakfast every morning.
examples.uz: Xona narxi har kuni ertalabki nonushtani o'z ichiga oladi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple 'includes', 'every morning' takrorlanishni bildiruvchi ibora.

uz: qattiq turib olmoq, oyoqni tirab turib olmoq
defEn: to say firmly that something must happen or is true
defUz: biror narsa albatta bo'lishi yoki rost ekanini qattiq turib aytmoq

examples.en: I didn't want to try the dish, but the chef insisted.
examples.uz: Men taomni tatib ko'rishni istamagandim,
examples.grammar: 'I didn't want ..., but the chef insisted' - Past Simple, 'did not want' inkor; 'but' qarshilantiruvchi bog'lovchi.

examples.en: She insisted on paying for the meal herself.
examples.uz: U taom uchun o'zi to'lashda qattiq turib oldi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple 'insisted', 'insist on + -ing' biror narsada qat'iy turishni bildiruvchi tuzilma.

defEn: to decide how you will do something before you do it
defUz: biror ishni bajarishdan oldin uni qanday qilishni belgilamoq, rejalashtirmoq

examples.en: If you want to lose weight, you need to plan your diet.
examples.uz: Agar vazn yo'qotishni istasangiz, siz
examples.grammar: 'If you want ..., you need to plan ...' - shart mayli (first conditional), 'If' bilan boshlanuvchi shart gapi, asosiy gapda 'need to'.

examples.en: We are planning a long walk in the mountains next week.
examples.uz: Biz keyingi hafta tog'larda uzoq sayr qilishni rejalashtiryapmiz.
examples.grammar: Present Continuous 'are planning' yaqin kelajakdagi rejani bildiradi; 'next week' kelasi vaqtni ko'rsatadi.

defEn: to stop activity and relax for a while
defUz: faoliyatni to'xtatib, bir muddat dam olmoq

examples.en: Don't go to the gym every day
examples.uz: rest every other day. – Sport zaliga har kuni bormang–kunora
examples.grammar: 'Don't go to the gym every day' - buyruq gap inkor shakli, 'do not' yordamchi fe'li bilan tuziladi; 'every day' takrorlanishni bildiradi.

examples.en: You should rest for a few days after the long race.
examples.uz: Uzoq poygadan keyin bir necha kun dam olishingiz kerak.
examples.grammar: 'should' maslahat beruvchi modal fe'l; 'after' vaqtni bildiruvchi predlog.

defEn: to suddenly push air out of your nose and mouth with a loud sound
defUz: burun va og'izdan to'satdan ovoz bilan havo chiqarmoq, aksirmoq

examples.en: Use a tissue when you sneeze, please.
examples.uz: Iltimos, aksirganingizda salfetkadan foydalaning.
examples.grammar: 'Use a tissue when you sneeze, please' - buyruq gap, 'when you sneeze' vaqt ergash gapi; 'please' iltimosni yumshatadi.

examples.en: I always sneeze when there is dust in the room.
examples.uz: Xonada chang bo'lganda men doim aksiraman.
examples.grammar: Present Simple 'sneeze', 'when' vaqt ergash gapini boshlaydi; 'always' takrorni bildiruvchi ravish.

defEn: to have a certain heaviness, or to measure how heavy something is
defUz: ma'lum og'irlikka ega bo'lmoq yoki og'irlikni o'lchamoq

examples.en: My mum weighs the same as when she was 20
examples.uz: she hasn't put on weight. – Mening oyim 20
examples.grammar: 'My mum weighs the same as when she was 20' - Present Simple 'weighs' bilan Past Simple 'was' qo'shilgan; 'the same as' tenglikni bildiradi.

examples.en: The nurse weighed the baby and wrote down the number.
examples.uz: Hamshira chaqaloqni tortdi va raqamni yozib qo'ydi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple 'weighed' va 'wrote down'; 'wrote down' phrasal fe'l yozib qo'yishni bildiradi.

defEn: to eat in a restaurant or cafe instead of at home
defUz: uy o'rniga restoran yoki kafeda ovqatlanmoq

examples.en: I want to eat out tonight in that new French restaurant.
examples.uz: Bugun oqshomda yangi ochilgan
examples.grammar: 'I want to eat out tonight ...' - Present Simple 'want', 'to eat out' phrasal fe'l infinitiv shaklida; 'tonight' vaqtni bildiradi.

examples.en: We eat out once a week, usually on Saturday evening.
examples.uz: Biz haftada bir marta, odatda shanba kuni kechqurun tashqarida ovqatlanamiz.
examples.grammar: Present Simple 'eat out', 'once a week' takrorlanish chastotasini bildiradi.

defEn: to put your body flat on a bed or other surface to rest
defUz: dam olish uchun tanani to'shak yoki boshqa yuzaga yotqizmoq

examples.en: You look tired. You should go and lie down.
examples.uz: Charchagan ko'rinasiz. Borib yotishingiz kerak.
examples.grammar: 'You look tired. You should go and lie down' - Present Simple 'look' holatni bildiradi; 'should' maslahat beruvchi modal fe'l; 'go and lie down' ikki fe'lni bog'laydi.

examples.en: If you feel dizzy, lie down for a few minutes.
examples.uz: Agar boshingiz aylansa, bir necha daqiqa yotib oling.
examples.grammar: Shart mayli, 'If' shart gapini boshlaydi, asosiy gap buyruq shaklida; 'lie down' phrasal fe'l.

defEn: to go to bed much later than usual
defUz: odatdagidan kechroq, uxlamay uyg'oq o'tirmoq

examples.en: How late do you stay up on a Friday night?
examples.uz: Juma kechasida qanchalik kech mahalgacha
examples.grammar: 'How late do you stay up on a Friday night?' - Present Simple so'roq gap, 'do' yordamchi fe'li; 'how late' darajani so'raydi.

examples.en: The children stayed up late to watch the football match.
examples.uz: Bolalar futbol o'yinini ko'rish uchun kechgacha uxlamay o'tirishdi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple 'stayed up', 'to watch' maqsadni bildiruvchi infinitiv.

defEn: because of something that happened before
defUz: ilgari yuz bergan biror narsa tufayli, natijada

examples.en: He fell on the stairs and hurt his back as a result.
examples.uz: U zinaga yiqilib tushdi va natijada belini
examples.grammar: 'He fell ... and hurt his back as a result' - Past Simple, 'as a result' oldingi voqea natijasini bildiruvchi ibora gap oxirida keladi.

examples.en: She ate too much sugar and, as a result, she felt ill.
examples.uz: U juda ko'p shakar yedi va natijada o'zini yomon his qildi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple 'ate' va 'felt'; 'as a result' sabab-natija aloqasini bog'laydi.

defEn: to take action to handle a problem or person
defUz: muammo yoki odam bilan ish yuritib, uni hal qilmoq

examples.en: It's not easy to deal with Paul when he's angry.
examples.uz: Po'lning jahli chiqqanida, u bilan ish yuritish
examples.grammar: 'It's not easy to deal with Paul when he's angry' - Present Simple, 'It is not easy to + fe'l' tuzilmasi; 'when' vaqt ergash gapini boshlaydi.

examples.en: Doctors deal with many sick people every day.
examples.uz: Shifokorlar har kuni ko'plab kasal odamlar bilan ish yuritadilar.
examples.grammar: Present Simple 'deal with', 'every day' takrorlanishni bildiruvchi ibora.

defEn: to stop working for a short time and relax
defUz: qisqa vaqtga ishni to'xtatib, dam olmoq

examples.en: I don't want to do anything this weekend, just have a rest.
examples.uz: Bu hafta oxirida hech narsa qilishni
examples.grammar: 'I don't want to do anything ..., just have a rest' - Present Simple inkor 'do not want'; 'just have a rest' yagona istakni ta'kidlaydi.

examples.en: Let's have a rest before we walk to the next village.
examples.uz: Keyingi qishloqqa piyoda borishdan oldin dam olaylik.
examples.grammar: 'Let's + fe'l' birgalikda harakatga undash; 'before' vaqt ergash gapini boshlaydi.

defEn: to wash your whole body under running water
defUz: butun tanani oqar suv ostida yuvmoq, dush qabul qilmoq

examples.en: After going to the gym, I always take a shower.
examples.uz: Sport zaliga borgandan so'ng, men har doim
examples.grammar: 'After going to the gym, I always take a shower' - Present Simple, 'After + -ing' vaqtni bildiradi; 'always' takror ravishi.

examples.en: I take a shower every morning before I go to work.
examples.uz: Men har kuni ertalab ishga borishdan oldin dush qabul qilaman.
examples.grammar: Present Simple 'take a shower', 'before' vaqt ergash gapini boshlaydi; 'every morning' takrorni bildiradi.

defEn: to become lighter or thinner
defUz: yengilroq yoki ozg'inroq bo'lmoq, vazn yo'qotmoq

examples.en: After ten weeks on the diet, I started losing weight.
examples.uz: Parxezdagi o'n kundan so'ng, men vazn
examples.grammar: 'After ten weeks on the diet, I started losing weight' - Past Simple 'started', 'start + -ing' ish-harakatning boshlanishini bildiradi.

examples.en: He wants to lose weight, so he eats less sugar now.
examples.uz: U vazn yo'qotmoqchi, shuning uchun hozir kamroq shakar yeydi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple 'wants' va 'eats'; 'so' natijani bildiruvchi bog'lovchi; 'less' qiyosiy daraja.

defEn: one time or two times in a day, week, month or year
defUz: kun, hafta, oy yoki yilda bir yoki ikki marta

examples.en: I go swimming twice a week to keep fit.
examples.uz: Men jismonan tetik holatimni saqlab qolish uchun bir
examples.grammar: 'I go swimming twice a week to keep fit' - Present Simple, 'twice a week' takrorlanish chastotasini bildiradi; 'to keep fit' maqsad infinitivi.

examples.en: She visits the doctor once a year for a check-up.
examples.uz: U yiliga bir marta tekshiruv uchun shifokorga boradi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple 'visits', 'once a year' takrorlanish chastotasini bildiruvchi ibora.

defEn: to measure how hot a person's body is
defUz: odam tanasining haroratini o'lchamoq

examples.en: The nurse took his temperature with a thermometer.
examples.uz: Hamshira termometr bilan uning
examples.grammar: 'The nurse took his temperature with a thermometer' - Past Simple, 'took' tartibsiz fe'l; 'with a thermometer' vositani bildiruvchi predlogli ibora.

examples.en: The doctor will take your temperature before the test.
examples.uz: Shifokor tekshiruvdan oldin haroratingizni o'lchaydi.
examples.grammar: Future 'will take', 'before' vaqtni bildiruvchi predlog; egalik olmoshi 'your'.

defEn: feeling that everything is turning around you and you might fall
defUz: atrof aylanayotgandek tuyuladigan va yiqilib ketish hissi bo'lgan, boshi aylanayotgan

examples.en: Your face has gone white
examples.uz: do you feel dizzy? – Yuzingiz oqarib ketibdi–boshingiz aylanyaptimi?
examples.grammar: 'Your face has gone white' - Present Perfect 'has gone' o'zgarish natijasini bildiradi; 'white' sifat holatni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: I felt dizzy after I stood up too fast.
examples.uz: Men juda tez o'rnimdan turganimdan keyin boshim aylandi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple 'felt' va 'stood up'; 'after' vaqt ergash gapini boshlaydi; 'dizzy' sifat 'felt' bilan keladi.

defEn: relating to the main parts of something, not the details
defUz: tafsilotlarga emas, asosiy qismlarga oid, umumiy

examples.en: I read some books to get a general idea about diets.
examples.uz: Men dietalar haqida umumiy tasavvurga
examples.grammar: 'I read some books to get a general idea about diets' - Past Simple 'read', 'to get' maqsad infinitivi; 'a general idea' sifat + ot birikmasi.

examples.en: The teacher gave us a general idea of the new topic.
examples.uz: O'qituvchi bizga yangi mavzu haqida umumiy tasavvur berdi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple 'gave', 'a general idea' sifat + ot birikmasi artikl bilan keladi.

defEn: relating to medicine, doctors or treating illness
defUz: tibbiyot, shifokorlar yoki kasallikni davolashga oid, tibbiy

examples.en: Go and see a doctor at the medical centre.
examples.uz: Borib, tibbiy markazda shifokorga ko'rining.
examples.grammar: 'Go and see a doctor at the medical centre' - buyruq gap, 'go and see' ikki fe'lni bog'laydi; 'medical' sifat 'centre' otini aniqlaydi.

examples.en: She needs medical help because she feels very ill.
examples.uz: U o'zini juda yomon his qilgani uchun tibbiy yordamga muhtoj.
examples.grammar: Present Simple 'needs', 'because' sababni bildiruvchi bog'lovchi; 'medical' sifat otdan oldin keladi.

examples.en: That man needs medical care immediately.
examples.uz: Bu kishiga zudlik bilan tibbiy yordam kerak.
examples.grammar: 'That man needs medical care immediately' - Present Simple; 'medical' sifati otni aniqlaydi, 'immediately' ravishi vaqtni bildiradi.

examples.en: The village needs a new medical centre.
examples.uz: Qishloqqa yangi tibbiyot markazi kerak.
examples.grammar: 'The village needs a new medical centre' - Present Simple; 'medical' sifati 'centre' otini aniqlaydi.

defEn: usual, ordinary and expected
defUz: odatiy, kutilgandek, oddiy

examples.en: After so long in hospital, she just wants a normal life again.
examples.uz: Shifoxonada juda uzoq
examples.grammar: 'After so long in hospital, she just wants a normal life again' - Present Simple 'wants', 'after so long' vaqtni bildiradi; 'normal' sifat otni aniqlaydi.

examples.en: After the medicine, his temperature went back to normal.
examples.uz: Dorini ichgandan keyin uning harorati me'yorga qaytdi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple 'went back', 'after' vaqtni bildiruvchi predlog; 'to normal' holatni bildiradi.

defEn: happening again and again at the same times
defUz: bir xil vaqtlarda qayta-qayta sodir bo'ladigan, doimiy

examples.en: Take regular exercise
examples.uz: every two days at least. – Doimiy mashq qilib turing–hech bo'lmasa har
examples.grammar: 'Take regular exercise' - buyruq gap, fe'l bosh shaklda maslahat bildiradi; 'regular' sifat 'exercise' otini aniqlaydi.

examples.en: Regular sleep is important for good health.
examples.uz: Doimiy uyqu yaxshi sog'liq uchun muhim.
examples.grammar: Present Simple 'is', 'regular' sifat otdan oldin kelib uni aniqlaydi.

defEn: made without any sugar
defUz: tarkibida shakar bo'lmagan, shakardan holi

examples.en: What makes sugar-free drinks sweet?
examples.uz: Tarkibida shakar bo'lmagan ichimliklarni nima shirin
examples.grammar: 'What makes sugar-free drinks sweet?' - Present Simple so'roq gap, 'makes' uchinchi shaxs birlikda -s oladi; 'sugar-free' sifat otni aniqlaydi.

examples.en: I drink sugar-free tea because it is better for my teeth.
examples.uz: Men shakarsiz choy ichaman, chunki u tishlarim uchun foydaliroq.
examples.grammar: Present Simple 'drink', 'because' sababni bildiradi; 'sugar-free' sifat otdan oldin keladi.

defEn: in most cases, usually
defUz: ko'p hollarda, odatda, umuman olganda

examples.en: Generally, I eat healthily, but I like a burger now and then.
examples.uz: Umuman olganda, men sog'liqqa
examples.grammar: 'Generally, I eat healthily, but ...' - Present Simple, 'Generally' gap boshida ravish vazifasida; 'but' qarshilantiruvchi bog'lovchi.

examples.en: Generally, people feel better after some exercise.
examples.uz: Umuman olganda, odamlar biroz mashqdan keyin o'zlarini yaxshiroq his qilishadi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple 'feel', 'Generally' gap boshida ravish; 'after' vaqtni bildiruvchi predlog.

defEn: in the usual way, most of the time
defUz: odatdagidek, ko'pincha, odatda

examples.en: Normally, I don't like fish, but this is so tasty!
examples.uz: Odatda, menga baliq yoqmaydi, biroq bunisi juda
examples.grammar: 'Normally, I don't like fish, but this is so tasty!' - Present Simple inkor 'do not like'; 'Normally' ravish gap boshida; 'but' qarshilantiradi.

examples.en: I normally walk to school, but today I took the bus.
examples.uz: Men odatda maktabga piyoda boraman, lekin bugun avtobusda bordim.
examples.grammar: Present Simple 'walk' bilan Past Simple 'took' qo'shilgan; 'normally' takror ravishi; 'but' qarshilantiradi.

defEn: a good mix where no part is too much or too little
defUz: hech bir qismi ortiq yoki kam bo'lmagan yaxshi nisbat, muvozanat

examples.en: Try to keep a balance between work and relaxation.
examples.uz: Ish va dam olish o'rtasida me'yorni
examples.grammar: 'Try to keep a balance between work and relaxation' - buyruq gap, 'try to keep' tuzilmasi; 'between ... and ...' ikki narsa o'rtasidagi nisbatni bildiradi.

examples.en: A good balance of food and exercise keeps you healthy.
examples.uz: Ovqat va mashqning yaxshi muvozanati sizni sog'lom saqlaydi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple 'keeps', 'a good balance of' otli ibora; 'and' ikki otni bog'laydi.

defEn: having the right mix of different things
defUz: turli narsalarning to'g'ri nisbatiga ega bo'lgan, muvozanatlashtirilgan

examples.en: It's important to eat a balanced diet and exercise.
examples.uz: Me'yorlashtirilgan tarzda ovqatlanish va
examples.grammar: 'It's important to eat a balanced diet and exercise' - Present Simple, 'It is important to + fe'l' tuzilmasi; 'balanced' sifat otni aniqlaydi.

examples.en: She always eats a balanced meal with meat and vegetables.
examples.uz: U doim go'sht va sabzavotli muvozanatlashtirilgan taom yeydi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple 'eats', 'always' takror ravishi; 'balanced' sifat otdan oldin keladi.

defEn: a box, bottle or other object used to hold things
defUz: narsalarni saqlash uchun ishlatiladigan quti, idish yoki shisha

examples.en: Put any food that's left in a plastic container.
examples.uz: Qolib ketgan har qanday ovqatni plastik idishga
examples.grammar: 'Put any food that's left in a plastic container' - buyruq gap, 'that's left' sifatdosh ergash gapi otni aniqlaydi; 'in a plastic container' joyni bildiradi.

examples.en: I keep the fresh fruit in a clean container in the fridge.
examples.uz: Men yangi mevani muzlatgichdagi toza idishda saqlayman.
examples.grammar: Present Simple 'keep', 'in a clean container' joyni bildiruvchi predlogli ibora.

defEn: the strength and power that lets you do active things
defUz: faol ishlar qilish imkonini beruvchi kuch va quvvat, g'ayrat

examples.en: She's always full of energy.
examples.uz: U doimo g'ayratga to'la.
examples.grammar: 'She's always full of energy' - Present Simple, 'is full of' to'laligini bildiruvchi ibora; 'always' takror ravishi.

examples.en: Healthy food gives you energy for the whole day.
examples.uz: Sog'lom ovqat sizga butun kun uchun g'ayrat beradi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple 'gives', 'energy' sanab bo'lmaydigan ot artiklsiz keladi.

defEn: having a lot of energy and being very active
defUz: ko'p g'ayratga ega va juda faol, serg'ayrat

examples.en: I feel much more energetic since I started exercising.
examples.uz: Men mashq qilishni boshlaganimdan beri
examples.grammar: 'I feel much more energetic since I started exercising' - Present Simple 'feel', 'much more' qiyosiy darajani kuchaytiradi; 'since' vaqt boshini bildiradi.

examples.en: After a good breakfast, I always feel energetic.
examples.uz: Yaxshi nonushtadan keyin men doim o'zimni serg'ayrat his qilaman.
examples.grammar: Present Simple 'feel', 'after' vaqtni bildiradi; 'energetic' sifat 'feel' bilan keladi.

defEn: the condition of your body and how well it works
defUz: tananing ahvoli va uning qanchalik yaxshi ishlashi, sog'liq

examples.en: Her health gradually improved.
examples.uz: Uning sog'lig'i asta-sekin yaxshilandi.
examples.grammar: 'Her health gradually improved' - Past Simple 'improved', 'gradually' ravish asta-sekinlikni bildiradi; egalik olmoshi 'her'.

examples.en: Good food and sleep are important for your health.
examples.uz: Yaxshi ovqat va uyqu sog'lig'ingiz uchun muhim.
examples.grammar: Present Simple 'are' ko'plik ega bilan; 'health' sanab bo'lmaydigan ot egalik olmoshi 'your' bilan keladi.

examples.en: Regular exercise is good for your health.
examples.uz: Muntazam jismoniy mashqlar sog'lig'ingiz uchun
examples.grammar: 'Regular exercise is good for your health' - Present Simple; 'be good for' iborasi foydani, 'your' egalik olmoshini bildiradi.

examples.en: Eating fruit is good for your health.
examples.uz: Meva yeyish sog'lig'ingiz uchun foydali.
examples.grammar: 'Eating fruit is good for your health' - Present Simple; 'Eating' gerundiy ega vazifasini bajaradi.

defEn: good for your health, or not ill
defUz: sog'liq uchun foydali yoki kasal emas, sog'lom

examples.en: A salad is a very healthy meal.
examples.uz: Salat sog'liqqa juda foydali taomdir.
examples.grammar: 'A salad is a very healthy meal' - Present Simple, 'is' + artikl 'a' + sifat 'healthy' + ot 'meal' tuzilmasi.

examples.en: Fruit and vegetables are a healthy part of every meal.
examples.uz: Meva va sabzavotlar har bir taomning sog'lom qismidir.
examples.grammar: Present Simple 'are', 'healthy' sifat otni aniqlaydi; 'every meal' birlikda umumlashtiruvchi ma'no.

examples.en: The people are poor but healthy.
examples.uz: Odamlar qashshoq, lekin sog'lom.
examples.grammar: 'The people are poor but healthy' - Present Simple; 'but' bog'lovchisi qarama-qarshilikni, 'poor', 'healthy' sifatlarini bildiradi.

examples.en: Fresh food keeps the children healthy.
examples.uz: Yangi ovqat bolalarni sog'lom saqlaydi.
examples.grammar: 'Fresh food keeps the children healthy' - Present Simple; 'keep + someone + sifat' holatda saqlashni bildiradi.

defEn: bad for your health
defUz: sog'liq uchun zararli

examples.en: Burgers and chips every day is unhealthy.
examples.uz: Har kuni burger va chipslar yeyish sog'liqqa zararli.
examples.grammar: 'Burgers and chips every day is unhealthy' - Present Simple, 'is' + sifat 'unhealthy' holatni bildiradi; 'every day' takrorni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: Eating a lot of fast food is unhealthy for everyone.
examples.uz: Ko'p tez tayyor ovqat yeyish hamma uchun sog'liqqa zararli.
examples.grammar: Present Simple 'is', 'Eating a lot of fast food' gerundiy ega; 'unhealthy' sifat kesim qismida.

defEn: in a way that is good for your health
defUz: sog'liq uchun foydali tarzda

examples.en: I need to eat more healthily and lose some weight.
examples.uz: Men ko'proq sog'liqqa foydali tarzda
examples.grammar: 'I need to eat more healthily and lose some weight' - 'need to' majburiyatni bildiradi; 'more healthily' qiyosiy daraja ravishda; 'and lose' ikkinchi maqsadni qo'shadi.

examples.en: If you want to feel better, you should eat more healthily.
examples.uz: Agar o'zingizni yaxshiroq his qilmoqchi bo'lsangiz, sog'liqqa foydaliroq tarzda ovqatlanishingiz kerak.
examples.grammar: Shart mayli 'If', asosiy gapda 'should' modal fe'l; 'healthily' ravish fe'lni aniqlaydi.

examples.en: They live very healthily, working hard on their farms.
examples.uz: Ular tomorqalarida qattiq ishlab, sog'lom
examples.grammar: 'They live very healthily' - Present Simple; 'healthily' ravishi yashash tarzini, 'very' ravishi darajani bildiradi.

examples.en: If you eat healthily, you will feel better.
examples.uz: Agar sog'lom ovqatlansangiz, o'zingizni yaxshiroq his qilasiz.
examples.grammar: 'If you eat healthily' - shart mayli; 'If' shartni, 'will feel' natijani bildiradi.

defEn: in a way that is bad for your health
defUz: sog'liq uchun zararli tarzda

examples.en: If you eat so unhealthily, you'll start to gain weight.
examples.uz: Agar bu qadar sog'liqqa zararli tarzda
examples.grammar: 'If you eat so unhealthily, you'll start to gain weight' - shart mayli, 'If' shart gapi, asosiy gapda Future 'will'; 'unhealthily' ravish fe'lni aniqlaydi.

examples.en: He eats very unhealthily and never does any exercise.
examples.uz: U juda sog'liqqa zararli tarzda ovqatlanadi va hech qachon mashq qilmaydi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple 'eats' va 'does'; 'never' inkor ravishi; 'unhealthily' ravish fe'lni aniqlaydi.

defEn: going up a long way from the bottom to the top
defUz: pastdan tepaga uzoq ko'tariladigan, baland

examples.en: What's the highest mountain in the US?
examples.uz: AQShdagi eng baland tog' qaysi?
examples.grammar: 'What's the highest mountain in the US?' - Present Simple so'roq gap, 'the highest' orttirma daraja; 'in the US' joyni bildiradi.

examples.en: Eating too much salt can give you high blood pressure.
examples.uz: Juda ko'p tuz yeyish qon bosimini ko'tarib yuborishi mumkin.
examples.grammar: 'can' imkoniyatni bildiruvchi modal fe'l; 'high' sifat otni aniqlaydi.

defEn: the quality of being physically strong
defUz: jismonan kuchli bo'lish xususiyati, kuch

examples.en: Lifting weights will improve your strength.
examples.uz: Og'ir narsalar ko'tarish kuchingizni yaxshilaydi.
examples.grammar: 'Lifting weights will improve your strength' - Future 'will improve', 'Lifting weights' gerundiy ega; egalik olmoshi 'your'.

examples.en: Regular exercise builds strength in your arms and legs.
examples.uz: Doimiy mashq qo'l va oyoqlaringizdagi kuchni oshiradi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple 'builds', 'strength' sanab bo'lmaydigan ot artiklsiz keladi.

defEn: to make something stronger
defUz: biror narsani kuchliroq qilmoq, kuchaytirmoq

examples.en: Walking up and down the stairs will strengthen your legs.
examples.uz: Zinadan chiqib-tushish oyoqlaringizni
examples.grammar: 'Walking up and down the stairs will strengthen your legs' - Future 'will strengthen', 'Walking up and down' gerundiy ega; egalik olmoshi 'your'.

examples.en: Swimming helps to strengthen the muscles in your back.
examples.uz: Suzish belingizdagi mushaklarni kuchaytirishga yordam beradi.
examples.grammar: Present Simple 'helps', 'to strengthen' infinitiv maqsadni bildiradi; egalik olmoshi 'your'.

defEn: in a firm or powerful way
defUz: qattiq yoki kuchli tarzda, juda

examples.en: "I strongly advise you to do some exercise," the doctor said.
examples.uz: "Biroz jismoniy mashq qilishingizni
examples.grammar: 'I strongly advise you to do some exercise', the doctor said - Present Simple 'advise', 'strongly' ravish fe'lni kuchaytiradi; 'advise somebody to do' tuzilmasi.

examples.en: The doctor strongly told him to stop eating so much sugar.
examples.uz: Shifokor unga shuncha ko'p shakar yeyishni to'xtatishni qattiq tayinladi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple 'told', 'strongly' ravish fe'lni kuchaytiradi; 'tell somebody to do' tuzilmasi.

defEn: how heavy a person or thing is
defUz: odam yoki narsaning og'irligi, vazni

examples.en: What's the weight of your cat?
examples.uz: Mushugingizning vazni qanday?
examples.grammar: 'What's the weight of your cat?' - Present Simple so'roq gap, 'the weight of' otli ibora; egalik olmoshi 'your'.

examples.en: He lost a lot of weight after he changed his diet.
examples.uz: U parxezini o'zgartirgandan keyin ancha vazn yo'qotdi.
examples.grammar: Past Simple 'lost' va 'changed'; 'after' vaqt ergash gapini boshlaydi.

defEn: a computer program you use on a phone or tablet
defUz: telefon yoki planshetda ishlatiladigan kichik dastur

examples.en: This is an app for a smartphone that finds you a taxi.
examples.uz: Bu sizga taksi topib beradigan smartfon
examples.grammar: 'This is + an + ot' - 'an' artikli unli tovush bilan boshlanuvchi ot oldida kelgan; 'that finds you a taxi' - 'app' otini izohlovchi ergash gap.

examples.en: I downloaded a new app to learn English words every day.
examples.uz: Men har kuni inglizcha so'zlarni o'rganish uchun yangi ilova yukladim.
examples.grammar: 'downloaded' - Past Simple zamonidagi fe'l; 'to learn' - infinitiv maqsadni bildiradi.

defEn: a piece of writing in a newspaper, magazine or website
defUz: gazeta, jurnal yoki saytdagi yozma matn

examples.en: I read an article in a magazine about laptops.
examples.uz: Men bir jurnalda noutbuklar haqida maqola
examples.grammar: 'read an article' - Past Simple zamonida; 'an' artikli 'article' oldida unli tovush sababli; 'in a magazine' va 'about laptops' - predloglar bilan tuzilgan.

examples.en: She wrote an interesting article about new phones for the school website.
examples.uz: U maktab sayti uchun yangi telefonlar haqida qiziqarli maqola yozdi.
examples.grammar: 'wrote' - Past Simple; 'about' va 'for' - predloglar; 'an interesting article' - sifat + ot birikmasi.

defEn: a TV station that shows programmes
defUz: ko'rsatuvlar namoyish etadigan telekanal

examples.en: Can you change the channel? I don't want to watch this.
examples.uz: Kanalni o'zgartira olasizmi? Buni
examples.grammar: 'Can you change ...?' - 'Can' modal fe'li bilan tuzilgan so'roq gap; 'I don't want to watch' - Present Simple inkor shakli, 'to watch' infinitivi bilan.

examples.en: This channel shows a good film every Friday evening.
examples.uz: Bu kanal har juma oqshomi yaxshi film ko'rsatadi.
examples.grammar: 'shows' - Present Simple, uchinchi shaxs birlikda '-s' qo'shimchasi; 'every Friday evening' - takrorlanishni bildiruvchi vaqt holi.

defEn: a film or TV programme about real life and facts
defUz: haqiqiy hayot va faktlar haqidagi film yoki ko'rsatuv

examples.en: I saw a documentary about future technology.
examples.uz: Men kelajak texnologiyasi to'g'risida bir hujjatli
examples.grammar: 'saw a documentary' - Past Simple zamonida; 'a' artikli birlikdagi ot oldida; 'about future technology' - predlog bilan tuzilgan ergash holat.

examples.en: We watched a documentary about computers in our history class.
examples.uz: Biz tarix darsimizda kompyuterlar haqida hujjatli film tomosha qildik.
examples.grammar: 'watched' - Past Simple; 'a documentary' - birlikdagi ot artikl bilan; 'about' va 'in' - predloglar.

defEn: a small round mark, used in website and email addresses
defUz: sayt va email manzillarida ishlatiladigan kichik nuqta

examples.en: The company website is K-L-M dot R-U.
examples.uz: Kompaniya vebsayti K-L-M nuqta R-U.
examples.grammar: 'The company website is ...' - Present Simple zamonida 'to be' fe'lining 'is' shakli bilan tuzilgan darak gap; 'dot' bu yerda manzilning ko'rinishini bildiradi.

examples.en: Type your name, then a dot, and then the company name.
examples.uz: Avval ismingizni, keyin nuqtani, so'ng kompaniya nomini yozing.
examples.grammar: 'Type' - buyruq gap (imperative); 'then' - ketma-ketlikni bildiruvchi bog'lovchi; 'a dot' - birlikdagi ot artikl bilan.

uz: quloqning ichiga kiradigan/quloqning ustidan taqiladigan quloqchin 81                                                                   @destination_vocabulary
defEn: a device you wear on or in your ears to listen to sound
defUz: tovushni eshitish uchun quloqqa taqiladigan qurilma

examples.en: She can't hear you as she's wearing headphones.
examples.uz: U sizni eshitmaydi chunki qulog'ining ustidan
examples.grammar: 'She can't hear you' - 'can' modal fe'lining inkor shakli 'can't'; 'as she's wearing headphones' - 'as' bog'lovchisi sababni bildiradi, 'is wearing' esa Present Continuous.

examples.en: I put on my headphones to listen to music on the bus.
examples.uz: Men avtobusda musiqa tinglash uchun quloqchinlarimni taqib oldim.
examples.grammar: 'put on' - phrasal fe'l (kiymoq, taqmoq); 'to listen' - infinitiv maqsadni bildiradi; 'on the bus' - predlogli holat.

defEn: a message sent from one computer or phone to another
defUz: bir kompyuter yoki telefondan boshqasiga yuboriladigan xabar

examples.en: Send me an email with details of the party.
examples.uz: Menga bazmning tafsilotlari bilan email jo'nating.
examples.grammar: 'Send me an email' - buyruq gap (imperative); 'me' - vositali to'ldiruvchi; 'with details of the party' - 'with' va 'of' predloglari bilan tuzilgan birikma.

examples.en: I get a lot of emails from my teacher every week.
examples.uz: Men har hafta o'qituvchimdan ko'plab email olaman.
examples.grammar: 'get' - Present Simple; 'emails' - ko'plik shakli; 'from' - predlog; 'every week' - takrorlanishni bildiruvchi vaqt holi.

defEn: one part of a TV or radio series
defUz: teleserial yoki radioturkumning bir qismi

examples.en: I can't come out tonight
examples.uz: the final episode of my favourite show's on. – Bugun oqshomda
examples.grammar: 'I can't come out tonight' - 'can' modal fe'lining inkor shakli bilan tuzilgan; 'tonight' - vaqt holi; gap so'zlashuv uslubida tugatilmagan holda berilgan.

examples.en: The last episode of the show was very exciting.
examples.uz: Ko'rsatuvning oxirgi qismi juda qiziqarli edi.
examples.grammar: 'was' - Past Simple, 'to be' fe'lining o'tgan zamon shakli; 'the last episode' - 'the' aniq artikli bilan; 'very' - ravish sifatni kuchaytiradi.

defEn: facts or details about something
defUz: biror narsa haqidagi faktlar yoki tafsilotlar

examples.en: The article had some great information about new apps.
examples.uz: Maqolada yangi mobil ilovalar haqida
examples.grammar: 'The article had some great information' - Past Simple zamonida; 'some' sanalmaydigan ot oldida ishlatilgan; 'information' sanalmaydigan ot, ko'plik shakli yo'q.

examples.en: I found useful information about laptops on this website.
examples.uz: Men bu saytdan noutbuklar haqida foydali ma'lumot topdim.
examples.grammar: 'found' - Past Simple (find fe'lining noto'g'ri shakli); 'information' sanalmaydigan ot, artiklsiz; 'about' va 'on' - predloglar.

defEn: the part of a computer with keys for typing
defUz: kompyuterning yozish uchun tugmali qismi

examples.en: I spilled juice on the keyboard and now the keys stick.
examples.uz: Men klaviatura ustiga sharbat to'kib
examples.grammar: 'I spilled juice on the keyboard' - Past Simple zamonida; 'on' - predlog; 'now the keys stick' - Present Simple, 'now' vaqt holi bilan natijani bildiradi.

examples.en: My new keyboard is quiet and easy to use.
examples.uz: Yangi klaviaturam tinch va ishlatishga oson.
examples.grammar: 'is' - Present Simple, 'to be' fe'li; 'quiet and easy' - 'and' bog'lovchisi bilan ulangan ikki sifat; 'to use' - infinitiv.

defEn: a small computer you can carry with you
defUz: o'zingiz bilan ko'tarib yura oladigan kichik kompyuter

examples.en: A laptop is good because you can carry it around.
examples.uz: Noutbuk yaxshi chunki uni ko'tarib yura
examples.grammar: 'A laptop is good' - Present Simple, 'a' artikli umumiy ma'noda; 'because you can carry it around' - 'because' bog'lovchisi sababni, 'can' modal fe'li imkoniyatni bildiradi.

examples.en: She bought a new laptop for her online classes.
examples.uz: U onlayn darslari uchun yangi noutbuk sotib oldi.
examples.grammar: 'bought' - Past Simple (buy fe'lining noto'g'ri shakli); 'a new laptop' - sifat + ot; 'for' - predlog maqsadni bildiradi.

defEn: the part of a computer that stores information
defUz: kompyuterning ma'lumotni saqlaydigan qismi

examples.en: My new computer has 500 GB of memory.
examples.uz: Yangi kompyuterim 500 GB xotiraga ega.
examples.grammar: 'My new computer has 500 GB of memory' - Present Simple, 'has' uchinchi shaxs birlikda; 'of memory' - 'of' predlogi miqdorni bildiradi.

examples.en: This phone has a lot of memory for photos and videos.
examples.uz: Bu telefonda rasm va videolar uchun ko'p xotira bor.
examples.grammar: 'has' - Present Simple, uchinchi shaxs birlik; 'a lot of' - ko'plikni bildiruvchi miqdor ifodasi; 'for' - predlog.

defEn: a phone you can carry and use anywhere
defUz: har joyda ko'tarib ishlatish mumkin bo'lgan telefon

examples.en: I dropped my mobile in the water and it won't turn on.
examples.uz: Qo'l telefonimni suvga tushirib
examples.grammar: 'I dropped my mobile in the water' - Past Simple; 'in' - predlog; 'it won't turn on' - Future inkor shakli ('will not' = 'won't'), 'turn on' phrasal fe'li bilan.

examples.en: I use my mobile to call my friends and read the news.
examples.uz: Men do'stlarimga qo'ng'iroq qilish va yangiliklarni o'qish uchun qo'l telefonimdan foydalanaman.
examples.grammar: 'use' - Present Simple; 'to call' va 'read' - infinitivlar maqsadni bildiradi; 'and' - bog'lovchi.

defEn: a small device you move to control a computer
defUz: kompyuterni boshqarish uchun harakatlantiriladigan kichik qurilma

examples.en: This mouse isn't working
examples.uz: nothing happened when I clicked. – Bu sichqoncha ishlamayapti–
examples.grammar: 'This mouse isn't working' - Present Continuous inkor shakli ('is not' = 'isn't'); 'This' - ko'rsatish olmoshi 'mouse' otini aniqlaydi.

examples.en: I clicked the mouse twice to open the program.
examples.uz: Men dasturni ochish uchun sichqonchani ikki marta bosdim.
examples.grammar: 'clicked' - Past Simple; 'twice' - takror miqdorini bildiruvchi ravish; 'to open' - infinitiv maqsadni bildiradi.

defEn: a computer for one person at home or at work
defUz: uyda yoki ishda bir kishi uchun mo'ljallangan kompyuter

examples.en: I opened the tower of my PC to clean it.
examples.uz: Men shaxsiy kompyuterimning ma'lumotlar
examples.grammar: 'I opened the tower of my PC' - Past Simple; 'the tower of my PC' - 'of' predlogi egalikni bildiradi; 'to clean it' - infinitiv maqsadni bildiradi.

examples.en: My old PC is slow, so I want to buy a new one.
examples.uz: Eski shaxsiy kompyuterim sekin, shuning uchun yangisini sotib olmoqchiman.
examples.grammar: 'is' - Present Simple; 'so' - natijani bildiruvchi bog'lovchi; 'want to buy' - 'want' + infinitiv qurilmasi.

defEn: a set of instructions that tells a computer what to do
defUz: kompyuterga nima qilishni aytadigan ko'rsatmalar to'plami

examples.en: He writes programs for a software company.
examples.uz: U dasturiy ta'minot kompaniyasi uchun dasturlar
examples.grammar: 'He writes programs for a software company' - Present Simple, 'writes' uchinchi shaxs birlikda '-s' bilan; 'programs' - ko'plik; 'for' - predlog.

examples.en: This program helps me to write and save my homework.
examples.uz: Bu dastur menga uy vazifamni yozish va saqlashga yordam beradi.
examples.grammar: 'helps' - Present Simple, uchinchi shaxs birlik; 'to write and save' - 'and' bog'lovchisi bilan ulangan infinitivlar.

defEn: a show on TV or radio
defUz: televizor yoki radiodagi ko'rsatuv

examples.en: There's a great programme on TV tonight.
examples.uz: Bugun oqshomda televizorda ajoyib teledastur
examples.grammar: 'There's a great programme on TV tonight' - 'There is' (= 'There's) qurilmasi narsa borligini bildiradi; 'a' artikli birlikda; 'on TV' va 'tonight' - holatlar.

examples.en: My favourite programme starts at eight o'clock.
examples.uz: Mening sevimli ko'rsatuvim soat sakkizda boshlanadi.
examples.grammar: 'starts' - Present Simple, uchinchi shaxs birlik; 'at eight o'clock' - 'at' predlogi aniq vaqtni bildiradi.

defEn: a phone that works like a small computer
defUz: kichik kompyuter kabi ishlaydigan telefon

examples.en: He uses his smartphone for surfing the net and sending messages.
examples.uz: U smartfonidan internetda
