examples.grammar: 'He uses his smartphone for surfing the net' - Present Simple, 'uses' uchinchi shaxs birlikda; 'for surfing' - 'for' predlogi + gerund (-ing) shakli.

examples.en: I use my smartphone to take photos and send messages.
examples.uz: Men rasmga olish va xabar yuborish uchun smartfonimdan foydalanaman.
examples.grammar: 'use' - Present Simple; 'to take' va 'send' - infinitivlar maqsadni bildiradi; 'and' - bog'lovchi.

defEn: the flat part of a device that shows pictures and text
defUz: qurilmaning rasm va matnni ko'rsatadigan tekis qismi

examples.en: The TV screen has a big crack in it!
examples.uz: Televizor ekranida katta siniq bor!
examples.grammar: 'The TV screen has a big crack in it' - Present Simple, 'has' uchinchi shaxs birlikda; 'a big crack' - sifat + ot birikmasi; 'in it' - predlogli holat.

examples.en: The phone screen is too small to read long articles.
examples.uz: Telefon ekrani uzun maqolalarni o'qish uchun juda kichik.
examples.grammar: 'is' - Present Simple; 'too small' - 'too' + sifat ortiqchalikni bildiradi; 'to read' - infinitiv.

defEn: a TV or radio story shown in many parts
defUz: ko'p qismlarda namoyish etiladigan tele yoki radio hikoya

examples.en: I watch TV serial every Tuesday night.
examples.uz: Men har seshanba tunida teleserial tomosha qilaman.
examples.grammar: 'I watch TV serial every Tuesday night' - Present Simple, odatiy harakatni bildiradi; 'every Tuesday night' - takrorlanishni bildiruvchi vaqt holi.

examples.en: My sister watches a new serial on her tablet every evening.
examples.uz: Singlim har oqshom planshetida yangi serial tomosha qiladi.
examples.grammar: 'watches' - Present Simple, uchinchi shaxs birlikda '-es' bilan; 'every evening' - takrorlanish holi; 'on' - predlog.

defEn: the radio waves that let a phone work
defUz: telefon ishlashi uchun zarur radioto'lqinlar

examples.en: Have you got a strong signal on your mobile?
examples.uz: Qo'l telefoningizda kuchli signal bormi?
examples.grammar: 'Have you got a strong signal ...?' - 'have got' qurilmasi bilan tuzilgan so'roq gap, egalikni bildiradi; 'a strong signal' - sifat + ot birikmasi.

examples.en: There is no signal here, so I cannot make a call.
examples.uz: Bu yerda signal yo'q, shuning uchun qo'ng'iroq qila olmayman.
examples.grammar: 'There is no' - narsa yo'qligini bildiradi; 'so' - natija bog'lovchisi; 'cannot' - 'can' modal fe'lining inkor shakli.

defEn: a small flat computer with a touch screen
defUz: sensorli ekranli kichik yassi kompyuter

examples.en: Tablets are better than laptops because you can hold them in one hand.
examples.uz: Planshetlar
examples.grammar: 'Tablets are better than laptops' - qiyosiy daraja ('better than'); 'because you can hold them in one hand' - 'because' bog'lovchisi, 'can' modal fe'li bilan.

examples.en: I read books and watch films on my tablet.
examples.uz: Men planshetimda kitob o'qiyman va film ko'raman.
examples.grammar: 'read' va 'watch' - Present Simple; 'and' - bog'lovchi; 'on' - predlog joyni bildiradi.

defEn: a short written message sent from a phone
defUz: telefondan yuboriladigan qisqa yozma xabar

examples.en: Jimmy sent the text message to my old mobile.
examples.uz: Jimi yozuvli xabarni eski qo'l telefonimga
examples.grammar: 'Jimmy sent the text message to my old mobile' - Past Simple; 'the' aniq artikli; 'to my old mobile' - 'to' predlogi yo'nalishni bildiradi.

examples.en: I sent her a text message to say happy birthday.
examples.uz: Men unga tug'ilgan kun muborak deyish uchun yozuvli xabar jo'natdim.
examples.grammar: 'sent' - Past Simple; 'to say' - infinitiv maqsadni bildiradi; 'a text message' - birlikdagi ot artikl bilan.

defEn: a place on the internet with pages you can visit
defUz: internetda tashrif buyurish mumkin bo'lgan sahifalarga ega joy

examples.en: The website has 10,000 visitors a day.
examples.uz: Ushbu sayt kuniga 10,000 tashrif buyuruvchiga ega (=
examples.grammar: 'The website has 10,000 visitors a day' - Present Simple, 'has' uchinchi shaxs birlikda; 'a day' - 'kuniga' ma'nosida chastotani bildiradi.

examples.en: This website has a lot of free games for children.
examples.uz: Bu saytda bolalar uchun ko'plab bepul o'yinlar bor.
examples.grammar: 'has' - Present Simple, uchinchi shaxs birlik; 'a lot of' - ko'plikni bildiruvchi miqdor; 'for' - predlog.

defEn: to put electricity into a phone or battery
defUz: telefon yoki batareyaga quvvat to'ldirmoq

examples.en: I need to charge my phone
examples.uz: it's got no battery left. – Men telefonimni zaryadlashim zarur–
examples.grammar: 'I need to charge my phone' - 'need to' + infinitiv qurilmasi zaruratni bildiradi; gap so'zlashuv uslubida sabab qismi bilan davom etadi.

examples.en: I always charge my phone before I go to bed.
examples.uz: Men har doim uxlashdan oldin telefonimni zaryadlayman.
examples.grammar: 'charge' - Present Simple; 'always' - chastota ravishi; 'before' - vaqt bog'lovchisi ergash gapni kiritadi.

defEn: to press a button on a computer mouse
defUz: kompyuter sichqonchasidagi tugmani bosmoq

examples.en: Click on the icon to open the file.
examples.uz: Faylni ochish uchun belgining ustiga bosing.
examples.grammar: 'Click on the icon to open the file' - buyruq gap (imperative); 'on' - predlog; 'to open the file' - infinitiv maqsadni bildiradi.

examples.en: Click the green button to start the program.
examples.uz: Dasturni boshlash uchun yashil tugmani bosing.
examples.grammar: 'Click' - buyruq gap (imperative); 'to start' - infinitiv maqsadni bildiradi; 'the green button' - sifat + ot artikl bilan.

defEn: to call, write to or speak to someone
defUz: biror kishiga qo'ng'iroq qilmoq, yozmoq yoki gaplashmoq

examples.en: You need to contact your mother
examples.uz: she called twice. – Onangiz bilan bog'lanishingiz lozim–ikki
examples.grammar: 'You need to contact your mother' - 'need to' + infinitiv qurilmasi zaruratni bildiradi; gap so'zlashuv uslubida sabab qismi bilan davom etadi.

examples.en: Please contact me by email if you have a question.
examples.uz: Savolingiz bo'lsa, iltimos, men bilan email orqali bog'laning.
examples.grammar: 'contact' - buyruq gap (imperative); 'by' - predlog vositani bildiradi; 'if you have' - 'if' shart mayli ergash gapni kiritadi.

defEn: to remove something from a computer or phone
defUz: biror narsani kompyuter yoki telefondan o'chirmoq

examples.en: If you deleted the file recently, it'll still be in the recycling bin.
examples.uz: Agar faylni yaqinda o'chirgan
examples.grammar: 'If you deleted the file recently, it'll still be in the recycling bin' - 'If' shart mayli; 'it'll' = 'it will' Future shakli; 'recently' va 'still' - vaqt ravishlari.

examples.en: I deleted all the old photos to save some space.
examples.uz: Men joy bo'shatish uchun barcha eski rasmlarni o'chirdim.
examples.grammar: 'deleted' - Past Simple; 'all the old photos' - 'all' + sifat + ot; 'to save' - infinitiv maqsadni bildiradi.

defEn: to copy a file from the internet to your device
defUz: faylni internetdan qurilmangizga ko'chirib olmoq

examples.en: He's downloading a program from the Internet.
examples.uz: U internetdan bir dastur yuklamoqda.
examples.grammar: 'He's downloading a program from the Internet' - Present Continuous ('is downloading'); 'from' - predlog manbani bildiradi; 'a program' - birlikdagi ot artikl bilan.

examples.en: I want to download a new game on my phone tonight.
examples.uz: Men bugun oqshom telefonimga yangi o'yin yuklab olmoqchiman.
examples.grammar: 'want to download' - 'want' + infinitiv; 'on' - predlog; 'tonight' - vaqt holi.

defEn: to call someone using a telephone
defUz: telefon orqali biror kishiga qo'ng'iroq qilmoq

examples.en: Jim phoned me on my mobile.
examples.uz: Jim uyali telefonimga qo'ng'iroq qildi.
examples.grammar: 'Jim phoned me on my mobile' - Past Simple; 'me' - to'ldiruvchi olmosh; 'on my mobile' - 'on' predlogi vositani bildiradi.

examples.en: I will phone you when I get home from school.
examples.uz: Maktabdan uyga kelganimda senga qo'ng'iroq qilaman.
examples.grammar: 'will phone' - Future ('will' bilan); 'when' - vaqt bog'lovchisi ergash gapni kiritadi; 'get home' - so'zlashuv iborasi.

defEn: to answer someone by speaking or writing
defUz: biror kishiga gapirib yoki yozib javob bermoq

examples.en: I sent her a message but she didn't reply.
examples.uz: Men unga xabar jo'natdim, biroq u javob qaytarmadi.
examples.grammar: 'I sent her a message but she didn't reply' - Past Simple; 'but' - zidlovchi bog'lovchi; 'didn't reply' - Past Simple inkor shakli.

examples.en: She always replies to my emails very quickly.
examples.uz: U har doim emaillarimga juda tez javob qaytaradi.
examples.grammar: 'replies' - Present Simple, uchinchi shaxs birlikda '-es' bilan; 'always' - chastota ravishi; 'to' - predlog; 'very quickly' - ravish.

uz: saqlab qo'ymoq · saqlab qolmoq, asrab qolmoq, qutqarmoq
defEn: to keep a file on a computer or device
defUz: faylni kompyuter yoki qurilmada saqlab qo'ymoq

examples.en: Save any files on a memory stick too.
examples.uz: Har qanday faylni xotira kartasiga (= fleshkaga) ham
examples.grammar: 'Save any files on a memory stick too' - buyruq gap (imperative); 'any' - sanalmaydigan yoki ko'plik ot oldida; 'on' - predlog; 'too' - 'ham' ma'nosida.

examples.en: Don't forget to save your work before you turn off the computer.
examples.uz: Kompyuterni o'chirishdan oldin ishingizni saqlashni unutmang.
examples.grammar: 'Don't forget' - buyruq gap inkor shakli; 'to save' - infinitiv; 'before' - vaqt bog'lovchisi ergash gapni kiritadi.

examples.en: We saved the girl from the water.
examples.uz: Biz qizaloqni suvdan qutqarib qoldik.
examples.grammar: 'We saved the girl from the water' - Past Simple; 'save ... from' tuzilmasi xavfdan qutqarishni bildiradi.

examples.en: The firefighters saved the family from the fire.
examples.uz: O't o'chiruvchilar oilani yong'indan qutqardi.
examples.grammar: 'The firefighters saved' - Past Simple; 'from' predlogi xavf manbasini bildiradi.

uz: onlayn efirga uzatmoq, onlayn translatsiya qilmoq
defEn: to watch or listen to something online without downloading it
defUz: biror narsani yuklab olmasdan onlayn ko'rmoq yoki tinglamoq

examples.en: This website streams TV programmes from all over the world.
examples.uz: Ushbu sayt butun dunyo bo'ylab
examples.grammar: 'This website streams TV programmes from all over the world' - Present Simple, 'streams' uchinchi shaxs birlikda '-s' bilan; 'from all over the world' - predlogli holat.

examples.en: We stream films on our TV every weekend.
examples.uz: Biz har dam olish kunida televizorimizda filmlarni onlayn ko'ramiz.
examples.grammar: 'stream' - Present Simple; 'on' - predlog; 'every weekend' - takrorlanishni bildiruvchi vaqt holi.

defEn: to send a short written message from a phone
defUz: telefondan qisqa yozma xabar jo'natmoq

examples.en: He texted his best friend, asking him to cover.
examples.uz: U eng yaxshi do'stiga xabar jo'natib, biror
examples.grammar: 'He texted his best friend, asking him to cover' - Past Simple; 'asking' - ravishdosh (-ing) qo'shimcha harakatni bildiradi; 'to cover' - infinitiv.

examples.en: I texted my mum to say I would be late.
examples.uz: Men onamga kech qolishimni aytish uchun yozuvli xabar jo'natdim.
examples.grammar: 'texted' - Past Simple; 'to say' - infinitiv maqsadni bildiradi; 'would be' - kelajakni o'tgan zamondan ifodalaydi.

defEn: to send a file from your device to the internet
defUz: faylni qurilmangizdan internetga jo'natmoq

examples.en: I uploaded a new picture onto my profile page.
examples.uz: Men profilimga yangi rasm yukladim.
examples.grammar: 'I uploaded a new picture onto my profile page' - Past Simple; 'onto' - predlog yo'nalishni bildiradi; 'a new picture' - sifat + ot artikl bilan.

examples.en: She uploaded her holiday photos to the website.
examples.uz: U ta'tildagi rasmlarini saytga yukladi.
examples.grammar: 'uploaded' - Past Simple; 'to' - predlog yo'nalishni bildiradi; 'her holiday photos' - egalik olmoshi + ot.

defEn: to do something with a tool, machine or object
defUz: biror asbob, mashina yoki narsa bilan ish bajarmoq

examples.en: Most people use a computer for the job nowadays.
examples.uz: Ko'pchilik odamlar hozirgi kunda
examples.grammar: 'Most people use a computer for the job nowadays' - Present Simple, odatiy harakat; 'for the job' - predlog maqsadni bildiradi; 'nowadays' - vaqt ravishi.

examples.en: Many students use a laptop to do their homework.
examples.uz: Ko'plab o'quvchilar uy vazifasini bajarish uchun noutbukdan foydalanadi.
examples.grammar: 'use' - Present Simple; 'to do' - infinitiv maqsadni bildiradi; 'their homework' - egalik olmoshi + ot.

defEn: to write information in the spaces on a form
defUz: anketadagi bo'sh joylarga ma'lumot yozmoq

examples.en: You have to fill in a form online to join the course.
examples.uz: Kursga qo'shilish uchun internetda bir
examples.grammar: 'You have to fill in a form online to join the course' - 'have to' zaruratni bildiradi; 'fill in' - phrasal fe'l; 'to join' - infinitiv maqsadni bildiradi.

examples.en: Please fill in your name and email on this page.
examples.uz: Iltimos, bu sahifaga ismingiz va emailingizni to'ldiring.
examples.grammar: 'fill in' - buyruq gapdagi phrasal fe'l; 'and' - bog'lovchi; 'on this page' - predlogli holat.

defEn: to stop a machine or light from working
defUz: mashina yoki chiroqni ishlashdan to'xtatmoq

examples.en: Turn off the computer
examples.uz: time for bed! – Kompyuterni o'chiring–uyqu vaqti bo'ldi!
examples.grammar: 'Turn off the computer' - buyruq gap (imperative); 'turn off' - phrasal fe'l; gap so'zlashuv uslubida sabab qismi bilan davom etadi.

examples.en: Please turn off the TV before you go to sleep.
examples.uz: Iltimos, uxlashga ketishdan oldin televizorni o'chiring.
examples.grammar: 'turn off' - buyruq gapdagi phrasal fe'l; 'before' - vaqt bog'lovchisi ergash gapni kiritadi.

defEn: to make a machine or light start working
defUz: mashina yoki chiroqni ishlashga keltirmoq

examples.en: Switch on the TV
examples.uz: it's time for my show! – Televizorni yoqing–mening ko'rsatuvimning vaqti
examples.grammar: 'Switch on the TV' - buyruq gap (imperative); 'switch on' - phrasal fe'l; gap so'zlashuv uslubida sabab qismi bilan davom etadi.

examples.en: I turned on the computer and opened my email.
examples.uz: Men kompyuterni yoqdim va emailimni ochdim.
examples.grammar: 'turned on' - Past Simple phrasal fe'l; 'and' - bog'lovchi; 'opened' - Past Simple.

defEn: to make a sound or volume louder
defUz: tovush yoki ovozni balandroq qilmoq

examples.en: Can you turn the TV up
examples.uz: I can't hear a thing. – Televizorni ovozini balandlata olasizmi–bironta
examples.grammar: 'Can you turn the TV up' - 'Can' modal fe'li bilan tuzilgan so'roq gap; 'turn ... up' - phrasal fe'l, to'ldiruvchi orasiga joylashgan.

examples.en: Can you turn up the music? I really like this song.
examples.uz: Musiqaning ovozini balandlata olasizmi? Bu qo'shiq menga juda yoqadi.
examples.grammar: 'Can you ...?' - 'can' modal fe'li bilan so'roq gap; 'turn up' - phrasal fe'l; 'really' - ravish fe'lni kuchaytiradi.

defEn: to make a sound or volume quieter
defUz: tovush yoki ovozni pastroq qilmoq

examples.en: Turn that music down! I've got a headache!
examples.uz: Musiqaning ovozini pasaytiring! Boshim og'riyapti!
examples.grammar: 'Turn that music down!' - buyruq gap (imperative); 'turn ... down' - phrasal fe'l, to'ldiruvchi orasiga joylashgan; 'I've got a headache' - 'have got' egalikni bildiradi.

examples.en: Please turn down the TV because the baby is sleeping.
examples.uz: Iltimos, televizorning ovozini pasaytiring, chunki chaqaloq uxlayapti.
examples.grammar: 'turn down' - buyruq gapdagi phrasal fe'l; 'because' - sabab bog'lovchisi; 'is sleeping' - Present Continuous.

defEn: to keep talking to or writing to someone over time
defUz: vaqt o'tishi bilan biror kishi bilan aloqani saqlab turmoq

examples.en: Text messages make it easier to keep in touch with my friends.
examples.uz: Yozuvli xabarlar do'stlarim bilan
examples.grammar: 'Text messages make it easier to keep in touch with my friends' - 'make + it + sifat' qurilmasi; 'to keep in touch' - infinitiv ibora; 'with' - predlog.

examples.en: I keep in touch with my old friends by email.
examples.uz: Men eski do'stlarim bilan email orqali aloqada bo'lib turaman.
examples.grammar: 'keep in touch' - Present Simple iborasi; 'with' va 'by' - predloglar vosita va aloqani bildiradi.

defEn: to use or connect to the internet
defUz: internetdan foydalanmoq yoki unga ulanmoq

examples.en: She went online to check her emails.
examples.uz: U emaillarini tekshirish uchun internetga kirdi.
examples.grammar: 'She went online to check her emails' - Past Simple ('went'); 'go online' - ibora; 'to check' - infinitiv maqsadni bildiradi.

examples.en: I go online every morning to read the news.
examples.uz: Men har kuni ertalab yangiliklarni o'qish uchun internetga kiraman.
examples.grammar: 'go online' - Present Simple iborasi; 'every morning' - takrorlanish holi; 'to read' - infinitiv maqsadni bildiradi.

defEn: to talk to someone on the internet by typing messages
defUz: internetda xabarlar yozish orqali biror kishi bilan suhbatlashmoq

examples.en: They chatted online for months before meeting.
examples.uz: Ular uchrashishlaridan avval oylab vaqt
examples.grammar: 'They chatted online for months before meeting' - Past Simple; 'for months' - davomiylik holi; 'before meeting' - 'before' + gerund (-ing) qurilmasi.

examples.en: We chat online every evening after school.
examples.uz: Biz har oqshom maktabdan keyin internetda suhbatlashamiz.
examples.grammar: 'chat' - Present Simple iborasi; 'every evening' - takrorlanish holi; 'after' - vaqt predlogi.

uz: elektron pochtasini tekshirmoq: yangi xabarlarni o'qimoq
defEn: to look at the new messages in your email
defUz: emailingizdagi yangi xabarlarni ko'rib chiqmoq

examples.en: You didn't send me anything
examples.uz: I checked my email a minute ago. – Siz menga hech narsa
examples.grammar: 'You didn't send me anything' - Past Simple inkor shakli; 'me' - to'ldiruvchi; gap so'zlashuv uslubida ikkinchi qism bilan davom etadi.

examples.en: I check my email every morning before work.
examples.uz: Men har kuni ertalab ishdan oldin emailimni tekshiraman.
examples.grammar: 'check' - Present Simple iborasi; 'every morning' - takrorlanish holi; 'before' - vaqt predlogi.

defEn: to receive or send a short written phone message
defUz: qisqa yozma telefon xabarini olmoq yoki jo'natmoq

examples.en: Paul got a text message from his mother telling him to come home.
examples.uz: Po'l onasidan uyga kelishi
examples.grammar: 'Paul got a text message from his mother telling him to come home' - Past Simple; 'from' - predlog manbani bildiradi; 'telling him to come' - sifatdosh qurilmasi.

examples.en: I sent a text message to my friend about the party.
examples.uz: Men do'stimga bazm haqida yozuvli xabar jo'natdim.
examples.grammar: 'sent' - Past Simple; 'to' va 'about' - predloglar; 'a text message' - birlikdagi ot artikl bilan.

uz: biror narsa haqida o'rganmoq, bilib olmoq
defEn: to get knowledge about a subject
defUz: biror mavzu haqida bilim olmoq

examples.en: I learned about computers from my older brother.
examples.uz: Men akamdan kompyuterlar haqida
examples.grammar: 'I learned about computers from my older brother' - Past Simple; 'learn about' - ibora; 'from' - predlog manbani bildiradi; 'older' - qiyosiy daraja.

examples.en: We learn about new technology in our science class.
examples.uz: Biz fan darsimizda yangi texnologiya haqida o'rganamiz.
examples.grammar: 'learn about' - Present Simple iborasi; 'in' - predlog joyni bildiradi; 'our science class' - egalik olmoshi + ot.

defEn: to try to find someone or something
defUz: biror kishi yoki narsani topishga urinmoq

examples.en: I'm looking for Harriet
examples.uz: have you seen her? – Men Hariyetni qidiryapman–uni ko'rdingizmi?
examples.grammar: 'I'm looking for Harriet' - Present Continuous ('am looking'); 'look for' - phrasal fe'l; gap so'zlashuv uslubida so'roq qismi bilan davom etadi.

examples.en: I am looking for a cheap phone on this website.
examples.uz: Men bu saytdan arzon telefon qidiryapman.
examples.grammar: 'am looking for' - Present Continuous phrasal fe'l; 'a cheap phone' - sifat + ot; 'on' - predlog.

defEn: talking to someone using a telephone
defUz: telefon orqali biror kishi bilan gaplashayotgan

examples.en: I talk to my grandma on the phone every week.
examples.uz: Men har hafta buvim bilan telefonda
examples.grammar: 'I talk to my grandma on the phone every week' - Present Simple, odatiy harakat; 'on the phone' - ibora; 'every week' - takrorlanish holi.

examples.en: She is on the phone with her friend right now.
examples.uz: U hozir do'sti bilan telefonda gaplashyapti.
examples.grammar: 'is on the phone' - Present iboradagi holat; 'with' - predlog; 'right now' - hozirgi vaqtni bildiruvchi hol.

defEn: modern and developed to a high level
defUz: yuqori darajada zamonaviy va rivojlangan

examples.en: This is the most advanced computer on the market.
examples.uz: Bu bozordagi (= sotib olish mumkin
examples.grammar: 'This is the most advanced computer on the market' - 'the most advanced' - sifatning orttirma darajasi; 'on the market' - predlogli holat.

examples.en: This phone has many advanced features for photos.
examples.uz: Bu telefon rasmlar uchun ko'plab takomillashgan imkoniyatlarga ega.
examples.grammar: 'has' - Present Simple, uchinchi shaxs birlik; 'advanced' - 'features' otini aniqlovchi sifat; 'for' - predlog.

defEn: using numbers or computer technology to store information
defUz: ma'lumotni saqlash uchun raqam yoki kompyuter texnologiyasidan foydalanadigan

examples.en: Digital cameras are great because you see the photo immediately.
examples.uz: Raqamli kameralar ajoyib
examples.grammar: 'Digital cameras are great because you see the photo immediately' - Present Simple; 'because' - sabab bog'lovchisi; 'immediately' - ravish.

examples.en: I keep all my photos on a digital camera.
examples.uz: Men barcha rasmlarimni raqamli kamerada saqlayman.
examples.grammar: 'keep' - Present Simple; 'digital' - 'camera' otini aniqlovchi sifat; 'on' - predlog.

defEn: costing no money
defUz: hech qanday pul talab qilmaydigan

examples.en: The basic software is free and you pay for the advanced program.
examples.uz: Sodda dasturiy ta'minot
examples.grammar: 'The basic software is free and you pay for the advanced program' - Present Simple; 'and' - bog'lovchi; 'pay for' - 'for' predlogi bilan fe'l.

examples.en: This app is free, so everyone can download it.
examples.uz: Bu ilova bepul, shuning uchun har kim uni yuklab olishi mumkin.
examples.grammar: 'is' - Present Simple; 'so' - natija bog'lovchisi; 'can download' - 'can' modal fe'li imkoniyatni bildiradi.

defEn: most important or largest
defUz: eng muhim yoki eng katta

examples.en: There are around fifty computers in the main office.
examples.uz: Asosiy ofisda taxminan ellikta kompyuter
examples.grammar: 'There are around fifty computers in the main office' - 'There are' ko'plikda narsalar borligini bildiradi; 'around' - taxminan; 'in the main office' - predlogli holat.

examples.en: The main computer in the office is very fast.
examples.uz: Ofisdagi asosiy kompyuter juda tez.
examples.grammar: 'is' - Present Simple; 'main' - 'computer' otini aniqlovchi sifat; 'in' - predlog joyni bildiradi.

uz: mutimediyali: axborot uzatishning xilma-xil usullari, masalan matn, tovush, jonlantirilgan va grafik tasvirlarni qamrab oluvchi texnologiyaga ega
defEn: using text, sound, pictures and video together
defUz: matn, tovush, rasm va videoni birgalikda ishlatadigan

examples.en: The shop sells multimedia devices like smartphones.
examples.uz: Ushbu do'kon smartfonlar kabi
examples.grammar: 'The shop sells multimedia devices like smartphones' - Present Simple, 'sells' uchinchi shaxs birlikda; 'like' - misol keltiruvchi predlog; 'devices' - ko'plik.

examples.en: We use a multimedia program to learn in class.
examples.uz: Biz darsda o'rganish uchun multimediyali dasturdan foydalanamiz.
examples.grammar: 'use' - Present Simple; 'multimedia' - 'program' otini aniqlovchi sifat; 'to learn' - infinitiv maqsadni bildiradi.

defEn: in fact or really
defUz: aslida, haqiqatda

examples.en: Programming sounds difficult but actually it's not.
examples.uz: Dasturlash qiyindek eshitiladi, lekin aslida
examples.grammar: 'Programming sounds difficult but actually it's not' - Present Simple; 'but' - zidlovchi bog'lovchi; 'actually' - gap mazmunini izohlovchi ravish.

examples.en: The film looked boring, but actually it was very good.
examples.uz: Film zerikarli ko'rindi, lekin aslida u juda yaxshi edi.
examples.grammar: 'looked' va 'was' - Past Simple; 'but' - zidlovchi bog'lovchi; 'actually' - izohlovchi ravish.

defEn: after something has happened
defUz: biror narsa sodir bo'lganidan keyin

examples.en: He showed me how to do it and afterwards I tried.
examples.uz: U menga buni qanday bajarishni ko'rsatdi,
examples.grammar: 'He showed me how to do it and afterwards I tried' - Past Simple; 'how to do it' - so'roq so'z + infinitiv; 'afterwards' - vaqt ravishi.

examples.en: We watched a film and afterwards we talked about it.
examples.uz: Biz film ko'rdik va keyin u haqida gaplashdik.
examples.grammar: 'watched' va 'talked' - Past Simple; 'and' - bog'lovchi; 'afterwards' - ketma-ketlikni bildiruvchi vaqt ravishi.

defEn: almost but not completely
defUz: deyarli, lekin to'liq emas

examples.en: I nearly have enough money for a new mobile.
examples.uz: Yangi qo'l telefoni uchun deyarli yetarlicha
examples.grammar: 'I nearly have enough money for a new mobile' - Present Simple; 'nearly' - darajani bildiruvchi ravish; 'enough money' - miqdor; 'for' - predlog.

examples.en: I am nearly ready to send the email.
examples.uz: Men emailni jo'natishga deyarli tayyorman.
examples.grammar: 'am' - Present Simple; 'nearly' - darajani bildiruvchi ravish; 'to send' - infinitiv.

defEn: to share ideas or information with people
defUz: odamlar bilan fikr yoki ma'lumot almashmoq

examples.en: We usually communicate by letter.
examples.uz: Biz odatda xat orqali muloqot qilamiz.
examples.grammar: 'We usually communicate by letter' - Present Simple, odatiy harakat; 'usually' - chastota ravishi; 'by letter' - 'by' predlogi vositani bildiradi.

examples.en: We communicate with our teacher by email every week.
examples.uz: Biz har hafta o'qituvchimiz bilan email orqali muloqot qilamiz.
examples.grammar: 'communicate' - Present Simple; 'with' va 'by' - predloglar; 'every week' - takrorlanish holi.

defEn: the act of sharing information with people
defUz: odamlar bilan ma'lumot almashish jarayoni

examples.en: Text messages make communication easier and cheaper.
examples.uz: Yozuvli xabarlar muloqotni osonroq
examples.grammar: 'Text messages make communication easier and cheaper' - 'make + ot + sifat' qurilmasi; 'easier' va 'cheaper' - qiyosiy daraja; 'and' - bog'lovchi.

examples.en: The internet makes communication between people very fast.
examples.uz: Internet odamlar o'rtasidagi muloqotni juda tez qiladi.
examples.grammar: 'makes' - Present Simple, uchinchi shaxs birlik; 'between' - predlog; 'very fast' - ravish + sifat.

defEn: to join one thing to another
defUz: bir narsani boshqasiga ulamoq

examples.en: Click "Continue" to connect to the internet.
examples.uz: Internetga bog'lanish uchun "Davom etish"ni
examples.grammar: 'Click ... to connect to the internet' - buyruq gap (imperative); 'to connect' - infinitiv maqsadni bildiradi; 'to the internet' - predlogli holat.

examples.en: I cannot connect my phone to the internet here.
examples.uz: Men bu yerda telefonimni internetga ulay olmayapman.
examples.grammar: 'cannot connect' - 'can' modal fe'lining inkor shakli; 'to' - predlog; 'here' - joy holi.

defEn: a link that lets devices work together
defUz: qurilmalarni birga ishlashga imkon beruvchi aloqa

examples.en: How fast is your Internet connection?
examples.uz: Sizning internet aloqangiz qanchalik tez?
examples.grammar: 'How fast is your Internet connection?' - 'How + sifat' bilan so'roq gap; 'is' - 'to be' fe'li; 'your Internet connection' - egalik olmoshi + ot.

examples.en: The internet connection at home is very slow today.
examples.uz: Bugun uydagi internet aloqasi juda sekin.
examples.grammar: 'is' - Present Simple; 'at home' - predlogli joy holi; 'very slow' - ravish + sifat; 'today' - vaqt holi.

defEn: not difficult to do
defUz: qilish qiyin bo'lmagan

examples.en: Playing tennis is not as easy as it looks.
examples.uz: Tennis o'ynash ko'ringanidek oson emas.
examples.grammar: 'Playing tennis is not as easy as it looks' - 'as ... as' teng qiyos qurilmasi; 'Playing' - gerund (-ing) ega vazifasida; 'is not' - inkor.

examples.en: This new app is very easy to use.
examples.uz: Bu yangi ilova ishlatishga juda oson.
examples.grammar: 'is' - Present Simple; 'very' - ravish sifatni kuchaytiradi; 'to use' - infinitiv.

defEn: without difficulty or effort
defUz: qiyinchiliksiz, oson tarzda

examples.en: I can communicate with my American penfriend much more easily by email.
examples.uz: Men amerikalik
examples.grammar: 'I can communicate ... much more easily by email' - 'can' modal fe'li; 'much more easily' - ravishning qiyosiy darajasi kuchaytirilgan; 'by email' - predlogli vosita.

examples.en: I can find any word easily on this website.
examples.uz: Men bu saytdan har qanday so'zni osongina topa olaman.
examples.grammar: 'can find' - 'can' modal fe'li imkoniyatni bildiradi; 'easily' - ravish fe'lni izohlaydi; 'on' - predlog.

defEn: to make or design something new for the first time
defUz: biror yangi narsani birinchi marta yaratmoq yoki ishlab chiqmoq

examples.en: Who invented the first true helicopter?
examples.uz: Birinchi haqiqiy vertalyotni kim yaratgan?
examples.grammar: 'Who invented the first true helicopter?' - 'Who' bilan so'roq gap, Past Simple; 'the first true' - 'the' artikli + sifatlar; 'helicopter' - ega-obyekt.

examples.en: People invented the computer to do difficult work quickly.
examples.uz: Odamlar qiyin ishni tez bajarish uchun kompyuterni ixtiro qilishdi.
examples.grammar: 'invented' - Past Simple; 'to do' - infinitiv maqsadni bildiradi; 'quickly' - ravish.

defEn: a new thing that someone has made for the first time
defUz: kimdir birinchi marta yaratgan yangi narsa

examples.en: Was the computer the most important invention ever?
examples.uz: Kompyuter eng muhim ixtiro bo'lganmi?
examples.grammar: 'Was the computer the most important invention ever?' - 'Was' bilan Past Simple so'roq gap; 'the most important' - orttirma daraja; 'ever' - kuchaytiruvchi so'z.

examples.en: The phone was a very important invention for the world.
examples.uz: Telefon dunyo uchun juda muhim ixtiro edi.
examples.grammar: 'was' - Past Simple, 'to be' fe'li; 'a very important invention' - artikl + ravish + sifat + ot; 'for' - predlog.

defEn: a person who makes something new
defUz: yangi narsa yaratadigan inson

examples.en: The inventor of the telephone was Alexander Graham Bell.
examples.uz: Telefonning ixtirochisi Aligzandr
examples.grammar: 'The inventor of the telephone was Alexander Graham Bell' - Past Simple; 'the inventor of the telephone' - 'of' predlogi egalikni bildiradi; 'was' - 'to be' fe'li.

examples.en: The inventor of this machine became very famous.
examples.uz: Bu mashinaning ixtirochisi juda mashhur bo'lib ketdi.
examples.grammar: 'became' - Past Simple (become fe'lining noto'g'ri shakli); 'of' - predlog egalikni bildiradi; 'very famous' - ravish + sifat.

uz: kashfiyotchi, keng tasavvurga ega, yaratuvchan, yangilikka intiluvchan
defEn: good at thinking of new ideas
defUz: yangi g'oyalar o'ylab topishga usta

examples.en: You have to be inventive to find solutions to problems.
examples.uz: Muammolarga yechimlar topish uchun
examples.grammar: 'You have to be inventive to find solutions to problems' - 'have to' zaruratni bildiradi; 'to be inventive' - infinitiv; 'to find' - infinitiv maqsadni bildiradi.

examples.en: She is very inventive and always finds new ideas.
examples.uz: U juda yaratuvchan va har doim yangi g'oyalar topadi.
examples.grammar: 'is' va 'finds' - Present Simple; 'inventive' - sifat; 'and' - bog'lovchi; 'always' - chastota ravishi.

defEn: behaving in a kind and respectful way
defUz: mehribon va hurmatli tarzda o'zini tutadigan

examples.en: Please be polite to our guests.
examples.uz: Iltimos, mehmonlarimizga xushmuomala bo'ling.
examples.grammar: 'Please be polite to our guests' - buyruq gap (imperative) 'Please' bilan yumshatilgan; 'be polite' - 'to be' fe'lining buyruq shakli; 'to' - predlog.

examples.en: He is always polite when he talks to older people.
examples.uz: U keksa odamlar bilan gaplashganda har doim xushmuomala bo'ladi.
examples.grammar: 'is' - Present Simple; 'always' - chastota ravishi; 'when' - vaqt bog'lovchisi ergash gapni kiritadi.

defEn: not kind or respectful in behaviour
defUz: o'zini xushmuomala yoki hurmatli tutmaydigan

examples.en: You didn't say hello
examples.uz: how impolite! – Siz salom bermadingiz–naqadar qo'pollik!
examples.grammar: 'You didn't say hello' - Past Simple inkor shakli; gap so'zlashuv uslubida hayajonli izoh bilan davom etadi; 'impolite' - sifat.

examples.en: It is impolite to read messages during a meal.
examples.uz: Ovqat paytida xabarlarni o'qish qo'pollik hisoblanadi.
examples.grammar: 'is' - Present Simple; 'impolite' - sifat; 'to read' - infinitiv ega vazifasida; 'during' - predlog.

defEn: in a kind and respectful way
defUz: mehribon va hurmatli tarzda

examples.en: I politely told him I didn't want the job.
examples.uz: Men ishni xohlamasligimni muloyimlik bilan unga
examples.grammar: 'I politely told him I didn't want the job' - Past Simple; 'politely' - tarzni bildiruvchi ravish; 'I didn't want' - inkor ergash gap.

examples.en: She politely asked me to turn down the music.
examples.uz: U mendan musiqaning ovozini pasaytirishni muloyimlik bilan so'radi.
examples.grammar: 'asked' - Past Simple; 'politely' - tarzni bildiruvchi ravish; 'to turn down' - infinitiv.

defEn: in a way that is not kind or respectful
defUz: xushmuomala yoki hurmatli bo'lmagan tarzda

examples.en: Don't speak so impolitely to your teacher!
examples.uz: O'qituvchingizga bunchalik qo'pollik bilan
examples.grammar: 'Don't speak so impolitely to your teacher!' - buyruq gap inkor shakli; 'so' - darajani kuchaytiradi; 'impolitely' - tarzni bildiruvchi ravish; 'to' - predlog.

examples.en: He spoke impolitely to his friend and made her angry.
examples.uz: U do'stiga qo'pollik bilan gapirdi va uni jahli chiqdi.
examples.grammar: 'spoke' va 'made' - Past Simple; 'impolitely' - tarzni bildiruvchi ravish; 'and' - bog'lovchi.

defEn: able to happen or be done
defUz: sodir bo'lishi yoki bajarilishi mumkin bo'lgan

examples.en: It is possible to get there by bus.
examples.uz: U yerga avtobus orqali borish mumkin.
examples.grammar: 'It is possible to get there by bus' - 'It is + sifat + infinitiv' qurilmasi; 'to get there' - infinitiv; 'by bus' - 'by' predlogi vositani bildiradi.

examples.en: It is possible to watch this film online for free.
examples.uz: Bu filmni internetda bepul ko'rish mumkin.
examples.grammar: 'It is possible' - 'It is + sifat' qurilmasi; 'to watch' - infinitiv; 'online' va 'for free' - holatlar.

uz: iloji yo'q, imkonsiz, haqiqatga to'g'ri kelmaydigan · imkonsiz, haqiqatga to'g'ri kelmaydigan
defEn: not able to happen or be done
defUz: sodir bo'lishi yoki bajarilishi mumkin bo'lmagan

examples.en: It's impossible to win at this computer game.
examples.uz: Bu kompyuter o'yinida g'olib bo'lish imkonsiz.
examples.grammar: 'It's impossible to win at this computer game' - 'It is + sifat + infinitiv' qurilmasi; 'to win' - infinitiv; 'at this computer game' - predlogli holat.

examples.en: It is impossible to use this phone without a battery.
examples.uz: Bu telefonni batareyasiz ishlatish imkonsiz.
examples.grammar: 'It is impossible' - 'It is + sifat' qurilmasi; 'to use' - infinitiv; 'without' - predlog.

examples.en: It's impossible to know how long we have to change the planet.
examples.uz: Sayyorani o'zgartirish uchun
examples.grammar: 'It's impossible to know how long we have' - 'It's + sifat + to + infinitiv' qurilmasi; 'how long ...' so'roq so'zli ergash gap.

examples.en: It is impossible to cross the river when it is flooded.
examples.uz: Daryo toshganda uni kechib o'tish imkonsiz.
examples.grammar: 'It is impossible to cross' - 'It is + sifat + infinitiv' qurilmasi; 'when it is flooded' vaqt ergash gapi.

defEn: a thing that may happen or be true
defUz: sodir bo'lishi yoki to'g'ri bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan narsa

examples.en: There is a good possibility that I will study Computer Science.
examples.uz: Kompyuter Ilmini o'rganishim
examples.grammar: 'There is a good possibility that I will study Computer Science' - 'There is' qurilmasi; 'that I will study' - 'that' bog'lovchili ergash gap, Future shakli.

examples.en: There is a possibility that we will get a new computer soon.
examples.uz: Tez orada yangi kompyuter olishimiz ehtimoli bor.
examples.grammar: 'There is a possibility' - narsa borligini bildiradi; 'that' - bog'lovchi ergash gapni kiritadi; 'will get' - Future.

defEn: to make a paper copy from a computer
defUz: kompyuterdan qog'ozdagi nusxani chiqarmoq

examples.en: I'm printing a copy of the document for you.
examples.uz: Siz uchun hujjatning nusxasini printerdan
examples.grammar: 'I'm printing a copy of the document for you' - Present Continuous ('am printing'); 'a copy of the document' - 'of' predlogi bilan; 'for you' - predlogli holat.

examples.en: Can you print this article for me, please?
examples.uz: Iltimos, bu maqolani men uchun printerdan chiqarib bera olasizmi?
examples.grammar: 'Can you ...?' - 'can' modal fe'li bilan so'roq gap; 'for me' - predlogli holat; 'please' - so'rovni yumshatadi.

defEn: a machine that makes paper copies from a computer
defUz: kompyuterdan qog'oz nusxalarini chiqaradigan mashina

examples.en: There's some paper stuck in the printer.
examples.uz: Printerga ozgina qog'oz tiqilib qolgan.
examples.grammar: 'There's some paper stuck in the printer' - 'There is' (= 'There's) narsa borligini bildiradi; 'stuck' - sifatdosh; 'in the printer' - predlogli holat.

examples.en: Our new printer is fast and very quiet.
examples.uz: Bizning yangi printerimiz tez va juda tinch.
examples.grammar: 'is' - Present Simple; 'fast and very quiet' - 'and' bog'lovchisi bilan ulangan sifatlar; 'very' - kuchaytiruvchi ravish.

defEn: a person who uses a machine, program or website
defUz: mashina, dastur yoki saytdan foydalanadigan inson

examples.en: They ask users to create a password 14 characters long.
examples.uz: Ular foydalanuvchilardan 14 belgidan
examples.grammar: 'They ask users to create a password 14 characters long' - Present Simple; 'ask users to create' - 'ask + obyekt + infinitiv' qurilmasi; 'long' - o'lchovni bildiradi.

examples.en: This website has more than a million users now.
examples.uz: Bu sayt hozir bir milliondan ortiq foydalanuvchiga ega.
examples.grammar: 'has' - Present Simple, uchinchi shaxs birlik; 'more than' - miqdoriy qiyos; 'users' - ko'plik; 'now' - vaqt holi.

defEn: helpful and good to use
defUz: yordam beradigan va ishlatishga yaxshi

examples.en: A smartphone is very useful when you're travelling.
examples.uz: Sayohat qilayotganingizda, smartfon juda
examples.grammar: 'A smartphone is very useful when you're travelling' - Present Simple; 'very' - sifatni kuchaytiradi; 'when you're travelling' - 'when' bog'lovchisi, Present Continuous.

examples.en: This app is very useful for learning new words.
examples.uz: Bu ilova yangi so'zlarni o'rganish uchun juda foydali.
examples.grammar: 'is' - Present Simple; 'very useful' - ravish + sifat; 'for learning' - 'for' predlogi + gerund (-ing).

defEn: not helpful or not able to be used
defUz: yordam bermaydigan yoki ishlatib bo'lmaydigan

examples.en: The information was useless to him.
examples.uz: Ma'lumot unga foydasiz bo'ldi.
examples.grammar: 'The information was useless to him' - Past Simple, 'to be' fe'lining 'was' shakli; 'useless' - sifat; 'to him' - predlogli holat.

examples.en: My old phone is useless because the screen is broken.
examples.uz: Eski telefonim foydasiz, chunki ekrani singan.
examples.grammar: 'is' - Present Simple; 'useless' - sifat; 'because' - sabab bog'lovchisi ergash gapni kiritadi.

defEn: to look at or watch something
defUz: biror narsaga qaramoq yoki uni tomosha qilmoq

examples.en: You can view the sharks from outside the glass tank.
examples.uz: Akulalarni akvarium tashqarisidan
examples.grammar: 'You can view the sharks from outside the glass tank' - 'can' modal fe'li imkoniyatni bildiradi; 'from outside' - predloglar; 'the glass tank' - sifat vazifasidagi ot + ot.

examples.en: You can view all your photos on the big screen.
examples.uz: Siz barcha rasmlaringizni katta ekranda ko'rishingiz mumkin.
examples.grammar: 'can view' - 'can' modal fe'li imkoniyatni bildiradi; 'all your photos' - 'all' + egalik olmoshi + ot; 'on' - predlog.

defEn: a person who watches a TV programme
defUz: teleko'rsatuvni tomosha qiladigan inson

examples.en: The TV show has millions of viewers.
examples.uz: Teleko'rsatuv millionlab tomoshabinlarga ega.
examples.grammar: 'The TV show has millions of viewers' - Present Simple, 'has' uchinchi shaxs birlikda; 'millions of viewers' - 'of' predlogi miqdorni bildiradi; 'viewers' - ko'plik.

examples.en: This new programme has many young viewers.
examples.uz: Bu yangi ko'rsatuv ko'plab yosh tomoshabinlarga ega.
examples.grammar: 'has' - Present Simple, uchinchi shaxs birlik; 'many' - ko'plik ot oldida; 'young viewers' - sifat + ot.

defEn: a person whose job is to write books, articles or shows
defUz: kitob, maqola yoki ko'rsatuv yozishni kasb qilgan inson

examples.en: He works as a writer for a TV show.
examples.uz: U bir teleko'rsatuvda yozuvchi bo'lib ishlaydi.
examples.grammar: 'He works as a writer for a TV show' - Present Simple, 'works' uchinchi shaxs birlikda; 'as a writer' - 'as' predlogi rolni bildiradi; 'for' - predlog.

examples.en: She is a writer and she writes stories for children.
examples.uz: U yozuvchi va u bolalar uchun hikoyalar yozadi.
examples.grammar: 'is' va 'writes' - Present Simple; 'and' - bog'lovchi; 'for' - predlog maqsadni bildiradi.

defEn: words that someone has written, or the skill of writing
defUz: kimdir yozgan so'zlar yoki yozish qobiliyati

examples.en: Her writing is good, but it's not good enough to write for this serial.
examples.uz: Uning yozishi yaxshi, biroq
examples.grammar: 'Her writing is good, but it's not good enough to write for this serial' - Present Simple; 'but' - zidlovchi bog'lovchi; 'good enough to write' - sifat + 'enough' + infinitiv.

examples.en: Her writing is clear and easy to read.
examples.uz: Uning yozuvi tushunarli va o'qishga oson.
examples.grammar: 'is' - Present Simple; 'clear and easy' - 'and' bog'lovchisi bilan ulangan sifatlar; 'to read' - infinitiv.

defEn: an area of sand or stones beside the sea
defUz: dengiz bo'yidagi qumli yoki toshli joy

examples.en: We lay on the beach getting dry from our swim in the sea.
examples.uz: Biz dengizdagi suzishimizdan qurib
examples.grammar: 'We lay on the beach' - Past Simple ('lay' = lie fe'lining o'tgan zamoni); 'on the beach' - predlog (on) va artikl (the) bilan joyni bildiradi.

examples.en: We spent the whole afternoon on the beach building sandcastles.
examples.uz: Biz butun tushdan keyingi vaqtni plyajda qum qal'alari qurib o'tkazdik.
examples.grammar: 'spent ... building' - Past Simple va 'building' sifatdoshi qanday vaqt o'tkazganini bildiradi.

defEn: long-term changes in the world's weather caused by pollution
defUz: ifloslanish sababli dunyo ob-havosidagi uzoq muddatli o'zgarishlar

examples.en: Climate change creates extreme weather all over the world.
examples.uz: Iqlim o'zgarishi butun dunyo
examples.grammar: 'Climate change creates extreme weather' - Present Simple; ega birlik bo'lgani uchun fe'l 's' qo'shimchasini oladi ('creates').

examples.en: Many scientists say that climate change is a big problem for our planet.
examples.uz: Ko'plab olimlar iqlim o'zgarishi sayyoramiz uchun katta muammo ekanini aytishadi.
examples.grammar: 'say that ...' - 'that' bog'lovchisi bilan ergash gap qo'shilgan; bosh gap Present Simpleda.

defEn: any living animal
defUz: har qanday tirik hayvon, jonzot

examples.en: The dolphin is a beautiful sea creature.
examples.uz: Delfin chiroyli dengiz mavjudotidir.
examples.grammar: 'The dolphin is a beautiful sea creature' - Present Simple ('is'); 'a beautiful sea creature' artikl (a) va sifatlar bilan ot guruhini hosil qiladi.

examples.en: We saw many strange creatures at the bottom of the sea.
examples.uz: Biz dengiz tubida ko'plab g'aroyib jonzotlarni ko'rdik.
examples.grammar: 'saw' - Past Simple; 'creatures' - ot ko'plikda ('-s').

defEn: how deep something is, the distance from the top to the bottom
defUz: biror narsaning chuqurligi, ustidan tubigacha bo'lgan masofa

examples.en: The depth of the water is about 10 metres.
examples.uz: Suvning chuqurligi taxminan 10 metr.
examples.grammar: 'The depth of the water is about 10 metres' - Present Simple ('is'); 'the depth of the water' - 'of' predlogi bilan egalik munosabatini bildiradi.

examples.en: Divers must check the depth of the water before they jump in.
examples.uz: G'avvoslar suvga sakrashdan oldin suvning chuqurligini tekshirishi kerak.
examples.grammar: 'must check' - modal fe'l (must) infinitiv bilan majburiyatni bildiradi; 'before they jump' - vaqt ergash gapi.

defEn: the natural world of land, water, air, plants and animals
defUz: yer, suv, havo, o'simlik va hayvonlardan iborat tabiiy olam

examples.en: Saving the environment is an important thing to do.
examples.uz: Atrof-muhitni saqlab qolish qilish kerak
examples.grammar: 'Saving the environment is an important thing' - 'Saving' gerundiy ega vazifasida; 'is an important thing' - Present Simple va artikl (an).

examples.en: We can all help to protect the environment by using less plastic.
examples.uz: Kamroq plastik ishlatib, biz hammamiz atrof-muhitni asrashga yordam bera olamiz.
examples.grammar: 'can help' - modal fe'l (can); 'by using' - 'by' predlogi va gerundiy usulni bildiradi.

defEn: clean air outside, away from buildings and pollution
defUz: binolardan va ifloslanishdan uzoqdagi tashqaridagi toza havo

examples.en: Go out for a walk and get some fresh air.
examples.uz: Piyoda sayrga chiqing va biroz toza havo oling.
examples.grammar: 'Go out for a walk and get some fresh air' - buyruq gap (imperative); ikki fe'l 'and' bog'lovchisi bilan bog'langan; 'some' sanab bo'lmaydigan ot bilan ishlatilgan.

examples.en: I opened the window to let some fresh air into the room.
examples.uz: Men xonaga biroz toza havo kirishi uchun derazani ochdim.
examples.grammar: 'opened' - Past Simple; 'to let' - maqsad infinitivi.

defEn: a wall made of wood or wire around a piece of land
defUz: yer bo'lagi atrofidagi yog'och yoki simdan ishlangan to'siq

examples.en: The fence between the gardens was blown down in the storm.
examples.uz: Bog'lar orasidagi panjara
examples.grammar: 'The fence ... was blown down in the storm' - Past Simple passiv ('was blown down'); 'between the gardens' - predlog (between) o'rinni bildiradi.

examples.en: My father built a wooden fence around our garden.
examples.uz: Otam bog'imiz atrofiga yog'och panjara o'rnatdi.
examples.grammar: 'built' - Past Simple ('build' fe'lining noto'g'ri shakli); 'around' - o'rin predlogi.

defEn: an area of open land used for crops or animals
defUz: ekin yoki hayvonlar uchun ishlatiladigan ochiq yer maydoni

examples.en: There were twenty cows eating grass in the field.
examples.uz: Dalada yigirmata sigir maysa yeyotgandi.
examples.grammar: 'There were twenty cows eating grass in the field' - 'There were' ko'plikda narsa borligini bildiradi; 'eating grass' sifatdosh sigirlarni izohlaydi.

examples.en: The farmer grows wheat in this big field every year.
examples.uz: Dehqon har yili bu katta dalada bug'doy yetishtiradi.
examples.grammar: 'grows' - Present Simple, ega birlik bo'lgani uchun '-s'; 'every year' takroriylikni bildiradi.

defEn: a large amount of water that covers land that is usually dry
defUz: odatda quruq bo'lgan yerni qoplagan katta miqdordagi suv

examples.en: The flood left the village under water.
examples.uz: Suv toshqini qishloqni suv ostida qoldirdi.
examples.grammar: 'The flood left the village under water' - Past Simple ('left'); 'under water' - predlog (under) holatni bildiradi.

examples.en: After the heavy rain, a flood damaged many houses in the town.
examples.uz: Kuchli yomg'irdan keyin, suv toshqini shaharda ko'plab uylarga zarar yetkazdi.
examples.grammar: 'After the heavy rain' - vaqtni bildiruvchi predlogli ibora; 'damaged' - Past Simple.

defEn: a large fire that burns through trees in a forest
defUz: o'rmondagi daraxtlarni yondiruvchi katta yong'in

examples.en: The fire fighters fought the forest fire for days.
examples.uz: O't o'chiruvchilar o'rmon yong'ini bilan kunlab
examples.grammar: 'The fire fighters fought the forest fire for days' - Past Simple ('fought'); 'for days' - predlog (for) davomiylikni bildiradi.

examples.en: The hot, dry summer caused a terrible forest fire in the hills.
examples.uz: Issiq va quruq yoz tepaliklarda dahshatli o'rmon yong'iniga sabab bo'ldi.
examples.grammar: 'caused' - Past Simple; 'hot, dry' ikki sifat otni izohlaydi.

defEn: the slow rise in the Earth's temperature caused by pollution
defUz: ifloslanish tufayli Yer haroratining sekin ko'tarilishi

examples.en: Global warming is turning huge areas into deserts.
examples.uz: Global isish ulkan maydonlarni sahrolarga
examples.grammar: 'Global warming is turning huge areas into deserts' - Present Continuous ('is turning') hozir davom etayotgan jarayonni bildiradi; 'into' predlogi natijani ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: Global warming is making the ice at the North Pole melt.
examples.uz: Global isish Shimoliy qutbdagi muzning erishiga sabab bo'lmoqda.
examples.grammar: 'is making ... melt' - Present Continuous va 'make + infinitiv' qurilishi majburlashni bildiradi.

defEn: a piece of land with water all around it
defUz: atrofi suv bilan o'ralgan quruqlik bo'lagi

examples.en: They live on a tiny island off the coast of Wales.
examples.uz: Ular Uels qirg'og'i bo'yidagi kichik bir
examples.grammar: 'They live on a tiny island off the coast of Wales' - Present Simple ('live'); 'on a tiny island' va 'off the coast' predloglar bilan o'rinni bildiradi.

examples.en: We took a small boat to a beautiful island in the sea.
examples.uz: Biz dengizdagi chiroyli orolga kichik qayiqda bordik.
examples.grammar: 'took' - Past Simple ('take' noto'g'ri fe'l); 'to a beautiful island' yo'nalishni bildiradi.

defEn: small pieces of rubbish left in public places
defUz: jamoat joylarida tashlab ketilgan mayda chiqindilar

examples.en: The children were picking up litter from the school field.
examples.uz: Bolalar maktab maydonidan chiqindi
examples.grammar: 'The children were picking up litter' - Past Continuous ('were picking up') o'tmishda davom etgan ishni bildiradi; 'pick up' frazaviy fe'l.

examples.en: Please do not drop litter on the ground in the park.
examples.uz: Iltimos, parkda yerga chiqindi tashlamang.
examples.grammar: 'do not drop' - inkor buyruq gap (negative imperative).

uz: axlat qutisi/qayta ishlab chiqariladigan chiqindilar uchun maxsus quti
defEn: a container for rubbish or for things that can be reused
defUz: chiqindi yoki qayta ishlanadigan narsalar uchun quti

examples.en: Put glass in the recycling bin.
examples.uz: Shishani qayta ishlab chiqariladigan chiqindilar uchun maxsus
examples.grammar: 'Put glass in the recycling bin' - buyruq gap (imperative); 'in the recycling bin' predlog (in) va artikl (the) bilan o'rinni bildiradi.

examples.en: We put all the empty bottles into the recycling bin.
examples.uz: Biz hamma bo'sh shishalarni qayta ishlash qutisiga soldik.
examples.grammar: 'put' - bu gapda Past Simple (shakli o'zgarmaydigan noto'g'ri fe'l); 'into' yo'nalishni bildiradi.

uz: mashina yo'li, shosse, katta yo'l, avtomagistral
defEn: a wide road for fast travel between cities
defUz: shaharlar orasida tez harakatlanish uchun keng yo'l

examples.en: It takes an hour to drive to London on the new motorway.
examples.uz: Yangi avtomagistralda Londonga
examples.grammar: 'It takes an hour to drive to London' - 'It takes + vaqt + to + infinitiv' qancha vaqt ketishini bildiruvchi qurilma; Present Simple ('takes').

examples.en: There were a lot of cars on the motorway this morning.
examples.uz: Bugun ertalab avtomagistralda juda ko'p mashinalar bor edi.
examples.grammar: 'There were' o'tgan zamonda ko'plikda narsa borligini bildiradi; 'on the motorway' o'rinni bildiradi.

defEn: a very high hill with steep sides
defUz: tik yon bag'irli juda baland tepalik, tog'

examples.en: We live in a village near the top of the mountain.
examples.uz: Biz tog' cho'qqisi yaqinidagi qishloqda
examples.grammar: 'We live in a village near the top of the mountain' - Present Simple ('live'); 'near the top of the mountain' predloglar bilan joyni aniqlaydi.

examples.en: It took us five hours to climb to the top of the mountain.
examples.uz: Tog' cho'qqisiga chiqish bizdan besh soat vaqt oldi.
examples.grammar: 'It took ... to climb' - vaqt sarfini bildiruvchi 'it + take' qurilmasi; 'to climb' infinitiv.

defEn: soft wet earth
defUz: yumshoq va nam tuproq, loy

examples.en: The floods left the fields full of thick mud.
examples.uz: Suv toshqinlari keng maydonlarni quyuq loyga beladi.
examples.grammar: 'The floods left the fields full of thick mud' - Past Simple ('left'); 'full of thick mud' - 'full of' iborasi nima bilan to'laligini bildiradi.

examples.en: The children came home with mud all over their shoes.
examples.uz: Bolalar oyoq kiyimlari loyga belangan holda uyga qaytishdi.
examples.grammar: 'came' - Past Simple ('come' noto'g'ri fe'l); 'with mud all over' holatni bildiradi.

defEn: a gas in the air that people and animals need to breathe
defUz: odam va hayvonlar nafas olish uchun zarur bo'lgan havodagi gaz

examples.en: Trees take in carbon dioxide and produce oxygen.
examples.uz: Daraxtlar karbonat angidridni o'ziga
examples.grammar: 'Trees take in carbon dioxide and produce oxygen' - Present Simple, ikki fe'l 'and' bilan bog'langan; 'take in' frazaviy fe'l.

examples.en: We need clean air with a lot of oxygen to stay healthy.
examples.uz: Sog' bo'lib qolish uchun bizga ko'p kislorodli toza havo kerak.
examples.grammar: 'need' - Present Simple; 'to stay healthy' maqsad infinitivi.

defEn: a narrow way for walking
defUz: yurish uchun tor yo'l, so'qmoq

examples.en: We walked along a path in the forest.
examples.uz: Biz o'rmondagi so'qmoq bo'ylab yurdik.
examples.grammar: 'We walked along a path in the forest' - Past Simple ('walked'); 'along a path' va 'in the forest' predloglar bilan harakat va o'rinni bildiradi.

examples.en: Follow this path and you will reach the river.
examples.uz: Ushbu so'qmoqdan yuravering, shunda daryoga yetib borasiz.
examples.grammar: 'Follow' - buyruq gap; 'you will reach' - Future ('will') natijani bildiradi.

defEn: harmful dirt or chemicals in the air, water or land
defUz: havo, suv yoki yerdagi zararli kir yoki kimyoviy moddalar

examples.en: Factories produce a lot of air pollution.
examples.uz: Zavodlar juda ko'p havo ifloslanishini keltirib chiqaradi.
examples.grammar: 'Factories produce a lot of air pollution' - Present Simple ('produce'); 'a lot of' sanab bo'lmaydigan ot bilan ko'p miqdorni bildiradi.

examples.en: Cars in big cities cause a lot of air pollution.
examples.uz: Katta shaharlardagi mashinalar ko'p havo ifloslanishiga sabab bo'ladi.
examples.grammar: 'cause' - Present Simple, ega ko'plik bo'lgani uchun fe'l '-s' olmaydi.

defEn: a thick forest in hot areas where it rains a lot
defUz: ko'p yomg'ir yog'adigan issiq hududlardagi qalin o'rmon

examples.en: Thousands of birds and animals live in the Amazon rainforest.
examples.uz: Amazonka tropik o'rmonida
examples.grammar: 'Thousands of birds and animals live in the Amazon rainforest' - Present Simple ('live'); 'Thousands of' ko'p miqdorni bildiradi.

examples.en: Many rare plants grow only in the rainforest.
examples.uz: Ko'plab noyob o'simliklar faqat tropik o'rmonda o'sadi.
examples.grammar: 'grow' - Present Simple; 'only' ravish chegaralashni bildiradi.

defEn: a time when there is no sound at all
defUz: hech qanday tovush bo'lmagan vaqt, jimjitlik

examples.en: There was complete silence in the forest
examples.uz: not even a bird sang. – O'rmonda mutloq jimlik edi–
examples.grammar: 'There was complete silence in the forest' - 'There was' o'tgan zamonda sanab bo'lmaydigan narsa borligini bildiradi; 'in the forest' o'rinni bildiradi.

examples.en: After the loud music stopped, there was a long silence.
examples.uz: Baland musiqa to'xtagandan keyin, uzoq sukunat cho'kdi.
examples.grammar: 'After ... stopped' - vaqt ergash gapi; 'there was' o'tgan zamonda borligini bildiradi.

uz: yovvoyi tabiat: yovvoyi hayvonlar va o'simliklar
defEn: wild animals and plants living in nature
defUz: tabiatda yashovchi yovvoyi hayvon va o'simliklar

examples.en: The wildlife in the area needs protecting.
examples.uz: Hududdagi yovvoyi tabiat muhofazaga muhtoj.
examples.grammar: 'The wildlife in the area needs protecting' - Present Simple ('needs'); 'need + gerundiy (protecting)' biror narsa kerakligini bildiradi.

examples.en: There is a lot of wildlife in the mountains near our village.
examples.uz: Qishlog'imiz yaqinidagi tog'larda ko'plab yovvoyi tabiat bor.
examples.grammar: 'There is' birlikda narsa borligini bildiradi; 'near our village' o'rinni bildiradi.

defEn: to say that someone is the cause of something bad
defUz: kimnidir yomon narsaning sababchisi deb aytmoq, ayblamoq

examples.en: We must find who is to blame for the pollution.
examples.uz: Ifloslanishga kim aybdor ekanligini topishimiz
examples.grammar: 'We must find who is to blame for the pollution' - modal fe'l (must); 'to blame for' aybdorlikni bildiruvchi ibora.

examples.en: Do not blame me for the broken window.
examples.uz: Singan deraza uchun meni aybdor qilmang.
examples.grammar: 'Do not blame' - inkor buyruq gap; 'for the broken window' sababni bildiradi.

defEn: to worry or trouble someone
defUz: kimnidir bezovta qilmoq, g'ashiga tegmoq

examples.en: Doesn't the rubbish on the beach bother you? It makes me angry.
examples.uz: Plyajdagi chiqindi sizning
examples.grammar: 'Doesn't the rubbish on the beach bother you?' - Present Simple so'roq gap inkorda ('Doesn't'); 'It makes me angry' - 'make + ot + sifat' qurilmasi.

examples.en: The loud noise from the road bothers me at night.
examples.uz: Yo'ldan kelayotgan baland shovqin tunda meni bezovta qiladi.
examples.grammar: 'bothers' - Present Simple, ega birlik bo'lgani uchun '-s'; 'at night' vaqtni bildiradi.

defEn: to make something happen, usually something bad
defUz: biror narsaning, odatda yomon narsaning sodir bo'lishiga sabab bo'lmoq

examples.en: Pollution has caused many problems for the fish in the river.
examples.uz: Ifloslanish daryodagi baliqlar
examples.grammar: 'Pollution has caused many problems for the fish' - Present Perfect ('has caused') o'tmishdagi natijasi hozir sezilayotgan ishni bildiradi.

examples.en: Dropping litter can cause big problems for animals.
examples.uz: Chiqindi tashlash hayvonlar uchun katta muammolarga sabab bo'lishi mumkin.
examples.grammar: 'Dropping' gerundiy ega vazifasida; 'can cause' modal fe'l imkoniyatni bildiradi.

defEn: to say that you are not happy about something
defUz: biror narsadan norozi ekanligingni aytmoq, shikoyat qilmoq

examples.en: They complained to the police about the noise.
examples.uz: Ular shovqin to'g'risida politsiyaga shikoyat
examples.grammar: 'They complained to the police about the noise' - Past Simple ('complained'); 'to the police' va 'about the noise' predloglar bilan kim va nima haqida ekanligini bildiradi.

examples.en: The neighbours complain about the smell from the factory.
examples.uz: Qo'shnilar zavoddan kelayotgan hid haqida shikoyat qilishadi.
examples.grammar: 'complain' - Present Simple; 'about the smell' shikoyat mavzusini bildiradi.

defEn: to damage something so badly that it no longer exists
defUz: biror narsani butunlay yo'q qilib, vayron qilmoq

examples.en: The fire destroyed huge areas of forest.
examples.uz: Yong'in ulkan o'rmon maydonlarini vayron qildi.
examples.grammar: 'The fire destroyed huge areas of forest' - Past Simple ('destroyed'); 'huge areas of forest' - 'of' predlogi bilan miqdorni bildiradi.

examples.en: The strong storm destroyed many trees in the park.
examples.uz: Kuchli bo'ron parkdagi ko'plab daraxtlarni vayron qildi.
examples.grammar: 'destroyed' - Past Simple; 'many trees' ko'plikda otni bildiradi.

defEn: to make a hole in the ground
defUz: yerda chuqurlik hosil qilmoq, kovlamoq

examples.en: Let's dig here to try and find some potatoes.
examples.uz: Harakat qilib ko'rib, bir nechta kartoshka topish
examples.grammar: 'Let's dig here to try and find some potatoes' - 'Let's + infinitiv' taklif gapi; 'to try and find' maqsadni bildiradi.

examples.en: The dog likes to dig holes in the garden.
examples.uz: It bog'da chuqurliklar kovlashni yoqtiradi.
examples.grammar: 'likes to dig' - Present Simple va 'like + to + infinitiv' qurilmasi.

defEn: to go away so that you cannot be seen
defUz: ko'rinmaydigan bo'lib ketmoq, g'oyib bo'lmoq

examples.en: Many of the birds have disappeared from this forest.
examples.uz: Qushlarning ko'pchiligi o'rmondan g'oyib
examples.grammar: 'Many of the birds have disappeared from this forest' - Present Perfect ('have disappeared'); 'from this forest' predlog bilan joyni bildiradi.

examples.en: The sun disappeared behind the dark clouds.
examples.uz: Quyosh qora bulutlar ortiga g'oyib bo'ldi.
examples.grammar: 'disappeared' - Past Simple; 'behind the dark clouds' o'rinni bildiradi.

defEn: to want something to happen or be true
defUz: biror narsaning sodir bo'lishini yoki rost bo'lishini istamoq, umid qilmoq

examples.en: We hope we can stop the damage before it's too late.
examples.uz: Umid qilamizki, haddan tashqari kech
examples.grammar: 'We hope we can stop the damage before it's too late' - Present Simple ('hope'); 'before it's too late' vaqt ergash gapi; 'can stop' modal fe'l.

examples.en: I hope the weather will be nice tomorrow.
examples.uz: Umid qilamanki, ertaga ob-havo yaxshi bo'ladi.
examples.grammar: 'hope' - Present Simple; ergash gapda 'will be' Future zamoni.

examples.en: Our hope is that the government will help.
examples.uz: Umidimiz hukumat yordam berishidan.
examples.grammar: 'Our hope is that the government will help' - 'that' bog'lovchisi ergash gapni boshlaydi, 'will help' Future zamonni bildiradi.

examples.en: We never lost hope during the long war.
examples.uz: Biz uzoq urush davomida umidimizni hech qachon yo'qotmadik.
examples.grammar: 'We never lost hope' - Past Simple; 'never' ravishi inkor ma'nosini kuchaytiradi.

defEn: to keep someone or something safe from harm
defUz: kimnidir yoki nimanidir ziyondan saqlamoq, himoya qilmoq

examples.en: It is up to us to protect the environment from harm.
examples.uz: Atrof-muhitni ziyondan himoya qilish
examples.grammar: 'It is up to us to protect the environment from harm' - 'It is up to us + to + infinitiv' mas'uliyatni bildiradi; 'from harm' predlog bilan ishlatilgan.

examples.en: We should protect wild animals and their homes.
examples.uz: Biz yovvoyi hayvonlarni va ularning makonini himoya qilishimiz kerak.
examples.grammar: 'should protect' - modal fe'l (should) maslahatni bildiradi.

defEn: to stay in the same place or condition
defUz: o'sha joyda yoki holatda qolmoq

examples.en: Nothing remained of the building after the fire.
examples.uz: Yong'indan so'ng, binodan hech nima qolmadi.
examples.grammar: 'Nothing remained of the building after the fire' - Past Simple ('remained'); 'Nothing' inkor egasi; 'after the fire' vaqtni bildiradi.

examples.en: Only a few trees remained after the forest fire.
examples.uz: O'rmon yong'inidan keyin atigi bir nechta daraxt qoldi.
examples.grammar: 'remained' - Past Simple; 'Only a few trees' chegaralangan miqdorni bildiradi.

defEn: to take something away from a place
defUz: biror narsani joyidan olib tashlamoq

examples.en: We removed most of our furniture from the house.
examples.uz: Biz uydan ko'pchilik mebellarimizni olib
examples.grammar: 'We removed most of our furniture from the house' - Past Simple ('removed'); 'most of our furniture' miqdorni, 'from the house' joyni bildiradi.

examples.en: Workers came to remove the rubbish from the street.
examples.uz: Ishchilar ko'chadan chiqindini olib tashlash uchun kelishdi.
examples.grammar: 'came to remove' - Past Simple va 'to remove' maqsad infinitivi.

defEn: to slide suddenly and lose your balance
defUz: to'satdan sirg'alib, muvozanatni yo'qotmoq

examples.en: I slipped in the mud and fell down.
examples.uz: Men loyda sirg'aldim va yiqilib tushdim.
examples.grammar: 'I slipped in the mud and fell down' - Past Simple, ikki fe'l 'and' bilan bog'langan; 'fall down' frazaviy fe'l.

examples.en: Be careful, you can slip on the wet path.
examples.uz: Ehtiyot bo'ling, nam so'qmoqda sirg'alib ketishingiz mumkin.
examples.grammar: 'Be careful' - buyruq gap; 'can slip' modal fe'l ehtimollikni bildiradi.

defEn: to cause a sharp pain, often from an insect or plant
defUz: ko'pincha hasharot yoki o'simlikdan keladigan o'tkir og'riq bermoq, achishtirmoq

examples.en: My arm really stings where that ant bit me.
examples.uz: Qo'limning chumoli chaqqan joyi juda achishib
examples.grammar: 'My arm really stings where that ant bit me' - Present Simple ('stings'); 'where that ant bit me' o'rin ergash gapi, ichida Past Simple ('bit').

examples.en: Some plants can sting your skin if you touch them.
examples.uz: Ba'zi o'simliklar agar tegsangiz teringizni achishtirishi mumkin.
examples.grammar: 'can sting' - modal fe'l; 'if you touch them' shart ergash gapi.

defEn: to use too much of something, or to use it badly
defUz: biror narsani haddan ko'p yoki noto'g'ri ishlatib, behuda sarflamoq

examples.en: Don't waste water
examples.uz: turn off that tap. – Suvni isrof qilmang–jo'mrakni o'chiring.
examples.grammar: 'Don't waste water, turn off that tap' - inkor buyruq gap ('Don't waste') va buyruq gap ('turn off'); 'turn off' frazaviy fe'l.

examples.en: Please do not waste water when you brush your teeth.
examples.uz: Iltimos, tish yuvayotganingizda suvni isrof qilmang.
examples.grammar: 'do not waste' - inkor buyruq gap; 'when you brush' vaqt ergash gapi.

defEn: to make a place tidy by removing rubbish
defUz: chiqindini olib tashlab, joyni tartibga keltirmoq, tozalamoq

examples.en: The group cleans up beaches along the coast.
examples.uz: Guruh sohil bo'yidagi plyajlarni tozalaydi.
examples.grammar: 'The group cleans up beaches along the coast' - Present Simple ('cleans up'), ega birlik bo'lgani uchun '-s'; 'clean up' frazaviy fe'l.

examples.en: We must clean up the park before the festival.
examples.uz: Biz bayramdan oldin parkni tozalashimiz kerak.
examples.grammar: 'must clean up' - modal fe'l (must); 'before the festival' vaqtni bildiradi.

defEn: to stop burning or shining
defUz: yonishdan to'xtamoq, o'chmoq

examples.en: The forest fire went out on its own.
examples.uz: O'rmon yong'ini o'zi o'chdi.
examples.grammar: 'The forest fire went out on its own' - Past Simple ('went out'); 'go out' frazaviy fe'l; 'on its own' mustaqil ravishda ekanini bildiradi.

examples.en: The candle went out when the wind blew.
examples.uz: Shamol esganda sham o'chdi.
examples.grammar: 'went out' - Past Simple frazaviy fe'l; 'when the wind blew' vaqt ergash gapi.

defEn: to stop a fire from burning
defUz: olovning yonishini to'xtatmoq, o'chirmoq

examples.en: The fire fighters managed to put the fire out.
examples.uz: O't o'chiruvchilar yong'inni o'chirishni
examples.grammar: 'The fire fighters managed to put the fire out' - Past Simple ('managed'); 'manage + to + infinitiv'; 'put out' frazaviy fe'l ('the fire' o'rtaga olingan).

examples.en: It took two hours to put out the big fire.
examples.uz: Katta yong'inni o'chirish ikki soat vaqt oldi.
examples.grammar: 'It took ... to put out' - vaqt sarfini bildiruvchi qurilma; 'to put out' maqsad infinitivi.

defEn: to get rid of something you do not want
defUz: kerak bo'lmagan narsani axlatga tashlamoq

examples.en: Let's throw away all this old furniture.
examples.uz: Keling bu hamma eski mebellarni axlatga tashlaymiz.
examples.grammar: 'Let's throw away all this old furniture' - 'Let's + infinitiv' taklif gapi; 'throw away' frazaviy fe'l.

examples.en: Do not throw away paper, you can recycle it.
examples.uz: Qog'ozni axlatga tashlamang, uni qayta ishlatish mumkin.
examples.grammar: 'Do not throw away' - inkor buyruq gap; 'can recycle' modal fe'l.

defEn: on a day with no clouds and good weather
defUz: bulutsiz va ochiq ob-havoli kunda

examples.en: On a clear day, you can see the sea from this mountain.
examples.uz: Bulutsiz kunda, ushbu tog'dan turib
examples.grammar: 'On a clear day, you can see the sea from this mountain' - 'On a clear day' vaqtni bildiruvchi predlogli ibora; 'can see' modal fe'l imkoniyatni bildiradi.

examples.en: On a clear day, you can see the mountains in the distance.
examples.uz: Ochiq kunda, uzoqdagi tog'larni ko'rishingiz mumkin.
examples.grammar: 'can see' - modal fe'l; 'in the distance' o'rinni bildiruvchi ibora.

defEn: far away but still able to be seen or heard
defUz: uzoqda, lekin hali ham ko'rinadigan yoki eshitiladigan masofada

examples.en: In the distance, you can just see the island.
examples.uz: Olis masofa naridan, faqatgina orolni ko'rishingiz
examples.grammar: 'In the distance, you can just see the island' - 'In the distance' o'rinni bildiruvchi predlogli ibora; 'can just see' modal fe'l va 'just' ravishi.

examples.en: We could hear a dog barking somewhere in the distance.
examples.uz: Biz uzoqdan qayerdadir it akillayotganini eshitardik.
examples.grammar: 'could hear' - modal fe'l (could) o'tmishdagi imkoniyat; 'barking' sifatdosh.

defEn: in place of something or someone
defUz: biror narsa yoki kimsaning o'rniga

examples.en: Instead of going away this weekend, let's help clean up the forest.
examples.uz: Bu hafta oxirida dam olishga
examples.grammar: 'Instead of going away this weekend, let's help clean up the forest' - 'Instead of + gerundiy (going)' qurilmasi; 'let's help' taklif gapi.

examples.en: Let's walk to school instead of taking the bus.
examples.uz: Avtobusda borish o'rniga maktabga piyoda boraylik.
examples.grammar: 'Let's walk' - taklif gapi; 'instead of taking' - 'instead of + gerundiy' qurilmasi.

defEn: to feel afraid or unhappy about something
defUz: biror narsa haqida qo'rqib yoki tashvishlanib his qilmoq

examples.en: I worry about what future our children will have.
examples.uz: Men farzandlarimiz kelajagi qanday bo'lishi
examples.grammar: 'I worry about what future our children will have' - Present Simple ('worry'); 'about what ... will have' predlog va ergash gap bilan tashvish mavzusini bildiradi.

examples.en: Many people worry about pollution in the big cities.
examples.uz: Ko'p odamlar katta shaharlardagi ifloslanish haqida tashvishlanishadi.
examples.grammar: 'worry about' - Present Simple; 'about pollution' tashvish mavzusini bildiradi.

defEn: very bad or unpleasant
defUz: juda yomon yoki yoqimsiz

examples.en: The smell of the polluted river was awful.
examples.uz: Ifloslangan daryoning hidi yoqimsiz edi.
examples.grammar: 'The smell of the polluted river was awful' - Past Simple ('was'); 'awful' - sifat egani izohlovchi kesim vazifasida.

examples.en: The weather was awful, so we stayed at home all day.
examples.uz: Ob-havo juda yomon edi, shuning uchun biz kun bo'yi uyda qoldik.
examples.grammar: 'was awful' - Past Simple va sifat kesimi; 'so' bog'lovchisi natijani bildiradi.

defEn: working by or producing electricity
defUz: elektr tokida ishlaydigan yoki tok ishlab chiqaradigan

examples.en: I got an electric shock from the wire.
examples.uz: Men simdan elektrli tok urishi qabul qildim (= meni tok
examples.grammar: 'I got an electric shock from the wire' - Past Simple ('got'); 'an electric shock' - artikl (an) va sifat (electric) bilan ot guruhi.

examples.en: My grandmother bought a new electric car this year.
examples.uz: Buvim shu yili yangi elektr mashina sotib oldi.
examples.grammar: 'bought' - Past Simple ('buy' noto'g'ri fe'l); 'electric' sifat 'car' otini izohlaydi.

defEn: not deep, with water close to the top
defUz: chuqur emas, sayoz

examples.en: The water was very shallow
examples.uz: it came up to my knees. – Suv juda sayoz edi–u tizzalarimgacha
examples.grammar: 'The water was very shallow, it came up to my knees' - Past Simple ('was', 'came up'); 'very shallow' - ravish (very) sifatni kuchaytiradi.

examples.en: The children played safely in the shallow water near the beach.
examples.uz: Bolalar plyaj yonidagi sayoz suvda xavfsiz o'ynashdi.
examples.grammar: 'played' - Past Simple; 'shallow' sifat 'water' otini izohlaydi.

defEn: without any sound, completely quiet
defUz: hech qanday tovushsiz, butunlay tinch

examples.en: Everyone had gone and the village was silent.
examples.uz: Hamma ketib bo'lgandi va qishloq jimjit edi.
examples.grammar: 'Everyone had gone and the village was silent' - Past Perfect ('had gone') va Past Simple ('was'); 'silent' sifat kesim vazifasida.

examples.en: The whole forest was silent in the early morning.
examples.uz: Butun o'rmon erta tongda jimjit edi.
examples.grammar: 'was silent' - Past Simple va sifat kesimi; 'in the early morning' vaqtni bildiradi.

defEn: easy to understand or do, not difficult
defUz: tushunish yoki bajarish oson, qiyin emas

examples.en: They have a very simple diet
examples.uz: mostly vegetables. – Ular juda oddiy ovqatlanishadi–asosan
examples.grammar: 'They have a very simple diet, mostly vegetables' - Present Simple ('have'); 'a very simple diet' - ravish (very) sifatni kuchaytiradi.

examples.en: The farmers here have a simple but happy life.
examples.uz: Bu yerdagi dehqonlar oddiy, lekin baxtli hayot kechirishadi.
examples.grammar: 'have' - Present Simple; 'simple but happy' ikki sifat 'but' bilan bog'langan.

defEn: happening quickly and without warning
defUz: tez va ogohlantirishsiz sodir bo'ladigan, kutilmagan

examples.en: I felt a sudden pain in my arm.
examples.uz: Men qo'limda kutilmaganda og'riq his qildim.
examples.grammar: 'I felt a sudden pain in my arm' - Past Simple ('felt'); 'a sudden pain' - artikl (a) va sifat (sudden) bilan ot guruhi.

examples.en: There was a sudden change in the weather before the storm.
examples.uz: Bo'rondan oldin ob-havoda kutilmagan o'zgarish bo'ldi.
examples.grammar: 'There was' o'tgan zamonda borligini bildiradi; 'sudden' sifat 'change' otini izohlaydi.

defEn: made of wood
defUz: yog'ochdan yasalgan

examples.en: The wooden furniture was all destroyed in the fire.
examples.uz: Yog'ochdan yasalgan mebellarning
examples.grammar: 'The wooden furniture was all destroyed in the fire' - Past Simple passiv ('was destroyed'); 'wooden' sifat 'furniture' otini izohlaydi.

examples.en: We sat on an old wooden bench in the park.
examples.uz: Biz parkdagi eski yog'och skameykada o'tirdik.
examples.grammar: 'sat' - Past Simple ('sit' noto'g'ri fe'l); 'wooden' sifat 'bench' otini izohlaydi.

defEn: quickly and without warning
defUz: tez va kutilmaganda, to'satdan

examples.en: Suddenly, water began to come into the room.
examples.uz: To'satdan, suv xonaga oqib kira boshladi.
examples.grammar: 'Suddenly, water began to come into the room' - Past Simple ('began'); 'Suddenly' ravish gap boshida ishni qanday yuz berganini bildiradi.

examples.en: Suddenly, the rain started and everyone ran inside.
examples.uz: To'satdan yomg'ir boshlandi va hamma ichkariga yugurdi.
examples.grammar: 'started ... ran' - Past Simple; 'Suddenly' ravish ishning kutilmaganligini bildiradi.

defEn: luckily, in a good or happy way
defUz: omadga ko'ra, yaxshiyamki

examples.en: Fortunately, nobody was hurt in the fire.
examples.uz: Yaxshiyamki, yong'inda hech kim shikastlanmabdi.
examples.grammar: 'Fortunately, nobody was hurt in the fire' - Past Simple passiv ('was hurt'); 'Fortunately' butun gapga munosabat bildiruvchi ravish.

examples.en: Fortunately, the rain stopped before our walk in the forest.
examples.uz: Yaxshiyamki, o'rmonda sayrimizdan oldin yomg'ir to'xtadi.
examples.grammar: 'stopped' - Past Simple; 'Fortunately' gap boshida munosabat bildiruvchi ravish.

defEn: sadly, in a bad or unlucky way
defUz: afsuski, omadsizlikka ko'ra

examples.en: Unfortunately, the flood washed away our car.
examples.uz: Afsuski, toshqin mashinamizni oqizib ketibdi.
examples.grammar: 'Unfortunately, the flood washed away our car' - Past Simple ('washed away'); 'Unfortunately' butun gapga munosabat bildiruvchi ravish.

examples.en: Unfortunately, we could not stop the forest fire in time.
examples.uz: Afsuski, biz o'rmon yong'inini o'z vaqtida to'xtata olmadik.
examples.grammar: 'could not stop' - modal fe'l (could) inkorda; 'Unfortunately' munosabat bildiruvchi ravish.

defEn: a statement that you are not happy about something
defUz: biror narsadan norozi ekanligingni bildiruvchi gap, shikoyat

examples.en: We made a complaint about the pollution from the factory.
examples.uz: Biz zavoddan chiqayotgan
examples.grammar: 'We made a complaint about the pollution from the factory' - Past Simple ('made'); 'make a complaint' iborasi shikoyat qilishni bildiradi.

examples.en: The company received many complaints about the dirty water.
examples.uz: Kompaniya iflos suv haqida ko'plab shikoyatlar oldi.
examples.grammar: 'received' - Past Simple; 'complaints' - ot ko'plikda ('-s').

defEn: going a long way down from the top
defUz: ustidan pastga uzoq ketadigan, chuqur

examples.en: The water is only a few centimetres deep.
examples.uz: Suv bor yo'g'i bir necha santimetr chuqur.
examples.grammar: 'The water is only a few centimetres deep' - Present Simple ('is'); 'a few centimetres deep' o'lchov bilan chuqurlikni bildiradi.

examples.en: Be careful, the river is very deep in the middle.
examples.uz: Ehtiyot bo'ling, daryo o'rtasida juda chuqur.
examples.grammar: 'is deep' - Present Simple va sifat kesimi; 'very' ravish sifatni kuchaytiradi.

defEn: to become deeper or to make something deeper
defUz: chuqurroq bo'lmoq yoki biror narsani chuqurroq qilmoq

examples.en: The flood waters continue to deepen.
examples.uz: Toshqin suvlari chuqurlashishda davom etmoqda.
examples.grammar: 'The flood waters continue to deepen' - Present Simple ('continue'); 'continue + to + infinitiv (to deepen)' davom etishni bildiradi.

examples.en: Workers are trying to deepen the river near the town.
examples.uz: Ishchilar shahar yaqinidagi daryoni chuqurlashtirishga harakat qilishmoqda.
examples.grammar: 'are trying' - Present Continuous; 'to deepen' maqsad infinitivi.

defEn: very strongly or completely
defUz: juda kuchli yoki to'liq tarzda, qattiq

examples.en: I'm deeply worried about what will happen to the wildlife.
examples.uz: Men yovvoyi tabiatga nima
examples.grammar: 'I'm deeply worried about what will happen to the wildlife' - Present Continuous holati ('I'm'); 'deeply' ravish 'worried' sifatini kuchaytiradi.

examples.en: We are deeply worried about the future of the forest.
examples.uz: Biz o'rmonning kelajagidan qattiq tashvishdamiz.
