examples.grammar: 'are worried' - holat kesimi; 'deeply' ravish darajani kuchaytiradi.

defEn: far away in space or time
defUz: joy yoki vaqt jihatidan uzoqda

examples.en: The airport was about 20 kilometres distant.
examples.uz: Aeroport taxminan 20 kilometr uzoq edi.
examples.grammar: 'The airport was about 20 kilometres distant' - Past Simple ('was'); 'distant' sifat masofa bilan birga kesim vazifasida.

examples.en: We could see the distant mountains on the other side of the lake.
examples.uz: Biz ko'lning narigi tomonidagi uzoqdagi tog'larni ko'ra olardik.
examples.grammar: 'could see' - modal fe'l (could); 'distant' sifat 'mountains' otini izohlaydi.

defEn: the amount of space between two places
defUz: ikki joy orasidagi masofa

examples.en: In the distance, we could see the forest burning.
examples.uz: Olis masofa narida, biz o'rmon yonayotganini
examples.grammar: 'In the distance, we could see the forest burning' - 'In the distance' o'rinni bildiruvchi ibora; 'could see' modal fe'l.

examples.en: The distance between the two villages is about ten kilometres.
examples.uz: Ikki qishloq orasidagi masofa taxminan o'n kilometr.
examples.grammar: 'is' - Present Simple; 'between the two villages' o'rin munosabatini bildiradi.

defEn: in a way that is far away
defUz: uzoq tarzda, olisdan

examples.en: I'm distantly related to the king.
examples.uz: Men qirol bilan uzoq qarindoshman.
examples.grammar: 'I'm distantly related to the king' - Present Simple holati ('I'm related'); 'distantly' ravish qanchalik uzoq qarindoshlikni bildiradi.

examples.en: I am only distantly related to that famous family.
examples.uz: Men o'sha mashhur oilaga faqat uzoq qarindosh bo'laman.
examples.grammar: 'am related' - holat kesimi; 'distantly' ravish darajani bildiradi.

defEn: the power that is used to make light and run machines
defUz: yorug'lik berish va mashinalarni ishlatish uchun ishlatiladigan quvvat

examples.en: All the houses now have electricity.
examples.uz: Endi barcha uylar elektr tokiga ega.
examples.grammar: 'All the houses now have electricity' - Present Simple ('have'); 'now' ravish hozirgi vaqtni bildiradi.

examples.en: The storm cut off the electricity in our whole village.
examples.uz: Bo'ron butun qishlog'imizda elektr tokini uzib qo'ydi.
examples.grammar: 'cut off' - Past Simple frazaviy fe'l (shakli o'zgarmaydi).

defEn: covered with a large amount of water
defUz: katta miqdordagi suv bilan qoplangan, suv bosgan

examples.en: The entire farm is flooded with water.
examples.uz: Butun fermani suv bosgan.
examples.grammar: 'The entire farm is flooded with water' - Present Simple passiv shakli ('is flooded'); 'with water' nima bilan qoplanganini bildiradi.

examples.en: The roads were flooded after three days of heavy rain.
examples.uz: Uch kunlik kuchli yomg'irdan keyin yo'llar suv ostida qoldi.
examples.grammar: 'were flooded' - Past Simple passiv; 'after three days' vaqtni bildiradi.

defEn: feeling that something good will happen
defUz: yaxshi narsa sodir bo'lishiga ishonadigan, umidvor

examples.en: They are hopeful that the floods won't get worse.
examples.uz: Ular toshqinlar yomonlashmasligiga
examples.grammar: 'They are hopeful that the floods won't get worse' - Present Simple holati ('are hopeful'); 'that ...' ergash gap, ichida Future inkor ('won't get').

examples.en: We are hopeful that the wildlife will return to the forest.
examples.uz: Biz yovvoyi tabiat o'rmonga qaytishiga umidvormiz.
examples.grammar: 'are hopeful' - sifat kesimi; 'that ... will return' ergash gapda Future zamoni.

defEn: used to say that you hope something will happen
defUz: biror narsa sodir bo'lishiga umid qilishni bildirish uchun ishlatiladi

examples.en: Hopefully, the fire will go out on its own.
examples.uz: Umid qilamizki, olov o'zi o'chadi.
examples.grammar: 'Hopefully, the fire will go out on its own' - Future ('will go out'); 'Hopefully' butun gapga umid munosabatini bildiruvchi ravish.

examples.en: Hopefully, the weather will be better for our trip tomorrow.
examples.uz: Umid qilamizki, ertaga sayohatimiz uchun ob-havo yaxshiroq bo'ladi.
examples.grammar: 'will be' - Future; 'Hopefully' gap boshida umidni bildiruvchi ravish.

defEn: covered with mud or full of mud
defUz: loy bilan qoplangan yoki loyga to'la

examples.en: The fields were muddy from the rain.
examples.uz: Dalalar yomg'ir tufayli loy bosgandi.
examples.grammar: 'The fields were muddy from the rain' - Past Simple ('were'); 'muddy' sifat kesim vazifasida; 'from the rain' sababni bildiradi.

examples.en: After the rain, the path through the forest was very muddy.
examples.uz: Yomg'irdan keyin o'rmon orqali o'tuvchi so'qmoq juda loy edi.
examples.grammar: 'was muddy' - Past Simple va sifat kesimi; 'After the rain' vaqtni bildiradi.

defEn: nice, enjoyable or friendly
defUz: yoqimli, maroqli yoki do'stona

examples.en: We had a pleasant evening eating and singing.
examples.uz: Oqshomni ovqatlanib va qo'shiq kuylab ajoyib
examples.grammar: 'We had a pleasant evening eating and singing' - Past Simple ('had'); 'eating and singing' sifatdoshlar oqshomni qanday o'tkazganini izohlaydi.

examples.en: It was a pleasant walk along the quiet river.
examples.uz: Tinch daryo bo'ylab yoqimli sayr bo'ldi.
examples.grammar: 'was' - Past Simple; 'pleasant' sifat 'walk' otini izohlaydi.

defEn: not nice, not enjoyable
defUz: yoqimsiz, maroqsiz

examples.en: What an unpleasant man! He was so rude!
examples.uz: Naqadar yoqimsiz odam! Juda qo'pol ekan!
examples.grammar: 'What an unpleasant man! He was so rude!' - undov gap ('What a/an + sifat + ot'); ikkinchi gap Past Simpleda ('was').

examples.en: There was an unpleasant smell coming from the rubbish.
examples.uz: Chiqindidan yoqimsiz hid kelardi.
examples.grammar: 'There was' o'tgan zamonda borligini bildiradi; 'coming' sifatdosh 'smell' otini izohlaydi.

defEn: in a nice or enjoyable way
defUz: yoqimli yoki maroqli tarzda

examples.en: I was pleasantly surprised about how they look after the forest.
examples.uz: O'rmonga qanchalik
examples.grammar: 'I was pleasantly surprised about how they look after the forest' - Past Simple ('was surprised'); 'pleasantly' ravish 'surprised' sifatini izohlaydi.

examples.en: We were pleasantly surprised by the clean air in the mountains.
examples.uz: Biz tog'lardagi toza havodan yoqimli ajablandik.
examples.grammar: 'were surprised' - Past Simple passiv; 'pleasantly' ravish tarzni bildiradi.

defEn: in a way that is not nice
defUz: yoqimsiz tarzda

examples.en: The woman spoke to us very unpleasantly, saying we were not welcome there.
examples.uz: Ayol u yerda
examples.grammar: 'The woman spoke to us very unpleasantly, saying we were not welcome' - Past Simple ('spoke'); 'unpleasantly' ravish gapirish tarzini bildiradi; 'saying ...' ravishdosh.

examples.en: The man spoke to the children very unpleasantly.
examples.uz: Erkak bolalar bilan juda yoqimsiz tarzda gaplashdi.
examples.grammar: 'spoke' - Past Simple; 'unpleasantly' ravish gapirish tarzini bildiradi.

defEn: to make air, water or land dirty and harmful
defUz: havo, suv yoki yerni kir va zararli qilmoq, ifloslantirmoq

examples.en: Pesticides can kill wildlife and pollute the atmosphere.
examples.uz: Pestitsidlar (= ekin maydonlarida
examples.grammar: 'Pesticides can kill wildlife and pollute the atmosphere' - modal fe'l (can); ikki fe'l ('kill' va 'pollute') 'and' bilan bog'langan.

examples.en: Dirty water from factories can pollute the rivers.
examples.uz: Zavodlardan chiqayotgan iflos suv daryolarni ifloslantirishi mumkin.
examples.grammar: 'can pollute' - modal fe'l imkoniyatni bildiradi; 'from factories' manbani bildiradi.

defEn: made dirty by harmful things
defUz: zararli narsalar bilan kir qilingan, ifloslangan

examples.en: The air is very polluted and makes you cough.
examples.uz: Havo juda ifloslangan va u odamni yo'taltiradi.
examples.grammar: 'The air is very polluted and makes you cough' - Present Simple ('is', 'makes'); 'make + ot + infinitiv' ('makes you cough') qurilmasi.

examples.en: The fish died because the river water was so polluted.
examples.uz: Daryo suvi shunchalik ifloslangani uchun baliqlar nobud bo'ldi.
examples.grammar: 'died' - Past Simple; 'because ...' sabab ergash gapi.

defEn: without making any sound
defUz: hech qanday tovush chiqarmasdan

examples.en: I walked as silently as I could so as not to scare the animals.
examples.uz: Men hayvonlarni qo'rqitib
examples.grammar: 'I walked as silently as I could so as not to scare the animals' - Past Simple ('walked'); 'as silently as' qiyoslash qurilmasi; 'so as not to scare' maqsadni bildiradi.

examples.en: The cat moved silently through the long grass.
examples.uz: Mushuk uzun maysa orasidan ovoz chiqarmay harakatlandi.
examples.grammar: 'moved' - Past Simple; 'silently' ravish harakat tarzini bildiradi.

defEn: in a plain or easy way
defUz: oddiy yoki sodda tarzda

examples.en: The people here live simply from farming.
examples.uz: Bu yerdagi odamlar oddiygina dehqonchilik bilan kun
examples.grammar: 'The people here live simply from farming' - Present Simple ('live'); 'simply' ravish yashash tarzini bildiradi; 'from farming' manbani bildiradi.

examples.en: The villagers live simply and grow their own food.
examples.uz: Qishloq aholisi oddiygina yashaydi va o'z ozuqasini o'stiradi.
examples.grammar: 'live ... grow' - Present Simple; 'simply' ravish yashash tarzini bildiradi.

defEn: the hard material that trees are made of
defUz: daraxtlardan olinadigan qattiq material, yog'och

examples.en: He chopped some wood for the fire.
examples.uz: U olov uchun biroz o'tin chopdi.
examples.grammar: 'He chopped some wood for the fire' - Past Simple ('chopped'); 'some' sanab bo'lmaydigan ot bilan miqdorni bildiradi; 'for the fire' maqsadni bildiradi.

examples.en: They use wood from the forest to build their houses.
examples.uz: Ular uylarini qurish uchun o'rmondan olingan yog'ochdan foydalanishadi.
examples.grammar: 'use' - Present Simple; 'to build' maqsad infinitivi.

defEn: A large group of people trained to fight for a country.
defUz: Mamlakat uchun jang qilishga o'rgatilgan katta harbiy guruh.

examples.en: The army are helping villages damaged in the fire.
examples.uz: Armiya yong'inda zarar ko'rgan qishloqlarga
examples.grammar: 'The army are helping' - Present Continuous; 'army' jamoa ot, 'are + helping' ko'plik shaklida ishlatilgan.

examples.en: The army helped the people after the flood.
examples.uz: Armiya suv toshqinidan keyin odamlarga yordam berdi.
examples.grammar: 'The army helped' - Past Simple; 'help' fe'lining o'tgan zamon shakli 'helped'.

defEn: A weapon that explodes and causes damage.
defUz: Portlab zarar yetkazadigan qurol.

examples.en: Luckily, the police found the bomb.
examples.uz: Yaxshiyamki, politsiya bombani topdi.
examples.grammar: 'The police found the bomb' - Past Simple; 'find' fe'lining o'tgan zamon shakli 'found', 'the' artikli aniq narsani bildiradi.

examples.en: The soldiers carried the bomb away from the houses.
examples.uz: Askarlar bombani uylardan uzoqqa olib ketishdi.
examples.grammar: 'The soldiers carried' - Past Simple; 'carry' fe'li o'tgan zamonda 'carried' bo'ladi.

uz: bir qator rejali harakatlar: odatda biror ijtimoiy, tijoriy yoki siyosiy maqsadni ko'zlab uyushtiriladigan reja-dasturlar
defEn: A series of planned actions to reach a goal.
defUz: Biror maqsadga erishish uchun rejalashtirilgan harakatlar qatori.

examples.en: The charity started a campaign to end famine.
examples.uz: Xayriya tashkiloti ocharchilikka barham berish
examples.grammar: 'started a campaign to end famine' - Past Simple; 'to end' infinitiv maqsadni bildiradi.

examples.en: The students started a campaign to clean the river.
examples.uz: O'quvchilar daryoni tozalash uchun bir kampaniya boshlashdi.
examples.grammar: 'started a campaign to clean' - Past Simple; 'to clean' infinitiv maqsad ma'nosini beradi.

defEn: An organization that helps people in need.
defUz: Muhtoj odamlarga yordam beradigan tashkilot.

examples.en: We always donate to charity at Christmas.
examples.uz: Biz har doim Rojdestvo bayramida xayriya
examples.grammar: 'We always donate to charity' - Present Simple; 'always' ravishi odatiy harakatni bildiradi, 'to' predlogi yo'nalishni ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: She works for a charity that helps poor children.
examples.uz: U kambag'al bolalarga yordam beradigan xayriya tashkilotida ishlaydi.
examples.grammar: 'a charity that helps' - 'that' bog'lovchisi ergash gapni bosh gapga bog'laydi.

defEn: The way a situation or place is at a certain time.
defUz: Biror joy yoki vaziyatning ma'lum paytdagi holati va shart-sharoitlari.

examples.en: Conditions in the town are getting better.
examples.uz: Shahardagi shart-sharoitlar yaxshilanib bormoqda.
examples.grammar: 'Conditions are getting better' - Present Continuous; 'get + sifat' (better) holatning o'zgarib borishini bildiradi.

examples.en: Living conditions in the camp were very hard.
examples.uz: Lagerdagi yashash sharoitlari juda og'ir edi.
examples.grammar: 'conditions were' - Past Simple; 'be' fe'lining ko'plik o'tgan zamon shakli 'were'.

uz: kasallik, xastalik (asosan ichki organlar bilan bog'liq kasalliklar)
defEn: An illness, often affecting the body inside.
defUz: Asosan ichki a'zolarga ta'sir qiladigan kasallik.

examples.en: He caught the disease and was very ill, but he's better now.
examples.uz: U xastalikka chalindi va juda betob
examples.grammar: 'He caught the disease and was very ill' - Past Simple; 'catch' fe'li o'tgan zamonda 'caught' bo'ladi, 'and' bog'lovchisi ikki gapni bog'laydi.

examples.en: Doctors are working to stop the disease.
examples.uz: Shifokorlar kasallikni to'xtatish uchun ishlamoqda.
examples.grammar: 'Doctors are working' - Present Continuous; 'to stop' infinitiv maqsadni bildiradi.

defEn: A time when there is very little food and people go hungry.
defUz: Oziq-ovqat juda kam bo'lib, odamlar ochlikka uchraydigan davr.

examples.en: The charity brought food to the area where the famine was.
examples.uz: Xayriya tashkiloti ocharchilik
examples.grammar: 'where the famine was' - Past Simple; 'where' ergash gapni boshlab, joyni aniqlaydi.

examples.en: The famine killed many animals in the village.
examples.uz: Ocharchilik qishloqdagi ko'plab hayvonlarni nobud qildi.
examples.grammar: 'The famine killed' - Past Simple; 'kill' fe'lining o'tgan zamon shakli 'killed'.

defEn: A bad feeling when you think something dangerous may happen.
defUz: Xavfli narsa yuz berishi mumkin deb o'ylaganda paydo bo'ladigan yomon his.

examples.en: My greatest fear is getting lost in the mountains.
examples.uz: Mening eng katta qo'rquvim tog'larda
examples.grammar: 'My greatest fear is getting lost' - Present Simple; 'greatest' sifatning orttirma darajasi, 'getting' gerundiy holat.

examples.en: He hid his fear and walked into the dark room.
examples.uz: U qo'rquvini yashirib, qorong'i xonaga kirdi.
examples.grammar: 'He hid his fear' - Past Simple; 'hide' fe'li o'tgan zamonda 'hid' bo'ladi.

defEn: The group of people who control a country.
defUz: Mamlakatni boshqaradigan odamlar guruhi.

examples.en: The government says it will build the villages again.
examples.uz: Hukumatning aytishicha, u qishloqlarni
examples.grammar: 'The government says it will build' - Present Simple ('says') va Future ('will build'); 'will' modal fe'li kelajakni bildiradi.

examples.en: The government built new schools in the area.
examples.uz: Hukumat hududda yangi maktablar qurdi.
examples.grammar: 'The government built' - Past Simple; 'build' fe'li o'tgan zamonda 'built' bo'ladi.

defEn: A person who comes to live in a new country.
defUz: Yashash uchun yangi mamlakatga kelgan odam.

examples.en: The immigrants left their home country to find a better life.
examples.uz: Muhojirlar yaxshiroq hayot topish
examples.grammar: 'The immigrants left their home country to find' - Past Simple; 'to find' infinitiv maqsadni bildiradi.

examples.en: Many immigrants work hard to help their families.
examples.uz: Ko'plab muhojirlar oilalariga yordam berish uchun qattiq mehnat qiladilar.
examples.grammar: 'Many immigrants work' - Present Simple; 'to help' infinitiv maqsad ma'nosini beradi.

defEn: A bad feeling in the body when you are hurt or ill.
defUz: Jarohatlanganda yoki kasal bo'lganda tanada paydo bo'ladigan yomon his.

examples.en: Cream made the pain from the burn a little less.
examples.uz: Krem kuyishdan qolgan og'riqni biroz
examples.grammar: 'Cream made the pain from the burn a little less' - Past Simple; 'make + ot + sifat' tuzilmasi natijani bildiradi.

examples.en: The medicine took away my back pain.
examples.uz: Dori belimning og'rig'ini olib ketdi.
examples.grammar: 'The medicine took away' - Past Simple; 'take away' phrasal fe'li o'tgan zamonda 'took away' bo'ladi.

defEn: A sudden strong feeling of fear that stops you thinking clearly.
defUz: To'g'ri o'ylashga to'sqinlik qiladigan to'satdan kuchli qo'rquv hissi.

examples.en: In the panic, some children lost their parents.
examples.uz: Sarosimada, ba'zi bolalar ota-onalarini yo'qotib
examples.grammar: 'In the panic, some children lost their parents' - Past Simple; 'In the panic' predlogli ibora vaziyatni bildiradi.

examples.en: There was panic in the street after the loud noise.
examples.uz: Baland shovqindan keyin ko'chada sarosima bo'ldi.
examples.grammar: 'There was panic' - Past Simple; 'there was' birlikda biror narsa borligini bildiradi.

defEn: A time with no war or fighting.
defUz: Urush yoki jang bo'lmagan davr.

examples.en: After years of war, there is peace in the country.
examples.uz: Yillab davom etgan urushdan keyin,
examples.grammar: 'After years of war, there is peace' - Present Simple; 'After' predlogi vaqt ma'nosini, 'there is' birlikda mavjudlikni bildiradi.

examples.en: The two countries signed a paper to keep the peace.
examples.uz: Ikki mamlakat tinchlikni saqlash uchun bir hujjat imzoladi.
examples.grammar: 'signed a paper to keep' - Past Simple; 'to keep' infinitiv maqsadni bildiradi.

defEn: The state of being very poor.
defUz: Juda kambag'al bo'lish holati.

examples.en: There's a lot of poverty in this area
examples.uz: they have nothing. – Ushbu hududda qashshoqlik juda ko'p–
examples.grammar: 'There's a lot of poverty in this area' - Present Simple; 'There is' (There's) mavjudlikni, 'a lot of' miqdorni bildiradi.

examples.en: The new jobs helped to reduce poverty in the town.
examples.uz: Yangi ish o'rinlari shaharda qashshoqlikni kamaytirishga yordam berdi.
examples.grammar: 'The new jobs helped to reduce' - Past Simple; 'to reduce' infinitiv maqsad ma'nosini beradi.

defEn: Treating people badly because of their race.
defUz: Odamlarga irqi tufayli yomon munosabatda bo'lish.

examples.en: Racism is terrible
examples.uz: everyone is the same underneath. – Irqchilik daxshatli narsa–hamma ham ich-
examples.grammar: 'Racism is terrible' - Present Simple; 'be' fe'lining birlik shakli 'is' va 'terrible' sifati holatni bildiradi.

examples.en: Many people are fighting against racism today.
examples.uz: Bugun ko'plab odamlar irqchilikka qarshi kurashmoqda.
examples.grammar: 'Many people are fighting' - Present Continuous; 'against' predlogi qarshilikni bildiradi.

defEn: The state of being safe from danger.
defUz: Xavfdan xoli, xavfsiz bo'lish holati.

examples.en: The army moved evryone to a place of safety.
examples.uz: Armiya barchani xavfsiz joyga ko'chirdi.
examples.grammar: 'The army moved everyone to a place of safety' - Past Simple; 'move' fe'li o'tgan zamonda 'moved', 'to' predlogi yo'nalishni bildiradi.

examples.en: The teacher checked the safety of the children.
examples.uz: O'qituvchi bolalarning xavfsizligini tekshirdi.
examples.grammar: 'The teacher checked' - Past Simple; 'check' fe'lining o'tgan zamon shakli 'checked'.

defEn: A person who is in an army.
defUz: Armiyada xizmat qiladigan odam.

examples.en: The army sent in hundreds of soldiers to help.
examples.uz: Armiya yordam berish uchun yuzlab askarlarni
examples.grammar: 'The army sent in hundreds of soldiers to help' - Past Simple; 'send' fe'li o'tgan zamonda 'sent', 'to help' infinitiv maqsadni bildiradi.

examples.en: A young soldier helped the old woman cross the road.
examples.uz: Yosh askar keksa ayolga yo'ldan o'tishga yordam berdi.
examples.grammar: 'A young soldier helped' - Past Simple; 'help + someone + infinitiv' tuzilmasi yordamni bildiradi.

defEn: A way to fix or end a problem.
defUz: Muammoni tuzatish yoki tugatish yo'li; yechim.

examples.en: We have to find a solution to the problem
examples.uz: fast! – Muammoga yechim topishimiz lozim–tezlik
examples.grammar: 'We have to find a solution to the problem' - Present Simple; 'have to' majburiyatni, 'to find' infinitiv maqsadni bildiradi.

examples.en: The teacher found a good solution to the problem.
examples.uz: O'qituvchi muammoga yaxshi yechim topdi.
examples.grammar: 'The teacher found' - Past Simple; 'find' fe'li o'tgan zamonda 'found' bo'ladi.

defEn: The use of violence to frighten people for political aims.
defUz: Siyosiy maqsadlarda odamlarni qo'rqitish uchun zo'ravonlikdan foydalanish.

examples.en: The government works hard to fight terrorism.
examples.uz: Hukumat terrorchilikka qarshi kurashish uchun
examples.grammar: 'The government works hard to fight terrorism' - Present Simple; 'work hard' iborasi, 'to fight' infinitiv maqsadni bildiradi.

examples.en: Many countries work together to stop terrorism.
examples.uz: Ko'plab mamlakatlar terrorchilikni to'xtatish uchun birgalikda ishlaydi.
examples.grammar: 'Many countries work together' - Present Simple; 'to stop' infinitiv maqsad ma'nosini beradi.

defEn: A person who uses violence to frighten people.
defUz: Odamlarni qo'rqitish uchun zo'ravonlikdan foydalanadigan odam.

examples.en: The police caught the terrorists before they could act.
examples.uz: Terrorchilar harakat qila olishidan avval,
examples.grammar: 'The police caught the terrorists before they could act' - Past Simple; 'before' bog'lovchisi vaqt ergash gapini boshlaydi.

examples.en: The terrorists were caught by the police.
examples.uz: Terrorchilar politsiya tomonidan ushlandi.
examples.grammar: 'were caught' - Past Simple passiv; 'by' predlogi harakat egasini bildiradi.

defEn: A fight between countries or large groups with weapons.
defUz: Mamlakatlar yoki katta guruhlar o'rtasidagi qurolli jang.

examples.en: The war is finally over and we have peace.
examples.uz: Urush va nihoyat tugadi va bizda tinchlik (hukm
examples.grammar: 'The war is finally over' - Present Simple; 'be over' iborasi tugaganlikni, 'finally' ravishi nihoyatni bildiradi.

examples.en: The long war made many people leave their homes.
examples.uz: Uzoq urush ko'plab odamlarni uylarini tark etishga majbur qildi.
examples.grammar: 'made many people leave' - Past Simple; 'make + someone + infinitiv' majbur qilishni bildiradi.

defEn: To ask for money or food, or to ask in a strong way.
defUz: Pul yoki ovqat so'ramoq, yoki kuchli yolvorib so'ramoq.

examples.en: I gave some money to an old man begging in the street.
examples.uz: Ko'chada sadaqa so'rayotgan bir
examples.grammar: 'an old man begging in the street' - 'begging' sifatdosh otni aniqlab kelmoqda, 'in' predlogi joyni bildiradi.

examples.en: The poor child begged for some bread.
examples.uz: Kambag'al bola bir oz non so'rab yolvordi.
examples.grammar: 'The poor child begged' - Past Simple; 'beg' fe'li o'tgan zamonda 'begged' bo'ladi, 'for' predlogi so'rov ob'ektini bildiradi.

defEn: To make a sick person well again.
defUz: Kasal odamni sog'aytirmoq, davolamoq.

examples.en: They may have found a medicine that cures the cold.
examples.uz: Shamollashni davolaydigan dori topgan
examples.grammar: 'a medicine that cures the cold' - 'that' bog'lovchisi ergash gapni, 'cures' Present Simple birlik shaklini bildiradi.

examples.en: The new medicine cured many sick people.
examples.uz: Yangi dori ko'plab kasal odamlarni davoladi.
examples.grammar: 'The new medicine cured' - Past Simple; 'cure' fe'li o'tgan zamonda 'cured' bo'ladi.

defEn: To give money or things to help others.
defUz: Boshqalarga yordam berish uchun pul yoki narsa bermoq, xayr-ehson qilmoq.

examples.en: How much money do you donate to charity?
examples.uz: Xayriyaga qancha pul xayr-ehson qilasiz?
examples.grammar: 'How much money do you donate' - Present Simple so'roq gap; 'do' yordamchi fe'li, 'how much' miqdorni so'raydi.

examples.en: They donated warm clothes to the homeless people.
examples.uz: Ular boshpanasiz odamlarga issiq kiyimlar xayr-ehson qilishdi.
examples.grammar: 'They donated' - Past Simple; 'donate' fe'li o'tgan zamonda 'donated', 'to' predlogi qabul qiluvchini bildiradi.

defEn: To get away from a dangerous or bad place.
defUz: Xavfli yoki yomon joydan qochib qutulmoq.

examples.en: Everyone managed to escape the fire.
examples.uz: Hamma yong'indan qochib qola oldi.
examples.grammar: 'Everyone managed to escape the fire' - Past Simple; 'manage to + infinitiv' bir ishni uddalashni bildiradi.

examples.en: The bird escaped from its cage.
examples.uz: Qush qafasidan qochib chiqdi.
examples.grammar: 'The bird escaped' - Past Simple; 'escape' fe'li o'tgan zamonda 'escaped', 'from' predlogi chiqish nuqtasini bildiradi.

defEn: To watch and protect a person or place.
defUz: Biror odam yoki joyni kuzatib, himoya qilmoq, qo'riqlamoq.

examples.en: There were ten men guarding the bank.
examples.uz: Bankni o'n nafar odam qo'riqlayotgandi.
examples.grammar: 'There were ten men guarding the bank' - Past Continuous tuzilma; 'guarding' sifatdosh, 'were' ko'plik o'tgan zamon shakli.

examples.en: Two dogs guarded the house at night.
examples.uz: Ikki it kechasi uyni qo'riqladi.
examples.grammar: 'Two dogs guarded' - Past Simple; 'guard' fe'li o'tgan zamonda 'guarded' bo'ladi.

defEn: To make someone suffer for doing something wrong.
defUz: Biror kishini noto'g'ri ish qilgani uchun jazolamoq.

examples.en: The teacher punished the boys by making them clean the desks.
examples.uz: O'qituvchi bolalarga partalarni
examples.grammar: 'punished the boys by making them clean' - Past Simple; 'by + V-ing' usulni bildiradi, 'make + someone + infinitiv' majburlash.

examples.en: The judge punished the man for stealing.
examples.uz: Sudya erkakni o'g'irlik qilgani uchun jazoladi.
examples.grammar: 'The judge punished' - Past Simple; 'for + V-ing' sababni bildiradi.

defEn: To find an answer to a problem.
defUz: Muammoga javob yoki yechim topmoq.

examples.en: I solved our problem
examples.uz: you can thank me later. – Men muammoyimizni hal qildim–keyinroq
examples.grammar: 'I solved our problem' - Past Simple; 'solve' fe'li o'tgan zamonda 'solved' bo'ladi.

examples.en: Together they solved the difficult problem.
examples.uz: Birgalikda ular qiyin muammoni hal qilishdi.
examples.grammar: 'Together they solved' - Past Simple; 'solve' fe'lining o'tgan zamon shakli 'solved'.

defEn: To drop to the ground suddenly.
defUz: To'satdan yerga qulamoq, yiqilib tushmoq.

examples.en: Many buildings fell down in the earthquake.
examples.uz: Ko'plab binolar zilzila davomida qulab tushdi.
examples.grammar: 'Many buildings fell down in the earthquake' - Past Simple; 'fall down' phrasal fe'li o'tgan zamonda 'fell down' bo'ladi.

examples.en: The old wall fell down after the heavy rain.
examples.uz: Eski devor kuchli yomg'irdan keyin qulab tushdi.
examples.grammar: 'The old wall fell down' - Past Simple; 'fall down' phrasal fe'li o'tgan zamonda 'fell down'.

defEn: To leave a place, often quickly.
defUz: Biror joydan, ko'pincha tezda, chiqib ketmoq.

examples.en: "Get out of the house!" shouted the policeman.
examples.uz: "Uydan tashqariga chiqing!" deb baqirdi
examples.grammar: 'Get out of the house!' - buyruq gap; 'get out of' phrasal fe'l + predlog yo'nalishni bildiradi.

examples.en: Everyone got out of the bus at the last stop.
examples.uz: Hamma oxirgi bekatda avtobusdan tushdi.
examples.grammar: 'Everyone got out' - Past Simple; 'get out' phrasal fe'li o'tgan zamonda 'got out' bo'ladi.

defEn: To move to a lower place.
defUz: Pastroq joyga harakatlanmoq, pastga tushmoq.

examples.en: We went down the mountain to the river.
examples.uz: Biz tog' bo'ylab daryo tomon pastga tushdik.
examples.grammar: 'We went down the mountain to the river' - Past Simple; 'go down' phrasal fe'li o'tgan zamonda 'went down', 'to' yo'nalishni bildiradi.

examples.en: We went down the stairs to the kitchen.
examples.uz: Biz oshxonaga zinapoyadan pastga tushdik.
examples.grammar: 'We went down' - Past Simple; 'go down' phrasal fe'li o'tgan zamonda 'went down' bo'ladi.

defEn: To explode, or for a gun to fire.
defUz: Portlamoq, yoki quroldan o'q uzilmoq.

examples.en: Luckily, there was no one in the building when the bomb went off.
examples.uz: Yaxshiyamki, bomba
examples.grammar: 'when the bomb went off' - Past Simple; 'go off' phrasal fe'li o'tgan zamonda 'went off', 'when' vaqt ergash gapini boshlaydi.

examples.en: The bomb went off near the empty market.
examples.uz: Bomba bo'sh bozor yonida portladi.
examples.grammar: 'The bomb went off' - Past Simple; 'go off' phrasal fe'li o'tgan zamonda 'went off' bo'ladi.

defEn: To leave a place quickly to get away from danger or someone.
defUz: Xavf yoki kimdandir uzoqlashish uchun bir joydan tezda qochib ketmoq.

examples.en: Animals running away from the fire came through the village.
examples.uz: Yong'indan qochayotgan
examples.grammar: 'Animals running away from the fire' - 'running away' sifatdosh otni aniqlaydi, 'from' predlogi qochish manbasini bildiradi.

examples.en: The little boy ran away from the big dog.
examples.uz: Kichkina bola katta itdan qochib ketdi.
examples.grammar: 'The little boy ran away' - Past Simple; 'run away' phrasal fe'li o'tgan zamonda 'ran away', 'from' predlogi manbani bildiradi.

defEn: To be burning.
defUz: Yonayotgan holatda bo'lmoq.

examples.en: The forest is on fire
examples.uz: I can see the flames. – O'rmon o't ostida–alangalarni ko'ryapman.
examples.grammar: 'The forest is on fire' - Present Simple; 'be on fire' iborasi yonayotgan holatni bildiradi.

examples.en: The whole building was on fire by morning.
examples.uz: Tongga borib butun bino yonayotgan edi.
examples.grammar: 'The whole building was on fire' - Past Simple; 'be on fire' iborasi o'tgan zamonda 'was on fire' bo'ladi.

defEn: To feel that someone or something is important to you.
defUz: Biror kim yoki narsa siz uchun muhim ekanini his qilmoq, qayg'urmoq.

examples.en: We care about these people, so we want to help them.
examples.uz: Biz bu odamlar haqida qayg'uramiz,
examples.grammar: 'We care about these people, so we want to help them' - Present Simple; 'so' bog'lovchisi natijani, 'about' predlogi ob'ektni bildiradi.

examples.en: She cares about animals and helps them.
examples.uz: U hayvonlar haqida qayg'uradi va ularga yordam beradi.
examples.grammar: 'She cares about' - Present Simple; 'care about' iborasi birlik shaklda 'cares' bo'ladi.

defEn: To need someone or something for help or support.
defUz: Yordam yoki ko'mak uchun biror kim yoki narsaga muhtoj bo'lmoq, tayanmoq.

examples.en: These people are depending on us to help them.
examples.uz: Bu odamlar bizning yordam berishimizga
examples.grammar: 'These people are depending on us to help them' - Present Continuous; 'depend on' iborasi, 'to help' infinitiv maqsadni bildiradi.

examples.en: Young children depend on their parents for everything.
examples.uz: Yosh bolalar hamma narsada ota-onalariga tayanadilar.
examples.grammar: 'Young children depend on' - Present Simple; 'depend on' iborasi tayanishni bildiradi.

defEn: To get away from a dangerous person, place or thing.
defUz: Xavfli odam, joy yoki narsadan qochib qutulmoq.

examples.en: The animals crossed the river to escape from the fire.
examples.uz: Hayvonlar yong'indan qochish uchun
examples.grammar: 'crossed the river to escape from the fire' - Past Simple; 'to escape from' infinitiv maqsadni va manbani bildiradi.

examples.en: The prisoner tried to escape from the room.
examples.uz: Mahbus xonadan qochishga urindi.
examples.grammar: 'The prisoner tried to escape from' - Past Simple; 'try to + infinitiv' urinishni, 'from' predlogi manbani bildiradi.

defEn: To stop being angry with someone for something they did.
defUz: Biror kishini qilgan ishi uchun kechirmoq, undan xafa bo'lishni to'xtatmoq.

examples.en: Forgive me for scaring you
examples.uz: I didn't mean to. – Sizni qo'rqitib yuborganim uchun meni kechiring–
examples.grammar: 'Forgive me for scaring you' - buyruq gap; 'forgive ... for + V-ing' tuzilmasi sababni bildiradi.

examples.en: She forgave him for breaking the window.
examples.uz: U uni derazani singdirgani uchun kechirdi.
examples.grammar: 'She forgave him for breaking' - Past Simple; 'forgive' o'tgan zamonda 'forgave', 'for + V-ing' sababni bildiradi.

defEn: Feeling afraid because of someone or something.
defUz: Biror kim yoki narsa tufayli qo'rqib turgan.

examples.en: Children are often frightened of the darkness.
examples.uz: Bolalar odatda qorong'ulikdan qo'rqadilar.
examples.grammar: 'Children are often frightened of the darkness' - Present Simple; 'be frightened of' iborasi qo'rquvni, 'often' ravishi takrorlanishni bildiradi.

examples.en: The girl was frightened by the loud thunder.
examples.uz: Qiz baland momaqaldiroqdan qo'rqib ketdi.
examples.grammar: 'The girl was frightened by' - Past Simple; 'be frightened by' iborasi qo'rquv sababini bildiradi.

defEn: To improve or to become worse.
defUz: Yaxshilanmoq yoki yomonlashmoq.

examples.en: Things are getting better for the area where the famine was.
examples.uz: Ocharchilik bo'lib o'tgan hududda
examples.grammar: 'Things are getting better' - Present Continuous; 'get + qiyosiy daraja' (better) holatning o'zgarib borishini bildiradi.

examples.en: After the medicine, he slowly got better.
examples.uz: Doridan keyin u asta-sekin tuzaldi.
examples.grammar: 'he slowly got better' - Past Simple; 'get better' iborasi o'tgan zamonda 'got better' bo'ladi.

defEn: To give money to an organization that helps people.
defUz: Odamlarga yordam beradigan tashkilotga pul bermoq.

examples.en: The school children raised £500 to give to charity.
examples.uz: Maktab o'quvchilari xayriyaga berish uchun
examples.grammar: 'raised 500 pounds to give to charity' - Past Simple; 'to give to charity' infinitiv maqsadni bildiradi.

examples.en: Every year they give money to charity at the school.
examples.uz: Har yili ular maktabda xayriyaga pul beradilar.
examples.grammar: 'they give money to charity' - Present Simple; 'to' predlogi qabul qiluvchini bildiradi.

defEn: To decide what you will do and how.
defUz: Nima qilishni va qanday qilishni belgilamoq, reja tuzmoq.

examples.en: The army made a plan to save the trapped villagers.
examples.uz: Armiya tuzoqqa tushib qolgan qishloq
examples.grammar: 'The army made a plan to save the trapped villagers' - Past Simple; 'make a plan' iborasi, 'to save' infinitiv maqsadni bildiradi.

examples.en: We made a plan to visit the village next week.
examples.uz: Biz kelasi hafta qishloqqa borishga reja tuzdik.
examples.grammar: 'We made a plan' - Past Simple; 'make' fe'li o'tgan zamonda 'made' bo'ladi.

defEn: To say something that is false, or to say what is true.
defUz: Yolg'on gapni aytmoq yoki haqiqatni aytmoq.

examples.en: The newspapers should tell people the truth about the famine.
examples.uz: Gazetalar odamlarga
examples.grammar: 'The newspapers should tell people the truth' - 'should' modal fe'li maslahatni, 'tell + someone + the truth' tuzilmasini bildiradi.

examples.en: Please tell me the truth about the accident.
examples.uz: Iltimos, menga avariya haqida haqiqatni ayting.
examples.grammar: 'Please tell me the truth' - buyruq gap; 'tell + someone + the truth' iborasi haqiqatni aytishni bildiradi.

defEn: Having no home to live in.
defUz: Yashash uchun uyi yoki boshpanasi bo'lmagan.

examples.en: The charity helps homeless people to get off the streets.
examples.uz: Xayriya tashkiloti boshpanasiz
examples.grammar: 'helps homeless people to get off the streets' - Present Simple; 'help + someone + infinitiv' tuzilmasi yordamni bildiradi.

examples.en: The fire left many families homeless.
examples.uz: Yong'in ko'plab oilalarni boshpanasiz qoldirdi.
examples.grammar: 'The fire left many families homeless' - Past Simple; 'leave + someone + sifat' holatga keltirishni bildiradi.

defEn: Not able to read or write.
defUz: O'qish va yozishni bilmaydigan, savodsiz.

examples.en: He teaches illiterate adults to read and write.
examples.uz: U katta yoshli savodsiz odamlarga o'qish va
examples.grammar: 'teaches illiterate adults to read and write' - Present Simple; 'teach + someone + infinitiv' o'rgatishni bildiradi.

examples.en: Many illiterate people could not read the sign.
examples.uz: Ko'plab savodsiz odamlar belgini o'qiy olmadilar.
examples.grammar: 'Many illiterate people could not read' - Past Simple; 'could not' modal fe'l qila olmaslikni bildiradi.

uz: gavjum, haddan tashqari ko'p odam bor bo'lgan
defEn: Having too many people in one place.
defUz: Bir joyda haddan tashqari ko'p odam bor bo'lgan, gavjum.

examples.en: The tent was overcrowded, with three families sleeping in it.
examples.uz: Chodirda haddan tashqari ko'p
examples.grammar: 'The tent was overcrowded, with three families sleeping in it' - Past Simple; 'with + ot + V-ing' qo'shimcha holatni bildiradi.

examples.en: The small bus was overcrowded in the morning.
examples.uz: Kichkina avtobus ertalab haddan tashqari gavjum edi.
examples.grammar: 'The small bus was overcrowded' - Past Simple; 'be' fe'lining birlik o'tgan zamon shakli 'was'.

defEn: Having very little money.
defUz: Juda kam pulga ega, kambag'al.

examples.en: The people here are very poor and often hungry.
examples.uz: Bu yerdagi odamlar juda kambag'al va odatda
examples.grammar: 'The people here are very poor and often hungry' - Present Simple; 'very' ravishi sifatni kuchaytiradi, 'and' bog'lovchisi ikki sifatni bog'laydi.

examples.en: The poor family had no food for the children.
examples.uz: Kambag'al oilada bolalar uchun ovqat yo'q edi.
examples.grammar: 'The poor family had no food' - Past Simple; 'have' fe'li o'tgan zamonda 'had', 'no' inkor miqdorni bildiradi.

defEn: Having a lot of money.
defUz: Ko'p pulga ega, boy.

examples.en: Rich people should give money to charity.
examples.uz: Boy odamlar xayriyaga pul berishlari kerak.
examples.grammar: 'Rich people should give money to charity' - Present Simple; 'should' modal fe'li maslahatni bildiradi.

examples.en: The rich man bought a big house by the sea.
examples.uz: Boy odam dengiz bo'yida katta uy sotib oldi.
examples.grammar: 'The rich man bought' - Past Simple; 'buy' fe'li o'tgan zamonda 'bought' bo'ladi.

defEn: Not in danger; protected from harm.
defUz: Xavfdan xoli, himoyalangan, xavfsiz.

examples.en: You're safe now
examples.uz: the danger has passed. – Endi xavfsizsiz–xavf o'tib ketdi.
examples.grammar: 'You are safe now' - Present Simple; 'be + sifat' (safe) holatni, 'now' ravishi hozirgi paytni bildiradi.

examples.en: The children are safe inside the house.
examples.uz: Bolalar uy ichida xavfsiz.
examples.grammar: 'The children are safe' - Present Simple; 'be' fe'lining ko'plik shakli 'are' va 'safe' sifati holatni bildiradi.

defEn: Very bad or unpleasant.
defUz: Juda yomon yoki noxush, daxshatli.

examples.en: We had a terrible year, but the next one will be better.
examples.uz: Bu yil rasvo yil bo'ldi, lekin keyingisi
examples.grammar: 'We had a terrible year, but the next one will be better' - Past Simple va Future; 'but' bog'lovchisi qarama-qarshilikni, 'will be' kelajakni bildiradi.

examples.en: The weather was terrible during our trip.
examples.uz: Sayohatimiz davomida ob-havo juda yomon edi.
examples.grammar: 'The weather was terrible' - Past Simple; 'be' fe'lining birlik o'tgan zamon shakli 'was'.

defEn: In or to all places.
defUz: Hamma joyda yoki hamma joyga.

examples.en: There's water everywhere
examples.uz: what happened? – Hamma yer suv bo'lib yotibdi–nima ro'y berdi?
examples.grammar: 'There is water everywhere' - Present Simple; 'There is' mavjudlikni, 'everywhere' ravishi joyni bildiradi.

examples.en: After the flood, there was mud everywhere.
examples.uz: Suv toshqinidan keyin hamma yerda loy bor edi.
examples.grammar: 'there was mud everywhere' - Past Simple; 'everywhere' ravishi joyni bildiradi.

defEn: Right now, without any delay.
defUz: Hech qanday kechikishsiz, darhol, hoziroq.

examples.en: We need the police to come here immediately.
examples.uz: Politsiya darhol bu yerga kelishi kerak.
examples.grammar: 'We need the police to come here immediately' - Present Simple; 'need + someone + infinitiv' tuzilmasi, 'immediately' ravishi vaqtni bildiradi.

examples.en: The doctor came immediately when we called.
examples.uz: Biz chaqirganimizda shifokor darhol keldi.
examples.grammar: 'The doctor came immediately' - Past Simple; 'immediately' ravishi harakat tezda bo'lganini bildiradi.

defEn: Used to say something is possible but not sure.
defUz: Biror narsa mumkin, lekin aniq emasligini bildiradigan so'z; balkim.

examples.en: Maybe I helped, but I'm not sure.
examples.uz: Balkim yordam bergandirman, lekin ishonchim komil emas. (=
examples.grammar: 'Maybe I helped, but I am not sure' - Past Simple; 'Maybe' ravishi ehtimolni, 'but' bog'lovchisi qarama-qarshilikni bildiradi.

examples.en: Maybe it will rain tomorrow.
examples.uz: Balkim ertaga yomg'ir yog'ar.
examples.grammar: 'Maybe it will rain' - Future; 'will' modal fe'li kelajakni, 'Maybe' ravishi ehtimolni bildiradi.

defEn: Used to say something is possible but not sure.
defUz: Biror narsa mumkin, lekin aniq emasligini bildiradigan so'z; ehtimol.

examples.en: Perhaps I'll come back one day, but I don't know.
examples.uz: Balkim bir kun kelib qaytib kelarman, lekin
examples.grammar: 'Perhaps I will come back one day, but I do not know' - Future; 'Perhaps' ravishi ehtimolni, 'will come' kelajakni bildiradi.

examples.en: Perhaps she is at home now.
examples.uz: Ehtimol u hozir uydadir.
examples.grammar: 'Perhaps she is at home' - Present Simple; 'Perhaps' ravishi ehtimolni bildiradi.

defEn: In a short time from now.
defUz: Hozirdan boshlab qisqa vaqt ichida, tez orada.

examples.en: Soon the rains will come and end the dry spell.
examples.uz: Tez orada yomg'irlar keladi va qisqa vaqtga
examples.grammar: 'Soon the rains will come' - Future; 'will' modal fe'li kelajakni, 'Soon' ravishi yaqin vaqtni bildiradi.

examples.en: The bus will arrive soon.
examples.uz: Avtobus tez orada keladi.
examples.grammar: 'The bus will arrive soon' - Future; 'will' modal fe'li kelajakni, 'soon' ravishi yaqin vaqtni bildiradi.

defEn: To tell someone what you think they should do.
defUz: Biror kishiga nima qilish kerakligi haqida fikr bildirmoq, maslahat bermoq.

examples.en: I advise you to come here in spring
examples.uz: it's the best season. – Bu yerga bahorda kelishingizni
examples.grammar: 'I advise you to come here in spring' - Present Simple; 'advise + someone + infinitiv' tuzilmasi maslahatni bildiradi.

examples.en: The doctor advised him to rest at home.
examples.uz: Shifokor unga uyda dam olishni maslahat berdi.
examples.grammar: 'The doctor advised him to rest' - Past Simple; 'advise' o'tgan zamonda 'advised', 'to rest' infinitiv maqsadni bildiradi.

defEn: Words that tell someone what they should do.
defUz: Biror kishiga nima qilish kerakligini aytadigan so'zlar; maslahat.

examples.en: Let me give you a piece of advice.
examples.uz: Sizga bir maslahat berishimga ijozat bering.
examples.grammar: 'Let me give you a piece of advice' - buyruq/taklif gap; 'a piece of advice' sanaladigan shaklni bildiradi (advice sanalmaydi).

examples.en: She gave me good advice about my studies.
examples.uz: U menga o'qishim haqida yaxshi maslahat berdi.
examples.grammar: 'She gave me good advice' - Past Simple; 'give' fe'li o'tgan zamonda 'gave' bo'ladi.

defEn: Feeling strong displeasure.
defUz: Kuchli norozilik his qilayotgan, jahli chiqqan.

examples.en: Please don't be angry with me. It wasn't my fault.
examples.uz: Iltimos, mendan jahlingiz chiqmasin. Bu
examples.grammar: 'Please do not be angry with me' - buyruq gap; 'be angry with' iborasi kimga nisbatan jahl chiqqanini bildiradi.

examples.en: My father was angry because I came home late.
examples.uz: Otam men uyga kech kelganim uchun jahli chiqdi.
examples.grammar: 'My father was angry because' - Past Simple; 'because' bog'lovchisi sababni bildiradi.

defEn: A strong feeling of being upset or annoyed.
defUz: Xafa yoki g'azablangan kuchli his; jahl.

examples.en: His face went red with anger.
examples.uz: Uning yuzi jahldan qizarib ketdi.
examples.grammar: 'His face went red with anger' - Past Simple; 'go red' iborasi rang o'zgarishini, 'with' predlogi sababni bildiradi.

examples.en: He could not hide his anger at the bad news.
examples.uz: U yomon xabardan kelgan jahlini yashira olmadi.
examples.grammar: 'He could not hide his anger' - Past Simple; 'could not' modal fe'l qila olmaslikni bildiradi.

defEn: In an angry way.
defUz: Jahl bilan, g'azab bilan.

examples.en: She shouted angrily that the people there needed help.
examples.uz: U yerdagi odamlar yordamga
examples.grammar: 'She shouted angrily that the people needed help' - Past Simple; 'angrily' ravishi harakat tarzini, 'that' bog'lovchisi ergash gapni bildiradi.

examples.en: He angrily closed the door and left.
examples.uz: U jahl bilan eshikni yopdi va chiqib ketdi.
examples.grammar: 'He angrily closed' - Past Simple; 'angrily' ravishi 'close' fe'lining tarzini bildiradi.

defEn: To feel that someone or something is important.
defUz: Biror kim yoki narsa muhim ekanini his qilmoq, qayg'urmoq.

examples.en: She cares deeply about environmental issues.
examples.uz: U atrof-muhit muammolari haqida chuqur
examples.grammar: 'She cares deeply about environmental issues' - Present Simple; 'care about' iborasi, 'deeply' ravishi darajani bildiradi.

examples.en: Good doctors care about their patients.
examples.uz: Yaxshi shifokorlar bemorlari haqida qayg'uradilar.
examples.grammar: 'Good doctors care about' - Present Simple; 'care about' iborasi qayg'urishni bildiradi.

defEn: Not giving enough attention, so you make mistakes.
defUz: Yetarlicha e'tibor bermaydigan, shu sabab xato qiladigan; ehtiyotsiz.

examples.en: Some careless smoker started the fire.
examples.uz: Qandaydir ehtiyotsiz sigaret chekuvchi odam yong'inni
examples.grammar: 'Some careless smoker started the fire' - Past Simple; 'careless' sifati otni aniqlaydi, 'start' o'tgan zamonda 'started'.

examples.en: The careless driver did not see the red light.
examples.uz: Ehtiyotsiz haydovchi qizil chiroqni ko'rmadi.
examples.grammar: 'The careless driver did not see' - Past Simple; 'did not' inkor yordamchi fe'lini bildiradi.

defEn: In a careful way; with attention.
defUz: Ehtiyotkorlik bilan, e'tibor bilan.

examples.en: We walked carefully across the old bridge.
examples.uz: Biz eski ko'prik bo'ylab ehtiyotkorlik bilan yurib
examples.grammar: 'We walked carefully across the old bridge' - Past Simple; 'carefully' ravishi harakat tarzini, 'across' predlogi yo'nalishni bildiradi.

examples.en: She carefully put the baby into the bed.
examples.uz: U chaqaloqni ehtiyotkorlik bilan to'shakka yotqizdi.
examples.grammar: 'She carefully put' - Past Simple; 'carefully' ravishi 'put' fe'lining tarzini bildiradi.

defEn: In a careless way; without enough attention.
defUz: Ehtiyotsizlik bilan, yetarlicha e'tibor bermay.

examples.en: If you act carelessly, you will get hurt.
examples.uz: Agar ehtiyotsizlik bilan harakat qilsangiz, shikastlanasiz.
examples.grammar: 'If you act carelessly, you will get hurt' - shart mayli; 'If' shartni, 'will get hurt' natijani bildiradi.

examples.en: He carelessly threw his bag on the floor.
examples.uz: U sumkasini ehtiyotsizlik bilan polga uloqtirdi.
examples.grammar: 'He carelessly threw' - Past Simple; 'carelessly' ravishi 'throw' fe'lining tarzini bildiradi.

defEn: To stop living.
defUz: Yashashdan to'xtamoq, o'lmoq.

examples.en: My father died suddenly at the age of 48.
examples.uz: Mening otam 48 yoshida kutilmaganda vafot etgan.
examples.grammar: 'My father died suddenly at the age of 48' - Past Simple; 'die' o'tgan zamonda 'died', 'at the age of' yoshni bildiradi.

examples.en: Many trees died because of the long dry weather.
examples.uz: Ko'plab daraxtlar uzoq quruq ob-havo tufayli nobud bo'ldi.
examples.grammar: 'Many trees died because of' - Past Simple; 'because of' predlogli ibora sababni bildiradi.

defEn: The end of life.
defUz: Hayotning oxiri, o'lim.

examples.en: Some people were hurt, but there were no deaths.
examples.uz: Ba'zi odamlar shikastlangandi, biroq hech
examples.grammar: 'there were no deaths' - Past Simple; 'there were' ko'plikda mavjudlikni, 'no' inkor miqdorni bildiradi.

examples.en: The death of the old king made the people sad.
examples.uz: Keksa shohning o'limi odamlarni qayg'uga soldi.
examples.grammar: 'The death ... made the people sad' - Past Simple; 'make + someone + sifat' holatga keltirishni bildiradi.

defEn: No longer living.
defUz: Endi tirik bo'lmagan, o'lik.

examples.en: The police don't know whether he's alive or dead.
examples.uz: Politsiya uning tirik yoki o'lik ekanligini
examples.grammar: 'whether he is alive or dead' - Present Simple; 'whether ... or' bog'lovchisi ikki imkoniyatni, 'alive', 'dead' sifatlarini bildiradi.

examples.en: The old tree in the garden is dead now.
examples.uz: Bog'dagi keksa daraxt endi qurib qolgan.
examples.grammar: 'The old tree ... is dead' - Present Simple; 'be + sifat' (dead) holatni bildiradi.

defEn: To hurt or damage someone or something.
defUz: Biror kim yoki narsaga ziyon yoki zarar yetkazmoq.

examples.en: Pollution can harm marine life.
examples.uz: Ifloslanish dengiz hayotiga ziyon yetkazishi mumkin.
examples.grammar: 'Pollution can harm marine life' - Present Simple; 'can' modal fe'li imkoniyatni, 'harm' infinitiv shaklni bildiradi.

examples.en: Too much sun can harm your skin.
examples.uz: Haddan ortiq quyosh teringizga zarar yetkazishi mumkin.
examples.grammar: 'Too much sun can harm' - Present Simple; 'can' modal fe'li imkoniyatni bildiradi.

defEn: Causing harm or damage.
defUz: Ziyon yoki zarar keltiradigan, zararli.

examples.en: The snake is not harmful to people.
examples.uz: Bu ilon odamlarga zararli emas.
examples.grammar: 'The snake is not harmful to people' - Present Simple; 'be + not + sifat' inkorni, 'to' predlogi kimga nisbatanligini bildiradi.

examples.en: Smoking is harmful to your health.
examples.uz: Chekish sog'lig'ingizga zararli.
examples.grammar: 'Smoking is harmful' - Present Simple; 'be + sifat' (harmful) holatni bildiradi.

defEn: Not able to cause harm; safe.
defUz: Zarar keltira olmaydigan, bezarar.

examples.en: Don't be scared of the spider
examples.uz: it's harmless. – O'rgimchakdan qo'rqmang–u bezarar.
examples.grammar: 'Do not be scared of the spider, it is harmless' - buyruq gap; 'be scared of' iborasi qo'rquvni, 'harmless' sifati holatni bildiradi.

examples.en: This little snake is harmless to children.
examples.uz: Bu kichkina ilon bolalar uchun bezarar.
examples.grammar: 'This little snake is harmless' - Present Simple; 'be + sifat' (harmless) holatni bildiradi.

defEn: Wanting to eat.
defUz: Ovqat yeyishni istayotgan, och.

examples.en: By dinner time we all felt really hungry.
examples.uz: Kechki ovqat paytigacha, biz barchamiz o'zimizni juda
examples.grammar: 'By dinner time we all felt really hungry' - Past Simple; 'feel + sifat' (hungry) holatni, 'By' predlogi vaqtni bildiradi.

examples.en: The children were hungry after the long walk.
examples.uz: Bolalar uzoq yurishdan keyin och edilar.
examples.grammar: 'The children were hungry' - Past Simple; 'be' fe'lining ko'plik o'tgan zamon shakli 'were'.

defEn: The feeling or state of needing food.
defUz: Ovqatga muhtojlik hissi yoki holati; ochlik.

examples.en: You could see the hunger on the children's faces.
examples.uz: Bolalarning yuzlarida ochlik ko'rinib turardi.
examples.grammar: 'You could see the hunger on the children's faces' - Past Simple; 'could' modal fe'li imkoniyatni, 'on' predlogi joyni bildiradi.

examples.en: Many people in the world still suffer from hunger.
examples.uz: Dunyodagi ko'plab odamlar hamon ochlikdan aziyat chekadi.
examples.grammar: 'Many people ... suffer from hunger' - Present Simple; 'suffer from' iborasi aziyatni bildiradi.

defEn: In a hungry way.
defUz: Ochlik bilan, ochiqib.

examples.en: The children ate the food hungrily.
examples.uz: Bolalar ovqatni ochiqib yeyishdi.
examples.grammar: 'The children ate the food hungrily' - Past Simple; 'eat' o'tgan zamonda 'ate', 'hungrily' ravishi yeyish tarzini bildiradi.

examples.en: The dog hungrily ate all the meat.
examples.uz: It hamma go'shtni ochiqib yedi.
examples.grammar: 'The dog hungrily ate' - Past Simple; 'hungrily' ravishi 'eat' fe'lining tarzini bildiradi.

defEn: Not well; sick.
defUz: Yaxshi emas; kasal, betob.

examples.en: We both started to feel ill shortly after the meal.
examples.uz: Ovqatdan biroz o'tib, biz ikkovimiz ham
examples.grammar: 'We both started to feel ill shortly after the meal' - Past Simple; 'start to + infinitiv' boshlanishni, 'feel ill' holatni bildiradi.

examples.en: She felt ill and stayed in bed all day.
examples.uz: U o'zini betob his qildi va kun bo'yi to'shakda yotdi.
examples.grammar: 'She felt ill and stayed' - Past Simple; 'and' bog'lovchisi ikki harakatni bog'laydi.

uz: kasallik, betoblik, xastalik (asosan ruhiyatga ta'sir o'tkazadigan kasalliklar)
defEn: A condition of being ill; a sickness.
defUz: Kasal bo'lish holati; kasallik.

examples.en: The doctor gave him some medicine for the illness.
examples.uz: Shifokor unga kasallikka qarshi ozroq dori
examples.grammar: 'The doctor gave him some medicine for the illness' - Past Simple; 'give' o'tgan zamonda 'gave', 'for' predlogi maqsadni bildiradi.

examples.en: A good diet can stop many illnesses.
examples.uz: Yaxshi parhez ko'plab kasalliklarni to'xtatishi mumkin.
examples.grammar: 'A good diet can stop many illnesses' - Present Simple; 'illness' ko'plikda 'illnesses' bo'ladi.

defEn: The fact of no longer having something.
defUz: Biror narsaga endi ega bo'lmaslik holati; yo'qotish.

examples.en: The loss of their homes didn't stop the people smiling.
examples.uz: Uylaridan judo bo'lish odamlarni
examples.grammar: 'The loss of their homes did not stop the people smiling' - Past Simple; 'stop + someone + V-ing' tuzilmasi to'xtatishni bildiradi.

examples.en: The loss of his job made him very sad.
examples.uz: Ishini yo'qotish uni juda qayg'uga soldi.
examples.grammar: 'The loss ... made him very sad' - Past Simple; 'make + someone + sifat' holatga keltirishni bildiradi.

defEn: Not able to find your way, or no longer able to be found.
defUz: Yo'lini topa olmaydigan yoki topib bo'lmaydigan; yo'qolib qolgan.

examples.en: The boy was lost in the forest for days, but lived.
examples.uz: Bolakay kunlab vaqt davomida o'rmonda
examples.grammar: 'The boy was lost in the forest for days, but lived' - Past Simple; 'be lost' holatni, 'for days' davomiylikni bildiradi.

examples.en: The little girl was lost in the big shop.
examples.uz: Kichkina qiz katta do'konda yo'qolib qoldi.
examples.grammar: 'The little girl was lost' - Past Simple; 'be lost' iborasi yo'qolgan holatni bildiradi.

defEn: Something you take to treat an illness.
defUz: Kasallikni davolash uchun ichiladigan narsa; dori.

examples.en: Did you take your medicine?
examples.uz: Doringizni ichdingizmi?
examples.grammar: 'Did you take your medicine?' - Past Simple so'roq gap; 'Did' yordamchi fe'li savolni, 'take medicine' iborasini bildiradi.

examples.en: The nurse gave the sick man some medicine.
examples.uz: Hamshira kasal odamga ozroq dori berdi.
examples.grammar: 'The nurse gave the sick man some medicine' - Past Simple; 'give' o'tgan zamonda 'gave' bo'ladi.

defEn: In a safe way; without harm.
defUz: Xavfsiz tarzda; zararsiz, sog'-omon.

examples.en: The girl came safely back just before night.
examples.uz: Qizaloq tun bo'lishidan shundoqqina avval sog'-
examples.grammar: 'The girl came safely back just before night' - Past Simple; 'come back' phrasal fe'li, 'safely' ravishi tarzini bildiradi.

examples.en: The plane landed safely at the airport.
examples.uz: Samolyot aeroportga sog'-omon qo'ndi.
examples.grammar: 'The plane landed safely' - Past Simple; 'safely' ravishi 'land' fe'lining tarzini bildiradi.

defEn: The study of the world using tests and facts.
defUz: Tajriba va dalillar yordamida dunyoni o'rganish; ilm-fan.

examples.en: We need to invest more in science and technology.
examples.uz: Biz ilm-fan va texnologiyaga ko'proq
examples.grammar: 'We need to invest more in science and technology' - Present Simple; 'need to + infinitiv' zaruratni, 'in' predlogi sohani bildiradi.

examples.en: She studies science at the university.
examples.uz: U universitetda ilm-fanni o'rganadi.
examples.grammar: 'She studies science' - Present Simple; 'study' fe'li birlik shaklda 'studies' bo'ladi.

defEn: A person who works in science.
defUz: Ilm-fan sohasida ishlaydigan odam; olim.

examples.en: Scientists are trying to find a way to fight the illness.
examples.uz: Olimlar kasallikka qarshi kurashish yo'lini
examples.grammar: 'Scientists are trying to find a way to fight the illness' - Present Continuous; 'try to + infinitiv' urinishni, 'to fight' maqsadni bildiradi.

examples.en: The scientist did many tests in the lab.
examples.uz: Olim laboratoriyada ko'plab tajribalar o'tkazdi.
examples.grammar: 'The scientist did many tests' - Past Simple; 'do' fe'li o'tgan zamonda 'did' bo'ladi.

defEn: Connected with science.
defUz: Ilm-fan bilan bog'liq; ilmiy.

examples.en: A scientific study found the people were surprisingly healthy.
examples.uz: Bir ilmiy tadqiqot shuni
examples.grammar: 'A scientific study found the people were surprisingly healthy' - Past Simple; 'scientific' sifati otni aniqlaydi, 'find' o'tgan zamonda 'found'.

examples.en: The scientific report showed clear results.
examples.uz: Ilmiy hisobot aniq natijalarni ko'rsatdi.
examples.grammar: 'The scientific report showed' - Past Simple; 'scientific' sifati 'report' otini aniqlaydi.

defEn: All the people who live together in a country or group.
defUz: Mamlakat yoki guruhda birga yashaydigan barcha odamlar; jamiyat.

examples.en: We must also consider the needs of the older members of society.
examples.uz: Biz jamiyatning keksa
examples.grammar: 'We must also consider the needs of the older members of society' - Present Simple; 'must' modal fe'li majburiyatni, 'of' predlogi tegishlilikni bildiradi.

examples.en: A good society helps its poor people.
examples.uz: Yaxshi jamiyat o'zining kambag'al odamlariga yordam beradi.
examples.grammar: 'A good society helps' - Present Simple; 'help' fe'li birlik shaklda 'helps' bo'ladi.

defEn: Connected with people living together in groups.
defUz: Odamlarning guruhlarda birga yashashi bilan bog'liq; ijtimoiy.

examples.en: Their social system keeps those poor people alive because they all help one another.
examples.uz: Ularning
examples.grammar: 'Their social system keeps those poor people alive' - Present Simple; 'social' sifati otni aniqlaydi, 'keep + someone + sifat' holatda saqlashni bildiradi.

examples.en: The town has many social problems to solve.
examples.uz: Shaharda hal qilinishi kerak bo'lgan ko'plab ijtimoiy muammolar bor.
examples.grammar: 'The town has many social problems' - Present Simple; 'social' sifati 'problems' otini aniqlaydi.

defEn: To stay alive after a danger or hard time.
defUz: Xavf yoki og'ir paytdan keyin tirik qolmoq; omon qolmoq.

examples.en: Nobody can survive long without water.
examples.uz: Hech kim suvsiz uzoq omon qola olmaydi.
examples.grammar: 'Nobody can survive long without water' - Present Simple; 'can' modal fe'li imkoniyatni, 'without' predlogi yo'qlikni bildiradi.

examples.en: Only a few plants survived the cold winter.
examples.uz: Sovuq qishdan faqat bir nechta o'simlik omon qoldi.
examples.grammar: 'Only a few plants survived' - Past Simple; 'survive' fe'li o'tgan zamonda 'survived' bo'ladi.

defEn: A person who stays alive after a danger.
defUz: Xavfdan keyin tirik qolgan odam.

examples.en: The army found a survivor under the fallen tree.
examples.uz: Armiya qulagan daraxt tagida bir omon
examples.grammar: 'The army found a survivor under the fallen tree' - Past Simple; 'find' o'tgan zamonda 'found', 'under' predlogi joyni bildiradi.

examples.en: The survivor told the people about the flood.
examples.uz: Omon qolgan odam odamlarga suv toshqini haqida gapirib berdi.
examples.grammar: 'The survivor told the people' - Past Simple; 'tell' fe'li o'tgan zamonda 'told' bo'ladi.

defEn: The state of staying alive.
defUz: Tirik qolish holati; omon qolish.

examples.en: The survival of the village after the fire depends on the government.
examples.uz: Yong'indan keyin
examples.grammar: 'The survival of the village after the fire depends on the government' - Present Simple; 'depend on' iborasi, 'of' predlogi tegishlilikni bildiradi.

examples.en: Water is important for the survival of all animals.
examples.uz: Suv barcha hayvonlarning omon qolishi uchun muhim.
examples.grammar: 'Water is important for the survival' - Present Simple; 'for' predlogi maqsad yoki sababni bildiradi.
